Alias.name: acs debug
Alias.script: -- acs debug on|off show debug output (all packages) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") acs.core.debug = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.debug) acs.save("core") acs.echo("debug " .. (acs.core.debug and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: acs dry
Alias.script: -- acs dry on|off echo commands instead of sending them (all packages) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") acs.core.dryrun = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.dryrun) acs.save("core") acs.echo("dry run " .. (acs.core.dryrun and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: acs echo
Alias.script: -- acs echo on|off show every command the system sends (all packages) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") acs.core.echo = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.echo) acs.save("core") acs.echo("command echo " .. (acs.core.echo and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: acs who
Alias.script: -- acs who character and class the system sees acs.echo(("character <white>%s<reset>, class <white>%s"):format(tostring(acs.me.name), tostring(acs.me.class)))

Alias.name: acs (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "acs" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["core" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end acs._modules.core.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: hb budget
Alias.script: -- hb budget [ms] warn (in acs debug) when a beat takes longer local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then hb.echo("budget is " .. hb.ms(hb.settings.budget) .. " ms") return end hb.settings.budget = n / 1000 hb.save_settings() hb.echo("budget " .. n .. " ms")

Alias.name: hb interval
Alias.script: -- hb interval [ms] show or set time between beats (default 250) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then hb.echo("interval is " .. math.floor(hb.settings.interval * 1000 + 0.5) .. " ms") return end if n < 50 then hb.err("at least 50 ms") return end hb.set_interval(n / 1000) hb.echo("beating every " .. n .. " ms")

Alias.name: hb list
Alias.script: -- hb list registered handlers in run order if #hb._order == 0 then hb.echo("no handlers registered") return end hb.echo("<white>pri name every watch") for _, s in ipairs(hb._order) do local state = (s.off or hb.settings.disabled[s.name]) and " <red>off" or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%3d <white>%-24s<grey> %5s %s%s"):format(s.priority, s.name, s.every > 0 and (s.every .. "s") or "beat", s.watch and table.concat(s.watch, ",") or "-", state)) end

Alias.name: hb mark
Alias.script: -- hb mark KEY flag KEY as changed (testing) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then hb.err("which key?") return end hb.mark(w[1]) hb.echo("marked " .. w[1])

Alias.name: hb off
Alias.script: -- hb off NAME switch a handler off (remembered) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then hb.err("which handler? see 'hb list'") return end hb.enable(w[1], false) hb.echo(w[1] .. " off")

Alias.name: hb on
Alias.script: -- hb on NAME switch a handler back on (also after errors) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then hb.err("which handler? see 'hb list'") return end if not hb.enable(w[1], true) then hb.echo("(no handler named " .. w[1] .. " yet; remembered)") end hb.echo(w[1] .. " on")

Alias.name: hb once
Alias.script: -- hb once run one beat now hb.beat() hb.echo("beat " .. hb.beats)

Alias.name: hb pause
Alias.script: -- hb pause stop the beat hb.pause() hb.echo("paused")

Alias.name: hb prof
Alias.script: -- hb prof [reset] time spent in each handler, costliest first local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] == "reset" then hb.reset_profile() hb.echo("profile reset") return end local r = {} for _, s in ipairs(hb._order) do r[#r + 1] = s end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.time > b.time end) hb.echo("<white>name calls total ms avg ms max ms") for _, s in ipairs(r) do cecho(("\n <grey>%-24s %7d %10s %8s %8s"):format(s.name, s.calls, hb.ms(s.time), hb.ms(s.calls > 0 and s.time / s.calls or 0), hb.ms(s.max))) end

Alias.name: hb resume
Alias.script: -- hb resume start it again hb.resume() hb.echo("running")

Alias.name: hb status
Alias.script: -- hb status running or paused, interval, cost per beat local st = hb.stats hb.echo(("%s, every <white>%d ms<reset>, beat %d, %d handlers"):format( hb.paused and "<yellow>paused<reset>" or "<green>running<reset>", math.floor(hb.settings.interval * 1000 + 0.5), hb.beats, #hb._order)) if st.beats > 0 then hb.echo(("beat cost: avg %s ms, max %s ms, %d over the %s ms budget"):format( hb.ms(st.total / st.beats), hb.ms(st.max), st.over, hb.ms(hb.settings.budget))) end

Alias.name: hb (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "hb" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["hb" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end hb.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: qm add
Alias.script: -- qm add [type] cmds add to the end (same as qa); cmds split on your separator local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" qm.quick("add", rest)

Alias.name: qm addclear
Alias.script: -- qm addclear [type] cmds clear that queue type, then add (same as qc) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" qm.quick("addclear", rest)

Alias.name: qm alerts
Alias.script: -- qm alerts on|off turn the game's queue alerts on at login (needed to track) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") qm.settings.alerts = acs.onoff(w[1], qm.settings.alerts) qm.save() if qm.settings.alerts then acs.send("config showqueuealerts on") end qm.echo("queue alerts at login " .. (qm.settings.alerts and "on" or "off (QM can't see what ran)"))

Alias.name: qm asep
Alias.script: -- qm asep [chars] what goes between commands in a game alias (/) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then qm.echo("in-game alias separator: <white>" .. qm.settings.alias_sep) return end qm.settings.alias_sep = w[1] qm.save() qm._aliases = {} qm.echo("in-game alias separator: <white>" .. w[1])

Alias.name: qm auto
Alias.script: -- qm auto on|off the game's own auto queueing (CONFIG USEQUEUEING) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] ~= "on" and w[1] ~= "off" then qm.err("qm auto on|off") return end local on = w[1] == "on" acs.send("config usequeueing " .. (on and "on" or "off")) qm.echo("game auto queueing " .. (on and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: qm clear
Alias.script: -- qm clear [type] clear one queue type, or everything local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") qm.clear(w[1] or "all")

Alias.name: qm forget
Alias.script: -- qm forget reset QM's copy if it's wrong (sends nothing) qm.forget("all") qm._aliases = {} qm.echo("forgot the queue copy and the game aliases set")

Alias.name: qm gag
Alias.script: -- qm gag on|off hide the [System] queue lines local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") qm.settings.gag = acs.onoff(w[1], qm.settings.gag) qm.save() qm.echo("queue lines " .. (qm.settings.gag and "hidden" or "shown"))

Alias.name: qm list
Alias.script: -- qm list [game] what's queued (game: the game's own QUEUE LIST) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] == "game" then qm.send("queue list") return end if #qm.items == 0 then qm.echo("nothing queued (as far as QM knows; <white>qm list game<reset> asks the game)") return end qm.echo(("<white>queued<reset> %d of %d"):format(#qm.items, qm.LIMIT)) for i, e in ipairs(qm.items) do cecho(("\n <grey>%2d. %s"):format(i, qm.describe(e))) end

Alias.name: qm prepend
Alias.script: -- qm prepend [type] cmds put at the front (same as qp) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" qm.quick("prepend", rest)

Alias.name: qm sep
Alias.script: -- qm sep [chars] what splits commands in qa / qc / qp (|) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then qm.echo("separator for qa / qc / qp: <white>" .. qm.settings.sep) return end qm.settings.sep = w[1] qm.save() qm.echo("separator for qa / qc / qp: <white>" .. w[1])

Alias.name: qm type
Alias.script: -- qm type [t] default type for qa / qc / qp (eqbal) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then qm.echo("default queue type: <white>" .. qm.settings.type) return end local t = qm.valid_type(w[1]) if not t then qm.err("not a queue type: " .. w[1] .. " (see qm types)") return end qm.settings.type = t qm.save() qm.echo("default queue type: <white>" .. t)

Alias.name: qm types
Alias.script:
-- qm types the queue types and custom flags qm.echo("<white>queue types") for _, t in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(qm.SIMPLE)) do cecho(("
 <white>%-10s<grey>%s"):format(t, qm.SIMPLE[t])) end cecho("
 <grey>or flags: e eq, b bal, c class, s ship, p paralysed, w bound, u upright, t stunned;") cecho("
 <grey>! before a flag inverts it. eb!p!t = eq, bal, not paralysed, not stunned")

Alias.name: qm (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "qm" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["qm" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end acs._modules.qm.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: qa
Alias.script: qm.quick("add", matches[2])

Alias.name: qc
Alias.script: qm.quick("addclear", matches[2])

Alias.name: qp
Alias.script: qm.quick("prepend", matches[2])

Alias.name: qx
Alias.script: qm.clear("all")

Alias.name: ss active
Alias.script: -- ss active list class skill cures and which are on for this class -- ss active on|off|auto <name> -- ss active add <name> <bal> <cd> <command> a new active cure -- ss active cures <name> <aff>...|any|health|mana local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local cls = ss.class() local s = ss.settings s.actives[cls] = s.actives[cls] or {} local t = s.actives[cls] local sub, name = w[1], w[2] local A = ss.data.actives if (sub == "on" or sub == "off" or sub == "auto") and name then if not A[name] then ss.err("unknown active cure " .. name) return end if sub == "auto" then t[name] = nil else t[name] = sub == "on" end ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " " .. sub .. " for " .. cls) elseif sub == "add" and w[5] then local c = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+%S+%s+%S+%s+(.*)$") A[name] = { cmd = c, cures = "any", bal = w[3], cd = tonumber(w[4]) or 10, classes = { cls } } s.custom_actives[name] = A[name] t[name] = true ss.save() ss.echo("added active cure " .. name .. " (cures any; narrow it with 'ss active cures " .. name .. " <affs>')") elseif sub == "cures" and name and w[3] then if not A[name] then ss.err("unknown active cure " .. name) return end local list = {} for i = 3, #w do list[#list + 1] = ss.data.canon(w[i]) end A[name].cures = (#list == 1 and (list[1] == "any" or list[1] == "health" or list[1] == "mana")) and list[1] or list s.custom_actives[name] = A[name] ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " now used for: " .. (type(A[name].cures) == "table" and table.concat(A[name].cures, ", ") or A[name].cures)) else ss.echo("<white>active cures<reset> for " .. cls .. " <dim_grey>(n/a = skill not found on this character)") for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(A)) do local ac = A[n] local cures = type(ac.cures) == "table" and table.concat(ac.cures, ",") or tostring(ac.cures) cecho(("\n %s<reset> %-11s %-18s <dim_grey>%s, %ss %s"):format( ss.state_word(ss.engine.active_on(n), ac.skill == nil or ss.has_skill(ac.skill)), n, ac.cmd, ac.bal or "eqbal", tostring(ac.cd or 10), cures:sub(1, 40))) end end

Alias.name: ss attackers
Alias.script: -- ss attackers who has hit you in the last 30s, with class and city -- ss attackers window <s> how long someone stays listed after their last hit -- ss attackers on|off tracking on or off -- ss attackers harm on|off only count lines that came with damage or an affliction -- ss attackers echo on|off announce each new attacker -- ss attackers skip <word> toggle a word that marks a line as friendly -- ss attackers clear local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings local sub = w[1] if sub == "window" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.attack_window = tonumber(w[2]) ss.save() ss.echo("attackers drop off after " .. s.attack_window .. "s") elseif sub == "on" or sub == "off" then s.attack_track = sub == "on" ss.save() ss.echo("attacker tracking " .. sub) elseif sub == "harm" or sub == "echo" then local k = sub == "harm" and "harm_required" or "attack_echo" if w[2] == "on" then s[k] = true elseif w[2] == "off" then s[k] = false else s[k] = not s[k] end ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " " .. (s[k] and "on" or "off")) elseif sub == "skip" and w[2] then local word = w[2]:lower() s.attack_skip[word] = not s.attack_skip[word] or nil ss.save() ss.echo("'" .. word .. "' " .. (s.attack_skip[word] and "marks a friendly line" or "no longer skipped")) elseif sub == "clear" then ss.attackers.clear() ss.echo("attackers cleared") else local list = ss.attackers.list() ss.echo(("<white>attackers<reset> (last %ds): %s"):format(s.attack_window, #list == 0 and "<dim_grey>none" or "")) local now = acs.now() for _, rec in ipairs(list) do local affs = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(rec.affs)) do affs[#affs + 1] = a end cecho(("\n <orange_red>%-12s<reset> %-12s %-10s %2d hit%s, %2ds ago <dim_grey>%s"):format( rec.name, rec.class or "?", rec.city or "?", rec.hits, rec.hits == 1 and " " or "s", math.floor(now - rec.last), table.concat(affs, ", "))) end end

Alias.name: ss autoactive
Alias.script: -- ss autoactive on|off turn on actives/passives you have the skill for local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "auto_actives" local label = "automatic actives" ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ss baltimes
Alias.script: -- ss baltimes [clear] how long your actions take, learned per class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local t = ss.parahold.times() if w[1] == "clear" then for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = nil end ss.save() end local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(t)) do r[#r + 1] = ("%s %.2fs"):format(k, t[k]) end ss.show("balance times for " .. ss.class(), r)

Alias.name: ss class
Alias.script: -- ss class [name] actives, passives and defences known for a class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local cls = w[1] or ss.class() local v = ss.data.for_class(cls) ss.echo("<white>" .. cls) ss.show("actives", v.actives) ss.show("passives", v.passives) ss.show("defences with known commands", acs.sorted_keys(v.defs))

Alias.name: ss clot
Alias.script: -- ss clot <amount> clot at this much bleeding (0 = off) -- ss clot mana <pct> never clot below this much mana (CURING MANATHRESHOLD) -- ss clot health <pct> with corrupted humours, clot only above this much health local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings local which, v = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) if which == "mana" and v then s.clot_min_mana = v elseif which == "health" and v then s.clot_health = v elseif tonumber(which) then s.clot_at = tonumber(which) elseif which then ss.err("usage: ss clot <amount> | mana <pct> | health <pct>") return end if which then ss.save() ss.resync() end local floor = ss.server.clot_floor() ss.echo(("clot at bleeding %d, not below %d%% mana%s, with corrupted humours only above %d%% health"):format( s.clot_at, floor, floor ~= s.clot_min_mana and " (raised for your opponent)" or "", s.clot_health))

Alias.name: ss cprio
Alias.script: -- ss cprio this class's priority table (the class script's, then yours) -- ss cprio <aff> <prio|clear> set one in your table for this class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local P, cls = ss.prio, ss.classes.key(ss.class()) local mine = P.mine() if w[1] and w[2] then local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. w[1] .. "'") return end mine.prios[aff] = w[2] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[2]) or nil ss.save() P.check() end local cs, sub = ss.classes.current(), ss.classes.current_sub() if cs then ss.echo("class script (" .. cls .. "): " .. P.tbl_text(cs.prios)) end if sub then ss.echo("subclass " .. ss.classes.current_sub_name() .. ": " .. P.tbl_text(sub.prios)) end ss.echo("yours (" .. cls .. "): " .. P.tbl_text(mine.prios))

Alias.name: ss cure
Alias.script: -- ss cure <aff> <command> teach or override a cure ('clear' to undo) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not aff then ss.err("usage: ss cure <aff> <command>") return end local c = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s*(.*)$") or "" if c == "clear" or c == "" then ss.settings.cure_overrides[aff] = nil ss.echo(aff .. ": using default cure") else ss.settings.cure_overrides[aff] = c ss.echo(aff .. " is cured by: " .. c) end ss.save()

Alias.name: ss defaffs
Alias.script: -- ss defaffs on|off (no effect: blindness, deafness and insomnia are never treated as afflictions) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "ignore_def_affs" local label = "defence-named afflictions left alone" ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ss defcmd
Alias.script: -- ss defcmd <def> <cmd>[@bal] how to raise a defence (@bal, @eq, @eqbal, @free, @herb, @salve, @sip, @smoke) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local def = acs.norm(w[1]) local c = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s*(.*)$") or "" if not def or c == "" then ss.err("usage: ss defcmd <def> <command>[@bal]") return end ss.settings.def_cmds[def] = c ss.save() ss.echo(def .. " raised with: " .. c)

Alias.name: ss defecho
Alias.script: -- ss defecho on|off Gained/Lost lines for your defences local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "def_echo" local label = "defence echoes" ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ss defprio
Alias.script: -- ss defprio <def> <1-25> priority of a defup or keepup defence (1 first) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local def, p = acs.norm(w[1]), tonumber(w[2]) if not def or not p then ss.err("usage: ss defprio <def> <1-25>") return end if not ss.keepup.set_prio(def, p) then ss.err(def .. " isn't on your defup or keepup") return end ss.echo(def .. " priority " .. ss.keepup.prio(def))

Alias.name: ss defs
Alias.script: -- ss defs [class] every defence for a class: click to choose defup or keepup local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local cls = w[1] or ss.class() if not ss.keepup.known_class(cls) then ss.err("no defence list for " .. cls) return end ss.keepup.grid(cls)

Alias.name: ss deftoggle
Alias.script: -- ss deftoggle [def] [on|off] keep a defence up while on (rebounding, shield...) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local def = acs.norm(w[1]) if not def then local r = {} for _, d in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.settings.def_toggles)) do r[#r + 1] = (ss.settings.def_toggles[d] and "<green>" or "<grey>") .. d .. "<reset>" end ss.show("toggles", r) return end local on = nil if w[2] == "on" then on = true elseif w[2] == "off" then on = false end ss.keepup.toggle(def, on)

Alias.name: ss defup
Alias.script: -- ss defup raise this class's defup defences that are down -- ss defup add|del <def> [prio] edit this class's defup table -- ss defup list show it -- ss defup stop stop raising ones that haven't come up local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local K = ss.keepup if w[1] == "stop" then K.stop() ss.echo("defup stopped") return end if w[1] then ss.def_table_cmd("defup", w) return end local n = K.defup_now() ss.echo(("defup: raising %d defence%s"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s"))

Alias.name: ss exec
Alias.script: -- ss exec [secs] you're executing someone: cure paralysis, the rest waits (default 8s) -- ss exec off stop -- ss exec time <secs> how long it lasts by default local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "off" or a == "stop" then ss.exec.stop() ss.echo("executing off") elseif a == "time" and tonumber(w[2]) then ss.settings.exec_secs = tonumber(w[2]) ss.save() ss.echo("executing lasts " .. w[2] .. "s") elseif a == nil or tonumber(a) then ss.exec.start(a) else ss.err("usage: ss exec [secs] | off | time <secs>") end

Alias.name: ss fake
Alias.script: -- ss fake <limb> apply mending to a limb, to look like restoration (legs, arms, head, torso, left leg...) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local limb = ss.salves.target(table.concat(w, " ")) if not limb then ss.err("usage: ss fake <legs|arms|head|torso|left leg|...>") return end if not ss.salves.fake(limb) then ss.err("no salve balance") end

Alias.name: ss focus
Alias.script: -- ss focus|tree on|off let serverside use focus / the tree tattoo local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") ss.toggle("server_focus", "serverside focus")(w) ss.resync()

Alias.name: ss group
Alias.script: -- ss group group fight now? (situations and paralysis hold are off in one) -- ss group auto|on|off by who's hitting you (auto), or set it yourself -- ss group size <n> | window <sec> how many people, hitting you in how long, make a group fight local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s, P = ss.settings, ss.prio local a = w[1] if a == "auto" or a == "on" or a == "off" then s.group_mode = a elseif a == "size" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.group_size = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(w[2]))) elseif a == "window" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.group_window = tonumber(w[2]) elseif a then ss.err("usage: ss group auto|on|off | size <n> | window <sec>") return end if a then ss.save() P.check() end ss.echo(("group fight: %s <dim_grey>(%s; %d of %d people in %ss)<reset>"):format( P.group() and "<yellow>yes<reset>, situations off" or "no", s.group_mode, ss.attackers.group_count(), s.group_size, tostring(s.group_window)))

Alias.name: ss ignore
Alias.script: -- ss ignore <aff> toggle: never spend cures on this affliction local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not aff then ss.show("ignored", acs.sorted_keys(ss.settings.ignore)) return end ss.settings.ignore[aff] = not ss.settings.ignore[aff] or nil ss.save() ss.echo(aff .. (ss.settings.ignore[aff] and " ignored" or " cured again"))

Alias.name: ss keepup
Alias.script: -- ss keepup show this class's keepup table -- ss keepup add|del <def> [prio] edit it -- ss keepup learn add the defences you have up now -- ss keepup on|off switch defup and keepup off entirely -- ss keepup combat on|off client mode: keep raising bal/eq defences while afflicted -- ss keepup suggest defences the shared reference lists for your class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local K, sub, s = ss.keepup, w[1], ss.settings if sub == "learn" then K.learn() elseif sub == "on" or sub == "off" then s.keepup_enabled = sub == "on" K.changed() ss.echo("defup and keepup " .. sub) elseif sub == "combat" then ss.toggle("keepup_in_combat", "keepup while afflicted")({ w[2] }) elseif sub == "suggest" then local r = {} for _, d in ipairs(K.suggest(w[2])) do local st = K.state(d) r[#r + 1] = (st == "keepup" and "<orange>" or st == "defup" and "<red>" or "<white>") .. d .. "<reset>" end ss.show("defences for " .. (w[2] or ss.class()) .. " <dim_grey>(red = defup, orange = keepup)<reset>", r) else ss.def_table_cmd("keepup", w) if #K.missing() > 0 then ss.show("missing now", K.missing()) end end

Alias.name: ss limbs
Alias.script: -- ss limbs how close each of your limbs is to breaking -- ss limbs hit <limb> [pct] count a hit by hand (pct: the opponent's, if known) -- ss limbs reset forget the hits (afflictions still count) -- ss limbs log [clear] average hit by stance (Blademaster), from the game's numbers local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "log" then if w[2] == "clear" then ss.settings.limb_log = {} ss.save() ss.echo("limb log cleared") return end local sum = {} for _, e in ipairs(ss.settings.limb_log or {}) do local t = sum[e.stance] or { n = 0, total = 0 } sum[e.stance] = t if e.pct then t.n, t.total = t.n + 1, t.total + e.pct end end local keys = acs.sorted_keys(sum) if #keys == 0 then ss.echo("limb log: no hits with a known stance yet") return end for _, k in ipairs(keys) do ss.echo(("%-6s %3d hits, average %.1f%%"):format(k, sum[k].n, sum[k].n > 0 and sum[k].total / sum[k].n or 0)) end return end if a == "reset" then ss.limbs.reset() elseif a == "hit" then if not ss.limbs.norm(w[2]) then ss.err("usage: ss limbs hit <head|torso|leftarm|rightarm|leftleg|rightleg> [pct]") return end if not (tonumber(w[3]) or ss.limbs.default_pct()) then ss.err("no percent: give one, or fight a class whose script has limb_hit") return end ss.limbs.hit(w[2], w[3]) end local parts = {} for _, n in ipairs(ss.limbs.NAMES) do local v = ss.limbs.get(n) parts[#parts + 1] = (v >= 100 and "<red>" or v >= 79 and "<yellow>" or "<white>") .. n .. " " .. v .. "<reset>" end ss.echo("limbs: " .. table.concat(parts, " "))

Alias.name: ss mode
Alias.script: -- ss mode server|client serverside curing, or SS sends every cure local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") ss.server.set_mode(w[1])

Alias.name: ss mosshealth
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local k = "mosshealth" local v = tonumber(w[1]) if not v then ss.echo(k .. " = " .. ss.settings[k]) return end ss.settings[k] = v ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " = " .. v) ss.resync()

Alias.name: ss mossmana
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local k = "mossmana" local v = tonumber(w[1]) if not v then ss.echo(k .. " = " .. ss.settings[k]) return end ss.settings[k] = v ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " = " .. v) ss.resync()

Alias.name: ss off
Alias.script: ss.settings.enabled = false ss.save() ss.echo("<red>off")

Alias.name: ss on
Alias.script: -- ss on|off resume or pause all automatic actions ss.settings.enabled = true ss.save() ss.echo("<green>on") ss.schedule()

Alias.name: ss options
Alias.script: -- ss options the other serverside curing options -- ss options <name> on|off|<n> set one (synced to serverside) -- ss options preempt <def> toggle: this defence goes ahead of the curing queue local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings local name, v = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), w[2] and w[2]:lower() if name == "preempt" and v then s.def_preempt[acs.norm(v)] = not s.def_preempt[acs.norm(v)] or nil ss.save() ss.prio.changed() elseif name then local o = ss.OPTIONS[name] if not o or not v then ss.err("usage: ss options <" .. table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(ss.OPTIONS), "|") .. "> <value>") return end if o[2] == "num" then if not tonumber(v) then ss.err(name .. " takes a number") return end s[o[1]] = tonumber(v) elseif v ~= "on" and v ~= "off" and not (o[2] == "opt" and v == "unset") then ss.err(name .. " takes on or off" .. (o[2] == "opt" and " (or unset)" or "")) return elseif o[2] == "bool" then s[o[1]] = v == "on" else s[o[1]] = v == "unset" and "" or v end ss.save() ss.resync() end for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.OPTIONS)) do local o = ss.OPTIONS[k] local val = s[o[1]] if o[2] == "bool" then val = val and "on" or "off" elseif val == "" then val = "unset" end ss.echo(("%-12s <white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>%s<reset>"):format(k, tostring(val), o[3])) end ss.show("preempt", acs.sorted_keys(s.def_preempt))

Alias.name: ss outrift
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "outrift" local label = nil ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ss parahold
Alias.script: -- ss parahold [on|off|balance|eq|both] paralysis waits at 25 while you can't act anyway local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s, H = ss.settings, ss.parahold local cls = acs.norm(ss.class()) local need = ({ balance = "balance", bal = "balance", eq = "equilibrium", equilibrium = "equilibrium", both = "both" })[w[1] or ""] if need then s.para_hold_on[cls] = need ss.save() elseif w[1] == "on" or w[1] == "off" then s.para_hold = w[1] == "on" ss.save() H.check() end ss.echo(("paralysis hold %s, waiting on %s for %s (now %s)"):format(s.para_hold and "<green>on<reset>" or "<red>off<reset>", H.needs() == "both" and "balance and equilibrium" or H.needs(), cls, ss.prio.active(H.SWAP) and "<yellow>holding<reset>" or "not holding"))

Alias.name: ss passive
Alias.script: -- ss passive list passives, and which are in effect now -- ss passive on|off|auto <name> -- ss passive add <name> <def|always> <ignore|delay> <aff>... a new passive local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local cls = ss.class() local s = ss.settings s.passives[cls] = s.passives[cls] or {} local t = s.passives[cls] local sub, name = w[1], w[2] local P = ss.data.passives if (sub == "on" or sub == "off" or sub == "auto") and name then if not P[name] then ss.err("unknown passive " .. name) return end if sub == "auto" then t[name] = nil else t[name] = sub == "on" end ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " " .. sub .. " for " .. cls) elseif sub == "add" and w[5] then local affs = {} for i = 5, #w do affs[#affs + 1] = ss.data.canon(w[i]) end local def = w[3] ~= "always" and acs.norm(w[3]) or nil P[name] = { def = def, skill = not def and name or nil, affs = affs, effect = w[4] == "delay" and "delay" or "ignore", wait = 3, classes = { cls } } s.custom_passives[name] = P[name] if not def then t[name] = true end ss.save() ss.echo("added passive " .. name) else ss.echo("<white>passives<reset> for " .. cls) for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(P)) do local p = P[n] cecho(("\n %s<reset> %-13s %-8s <dim_grey>%s %s"):format( ss.engine.passive_on(n) and "<green>in effect" or "<grey>inactive ", n, p.effect or "ignore", p.def and ("while " .. p.def .. " is up,") or "always,", table.concat(p.affs or {}, ","))) end end

Alias.name: ss pipe
Alias.script: -- ss pipe <herb> <id> smoke this pipe id for that herb local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[2] then ss.err("usage: ss pipe <valerian|elm|skullcap> <id>") return end ss.settings.pipes[w[1]] = w[2] ss.save() ss.echo(w[1] .. " pipe: " .. w[2])

Alias.name: ss preapply
Alias.script: -- ss preapply <limb> [salve] apply restoration (or that salve) before the limb is damaged local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local salve if w[#w] and (w[#w]:lower() == "mending" or w[#w]:lower() == "restoration") and #w > 1 then salve = table.remove(w):lower() end local limb = ss.salves.target(table.concat(w, " ")) if not limb then ss.err("usage: ss preapply <legs|arms|head|torso|left leg|...> [salve]") return end if not ss.salves.preapply(limb, salve) then ss.err("no salve balance") end

Alias.name: ss predefup
Alias.script: -- ss predefup [cmd|cmd|... | clear] commands sent before defup for this class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local cls = acs.norm(ss.class()) local cmds = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if cmds == "clear" then ss.settings.predefup[cls] = "" ss.save() elseif cmds ~= "" then ss.settings.predefup[cls] = cmds ss.save() end ss.show("before defup (" .. cls .. ")", ss.keepup.predefup())

Alias.name: ss predict
Alias.script: -- ss predict <aff> [off] tell serverside you have an affliction GMCP hasn't shown local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then ss.err("usage: ss predict <affliction> [off]") return end ss.server.predict(w[1], w[2] == "off")

Alias.name: ss prio
Alias.script: -- ss prio <aff> <1-25> set a priority in the current profile -- ss prio list show priorities changed from default -- ss prio batch [n] pairs sent per CURING PRIORITY command (default 50) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings local prof = s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile] if w[1] == "batch" then local n = tonumber(w[2]) if n and n >= 1 then s.prio_batch = math.floor(n) ss.save() end ss.echo("up to <white>" .. ss.prio.batch() .. "<reset> pairs per CURING PRIORITY command") return end if w[1] == "list" or not w[1] then local r = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(prof)) do if prof[a] ~= ss.data.default_prios[a] then r[#r + 1] = a .. "=" .. prof[a] end end ss.show("changed from default (" .. s.prio_profile .. ")", r) return end local aff, p = ss.data.canon(w[1]), tonumber(w[2]) if not p then ss.err("usage: ss prio <aff> <1-25>") return end prof[aff] = p ss.save() ss.prio.changed() ss.echo(aff .. " priority " .. p .. " in profile " .. s.prio_profile .. (ss.prio.get(aff) ~= p and (" <dim_grey>(a table has it at " .. ss.prio.get(aff) .. " right now)") or ""))

Alias.name: ss prioecho
Alias.script: -- ss prioecho on|off a line when situations come on or go off local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "prio_echo" local label = "situation echoes" ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ss profile
Alias.script: -- ss profile <name> switch to (or create) a priority profile -- ss profile copy <name> copy the current profile to a new name -- ss profile class [name] use this profile whenever you switch to this class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings if w[1] == "copy" and w[2] then s.prio_profiles[w[2]] = acs.copy(s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile]) s.prio_profile = w[2] elseif w[1] == "class" then s.class_profile[ss.class()] = w[2] or s.prio_profile ss.save() ss.echo(ss.class() .. " uses profile " .. s.class_profile[ss.class()]) return elseif w[1] then s.prio_profiles[w[1]] = s.prio_profiles[w[1]] or acs.copy(ss.data.default_prios) s.prio_profile = w[1] else ss.show("profiles (current " .. s.prio_profile .. ")", acs.sorted_keys(s.prio_profiles)) return end ss.save() ss.prio.changed() ss.echo("priority profile: <white>" .. s.prio_profile)

Alias.name: ss siphealth
Alias.script: -- ss siphealth|sipmana|mosshealth|mossmana <pct> local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local k = "siphealth" local v = tonumber(w[1]) if not v then ss.echo(k .. " = " .. ss.settings[k]) return end ss.settings[k] = v ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " = " .. v) ss.resync()

Alias.name: ss sipmana
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local k = "sipmana" local v = tonumber(w[1]) if not v then ss.echo(k .. " = " .. ss.settings[k]) return end ss.settings[k] = v ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " = " .. v) ss.resync()

Alias.name: ss sit
Alias.script: -- ss sit situation tables for this class, and which are on now -- ss sit <name> when <a> [b ...] when it's on: afflictions or your defences, all of them (!x not, x|y either) -- ss sit <name> <aff> <prio|clear> what it sets -- ss sit <name> on|off|del use it, skip it, or delete one of yours -- ss sit <name> hold off|on close to a kill: don't hold paralysis while it's on (ss parahold) -- ss sit general <name> ... the same, for every class -- ss sit vs [<name> ...] the same, against the class you're fighting (ss vs) -- ss when can also use has:<skill>, class:<c>, vs:<c>, phlegmatic>=6, hp<60, a&b local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local P = ss.prio local key = ss.classes.key(ss.class()) local vs if w[1] == "general" then key = "general" table.remove(w, 1) elseif w[1] == "vs" then vs = ss.opp.current() if not vs then ss.err("no opponent now (ss vs <class> sets one)") return end key = "vs " .. vs.class table.remove(w, 1) end local name, sub = w[1], w[2] if not name then local on = {} for _, n in ipairs(P.active_names()) do on[n] = true end if P.group() then ss.echo("<yellow>group fight<reset>: situations are off, the class table is on (ss group)") end local list = P.situations(vs) if vs then ss.echo("against " .. vs.class .. (vs.sub and (" " .. vs.sub) or "") .. ":") end if #list == 0 then ss.echo("no situations for " .. key .. " yet") end for i, sit in ipairs(list) do ss.echo(("%2d. %s%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)<reset> when %s: %s%s"):format(i, on[sit.name] and "<yellow>" or "<white>", sit.name, sit.where, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios), sit.hold == false and " <dim_grey>(no hold)<reset>" or "")) end local off = {} for _, t in ipairs(P.mines(vs)) do for n in pairs(t.off) do off[#off + 1] = n end end if #off > 0 then table.sort(off) ss.show("skipped", off) end return end local mine = P.mine(key) local function own() if not mine.sits[name] then local sc = P.find_sit(name, vs) local prios = {} if sc and type(sc.when) ~= "function" then for a, p in pairs(sc.prios or {}) do prios[a] = p end end mine.sits[name] = { when = sc and type(sc.when) == "table" and acs.copy(sc.when) or {}, prios = prios, hold = sc and sc.hold, defs = sc and sc.defs and acs.copy(sc.defs) or nil, set = sc and sc.set and acs.copy(sc.set) or nil, fake = sc and sc.fake, preapply = sc and sc.preapply, preapply_salve = sc and sc.preapply_salve } mine.order[#mine.order + 1] = name end return mine.sits[name] end if sub == "when" then local sit = own() sit.when = {} for i = 3, #w do sit.when[#sit.when + 1] = w[i]:lower() end elseif sub == "hold" and (w[3] == "on" or w[3] == "off") then local sit = own() if w[3] == "off" then sit.hold = false else sit.hold = nil end elseif sub == "off" or sub == "on" then mine.off[name] = sub == "off" or nil elseif sub == "del" then if not mine.sits[name] then ss.err(name .. " isn't one of yours (ss sit " .. name .. " off skips it)") return end mine.sits[name] = nil for i = #mine.order, 1, -1 do if mine.order[i] == name then table.remove(mine.order, i) end end ss.echo("deleted " .. name) elseif sub and w[3] then local aff = P.aff_name(sub) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. sub .. "'") return end own().prios[aff] = w[3] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[3]) or nil elseif sub then ss.err("usage: ss sit <name> when <terms> | <aff> <prio|clear> | hold off|on | on | off | del") return end if sub then ss.save() P.check() end local sit = P.find_sit(name, vs) if sit then local skipped = false for _, t in ipairs(P.mines(vs)) do if t.off[name] then skipped = true end end ss.echo(("%s when %s: %s%s"):format(name, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios), skipped and " <red>(skipped)" or (P.active(name) and " <yellow>(on now)" or ""))) elseif sub ~= "del" then ss.echo("no situation " .. name .. " (make one with ss sit " .. name .. " when <aff> ...)") end

Alias.name: ss skills
Alias.script: -- ss skills [text] abilities GMCP says you have (filter by text) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.skills)) do if not w[1] or k:find(w[1], 1, true) then r[#r + 1] = k end end ss.show(#r .. " skills", r)

Alias.name: ss status
Alias.script: -- ss status mode, balances, afflictions, missing defences local s, v = ss.settings, ss.vitals ss.echo(("<white>%s<reset> | mode <white>%s<reset> | class <white>%s<reset> | profile <white>%s"):format( s.enabled and "<green>ON" or "<red>OFF", s.mode, ss.class(), s.prio_profile)) local bals = {} for _, b in ipairs({ "balance", "equilibrium", "herb", "salve", "smoke", "sip", "moss", "focus", "tree" }) do bals[#bals + 1] = (ss.bals[b] ~= false and "<green>" or "<red>") .. b .. "<reset>" end ss.echo("balances: " .. table.concat(bals, " ")) if v.maxhp then ss.echo(("hp %d%% mp %d%% bleed %s"):format(v.hpp, v.mpp, tostring(v.stats.bleed or 0))) end local affs, skipped = {}, {} for _, a in ipairs(ss.engine.sorted_affs()) do affs[#affs + 1] = a .. "(" .. ss.engine.prio(a) .. ")" end for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.affs)) do local why = ss.engine.skip(a) if why then skipped[#skipped + 1] = a .. " <dim_grey>(" .. why .. ")<reset>" end end ss.show("afflictions", affs) if #skipped > 0 then ss.show("left alone", skipped) end ss.show("missing defences", ss.keepup.missing()) local sub = ss.classes.current_sub_name() if ss.classes.current() or sub then ss.echo("class script: <white>" .. ss.class() .. (sub and (" / " .. sub) or "")) end if #ss.prio.active_names() > 0 then ss.show("priority tables on", ss.prio.active_names()) end

Alias.name: ss subclass
Alias.script: -- ss subclass [name|auto] which subclass you are for this class (scripts in src/classes/) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local cls = ss.class() local cs = ss.classes.current() if not w[1] then local names = cs and acs.sorted_keys(cs.subclasses or {}) or {} ss.echo(("%s subclass: <white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)"):format(cls, tostring(ss.classes.current_sub_name() or "none"), #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "no subclasses")) return end if w[1] == "auto" then ss.settings.subclass[cls] = nil elseif not (cs and cs.subclasses and cs.subclasses[w[1]]) then ss.err(cls .. " has no subclass '" .. w[1] .. "'") return else ss.settings.subclass[cls] = w[1] end ss.save() ss.classes.apply() ss.echo(cls .. " subclass: " .. tostring(ss.classes.current_sub_name() or "none"))

Alias.name: ss swap
Alias.script: -- ss swap swaps in effect, and the saved ones -- ss swap in|out <name> put a saved swap on top of your priorities, or take it off -- ss swap set <name> <aff> <prio> add to a saved swap ('ss swap set <name> <aff> clear' removes) -- ss swap clear take every swap off local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = ss.settings local sub, name = w[1], w[2] if (sub == "in" or sub == "out") and name then if sub == "in" then if not s.swaps[name] then ss.err("no saved swap '" .. name .. "' (make one with ss swap set)") return end ss.prio.swap_in(name, s.swaps[name]) else ss.prio.swap_out(name) end ss.echo("swap " .. name .. " " .. sub) elseif sub == "set" and name and w[3] and w[4] then s.swaps[name] = s.swaps[name] or {} local aff = ss.data.canon(w[3]) s.swaps[name][aff] = w[4] ~= "clear" and tonumber(w[4]) or nil ss.save() if ss.prio.active(name) then ss.prio.swap_in(name, s.swaps[name]) end ss.echo(("swap %s: %s %s"):format(name, aff, tostring(s.swaps[name][aff] or "removed"))) elseif sub == "clear" then ss.prio.clear() ss.echo("all swaps off") else ss.show("swaps in effect", ss.prio.active_names()) local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(s.swaps)) do local parts = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(s.swaps[n])) do parts[#parts + 1] = a .. "=" .. s.swaps[n][a] end r[#r + 1] = n .. " (" .. table.concat(parts, " ") .. ")" end ss.show("saved swaps", r) end

Alias.name: ss vprio
Alias.script: -- ss vprio <aff> <prio|clear> your own number against the current opponent's class local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local P = ss.prio local o = ss.opp.current() if not o then ss.err("no opponent now (ss vs <class> sets one)") return end local mine = P.mine("vs " .. o.class) if w[1] and w[2] then local aff = P.aff_name(w[1]) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. w[1] .. "'") return end mine.prios[aff] = w[2] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[2]) or nil ss.save() P.check() elseif w[1] then ss.err("usage: ss vprio <aff> <prio|clear>") return end ss.echo(("vs %s, yours: %s"):format(o.class, P.tbl_text(mine.prios)))

Alias.name: ss vs
Alias.script: -- ss vs who you're fighting, and the vs tables on now -- ss vs <class> [subclass] fight on that class's tables until 'ss vs auto' -- ss vs sub <subclass>|auto set the opponent's subclass, or detect it again -- ss vs auto go by who's hitting you local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s, P = ss.settings, ss.prio local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "auto" then s.vs, s.vs_sub = "auto", "" elseif a == "sub" and w[2] then s.vs_sub = w[2]:lower() == "auto" and "" or acs.norm(w[2]) elseif a then local cls = ss.classes.key(a) if not ss.classes.scripts[cls] then ss.err("no class script for " .. a) return end s.vs, s.vs_sub = cls, w[2] and acs.norm(w[2]) or ss.opp.name_sub(a, cls) or "" end if a then ss.save() P.check() ss.server.clot_check() if ss.land_check then ss.land_check() end end local o = ss.opp.current() if P.group() then ss.echo("<yellow>group fight<reset>: no opponent table, just your class table") return end if not o then ss.echo("no opponent (nobody with a known class has hit you lately; ss vs <class> sets one)") return end ss.echo(("vs <yellow>%s%s<reset>%s <dim_grey>(%s)<reset>"):format(o.class, o.sub and (" " .. o.sub) or "", o.name and (": " .. o.name) or "", s.vs == "auto" and "auto" or "set by hand")) local ag, sub = P.against(o) ss.echo("table: " .. P.tbl_text(ag.prios or {})) if o.sub then ss.echo(o.sub .. ": " .. P.tbl_text(sub.prios or {})) end ss.echo("yours: " .. P.tbl_text(P.mine("vs " .. o.class).prios)) for _, sit in ipairs(P.situations(o)) do ss.echo((" %s%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)<reset> when %s: %s"):format(P.active(sit.name) and "<yellow>" or "<white>", sit.name, sit.where, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios))) end

Alias.name: ar ecure
Alias.script:
-- ar ecure list class cures enemies can use -- ar ecure <name> pattern|cd|cures|classes <value> add a line or fix one local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local name, field = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), w[2] and w[2]:lower() if not name or name == "list" then ar.echo("enemy class cures") for _, n in ipairs(ar.enemy.class_cure_names()) do local cc = ar.enemy.class_cure(n) cecho(("
 %s <grey>cd %ss, cures %s, %s<reset>
 %s"):format(n, cc.cd or "?", type(cc.cures) == "table" and table.concat(cc.cures, ",") or tostring(cc.cures), table.concat(cc.classes or {}, ","), table.concat(cc.patterns or { tostring(cc.pattern) }, "
 "))) end return end local cc = acs.copy(ar.enemy.class_cure(name) or { cures = "any", cd = 20, classes = {} }) local val = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") if field == "pattern" then cc.patterns = cc.patterns or {} table.insert(cc.patterns, val) cc.pattern = nil elseif field == "cd" then cc.cd = tonumber(val) elseif field == "cures" then cc.cures = val == "any" and "any" or acs.words((val or ""):gsub(",", " ")) elseif field == "classes" then cc.classes = acs.words((val or ""):gsub(",", " ")) else ar.err("ar ecure <name> pattern|cd|cures|classes <value>") return end ar.settings.class_cures[name] = cc ar.save() ar.reinstall() ar.echo("updated class cure " .. name)

Alias.name: room pickup
Alias.script: -- room pickup what gets picked up, and whether it's on -- room pickup on|off auto-pickup -- room pickup now pick up everything here that's on the list -- room pickup always NAME always pick up this item (exact name) -- room pickup never NAME never pick it up, and stop asking -- room pickup add TEXT pick up anything with TEXT in its name -- room pickup skip TEXT leave anything with TEXT in its name -- room pickup forget NAME|TEXT drop a saved rule -- room pickup ask on|off offer [always] [never] for new items local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local sub = (w[1] or ""):lower() local arg = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if sub == "" or sub == "list" then return rm.pk.show_list() end if sub == "on" or sub == "off" then rm.pk.data.on = sub == "on" rm.pk.save() return rm.echo("auto-pickup " .. sub) end if sub == "ask" then rm.pk.data.ask = rm.onoff(w[2], rm.pk.data.ask) rm.pk.save() return rm.echo("asking about new items " .. (rm.pk.data.ask and "on" or "off")) end if sub == "now" then return rm.echo(rm.pickup_now() .. " to pick up") end if not arg then return rm.err("room pickup " .. sub .. " TEXT") end if sub == "always" then rm.pickup_set(arg, "get") return rm.echo("always picking up " .. arg) end if sub == "never" then rm.pickup_set(arg, "skip") return rm.echo("never picking up " .. arg) end if sub == "forget" then rm.pickup_set(arg, nil) rm.pk.set_pattern(arg, nil) return rm.echo("forgot " .. arg) end if sub == "add" then rm.pk.set_pattern(arg, "get") return rm.echo("picking up anything with '" .. arg .. "'") end if sub == "skip" then rm.pk.set_pattern(arg, "skip") return rm.echo("leaving anything with '" .. arg .. "'") end rm.err("room pickup [on|off|now|ask on|off|always NAME|never NAME|add TEXT|skip TEXT|forget NAME|TEXT]")

Alias.name: room players
Alias.script: -- room players other players here local p = rm.player_list() rm.echo(#p .. " other player" .. (#p == 1 and "" or "s") .. " here") for _, n in ipairs(p) do cecho("\n <yellow>" .. rm.players[n]) end

Alias.name: room refresh
Alias.script: -- room refresh re-request the room item list rm.request_items() rm.echo("asked the game for the room's items")

Alias.name: room status
Alias.script:
-- room status this room: exits, denizens, items, players local r = rm.room rm.echo(("<white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>#%d"):format(r.name, r.num)) cecho(("
 area <white>%s<reset>, %s, coords %s"):format(r.area, r.environment, r.coords)) local d = acs.sorted_keys(r.details) if #d > 0 then cecho("
 details: " .. table.concat(d, ", ")) end cecho("
 exits: <cyan>" .. rm.exits_text()) cecho("
 denizens: " .. rm.group_text(rm.denizens(true), "<orange>")) cecho("
 items: " .. rm.group_text(rm.item_list(), "<light_grey>")) local p = rm.player_list() cecho("
 players: " .. (#p > 0 and ("<yellow>" .. table.concat(p, ", ")) or "<dim_grey>none")) local w = rm.walking() if w then cecho(("
 walking to <white>%s<reset>, %d step%s left"):format(tostring(w.dest), w.steps_left, w.steps_left == 1 and "" or "s")) end

Alias.name: room (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "room" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["rm" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end rm.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: afol area
Alias.script: -- afol area which city this area counts as -- afol area add CITY AREA AREA (or "here") belongs to CITY; CITY none: to no city -- afol area remove AREA forget an area you added local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local sub = (w[1] or ""):lower() if sub == "add" then local c = (w[2] or ""):lower() local name = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") if not (af.is_city[c] or c == "none") then return af.err("afol area add CITY|none AREA NAME") end if not name or name:lower() == "here" then name = af.room().area end if not name or name == "" then return af.err("which area?") end af.settings.areas[name:lower()] = c af.save_settings() return af.echo(("<white>%s<reset> %s"):format(name, c == "none" and "belongs to no city" or ("belongs to " .. c))) elseif sub == "remove" then local name = rest:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if not name or name:lower() == "here" then name = af.room().area end if not af.settings.areas[(name or ""):lower()] then return af.err("not on the list: " .. tostring(name)) end af.settings.areas[name:lower()] = nil af.save_settings() return af.echo("removed " .. name) end local area = af.room().area af.echo(("this area: <white>%s<reset> -> %s"):format(area ~= "" and area or "?", af.area_city(area) or "no city"))

Alias.name: afol areas
Alias.script: -- afol areas the areas you've added local keys = acs.sorted_keys(af.settings.areas) af.echo(#keys .. " area" .. (#keys == 1 and "" or "s") .. " added (city names in area names count on their own)") for _, k in ipairs(keys) do cecho(("\n %-32s %s"):format(k, af.settings.areas[k])) end

Alias.name: afol check
Alias.script: -- afol check DIR what would happen if your leader went DIR (squints) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local dir = af.dir_short[(w[1] or ""):lower()] if not dir then return af.err("check which direction?") end af.check(dir, function(ok, why, info, r) local where = ("%s (%s%s)"):format(af.dir_long[dir], info.area ~= "" and info.area or "?", info.guessed and ", guessed" or "") local seen = r and (r.ok and " <dim_grey>(squinted)" or (" <dim_grey>(no squint: " .. tostring(r.why) .. ")")) or "" if ok then af.echo("<green>would follow<reset> " .. where .. seen) else af.echo("<red>wouldn't follow<reset> " .. where .. ": " .. why .. seen) end end)

Alias.name: afol city
Alias.script: -- afol city NAME|none|auto your city (auto: from GMCP) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local c = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not c then return af.echo("your city: " .. (af.my_city() or "unknown")) end if c == "auto" then af.settings.city = nil elseif c == "none" then af.settings.city = "none" elseif af.is_city[c] then af.settings.city = c else return af.err("not a city: " .. c) end af.save_settings() af.echo("your city: " .. (af.my_city() or "unknown"))

Alias.name: afol echo
Alias.script: -- afol echo on|off a line for every step you follow local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") af.settings.echo = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.echo) af.save_settings() af.echo("step messages " .. (af.settings.echo and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: afol enemies
Alias.script: -- afol enemies all|list all: every city but yours; list: only your enemy cities local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local m = (w[1] or ""):lower() if m ~= "all" and m ~= "list" then return af.echo("enemies: <white>" .. af.settings.enemies .. "<reset> (afol enemies all|list)") end af.settings.enemies = m af.save_settings() af.echo(m == "all" and "every city but yours is an enemy" or "only your enemy list counts (afol enemy CITY)")

Alias.name: afol enemy
Alias.script: -- afol enemy CITY [off] add a city to (or take it off) your enemy list local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local c = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not c then return af.echo("enemy list: " .. (next(af.settings.enemy_cities) and table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(af.settings.enemy_cities), ", ") or "empty")) end if not af.is_city[c] then return af.err("not a city: " .. c) end af.settings.enemy_cities[c] = (w[2] ~= "off") or nil af.save_settings() af.echo(c .. (af.settings.enemy_cities[c] and " added to" or " removed from") .. " the enemy list" .. (af.settings.enemies == "all" and " (used after <white>afol enemies list<reset>)" or ""))

Alias.name: afol follow
Alias.script: -- afol NAME follow NAME, room by room, with the safety checks -- afol follow NAME the same local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then return af.err("follow whom?") end af.start(w[1])

Alias.name: afol guards
Alias.script: -- afol guards on|off stop for guards seen by squinting (never in your own city) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") af.settings.guards = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.guards) af.save_settings() af.echo("guards " .. (af.settings.guards and "stop you (outside your city)" or "are ignored"))

Alias.name: afol off
Alias.script: -- afol off stop following af.stop()

Alias.name: afol squint
Alias.script: -- afol squint on|off squint for totems and guards before stepping in local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") af.settings.squint = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.squint) af.sq.no_skill, af.sq.cache = nil, {} af.save_settings() af.echo("squint before following " .. (af.settings.squint and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: afol status
Alias.script:
-- afol status who you're following and the safety settings local st = af.f.state if af.f.leader then af.echo(("following <white>%s<reset> (%s)"):format(af.f.leader, st or "?")) else af.echo("not following anyone (<white>afol NAME<reset>)") end local enemies = {} for _, c in ipairs(af.cities) do if af.is_enemy_city(c) then enemies[#enemies + 1] = c end end cecho(("
 your city <white>%s<reset>; enemy cities: <red>%s"):format(af.my_city() or "unknown", #enemies > 0 and table.concat(enemies, ", ") or "none")) cecho(("
 squint %s%s<reset>, guards %s"):format(af.settings.squint and "on" or "off", af.sq.no_skill and " <yellow>(you can't squint)" or "", af.settings.guards and "on" or "off")) local n = acs.count(af.settings.areas) if n > 0 then cecho(("
 %d extra area%s (<white>afol areas<reset>)"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s")) end

Alias.name: afol stop
Alias.script: af.stop()

Alias.name: in find
Alias.script: -- in find <text> search inventory and containers local _ = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local r = IN.find(rest, true) IN.echo(("%d match '%s'"):format(#r, rest)) for _, it in ipairs(r) do local loc = it.loc ~= "inv" and (" <grey>in " .. ((IN.containers[it.loc:match("%d+") or ""] or {}).name or it.loc)) or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%-8s <reset>%s%s"):format(it.id, it.name, loc)) end

Alias.name: in look
Alias.script: -- in look <container> refresh and list a container local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local it = w[1] and IN.find(table.concat(w, " "), false)[1] if not it then return IN.err("look <container id or name>") end sendGMCP("Char.Items.Contents " .. it.id) send(" ", false) tempTimer(0.5, function() local c = IN.containers[it.id] IN.echo(it.name .. ": " .. (c and acs.count(c.items) or 0) .. " items") if c then for _, x in pairs(c.items) do IN.line(x) end end end)

Alias.name: in low
Alias.script: -- in low <item|default|sips> <n> low-stock warning level (0 = off) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key, n = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) if key == "sips" and n then IN.settings.low_sips = n elseif key == "default" and n then IN.settings.low_default = n elseif key and n then IN.settings.low[IN.rift_key(key)] = n else IN.echo(("warn below %d (default), %d sips"):format(IN.settings.low_default, IN.settings.low_sips)) for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(IN.settings.low)) do cecho(("\n %s %d"):format(k, IN.settings.low[k])) end return end acs.save("in") IN.echo("saved")

Alias.name: in refill

Alias.name: ptr allies
Alias.script: -- ptr allies same as ptr ally local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local listname = "allies" local sub = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if (sub == "add" or sub == "del" or sub == "remove") and w[2] then for i = 2, #w do if sub == "add" then pt.list_add(listname, w[i]) pt.echo(pt.tag(w[i], false) .. " added to " .. listname) elseif pt.list_del(listname, w[i]) then pt.echo(pt.cap(w[i]) .. " removed from " .. listname) else pt.err(pt.cap(w[i]) .. " is not in " .. listname) end end elseif sub == "clear" then pt.db.lists[listname] = {} pt.save_db() pt.echo(listname .. " cleared") else pt.show_list(listname, pt.tags(pt.list_names(listname))) end

" is not in " .. listname) end end elseif sub == "clear" then pt.db.lists[listname] = {} pt.save_db() pt.echo(listname .. " cleared") else pt.show_list(listname, pt.tags(pt.list_names(listname))) end

": not found on the API") end end) end

">" .. k .. "<reset>" end pt.show_list("colours", r) return end pt.settings.colors[what] = color pt.save_settings() pt.echo(what .. " colour: <" .. color .. ">" .. color)
