Alias.name: ptr hostile
Alias.script: -- ptr hostile [city|house NAME [off]] everyone from it counts as an enemy local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local kind, what = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), table.concat(w, " ", 2):lower() if (kind == "city" or kind == "house") and what ~= "" then local off = what:match("^(.-)%s+off$") what = off or what if kind == "city" and not pt.is_city[what] then pt.err("unknown city " .. what) return end local t = kind == "city" and pt.settings.hostile_cities or pt.settings.hostile_houses t[what] = not off or nil pt.save_settings() pt.echo(("%s %s is %s"):format(kind, pt.cap(what), off and "no longer hostile" or "<red>hostile")) else local cs, hs = {}, {} for _, c in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.settings.hostile_cities)) do cs[#cs + 1] = pt.cap(c) end for _, h in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.settings.hostile_houses)) do hs[#hs + 1] = h end pt.show_list("hostile cities", cs) pt.show_list("hostile houses", hs) end

Alias.name: ptr list
Alias.script: -- ptr list [LIST [add|del NAME...|clear|delete]] your own lists (e.g. watch, marks) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local ln = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not ln then local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.db.lists)) do r[#r + 1] = n .. " (" .. acs.count(pt.db.lists[n]) .. ")" end pt.show_list("lists", r) return end if (w[2] == "add") then pt.list(ln, true) end if not pt.list(ln) then pt.err("no list " .. ln .. " (create it with: ptr list " .. ln .. " add <name>)") return end if w[2] == "delete" then if ln == "enemies" or ln == "allies" then pt.err("can't delete " .. ln) return end pt.db.lists[ln] = nil pt.save_db() pt.echo("deleted list " .. ln) return end table.remove(w, 1) pt.list_cmd(ln)(w)

Alias.name: ptr note
Alias.script: -- ptr note NAME [text] attach a note (no text clears it) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local name = table.remove(w, 1) if not name then pt.err("usage: ptr note NAME TEXT") return end local text = table.concat(w, " ") pt.set(name, "note", text ~= "" and text or nil, "manual") pt.echo(pt.cap(name) .. (text ~= "" and (": note saved") or ": note cleared"))

Alias.name: ptr online
Alias.script: -- ptr online [scan] who is online by city; scan looks up unknown names local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local scan = w[1] == "scan" pt.api.fetch_online(function(o) local by_city, enemies, allies, unknown = {}, {}, {}, 0 for k in pairs(o.names) do local p = pt.db.people[k] if not p or not p.checked then unknown = unknown + 1 if scan then pt.api.lookup(k) end end if p then local c = p.city or "?" by_city[c] = (by_city[c] or 0) + 1 end if pt.is_enemy(k) then enemies[#enemies + 1] = k end if pt.is_ally(k) then allies[#allies + 1] = k end end table.sort(enemies) table.sort(allies) local cities = {} for _, c in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(by_city)) do cities[#cities + 1] = "<" .. (pt.settings.colors[c] or "grey") .. ">" .. pt.cap(c) .. "<reset> " .. by_city[c] end pt.echo(("<white>%d online<reset>: %s%s"):format(o.count, table.concat(cities, ", "), unknown > 0 and (" <dim_grey>| " .. unknown .. " unknown" .. (scan and ", looking them up" or " (ptr online scan)")) or "")) pt.show_list("enemies online", pt.tags(enemies)) pt.show_list("allies online", pt.tags(allies)) end)

Alias.name: ptr recheck
Alias.script: -- ptr recheck [SECONDS|off] how often to check the online list (default 60) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local v = w[1] == "off" and 0 or tonumber(w[1]) if v then pt.settings.recheck_every = v pt.save_settings() pt.api.start_recheck() end local e = pt.settings.recheck_every pt.echo(e > 0 and ("checking who's online every " .. e .. "s, looking up records older than " .. pt.settings.stale_days .. " days") or "automatic recheck off")

Alias.name: ptr roomlist
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local k = "roomlist" pt.settings[k] = pt.onoff(w[1], pt.settings[k]) pt.save_settings() pt.echo(k .. " " .. (pt.settings[k] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: ptr save
Alias.script: -- ptr save write the people database now pt.save_db(true) pt.echo("saved")

Alias.name: ptr set
Alias.script: -- ptr set NAME FIELD VALUE set city/house/class/race/... by hand local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local name, field = w[1], w[2] and w[2]:lower() local value = table.concat(w, " ", 3) if field == "rank" then field = "xp_rank" end if not name or not field or not pt.fields[field] or value == "" then pt.err("usage: ptr set NAME city|house|class|race|level|note|... VALUE") return end if field == "city" and not pt.is_city[value:lower()] and value:lower() ~= "none" then pt.err("unknown city " .. value) return end pt.set(name, field, value, "manual") pt.echo(pt.tag(name) .. ": " .. field .. " set (nothing changes it until 'ptr unset')")

Alias.name: ptr stats
Alias.script: -- ptr stats database size local n, checked = 0, 0 for _, p in pairs(pt.db.people) do n = n + 1 if p.checked then checked = checked + 1 end end pt.echo(("%d people known, %d looked up on the API, %d lists. API queue: %d"):format( n, checked, acs.count(pt.db.lists), #pt.api.queue + (pt.api.inflight and 1 or 0)))

Alias.name: ptr ui
Alias.script: -- ptr ui on|off window listing who is in your room local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") pt.settings.ui = pt.onoff(w[1], pt.settings.ui) pt.save_settings() pt.ui.toggle(pt.settings.ui)

Alias.name: ptr unset
Alias.script: -- ptr unset NAME FIELD clear a set or seen value (falls back to the API) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local field = w[2] and w[2]:lower() if not pt.get(w[1]) or not field then pt.err("usage: ptr unset NAME FIELD") return end pt.unset(w[1], field) local v = pt.field(w[1], field) pt.echo(pt.cap(w[1]) .. ": " .. field .. (v and (" back to the API value, " .. tostring(v)) or " cleared"))

Alias.name: ptr who
Alias.script: -- ptr NAME (or who NAME) what is known about someone local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if not w[1] then pt.err("usage: ptr NAME") return end pt.show(w[1])

Alias.name: ptr (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "ptr" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["pt" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end pt.M.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: bs add
Alias.script: -- bs add mob name add to this area's targets (part of the name is enough) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local name = table.concat(w, " "):lower() if name == "" then bs.err("usage: bs add mob name") return end local list = bs.area_list() if bs.find_entry(list, w) then bs.echo(name .. " is already on the list") return end list[#list + 1] = name bs.save_settings() bs.echo("added <white>" .. name .. "<reset> to " .. bs.area() .. " (#" .. #list .. ")") bs.schedule()

Alias.name: bs anything
Alias.script: -- bs anything on|off attack any mob in areas with no list local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s.anything = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s.anything = false else s.anything = not s.anything end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("attack anything in areas without a list: " .. (s.anything and "on" or "off")) bs.schedule()

Alias.name: bs areas
Alias.script: -- bs areas areas that have target lists local r = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(bs.settings.areas)) do local n = #bs.settings.areas[a] if n > 0 then r[#r + 1] = a .. " (" .. n .. ")" end end bs.show("areas", r)

Alias.name: bs attack
Alias.script: -- bs attack [command|default] this class's attack; &tar = the mob (added at the end if left out) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local part = "attack" local needs_tar = true local cls, key = bs.class(), part .. "s" local cmd = rest or "" if cmd ~= "" then if cmd == "default" then cmd = nil elseif needs_tar and cmd ~= "none" and not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end bs.settings[key][cls] = cmd bs.save_settings() bs.changed() end bs.echo(part .. " for " .. cls .. ": " .. tostring(bs.class_part(part)))

Alias.name: bs del
Alias.script: -- bs del mob name|# remove from this area's targets local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, w) if not i then bs.err("not on this area's list") return end bs.echo("removed " .. table.remove(list, i)) bs.save_settings()

Alias.name: bs enemy
Alias.script: -- bs enemy pause|flee|ignore what to do when an enemy (people tracker) arrives local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] == "pause" or w[1] == "flee" or w[1] == "ignore" then bs.settings.on_enemy = w[1] bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("when an enemy arrives: " .. bs.settings.on_enemy)

Alias.name: bs flee
Alias.script: -- bs flee PCT stop and leave at this health percent -- bs flee command | bs flee back how to leave (default: the way you came) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local s, v = bs.settings, tonumber(w[1]) if v then s.flee_at = v elseif w[1] == "back" then s.flee_cmd = "" elseif w[1] then s.flee_cmd = rest end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("leave at " .. s.flee_at .. "% health via " .. (s.flee_cmd ~= "" and s.flee_cmd or "the way you came"))

Alias.name: bs list
Alias.script: -- bs list [area] this (or another) area's targets, in order local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local area = #w > 0 and table.concat(w, " ") or bs.area() local r = {} for i, v in ipairs(bs.settings.areas[area] or {}) do r[#r + 1] = i .. "." .. v end bs.show("targets in " .. area, r)

Alias.name: bs off
Alias.script: bs.stop("by hand")

Alias.name: bs on
Alias.script: -- bs on|off start or stop hunting (or just: bs; bstart/bstop too) bs.start()

Alias.name: bs party
Alias.script: -- bs party on|off tell your party each new target local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "party" local label = "pt target: ID on each new target" local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s[key] = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s[key] = false else s[key] = not s[key] end bs.save_settings() bs.echo(label .. ": " .. (s[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: bs pickup
Alias.script: -- bs pickup [add|del text] what to pick up (gold by default) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local list = bs.settings.pickup local text = table.concat(w, " ", 2):lower() if w[1] == "add" and text ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = text bs.save_settings() elseif (w[1] == "del" or w[1] == "remove") and text ~= "" then for i, v in ipairs(list) do if v == text then table.remove(list, i) break end end bs.save_settings() end bs.show("pick up", list)

Alias.name: bs prep
Alias.script: -- bs prep cmd|cmd|none|default commands sent when you start hunting local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local cls = bs.class() if rest == "default" then bs.settings.preps[cls] = nil elseif rest == "none" then bs.settings.preps[cls] = {} elseif rest and rest ~= "" then local t = {} for c in rest:gmatch("[^|]+") do t[#t + 1] = (c:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end bs.settings.preps[cls] = t end bs.save_settings() bs.show("sent when you start, for " .. cls, bs.class_part("prep") or {})

Alias.name: bs qtype
Alias.script: -- bs qtype TYPE server queue type for swings (default freestand, as pve) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] then bs.settings.qtype = w[1] bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("swings queue as: " .. bs.settings.qtype)

Alias.name: bs rage
Alias.script: -- bs rage add COST COOLDOWN command battlerage ability for this class -- bs rage | bs rage clear | bs rage default list, remove all, or go back to the defaults -- bs rage low PCT no rage on a mob under this health (default 15) -- bs rage defend PCT under this health of yours, stun/weaken/etc first (default 60) -- bs rage fear on|off use fear abilities (off: feared mobs run away) -- bs rage extra AFF also spend rage giving AFF (inhibit, recklessness...); again to undo local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local cls, s = bs.class(), bs.settings if w[1] == "add" and tonumber(w[2]) and tonumber(w[3]) and w[4] then local cmd = table.concat(w, " ", 4) if not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end s.rage[cls] = s.rage[cls] or acs.copy(bs.default_rage[cls] or {}) table.insert(s.rage[cls], { cost = tonumber(w[2]), cd = tonumber(w[3]), cmd = cmd }) bs.save_settings() elseif w[1] == "clear" then s.rage[cls] = {} bs.save_settings() elseif w[1] == "default" then s.rage[cls] = nil bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "low" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.rage_low = tonumber(w[2]) bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "defend" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.rage_defend = tonumber(w[2]) bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "fear" then s.rage_fear = w[2] == "on" bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "extra" and w[2] then s.rage_extra[w[2]] = not s.rage_extra[w[2]] or nil bs.save_settings() end local r = {} for _, x in ipairs(bs.rage_list()) do local what = x.kind == "aff" and x.aff or x.kind == "cond" and ("needs " .. table.concat(x.needs, "/")) or x.kind or (bs.rage_damages(x) and "dmg" or "?") r[#r + 1] = x.cmd .. " (" .. x.cost .. "/" .. x.cd .. "s " .. what .. ")" end bs.show(("rage for %s (none under %d%% mob health, defensive under %d%% yours, fear %s)"):format( cls, s.rage_low, s.rage_defend, s.rage_fear and "on" or "off"), r) local ex = acs.sorted_keys(s.rage_extra) if #ex > 0 then bs.echo("also using rage for: " .. table.concat(ex, ", ")) end

Alias.name: bs raze
Alias.script: -- bs raze [command|default] what to hit a shielded mob with local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local part = "raze" local needs_tar = true local cls, key = bs.class(), part .. "s" local cmd = rest or "" if cmd ~= "" then if cmd == "default" then cmd = nil elseif needs_tar and cmd ~= "none" and not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end bs.settings[key][cls] = cmd bs.save_settings() bs.changed() end bs.echo(part .. " for " .. cls .. ": " .. tostring(bs.class_part(part)))

Alias.name: bs remove
Alias.script: local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, w) if not i then bs.err("not on this area's list") return end bs.echo("removed " .. table.remove(list, i)) bs.save_settings()

Alias.name: bs room
Alias.script: -- bs room mobs here; click one to add or remove it (old bget) local any = false bs.echo("<white>mobs in " .. bs.area() .. "<reset> (click to add or remove)") for _, id in ipairs(bs.order) do local item = bs.room[id] if bs.is_mob(item) then any = true local p = bs.priority(item.name) local col = id == bs.target and "<red>" or p and "<green>" or "<grey>" local label = "\n " .. col .. item.name .. "<reset> (" .. id .. ")" .. (p and (" #" .. p) or "") if cechoLink then cechoLink(label, function() bs.toggle_mob(item.name) end, (p and "remove " or "add ") .. item.name, true) else cecho(label) end end end if not any then cecho("\n <dim_grey>none") end

Alias.name: bs settarget
Alias.script: -- bs settarget on|off 'st ID' on each new target (gives its health) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "settarget" local label = "st ID on each new target" local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s[key] = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s[key] = false else s[key] = not s[key] end bs.save_settings() bs.echo(label .. ": " .. (s[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: bs shatter
Alias.script: -- bs shatter [command|none|default] rage ability that breaks shields (needs 17 rage) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local part = "shatter" local needs_tar = true local cls, key = bs.class(), part .. "s" local cmd = rest or "" if cmd ~= "" then if cmd == "default" then cmd = nil elseif needs_tar and cmd ~= "none" and not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end bs.settings[key][cls] = cmd bs.save_settings() bs.changed() end bs.echo(part .. " for " .. cls .. ": " .. tostring(bs.class_part(part)))

Alias.name: bs skip
Alias.script: -- bs skip leave the current target alone in this room if not bs.target then bs.echo("no target") return end bs.skip[bs.target] = true bs.target, bs.shield = nil, false bs.schedule()

Alias.name: bs stand
Alias.script: -- bs stand on|off put 'stand' at the front of each swing local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "stand" local label = "stand before each swing" local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s[key] = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s[key] = false else s[key] = not s[key] end bs.save_settings() bs.echo(label .. ": " .. (s[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: bs stash
Alias.script: -- bs stash command|none send after picking up gold, e.g. put sovereigns in pack local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" if rest == "none" then bs.settings.stash = "" elseif rest and rest ~= "" then bs.settings.stash = rest end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("after picking up gold: " .. (bs.settings.stash ~= "" and bs.settings.stash or "nothing"))

Alias.name: bs stats
Alias.script: -- bs stats [reset] kills, gold and xp since you started local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") if w[1] == "reset" then bs.stats = { kills = 0, gold = 0, xp = 0, since = bs.active and acs.now() or nil } end local s = bs.stats local mins = s.since and math.max(1, math.floor((acs.now() - s.since) / 60)) or 0 bs.echo(("%d kills, <yellow>%d gold<reset>, %.2f%% xp in %d min"):format(s.kills, s.gold, s.xp or 0, mins))

Alias.name: bs status
Alias.script: -- bs status area, target, thresholds, attack local s = bs.settings local t = bs.target and bs.room[bs.target] bs.echo(("%s<reset> | area <white>%s<reset> | class <white>%s<reset> | attack <white>%s"):format( bs.active and "<green>HUNTING" or "<red>idle", bs.area(), bs.class(), tostring(bs.attack_cmd()))) if bs.target then local cmds = bs.build(bs.target) if cmds then bs.echo("next swing: " .. table.concat(cmds, "/") .. (bs.shield and " <yellow>(shielded)" or "")) end end bs.echo(("warn %d%% | leave %d%% via %s | enemy: %s | target: %s"):format(s.warn_at, s.flee_at, s.flee_cmd ~= "" and s.flee_cmd or ("way back (" .. tostring(bs.back_dir()) .. ")"), s.on_enemy, t and (t.name .. " (" .. bs.target .. ")" .. (bs.target_hp and (" " .. bs.target_hp .. "%") or "")) or "none")) local why = bs.active and bs.target and bs.blocked() if why then bs.echo("waiting: " .. why) end

Alias.name: bs stayon
Alias.script: -- bs stayon on|off on: hunting stays on as you walk; off: stops when a room is done local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local key = "stayon" local label = "keep hunting as you walk" local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s[key] = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s[key] = false else s[key] = not s[key] end bs.save_settings() bs.echo(label .. ": " .. (s[key] and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: bs up
Alias.script: -- bs up mob name|# attack it before the one above it local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, w) if not i then bs.err("not on this area's list") return end if i > 1 then list[i - 1], list[i] = list[i], list[i - 1] bs.save_settings() end bs.run("list")

Alias.name: bs warn
Alias.script: -- bs warn PCT warn once at this health percent local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local v = tonumber(w[1]) if v then bs.settings.warn_at = v bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("warn at " .. bs.settings.warn_at .. "% health")

Alias.name: bs wield
Alias.script: -- bs wield [left, right|none|default] weapons each swing wields, e.g. shield, blackjack local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local rest = matches[2] or "" local part = "wield" local needs_tar = false local cls, key = bs.class(), part .. "s" local cmd = rest or "" if cmd ~= "" then if cmd == "default" then cmd = nil elseif needs_tar and cmd ~= "none" and not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end bs.settings[key][cls] = cmd bs.save_settings() bs.changed() end bs.echo(part .. " for " .. cls .. ": " .. tostring(bs.class_part(part)))

Alias.name: bs (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "bs" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["bs" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end bs.run(matches[2] or "")

Alias.name: bstart
Alias.script: bs.start()

Alias.name: bstop
Alias.script: bs.stop("by hand")

Alias.name: bget
Alias.script: bs.run("room")

Alias.name: gui border
Alias.script: -- gui border [#rrggbb] colour of the lines around each box local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local c = w[1] if not c then return gui.echo("border colour " .. gui.S().colors.frame) end if not c:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return gui.err("gui border #rrggbb") end gui.S().colors.frame = c gui.changed()

Alias.name: gui box
Alias.script: -- gui box [name on|off] list boxes, or turn one on/off (its neighbour takes the space) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local name = (w[1] or ""):lower() local b = gui.S().boxes[name] if not b then gui.echo("boxes: map on top; self | target, room | mobs below") for _, n in ipairs(gui.box_names) do local x = gui.S().boxes[n] local note = n == "mobs" and " <dim_grey>(shows while bashing)" or "" cecho(("\n %-8s %s%s"):format(n, x.on and "<green>on" or "<red>off", note)) end return end b.on = gui.onoff(w[2], b.on) gui.changed() gui.echo(name .. " " .. (b.on and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: gui click
Alias.script: -- gui click on|off clicking a player runs 't <name>' local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") gui.S().click_target = gui.onoff(w[1], gui.S().click_target) gui.changed() gui.echo("click a player to target: " .. (gui.S().click_target and "on" or "off"))

Alias.name: gui font
Alias.script: -- gui font [size] text size in the boxes local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("font size " .. gui.S().font) end gui.S().font = math.max(6, math.min(20, n)) gui.changed()

Alias.name: gui map
Alias.script: -- gui map [percent] map's share of the panel height (default 50) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("map takes " .. gui.S().map_height .. "% of the height") end gui.S().map_height = math.max(10, math.min(90, n)) gui.changed()

Alias.name: gui off
Alias.script: gui.S().on = false gui.changed() gui.echo("panel off")

Alias.name: gui on
Alias.script: -- gui on / off show or hide the panel gui.S().on = true gui.changed() gui.echo("panel on")

Alias.name: gui redraw
Alias.script: -- gui redraw rebuild the layout and redraw everything gui.ui.apply()

Alias.name: gui reset
Alias.script: -- gui reset back to default layout and settings for k in pairs(gui.S()) do gui.S()[k] = nil end acs.merge_defaults(gui.S(), gui.default_settings) gui.S().layout = gui.LAYOUT gui.changed() gui.echo("settings reset")

Alias.name: gui side
Alias.script: -- gui side left|right which side of the window local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local v = (w[1] or ""):lower() if v ~= "left" and v ~= "right" then return gui.err("gui side left|right") end gui.S().side = v gui.changed()

Alias.name: gui status
Alias.script: -- gui status settings and which packages it is reading from local s = gui.S() gui.echo(("%s, %s side, %d%% wide, font %d"):format(s.on and "on" or "off", s.side, s.width, s.font)) local src = {} for _, p in ipairs({ { "ss", ss }, { "ar", ar }, { "pt", pt }, { "rm", rm }, { "bs", bs }, { "hb", hb } }) do src[#src + 1] = (p[2] and "<green>" or "<dim_grey>") .. p[1] end cecho("\n sources: " .. table.concat(src, " ") .. "<reset> <dim_grey>(grey = not loaded, GMCP used instead)")

Alias.name: gui width
Alias.script: -- gui width [percent] panel width, 10-60 (default 35) local w = acs.words(matches[2] or "") local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("width " .. gui.S().width .. "%") end gui.S().width = math.max(10, math.min(60, n)) gui.changed()

Alias.name: gui (help and the rest)
Alias.script: -- "gui" on its own or with a word that isn't a command here: -- help, or what the package does with it. Each command has its own alias. local word = (matches[2] or ""):match("^(%S+)") if word and acs_command_items["gui" .. " " .. word:lower()] then return end gui.M.run(matches[2] or "")

ScriptGroup.name: Achaea
ScriptGroup.script: -- Achaea: every ACS package in one install. Groups below load in order.

Script.name: bundle quiet start
Script.script: -- Achaea bundle: hold back the packages' "loaded" lines while they load; -- the last script prints one line instead. Errors (red) still show. if not achaea_bundle_cecho then local real = cecho achaea_bundle_cecho = real cecho = function(s, ...) -- pass through once loading is over, for windows (cecho(win, text)) and errors if not achaea_bundle_cecho or select("#", ...) > 0 or tostring(s):find("<red>", 1, true) then return real(s, ...) end end end

Script.name: acs core
Script.script:
-- ACS shared core (v4). An identical copy ships inside every package of the -- system (SS curing, AR offense, ...). Whichever copy is newest wins; an equal -- or older copy loading later does nothing, so install order doesn't matter. -- -- What it provides, all under the global `acs`: -- acs.module(name, {prefix = "ss"}) per-package registry; see below -- acs.send(cmd) the one place commands leave the client -- (dry run, "acs echo", "acs.sent" event) -- acs.echo/err/debug(msg, tag) output helpers -- acs.store(name, defaults) per-character saved settings table -- acs.save(name) save one store -- acs.me = { name, class } from GMCP Char.Name / Char.Status -- acs.online() true once logged in; acs.send drops -- commands before that -- acs.gmcp_support({"Char.Skills 1"}) ask the server for GMCP modules -- helpers: norm, now, copy, merge_defaults, words, sorted_keys, count -- -- Events raised: "acs.class.changed"(new, old), "acs.char.loaded"(name), -- "acs.sent"(cmd), "acs.login"(name) each time you log in, "acs.logout".
local CORE_VERSION = 5
acs = acs or {} if (acs._core_version or 0) >= CORE_VERSION then return end acs._core_version = CORE_VERSION
acs._modules = acs._modules or {} acs._stores = acs._stores or {} acs._gmcp = acs._gmcp or {} acs.me = acs.me or {}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Output
function acs.echo(msg, tag) cecho("\n<dim_grey>[<cyan>" .. (tag or "acs") .. "<dim_grey>]<reset> " .. tostring(msg)) end
function acs.err(msg, tag) cecho("\n<dim_grey>[<red>" .. (tag or "acs") .. "<dim_grey>]<reset> <red>" .. tostring(msg)) end
function acs.debug(msg, tag) if acs.core and acs.core.debug then cecho("\n<dim_grey>[" .. (tag or "acs") .. " dbg] " .. tostring(msg)) end end
-- Logged in: set by the login line or the first character GMCP after a -- connect, cleared on disconnect. Before that nothing goes to the game, so -- loading Mudlet (or sitting at the login prompt) stays quiet. function acs.online() return acs._online == true end
-- "acs echo on": one line for every command acs.send handles, tagged with -- the package whose handler sent it (acs._src, set by the module guards). local function echo_sent(cmd, how) if not (acs.core and acs.core.echo) then return end local tag = acs._src and (" " .. acs._src) or "" local head = how == "sent" and "<green>>" or "<red>x" local note = how == "offline" and " <dim_grey>(not logged in, not sent)" or "" cecho("\n<dim_grey>[" .. head .. "<dim_grey>" .. tag .. "]<reset> <white>" .. tostring(cmd) .. note) end
-- Every package sends through here so dry run covers everything. Returns -- false (and sends nothing) when not logged in. function acs.send(cmd) if not acs.online() then acs.debug("not logged in, not sent: " .. tostring(cmd)) echo_sent(cmd, "offline") return false end if acs.core and acs.core.dryrun then acs.echo("<yellow>(dry) <reset>" .. cmd) else acs.debug("send: " .. cmd) echo_sent(cmd, "sent") send(cmd, false) end raiseEvent("acs.sent", cmd) return true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Small utilities
function acs.norm(name) if not name then return nil end return (tostring(name):lower():gsub("[%s_%-]", "")) end
-- Defences GMCP also lists as afflictions (AW): every package leaves -- these out of its affliction list. acs.NOT_AFFS = { blindness = true, deafness = true, insomnia = true } function acs.not_aff(name) if type(name) == "table" then name = name.name end name = acs.norm(tostring(name or ""):gsub("%s*%(%d+%)%s*$", "")) return acs.NOT_AFFS[name] == true end
function acs.now() return getEpoch and getEpoch() or os.time() end
function acs.copy(t) if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end local r = {} for k, v in pairs(t) do r[k] = acs.copy(v) end return r end
-- Fill keys missing from dst with copies from src, recursively. Lists -- (tables with [1]) are taken whole, not merged. function acs.merge_defaults(dst, src) for k, v in pairs(src) do if dst[k] == nil then dst[k] = acs.copy(v) elseif type(v) == "table" and type(dst[k]) == "table" and v[1] == nil then acs.merge_defaults(dst[k], v) end end return dst end
function acs.words(s) local r = {} for w in tostring(s or ""):gmatch("%S+") do r[#r + 1] = w end return r end
function acs.sorted_keys(t) local r = {} for k in pairs(t or {}) do r[#r + 1] = k end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return tostring(a) < tostring(b) end) return r end
function acs.count(t) local n = 0 for _ in pairs(t or {}) do n = n + 1 end return n end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Settings stores, saved per character as <mudlet home>/acs_<char>_<name>.lua. -- The table returned is kept for the whole session: when the character -- changes, its contents are swapped in place, so references stay valid.
local function store_path(name) local who = (acs.me.name or "default"):lower() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/acs_" .. who .. "_" .. name .. ".lua" end
local function load_into(name) local st = acs._stores[name] local t = {} local path = store_path(name) local f = io.open(path, "r") if f then f:close() if not pcall(table.load, path, t) then acs.err("could not read " .. path) t = {} end end for k in pairs(st.data) do st.data[k] = nil end for k, v in pairs(acs.merge_defaults(t, st.defaults)) do st.data[k] = v end end
function acs.store(name, defaults) local st = acs._stores[name] if not st then st = { data = {}, defaults = defaults or {} } acs._stores[name] = st else st.defaults = defaults or st.defaults end load_into(name) return st.data end
function acs.save(name) local st = acs._stores[name] if not st then return end local ok, err = pcall(table.save, store_path(name), st.data) if not ok then acs.err("could not save " .. name .. ": " .. tostring(err)) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Module registry. acs.module(name, {prefix =, bare =, tag =}) returns the package's registry, -- first removing everything that package registered before (so calling it at -- the top of a package's init makes reloading safe). Functions work with -- either M.on(...) or M:on(...). -- -- M.on(event, fn) event handler (errors are caught and shown) -- M.trigger(regex, fn) temp regex trigger; fn(matches) -- M.alias(regex, fn) temp alias; fn(matches) -- M.timer(sec, fn) temp timer, killed by cleanup if still pending -- M.command(word, fn, help) "<prefix> <word> ..." ; fn(words, rest) -- M.cleanup() -- -- Mudlet items: when a package ships a trigger or alias as a real Mudlet -- item (the all-in-one bundle does), the global acs_items lists it as -- acs_items["<module>\0<pattern>"] = true. M.trigger/M.alias with that -- pattern then make no temp trigger; the item's script calls -- acs.run_item(module, pattern), which runs the function registered for it.
acs._item_fns = acs._item_fns or {}
local function item_key(M, pattern) return M.name .. "\0" .. pattern end
local function as_item(M, pattern, fn) local key = item_key(M, pattern) if not (rawget(_G, "acs_items") and acs_items[key]) then return false end local list = acs._item_fns[key] or {} acs._item_fns[key] = list list[#list + 1] = { M = M, fn = fn } M._items[key] = true return true end
-- Called by a Mudlet trigger/alias item: run what the package registered -- for that pattern. function acs.run_item(module, pattern) for _, e in ipairs(acs._item_fns[module .. "\0" .. pattern] or {}) do e.fn() end end
local function shift(M, a, ...) if a == M then return ... end return a, ... end
function acs.module(name, opts) opts = opts or {} local M = acs._modules[name] if M then M.cleanup() else M = { name = name } acs._modules[name] = M end M.prefix = opts.prefix or M.prefix M.tag = opts.tag or M.prefix or name M._h, M._t, M._a, M._timers, M.commands = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} M._items = M._items or {}
local function guard(what, fn) return function(...) local src = acs._src acs._src = M.tag local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...) acs._src = src if not ok then acs.err(what .. ": " .. tostring(err), M.tag) end end end
function M.on(...) local event, fn = shift(M, ...) local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, guard(event, fn)) M._h[#M._h + 1] = id return id end function M.trigger(...) local pattern, fn = shift(M, ...) if rawget(_G, "acs_capture") then acs_capture(M.name, "trigger", pattern) end -- bundle build local g = guard("trigger " .. pattern, function() fn(matches) end) if as_item(M, pattern, g) then return item_key(M, pattern) end local id = tempRegexTrigger(pattern, g) M._t[#M._t + 1] = id return id end function M.alias(...) local pattern, fn = shift(M, ...) if rawget(_G, "acs_capture") then acs_capture(M.name, "alias", pattern) end -- bundle build local g = guard("alias", function() fn(matches) end) if as_item(M, pattern, g) then return item_key(M, pattern) end local id = tempAlias(pattern, g) M._a[#M._a + 1] = id return id end function M.timer(...) local sec, fn = shift(M, ...) local id id = tempTimer(sec, guard("timer", function() M._timers[id] = nil fn() end)) M._timers[id] = true return id end function M.command(...) local word, fn, help = shift(M, ...) M.commands[word:lower()] = { fn = fn, help = help } end function M.run(line) local w = acs.words(line) local sub = (table.remove(w, 1) or "help"):lower() local c = M.commands[sub] if not c then if sub == "help" then return acs.help(M) end acs.err("unknown command '" .. sub .. "' (try '" .. (M.prefix or name) .. " help')", M.tag) return end c.fn(w, (tostring(line):match("^%s*%S+%s*(.*)$"))) end function M.cleanup() for _, id in ipairs(M._h) do killAnonymousEventHandler(id) end for _, id in ipairs(M._t) do killTrigger(id) end for _, id in ipairs(M._a) do killAlias(id) end for id in pairs(M._timers) do killTimer(id) end for key in pairs(M._items or {}) do local keep = {} for _, e in ipairs(acs._item_fns[key] or {}) do if e.M ~= M then keep[#keep + 1] = e end end acs._item_fns[key] = keep[1] and keep or nil end M._h, M._t, M._a, M._timers, M._items = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} end
-- bare = false: the prefix on its own is left alone (for prefixes that -- are also game commands, like "in"); "<prefix> help" still works. if M.prefix then local pat = opts.bare == false and ("^" .. M.prefix .. [[\s+(\S.*)$]]) or ("^" .. M.prefix .. [[(?:\s+(.*))?$]]) M.alias(pat, function(m) M.run(m[2] or "") end) end return M end
function acs.help(M) acs.echo("<white>" .. (M.title or M.prefix or M.name) .. " commands", M.tag) for _, word in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(M.commands)) do local h = M.commands[word].help if h then if type(h) == "string" then h = { h } end for _, l in ipairs(h) do cecho("\n <grey>" .. M.prefix .. " " .. l) end end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP modules: each package asks for what it needs; the union is sent.
function acs.gmcp_support(list) for _, m in ipairs(list or {}) do acs._gmcp[m] = true end if gmcp and gmcp.Char then acs.send_gmcp_support() end end
function acs.send_gmcp_support() local r = {} for _, m in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(acs._gmcp)) do r[#r + 1] = '"' .. m .. '"' end if #r > 0 then sendGMCP("Core.Supports.Add [" .. table.concat(r, ", ") .. "]") end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Character: name (selects saved settings) and class (lowercase).
function acs.set_name(name) if not name or name == "" or name == acs.me.name then return end acs.me.name = name for n in pairs(acs._stores) do load_into(n) end raiseEvent("acs.char.loaded", name) end
function acs.set_class(cls) if not cls or cls == "" then return end cls = tostring(cls):lower() local old = acs.me.class if cls == old then return end acs.me.class = cls raiseEvent("acs.class.changed", cls, old) end
function acs.set_online(on) on = on and true or false if on == acs.online() then return end acs._online = on if on then raiseEvent("acs.login", acs.me.name) else raiseEvent("acs.logout") end end
local core = acs.module("core", { prefix = "acs" }) core.title = "ACS core" acs.core = acs.store("core", { dryrun = false, debug = false, echo = false })
core.on("gmcp.Char.Name", function() local n = gmcp.Char.Name if n then acs.set_name(n.name) end acs.set_online(true) end) core.on("gmcp.Char.Status", function() local s = gmcp.Char.Status if not s then return end if s.name then acs.set_name(s.name) end if s.class then acs.set_class(s.class) end acs.set_online(true) end) core.on("gmcp.Char.Vitals", function() acs.set_online(true) end) core.trigger([[^Password correct\. Welcome to Achaea\.]], function() acs.set_online(true) end) core.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() acs.set_online(false) end) core.on("sysDisconnectionEvent", function() acs.set_online(false) end) core.on("sysProtocolEnabled", function(_, proto) if proto == "GMCP" then acs.send_gmcp_support() end end)
function acs.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end core.command("dry", function(w) acs.core.dryrun = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.dryrun) acs.save("core") acs.echo("dry run " .. (acs.core.dryrun and "on" or "off")) end, "dry on|off echo commands instead of sending them (all packages)") core.command("debug", function(w) acs.core.debug = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.debug) acs.save("core") acs.echo("debug " .. (acs.core.debug and "on" or "off")) end, "debug on|off show debug output (all packages)") core.command("echo", function(w) acs.core.echo = acs.onoff(w[1], acs.core.echo) acs.save("core") acs.echo("command echo " .. (acs.core.echo and "on" or "off")) end, "echo on|off show every command the system sends (all packages)") core.command("who", function() acs.echo(("character <white>%s<reset>, class <white>%s"):format(tostring(acs.me.name), tostring(acs.me.class))) end, "who character and class the system sees")
if gmcp and gmcp.Char then if gmcp.Char.Status then acs.set_name(gmcp.Char.Status.name) acs.set_class(gmcp.Char.Status.class) elseif gmcp.Char.Name then acs.set_name(gmcp.Char.Name.name) end -- reinstalled while logged in if gmcp.Char.Status or gmcp.Char.Name or gmcp.Char.Vitals then acs._online = true end end
