DEF.by_class = {} -- "Jester" -> { "acrobatics", ... } for name, d in pairs(DEF.defs) do d.name = name d.sources, d.classes = d.sources or {}, d.classes or {} for _, c in ipairs(d.classes) do DEF.by_class[c] = DEF.by_class[c] or {} table.insert(DEF.by_class[c], name) end end for _, list in pairs(DEF.by_class) do table.sort(list) end
function DEF.canon(name) if not name then return nil end return (tostring(name):lower():gsub("[%s_%-']", "")) end
function DEF.get(name) return DEF.defs[DEF.canon(name)] end
-- Defences a given class can keep up: its own plus General ones. function DEF.for_class(class) local out, seen = {}, {} for _, c in ipairs({ class, "General" }) do for _, n in ipairs(DEF.by_class[c] or {}) do if not seen[n] then seen[n] = true; table.insert(out, n) end end end table.sort(out) return out end
achaea_defs = DEF return DEF

Script.name: heartbeat
Script.script:
-- HB: the heartbeat of the ACS system for Achaea (Mudlet). One timer beats -- every 250 ms (configurable) and runs the handlers other packages register -- with it: recomputing affliction and defence priorities, refreshing -- aliases, redrawing windows, and so on. -- -- Built on the shared ACS core (00_acs_core.lua). The global `hb` is this -- package's acs.module registry, so hb.on/hb.timer/hb.command come from the -- core and the "hb" alias is set up by it. -- -- For other packages: -- -- hb.register(name, fn, opts) add or replace a handler; fn(ctx) -- opts.priority lower runs first (default 50) -- opts.every seconds between runs (default 0 = every beat) -- opts.watch {"affs", "defs"}: only run when one of these keys -- was marked since this handler last ran -- opts.urgent with watch: a mark runs a beat right away instead of -- waiting for the next one -- opts.owner package name, for hb.unregister_owner -- ctx = { beat = n, now = seconds, dt = seconds since this handler -- last ran, changed = { key = true, ... } } -- hb.unregister(name), hb.unregister_owner(owner) -- hb.mark(key) flag state as changed -- hb.watch(event, key) mark key whenever a Mudlet event fires -- hb.kick() run a beat now (coalesced, next frame) -- hb.pause(), hb.resume(), hb.set_interval(sec) -- -- Events: "hb.ready" when HB (re)loads, so packages loaded earlier can -- register; "hb.beat"(n) after each beat's handlers ran.
hb = acs.module("hb", { prefix = "hb", tag = "hb" }) hb.title = "HB heartbeat" hb.version = "0.1.0"
hb.default_settings = { interval = 0.25, -- seconds between beats max_errors = 5, -- errors in a row before a handler is switched off budget = 0.05, -- warn when one beat takes longer than this (seconds) disabled = {}, -- handler name -> true, switched off by hand } hb.settings = acs.store("hb", hb.default_settings)
function hb.save_settings() acs.save("hb") end function hb.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "hb") end function hb.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "hb") end function hb.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "hb") end
-- Kept across reloads of HB itself, so other packages' handlers survive. hb._subs = hb._subs or {} -- name -> handler record hb._order = hb._order or {} -- handlers sorted by priority, then name hb._marks = hb._marks or {} -- key -> sequence number of its last mark hb._seq = hb._seq or 0 hb._watched = hb._watched or {} -- event -> key, re-wired on reload hb.beats = hb.beats or 0 hb.paused = hb.paused or false hb.stats = hb.stats or { beats = 0, total = 0, max = 0, over = 0, last = 0 }
-- CPU time with sub-millisecond precision, for the profile. local clock = os.clock
function hb.sort() local r = {} for _, s in pairs(hb._subs) do r[#r + 1] = s end table.sort(r, function(a, b) if a.priority ~= b.priority then return a.priority < b.priority end return a.name < b.name end) hb._order = r -- which keys should kick a beat as soon as they're marked local u = nil for _, sub in ipairs(r) do if sub.urgent and sub.watch then u = u or {} for _, k in ipairs(sub.watch) do u[k] = true end end end hb._urgent_keys = u end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Registry
function hb.register(name, fn, opts) assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "hb.register: name required") assert(type(fn) == "function", "hb.register: fn must be a function") opts = opts or {} local old = hb._subs[name] local s = { name = name, fn = fn, priority = tonumber(opts.priority) or 50, every = tonumber(opts.every) or 0, owner = opts.owner, urgent = opts.urgent and true or false, watch = nil, -- a new handler runs on the first beat; a replaced one keeps its place seen = old and old.seen or -1, last = old and old.last or nil, errors = 0, off = false, -- profile survives re-registering (package reloads) calls = old and old.calls or 0, time = old and old.time or 0, max = old and old.max or 0, } if opts.watch then s.watch = type(opts.watch) == "table" and opts.watch or { opts.watch } end hb._subs[name] = s hb.sort() hb.debug("registered " .. name) return name end
function hb.unregister(name) if not hb._subs[name] then return false end hb._subs[name] = nil hb.sort() return true end
function hb.unregister_owner(owner) local n = 0 for name, s in pairs(hb._subs) do if s.owner == owner then hb._subs[name] = nil n = n + 1 end end if n > 0 then hb.sort() end return n end
function hb.get(name) return hb._subs[name] end
-- Switch a handler on or off by hand (remembered per character). function hb.enable(name, on) local s = hb._subs[name] if on then hb.settings.disabled[name] = nil if s then s.off, s.errors = false, 0 end else hb.settings.disabled[name] = true end hb.save_settings() return s ~= nil end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Dirty flags. A mark bumps a sequence number; each watching handler -- remembers the number it last saw, so one that runs every 2 seconds still -- sees a mark made 1.9 seconds ago.
function hb.mark(key) hb._seq = hb._seq + 1 hb._marks[key] = hb._seq if hb._urgent_keys and hb._urgent_keys[key] then hb.kick() end end
function hb.marked(key) return hb._marks[key] end
function hb.changed_for(s) if not s.watch then return nil, true end local changed, any = {}, false for _, k in ipairs(s.watch) do local m = hb._marks[k] if m and m > s.seen then changed[k] = true any = true end end return changed, any end
function hb.watch(event, key) hb._watched[event] = key hb.on(event, function() hb.mark(key) end) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The beat
function hb.run_one(s, now) if s.off or hb.settings.disabled[s.name] then return end if s.every > 0 and s.last and now - s.last < s.every - 1e-6 then return end local changed, due = hb.changed_for(s) if not due then return end local ctx = { beat = hb.beats, now = now, dt = s.last and (now - s.last) or 0, changed = changed or {} } -- record what this run has seen before calling, so a handler that marks -- its own key doesn't loop forever s.seen = hb._seq s.last = now local t0 = clock() local ok, err = pcall(s.fn, ctx) local dt = clock() - t0 s.calls, s.time = s.calls + 1, s.time + dt if dt > s.max then s.max = dt end if ok then s.errors = 0 else s.errors = s.errors + 1 s.last_error = tostring(err) hb.err(s.name .. ": " .. s.last_error) if s.errors >= hb.settings.max_errors then s.off = true hb.err(("%s switched off after %d errors in a row; 'hb on %s' to retry"):format(s.name, s.errors, s.name)) raiseEvent("hb.handler.off", s.name, s.last_error) end end end
function hb.beat() if hb._in_beat then return end hb._in_beat = true hb.beats = hb.beats + 1 local now = acs.now() local t0 = clock() -- iterate a snapshot: handlers may register/unregister during the beat local order = hb._order for i = 1, #order do hb.run_one(order[i], now) end hb._in_beat = false local dt = clock() - t0 local st = hb.stats st.beats, st.total, st.last = st.beats + 1, st.total + dt, dt if dt > st.max then st.max = dt end if dt > hb.settings.budget then st.over = st.over + 1 hb.debug(("beat %d took %.1f ms"):format(hb.beats, dt * 1000)) end raiseEvent("hb.beat", hb.beats) end
-- Off-cycle beat, coalesced: many kicks in one batch of GMCP run one beat. function hb.kick() if hb._kick_pending or hb.paused then return end hb._kick_pending = true hb.timer(0, function() hb._kick_pending = false hb.beat() end) end
-- The timer reschedules itself each beat, so a changed interval takes effect -- at once and a reload never leaves two loops running. function hb.loop() hb._timer = nil if hb.paused then return end hb.beat() if not hb.paused and not hb._timer then hb._timer = hb.timer(hb.settings.interval, hb.loop) end end
function hb.start() if hb._timer then killTimer(hb._timer) hb._timer = nil end if hb.paused then return end hb._timer = hb.timer(hb.settings.interval, hb.loop) end
function hb.pause() hb.paused = true if hb._timer then killTimer(hb._timer) hb._timer = nil end raiseEvent("hb.paused") end
function hb.resume() if not hb.paused then return end hb.paused = false hb.start() raiseEvent("hb.resumed") end
function hb.set_interval(sec) sec = tonumber(sec) assert(sec and sec >= 0.05, "interval must be at least 0.05 seconds") hb.settings.interval = sec hb.save_settings() hb.start() end
function hb.reset_profile() hb.stats = { beats = 0, total = 0, max = 0, over = 0, last = 0 } for _, s in pairs(hb._subs) do s.calls, s.time, s.max = 0, 0, 0 end end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- HB commands: "hb help" lists them.
function hb.ms(sec) return ("%.2f"):format((sec or 0) * 1000) end
hb.command("status", function() local st = hb.stats hb.echo(("%s, every <white>%d ms<reset>, beat %d, %d handlers"):format( hb.paused and "<yellow>paused<reset>" or "<green>running<reset>", math.floor(hb.settings.interval * 1000 + 0.5), hb.beats, #hb._order)) if st.beats > 0 then hb.echo(("beat cost: avg %s ms, max %s ms, %d over the %s ms budget"):format( hb.ms(st.total / st.beats), hb.ms(st.max), st.over, hb.ms(hb.settings.budget))) end end, "status running or paused, interval, cost per beat")
hb.command("list", function() if #hb._order == 0 then hb.echo("no handlers registered") return end hb.echo("<white>pri name every watch") for _, s in ipairs(hb._order) do local state = (s.off or hb.settings.disabled[s.name]) and " <red>off" or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%3d <white>%-24s<grey> %5s %s%s"):format(s.priority, s.name, s.every > 0 and (s.every .. "s") or "beat", s.watch and table.concat(s.watch, ",") or "-", state)) end end, "list registered handlers in run order")
hb.command("prof", function(w) if w[1] == "reset" then hb.reset_profile() hb.echo("profile reset") return end local r = {} for _, s in ipairs(hb._order) do r[#r + 1] = s end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.time > b.time end) hb.echo("<white>name calls total ms avg ms max ms") for _, s in ipairs(r) do cecho(("\n <grey>%-24s %7d %10s %8s %8s"):format(s.name, s.calls, hb.ms(s.time), hb.ms(s.calls > 0 and s.time / s.calls or 0), hb.ms(s.max))) end end, "prof [reset] time spent in each handler, costliest first")
hb.command("interval", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then hb.echo("interval is " .. math.floor(hb.settings.interval * 1000 + 0.5) .. " ms") return end if n < 50 then hb.err("at least 50 ms") return end hb.set_interval(n / 1000) hb.echo("beating every " .. n .. " ms") end, "interval [ms] show or set time between beats (default 250)")
hb.command("pause", function() hb.pause() hb.echo("paused") end, "pause stop the beat") hb.command("resume", function() hb.resume() hb.echo("running") end, "resume start it again") hb.command("once", function() hb.beat() hb.echo("beat " .. hb.beats) end, "once run one beat now")
hb.command("on", function(w) if not w[1] then hb.err("which handler? see 'hb list'") return end if not hb.enable(w[1], true) then hb.echo("(no handler named " .. w[1] .. " yet; remembered)") end hb.echo(w[1] .. " on") end, "on NAME switch a handler back on (also after errors)") hb.command("off", function(w) if not w[1] then hb.err("which handler? see 'hb list'") return end hb.enable(w[1], false) hb.echo(w[1] .. " off") end, "off NAME switch a handler off (remembered)")
hb.command("mark", function(w) if not w[1] then hb.err("which key?") return end hb.mark(w[1]) hb.echo("marked " .. w[1]) end, "mark KEY flag KEY as changed (testing)")
hb.command("budget", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then hb.echo("budget is " .. hb.ms(hb.settings.budget) .. " ms") return end hb.settings.budget = n / 1000 hb.save_settings() hb.echo("budget " .. n .. " ms") end, "budget [ms] warn (in acs debug) when a beat takes longer")

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- HB startup. Re-importing is safe: acs.module in 01_hb.lua removes the old -- event handlers and timer first; registered handlers are kept.
-- State keys HB marks by itself, so packages can watch them without -- wiring events: { event, key }. hb.standard_marks = { { "gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List", "affs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add", "affs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", "affs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Defences.List", "defs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Defences.Add", "defs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Defences.Remove", "defs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Vitals", "vitals" }, { "gmcp.Room.Info", "room" }, { "gmcp.Room.Players", "players" }, { "gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", "players" }, { "gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer", "players" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.List", "items" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.Add", "items" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", "items" }, { "acs.class.changed", "class" }, { "acs.char.loaded", "char" }, }
function hb.init() for _, m in ipairs(hb.standard_marks) do hb._watched[m[1]] = m[2] end -- includes any hb.watch() other packages made before this reload for event, key in pairs(hb._watched) do hb.watch(event, key) end hb.on("sysDisconnectionEvent", function() hb.mark("char") end) -- Uninstalling stops the beat and removes the global, so other packages' -- `if hb then` guards see it gone; "hb.removed" lets them start their -- own fallback timers. hb.on("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg ~= "HB" then return end hb.pause() hb.cleanup() acs._modules.hb = nil hb = nil raiseEvent("hb.removed") end) hb.start() raiseEvent("hb.ready") hb.echo(("loaded v%s, beating every %d ms. Type <white>hb help<reset>."):format( hb.version, math.floor(hb.settings.interval * 1000 + 0.5))) end
hb.init()

Script.name: queue
Script.script:
-- QM queue: one place every package (and you) puts commands on Achaea's -- server-side queue (HELP QUEUEING), plus a client-side copy of what's on it. -- -- For other packages (guard with `if qm then`): -- -- qm.queue(cmds, opts) cmds: "stand" or { "stand", "kick rat" } or "stand|kick rat" -- opts.type queue type: eq, bal, eqbal, class, ship, para, unbound, -- stun, free, freestand, full, or custom flags ("eb", -- "c!p!tu"); default qm.settings.type (eqbal) -- opts.mode add (default), addclear, addclearfull, prepend, insert, replace -- opts.index for insert / replace -- opts.key who it's for ("ar", "bs", "move" ...); names the game alias -- for a group and is passed back when it runs -- opts.together several commands go as one game alias (SETALIAS) that is -- queued once, so they all run on the same balance (default). -- false: one queue entry each; the first gets opts.mode, the -- rest "add" -- opts.alias always go as the game alias qm<key>, even one command. If -- that alias is already waiting on the queue, only the -- alias is rewritten and the queue is left alone -- opts.on_run fn(entry) when the game runs it -- qm.add / qm.addclear / qm.prepend (cmds, type, opts) shorthands -- qm.clear(type) clear one queue type, or everything (nil / "all") -- qm.items what we think is queued, oldest first: -- { type, cmd, cmds, key, at, on_run } -- -- Events: "qm.queued"(entry), "qm.ran"(entry) when "[System]: Running queued -- <type> command: <CMD>" shows, "qm.cleared"(type or "all"), "qm.full"(entry -- the game refused, or nil). -- -- Commands you type that start with QUEUE or CLEARQUEUE are tracked too.
qm = acs.module("qm", { prefix = "qm", tag = "qm" }) qm.title = "QM queue" qm.version = "0.1.0"
qm.default_settings = { type = "eqbal", -- queue type for qa / qc / qp and qm.queue without one sep = "|", -- splits what you give qa / qm.queue into commands alias_sep = "/", -- goes between commands inside a game alias (SETALIAS) alias_prefix = "qm", -- game aliases for grouped commands: qm<key> alerts = true, -- CONFIG SHOWQUEUEALERTS ON at login (QM needs the Running lines) gag = false, -- hide the [System] queue lines reuse_for = 10, -- seconds a queued alias is trusted to still be waiting } qm.settings = acs.store("qm", qm.default_settings)
function qm.save() acs.save("qm") end function qm.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "qm") end function qm.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "qm") end function qm.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "qm") end
qm.LIMIT = 7 -- queued actions at once, across all queue types (seen in game) qm.ALIAS_MAX = 20 -- commands in one game alias qm.SIMPLE = { eq = "equilibrium", bal = "balance", eqbal = "eq and balance", class = "class balance", ship = "ship balance", para = "not paralysed", unbound = "not bound", stun = "not stunned", free = "eqbal, unbound, not paralysed or stunned", freestand = "free, plus standing", full = "freestand, plus class balance", } qm.MODES = { add = true, addclear = true, addclearfull = true, prepend = true, insert = true, replace = true }
qm.items = qm.items or {} qm._aliases = qm._aliases or {} -- game alias name -> what we last set it to
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Queue types
-- A simple type by name, or custom flags (e b c s p w u t, each may have a -- leading !). Returns the type lowercased, or nil. function qm.valid_type(t) if not t then return nil end t = tostring(t):lower() if qm.SIMPLE[t] then return t end if t:match("^[!ebcspwut]+$") and not t:find("!!") and not t:find("!$") then return t end return nil end
-- For the short aliases: is the first word a queue type rather than the -- start of a command? Simple names, "eb", and flags with a ! ("eb!p"); -- not bare flag words like "put" or "cut". function qm.type_word(w) w = tostring(w or ""):lower() if qm.SIMPLE[w] or w == "eb" then return w end if w:find("!", 1, true) and qm.valid_type(w) then return w end return nil end
-- "stand|kick rat" or { "stand", "kick rat|x" } -> { "stand", "kick rat", "x" } function qm.split(cmds) if type(cmds) == "string" then cmds = { cmds } end local sep, out = qm.settings.sep, {} for _, c in ipairs(cmds or {}) do local s, i = tostring(c), 1 while true do local j = sep ~= "" and s:find(sep, i, true) local part = s:sub(i, j and j - 1 or #s):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if part ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = part end if not j then break end i = j + #sep end end return out end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The client-side copy. Updated from every queue command that goes out -- (ours and typed ones) and from the game's lines.
local function key_of(e) return e.cmd:lower() end
function qm.count() return #qm.items end
function qm.drop_type(t) local keep = {} for _, e in ipairs(qm.items) do if e.type ~= t then keep[#keep + 1] = e end end qm.items = keep end
function qm.forget(t) if not t or t == "all" then qm.items = {} else qm.drop_type(t) end raiseEvent("qm.cleared", t or "all") end
-- Record one queue command. meta (from qm.queue) adds key, cmds, on_run. function qm.record(mode, t, cmd, index, meta) meta = meta or {} local e = { type = t, cmd = cmd, cmds = meta.cmds or { cmd }, key = meta.key, on_run = meta.on_run, at = acs.now() } local items = qm.items if mode == "addclearfull" then items = {} qm.items = items elseif mode == "addclear" then qm.drop_type(t) items = qm.items end if mode == "prepend" then table.insert(items, 1, e) elseif mode == "insert" then table.insert(items, math.max(1, math.min(tonumber(index) or 1, #items + 1)), e) elseif mode == "replace" then local i = tonumber(index) or 0 if items[i] then items[i] = e else items[#items + 1] = e end else if #items >= qm.LIMIT then qm.debug("queue looks full (" .. qm.LIMIT .. "), the game will refuse: " .. cmd) return nil end items[#items + 1] = e end -- inserting past the limit pushes the last command off while #items > qm.LIMIT do table.remove(items) end qm._last = e raiseEvent("qm.queued", e) return e end
-- Parse one outgoing command; returns true if it was a queue command. function qm.observe(line, meta) local s = tostring(line or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local low = s:lower() local t = low:match("^clearqueue%s+(%S+)$") or low:match("^queue%s+clear%s+(%S+)$") if low == "clearqueue" or low == "queue clear" then t = "all" end if t then qm.forget(t) return true end local mode, qt, rest = s:match("^[Qq][Uu][Ee][Uu][Ee]%s+(%a+)%s+(%S+)%s+(.+)$") mode = mode and mode:lower() if mode == "remove" or (not mode and low:match("^queue%s+remove%s+%d+$")) then table.remove(qm.items, tonumber(low:match("(%d+)$")) or 0) return true end if not (mode and qm.MODES[mode]) then return false end qt = qt:lower() local index if mode == "insert" or mode == "replace" then index, rest = rest:match("^(%d+)%s+(.+)$") if not index then return false end end qm.record(mode, qt, rest, index, meta) return true end
-- "[System]: Running queued free command: STAND" function qm.on_running(t, cmd) t, cmd = tostring(t):lower(), tostring(cmd):lower() local hit for i, e in ipairs(qm.items) do if key_of(e) == cmd and e.type == t then hit = i break end end if not hit then -- custom flags may show under another name: match the command alone for i, e in ipairs(qm.items) do if key_of(e) == cmd then hit = i break end end end local e if hit then e = table.remove(qm.items, hit) else e = { type = t, cmd = cmd, cmds = { cmd }, at = acs.now() } end e.ran_as = t if e.on_run then local ok, err = pcall(e.on_run, e) if not ok then qm.err("on_run: " .. tostring(err)) end end raiseEvent("qm.ran", e) return e end
-- "[System]: Your queue is full.": the newest command didn't go on. function qm.on_full() local e = qm._last if e then for i = #qm.items, 1, -1 do if qm.items[i] == e then table.remove(qm.items, i) break end end end qm._last = nil qm.err("queue full" .. (e and (", not queued: " .. table.concat(e.cmds or { e.cmd }, " | ")) or "") .. " (<white>qx<red> clears it)") raiseEvent("qm.full", e) return e end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sending
function qm.send(cmd, meta) qm._sending = true local ok = acs.send(cmd) qm._sending = false if ok or (acs.core and acs.core.dryrun) then qm.observe(cmd, meta) end return ok end
-- Game alias name for a group: qm + key (or type), letters and digits only. function qm.alias_name(key, t) return ((qm.settings.alias_prefix .. tostring(key or t)):lower():gsub("[^%w]", "")) end
-- Point a game alias at the commands; only sends SETALIAS when it changed. function qm.set_alias(name, cmds) local body = table.concat(cmds, qm.settings.alias_sep) if qm._aliases[name] == body then return true end if not acs.send("setalias " .. name .. " " .. body) then return false end qm._aliases[name] = body return true end
-- The entry waiting with this command (or alias name) and type, if any. function qm.find(cmd, t) cmd = tostring(cmd):lower() for _, e in ipairs(qm.items) do if e.cmd:lower() == cmd and (not t or e.type == t) then return e end end end
function qm.queue(cmds, opts) opts = opts or {} local list = qm.split(cmds) if #list == 0 then return false end local t = qm.valid_type(opts.type or qm.settings.type) if not t then qm.err("not a queue type: " .. tostring(opts.type)) return false end local mode = (opts.mode or "add"):lower() if not qm.MODES[mode] then qm.err("not a queue mode: " .. tostring(opts.mode)) return false end local idx = (mode == "insert" or mode == "replace") and ((tonumber(opts.index) or 1) .. " ") or "" local function one(m, cmd, meta) return qm.send(("queue %s %s %s%s"):format(m, t, m == mode and idx or "", cmd), meta) end if #list == 1 and not opts.alias then return one(mode, list[1], { key = opts.key, on_run = opts.on_run, cmds = list }) end if opts.together ~= false or opts.alias then if #qm.settings.alias_sep == 0 then qm.err("set the in-game alias separator first: qm asep /") return false end if #list > qm.ALIAS_MAX then qm.err(("%d commands, a game alias holds %d"):format(#list, qm.ALIAS_MAX)) return false end local name = qm.alias_name(opts.key, t) if not qm.set_alias(name, list) then return false end -- already waiting on the queue: the new alias is what will run, so the -- queue is left alone (e.g. reapplying something cured mid-balance) local e = opts.alias and (mode == "add" or mode == "addclear") and qm.find(name, t) if e and acs.now() - e.at < qm.settings.reuse_for then e.cmds, e.on_run = list, opts.on_run qm.debug("rewrote " .. name .. ", still queued") return true end return one(mode, name, { key = opts.key, on_run = opts.on_run, cmds = list }) end local ok = true for i, c in ipairs(list) do local last = i == #list ok = one(i == 1 and mode or "add", c, { key = opts.key, on_run = last and opts.on_run or nil }) and ok end return ok end
local function short(mode) return function(cmds, t, opts) opts = acs.copy(opts or {}) opts.type, opts.mode = t or opts.type, mode return qm.queue(cmds, opts) end end qm.add = short("add") qm.addclear = short("addclear") qm.addclearfull = short("addclearfull") qm.prepend = short("prepend")
function qm.clear(t) t = t and tostring(t):lower() or "all" if t ~= "all" and not qm.valid_type(t) then qm.err("not a queue type: " .. t) return false end return qm.send("clearqueue " .. t) end
-- The short aliases: "qa [type] cmd|cmd". function qm.quick(mode, text) local w = acs.words(text) local t = qm.type_word(w[1]) local rest = text if t and #w > 1 then rest = text:match("^%s*%S+%s+(.*)$") else t = nil end if not rest or rest:match("^%s*$") then qm.err("what should be queued?") return false end return qm.queue(rest, { type = t, mode = mode, key = "you" }) end
function qm.describe(e) local what = table.concat(e.cmds or { e.cmd }, " | ") return ("<grey>[<white>%s<grey>]<reset> %s%s"):format(e.type, what, e.key and (" <dim_grey>(" .. e.key .. ")") or "") end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- QM commands: "qm help" lists them. The short aliases qa / qc / qp / qx -- are set up in 99_init.lua.
qm.command("list", function(w) if w[1] == "game" then qm.send("queue list") return end if #qm.items == 0 then qm.echo("nothing queued (as far as QM knows; <white>qm list game<reset> asks the game)") return end qm.echo(("<white>queued<reset> %d of %d"):format(#qm.items, qm.LIMIT)) for i, e in ipairs(qm.items) do cecho(("\n <grey>%2d. %s"):format(i, qm.describe(e))) end end, "list [game] what's queued (game: the game's own QUEUE LIST)")
qm.command("clear", function(w) qm.clear(w[1] or "all") end, "clear [type] clear one queue type, or everything")
qm.command("add", function(w, rest) qm.quick("add", rest) end, "add [type] cmds add to the end (same as qa); cmds split on your separator") qm.command("addclear", function(w, rest) qm.quick("addclear", rest) end, "addclear [type] cmds clear that queue type, then add (same as qc)") qm.command("prepend", function(w, rest) qm.quick("prepend", rest) end, "prepend [type] cmds put at the front (same as qp)")
qm.command("type", function(w) if not w[1] then qm.echo("default queue type: <white>" .. qm.settings.type) return end local t = qm.valid_type(w[1]) if not t then qm.err("not a queue type: " .. w[1] .. " (see qm types)") return end qm.settings.type = t qm.save() qm.echo("default queue type: <white>" .. t) end, "type [t] default type for qa / qc / qp (eqbal)")
qm.command("types", function() qm.echo("<white>queue types") for _, t in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(qm.SIMPLE)) do cecho(("\n <white>%-10s<grey>%s"):format(t, qm.SIMPLE[t])) end cecho("\n <grey>or flags: e eq, b bal, c class, s ship, p paralysed, w bound, u upright, t stunned;") cecho("\n <grey>! before a flag inverts it. eb!p!t = eq, bal, not paralysed, not stunned") end, "types the queue types and custom flags")
qm.command("sep", function(w) if not w[1] then qm.echo("separator for qa / qc / qp: <white>" .. qm.settings.sep) return end qm.settings.sep = w[1] qm.save() qm.echo("separator for qa / qc / qp: <white>" .. w[1]) end, "sep [chars] what splits commands in qa / qc / qp (|)")
qm.command("asep", function(w) if not w[1] then qm.echo("in-game alias separator: <white>" .. qm.settings.alias_sep) return end qm.settings.alias_sep = w[1] qm.save() qm._aliases = {} qm.echo("in-game alias separator: <white>" .. w[1]) end, "asep [chars] what goes between commands in a game alias (/)")
qm.command("gag", function(w) qm.settings.gag = acs.onoff(w[1], qm.settings.gag) qm.save() qm.echo("queue lines " .. (qm.settings.gag and "hidden" or "shown")) end, "gag on|off hide the [System] queue lines")
qm.command("alerts", function(w) qm.settings.alerts = acs.onoff(w[1], qm.settings.alerts) qm.save() if qm.settings.alerts then acs.send("config showqueuealerts on") end qm.echo("queue alerts at login " .. (qm.settings.alerts and "on" or "off (QM can't see what ran)")) end, "alerts on|off turn the game's queue alerts on at login (needed to track)")
qm.command("auto", function(w) if w[1] ~= "on" and w[1] ~= "off" then qm.err("qm auto on|off") return end local on = w[1] == "on" acs.send("config usequeueing " .. (on and "on" or "off")) qm.echo("game auto queueing " .. (on and "on" or "off")) end, "auto on|off the game's own auto queueing (CONFIG USEQUEUEING)")
qm.command("forget", function() qm.forget("all") qm._aliases = {} qm.echo("forgot the queue copy and the game aliases set") end, "forget reset QM's copy if it's wrong (sends nothing)")

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- QM startup: the game's queue lines, the short aliases, and login. -- Re-importing is safe: acs.module in 01_qm.lua removes the old ones first.
function qm.install_triggers() qm.trigger([[^\[System\]: Running queued (\S+) command: (.+)$]], function(m) qm.on_running(m[2], m[3]) if qm.settings.gag then deleteLine() end end) qm.trigger([[^Cleared your queues\.$]], function() qm.forget("all") if qm.settings.gag then deleteLine() end end) qm.trigger([[^\[System\]: Your queue is full\.$]], function() qm.on_full() end) qm.trigger([[^\[System\]: (?:Added|Prepended|Inserted|Replaced|Removed|Queued) ]], function() if qm.settings.gag then deleteLine() end end) end
function qm.install_aliases() qm.alias([[^qa\s+(.+)$]], function(m) qm.quick("add", m[2]) end) qm.alias([[^qc\s+(.+)$]], function(m) qm.quick("addclear", m[2]) end) qm.alias([[^qp\s+(.+)$]], function(m) qm.quick("prepend", m[2]) end) qm.alias([[^qx$]], function() qm.clear("all") end) end
function qm.init() qm.install_triggers() qm.install_aliases() -- queue commands typed by hand, or sent by packages without qm.queue qm.on("sysDataSendRequest", function(_, line) if qm._sending then return end for _, part in ipairs(qm.split(line)) do qm.observe(part) end end) qm.on("acs.login", function() qm.forget("all") if qm.settings.alerts then acs.send("config showqueuealerts on") end end) qm.on("acs.logout", function() qm.forget("all") end) qm.echo(("loaded v%s. Type <white>qm help<reset>."):format(qm.version)) end
qm.init()

Script.name: data
Script.script:
-- SS data: afflictions, cures, priorities and general defences. -- -- Afflictions come from the shared reference (achaea_affs, bundled as -- 00b_afflictions.lua from achaea-shared/afflictions.lua): 200 afflictions -- with their cures, mineral twins, focus/tree eligibility and what each one -- blocks. The GMCP cure in Char.Afflictions.Add is always tried first; the -- reference is the fallback. Your own "ss cure <aff> <command>" beats both. -- Names are GMCP names (lowercase, no spaces); D.canon turns other -- spellings into them.
ss = ss or {} ss.data = ss.data or {} local D = ss.data D.AFF = achaea_affs D.ref = D.AFF
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Curatives: herb -> mineral, salve -> alchemical twin D.transmute = D.AFF.minerals D.mineral_to_herb = {} for h, m in pairs(D.transmute) do D.mineral_to_herb[m] = h end D.salve_alch = D.AFF.salve_alch D.alch_to_salve = {} for s, a in pairs(D.salve_alch) do D.alch_to_salve[a] = s end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Afflictions: D.affs[name] = the reference entry, plus -- cure list of fallback commands (the reference's cmds) for name, a in pairs(D.AFF.affs) do a.cure = a.cmds end D.affs = D.AFF.affs
-- Extra spellings seen in other systems. D.aff_aliases = { paralyzed = "paralysis", paralysed = "paralysis", asleep = "sleeping", sleep = "sleeping", sensitive = "sensitivity", deaf = "deafness", blind = "blindness", transfixed = "transfixation", impale = "impaled", inlove = "lovers", love = "lovers", pacifism = "pacified", }
-- Afflictions that block a cure channel. SS's channel names differ a little -- from the reference's (herb = eat, salve = apply), so map them here. D.blockers = { herb = { "anorexia" }, moss = { "anorexia" }, sip = { "anorexia" }, salve = {}, smoke = {}, focus = {}, tree = {}, writhe = {}, clot = {}, stand = { "paralysis" }, concentrate = {}, bal = {}, eq = {}, eqbal = {}, active = {}, all = {}, } D.CHANNEL = { eat = { "herb", "moss" }, apply = { "salve" }, smoke = { "smoke" }, focus = { "focus" }, tree = { "tree" }, writhe = { "writhe" }, clot = { "clot" }, moss = { "moss" }, sip = { "sip" }, concentrate = { "concentrate" }, physical = { "bal", "eqbal" }, eq = { "eq", "eqbal" }, active_cures = { "active" }, all = { "all" } } function D.add(ch, aff) for _, a in ipairs(D.blockers[ch]) do if a == aff then return end end table.insert(D.blockers[ch], aff) end for name, a in pairs(D.AFF.affs) do for _, b in ipairs(a.blocks or {}) do for _, ch in ipairs(D.CHANNEL[b] or {}) do D.add(ch, name) end end -- focusing with these hurts you, so treat focus as blocked for _, p in ipairs(a.punishes or {}) do if p == "focus" then D.add("focus", name) end end end
-- Afflictions you can't cure while you have another: cure -> { blockers } D.cure_blocked_by = {} for name, a in pairs(D.AFF.affs) do for _, t in ipairs(a.blocks_cure or {}) do D.cure_blocked_by[t] = D.cure_blocked_by[t] or {} table.insert(D.cure_blocked_by[t], name) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Default cure priorities (1 = first). Anything not listed gets 20. Only -- names in the reference are sent to serverside curing. D.default_prios = { -- locks and their components first paralysis = 1, sleeping = 1, sandfever = 3, anorexia = 2, slickness = 2, impatience = 3, asthma = 3, voyria = 4, bound = 4, webbed = 4, impaled = 4, transfixation = 4, entangled = 5, prone = 5, -- dangerous for survival ablaze = 5, haemophilia = 6, frozen = 6, hypothermia = 6, crushedthroat = 6, mangledhead = 6, damagedhead = 7, stupidity = 7, confusion = 7, recklessness = 7, disloyalty = 7, -- limb pressure mangledleftleg = 7, mangledrightleg = 7, mangledleftarm = 8, mangledrightarm = 8, brokenleftleg = 8, brokenrightleg = 8, brokenleftarm = 9, brokenrightarm = 9, damagedleftleg = 9, damagedrightleg = 9, damagedleftarm = 10, damagedrightarm = 10, serioustrauma = 8, crackedribs = 10, -- common kelp/ginseng stacks clumsiness = 10, weariness = 11, sensitivity = 9, nausea = 11, darkshade = 10, addiction = 12, lethargy = 11, scytherus = 9, healthleech = 12, hypochondria = 15, -- mental / misc dizziness = 12, epilepsy = 12, shyness = 14, dissonance = 13, depression = 14, masochism = 12, agoraphobia = 13, claustrophobia = 14, vertigo = 13, loneliness = 15, dementia = 12, hallucinations = 13, paranoia = 13, hypersomnia = 12, pacified = 11, peace = 11, generosity = 13, justice = 13, lovers = 14, retribution = 12, timeloop = 10, shivering = 12, deafness = 16, blindness = 16, itching = 16, stuttering = 15, indifference = 15, aeon = 2, deadening = 10, hellsight = 12, manaleech = 14, bleeding = 15, disrupted = 6, }
for aff in pairs(D.default_prios) do if not D.AFF.affs[aff] then D.default_prios[aff] = nil end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Defences. cmd = how to raise it, bal = what it needs/uses: -- "free" no balance needed "eqbal" needs balance+equilibrium -- "herb"/"salve"/"sip"/"smoke" curative balances -- These are the defences any class can have. Class skill defences live in -- 02_classes.lua; anything else is learned in game ("ss keepup learn") and -- fixed with "ss defcmd <def> <command>". D.defs = { -- curatives, any class insomnia = { cmd = "eat cohosh", bal = "herb" }, deafness = { cmd = "eat hawthorn", bal = "herb" }, blindness = { cmd = "eat bayberry", bal = "herb" }, kola = { cmd = "eat kola", bal = "herb" }, insulation = { cmd = "apply caloric", bal = "salve" }, density = { cmd = "apply mass", bal = "salve" }, levitating = { cmd = "sip levitation", bal = "sip" }, speed = { cmd = "sip speed", bal = "sip" }, temperance = { cmd = "sip frost", bal = "sip" }, venom = { cmd = "sip venom", bal = "sip" }, rebounding = { cmd = "smoke skullcap", bal = "smoke" }, -- tattoos (equilibrium/balance free in Achaea but need a hand) cloak = { cmd = "touch cloak", bal = "free" }, mindseye = { cmd = "touch mindseye", bal = "free" }, -- common general/skill defences; most need bal+eq deathsight = { cmd = "deathsight", bal = "eqbal" }, thirdeye = { cmd = "thirdeye", bal = "eqbal" }, nightsight = { cmd = "nightsight", bal = "eqbal" }, selfishness = { cmd = "selfishness", bal = "eqbal" }, clinging = { cmd = "cling", bal = "eqbal" }, shield = { cmd = "touch shield", bal = "eqbal", nokeepup = true }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Lookup helpers
function D.canon(name) if not name then return nil end local n = acs.norm(name) return D.aff_aliases[n] or D.AFF.canon(n) end
function D.info(aff) return D.affs[D.canon(aff)] end
function D.known(aff) return D.affs[D.canon(aff)] ~= nil end

Script.name: class data
Script.script:
-- SS class data: active cures, passives and skill defences, for any class. -- -- Nothing here is tied to one class. Each entry names the ability it uses -- ("skill"); SS asks Achaea which abilities you have (GMCP Char.Skills) and -- only offers what your current character can actually do. "classes" is a -- hint for listings and for other packages (e.g. offense guessing what an -- enemy of that class can cure), not a requirement. -- -- Everything is editable in game and saved per character: -- ss active add <name> <bal> <cd> <command> a new active cure -- ss active cures <name> <aff> [aff...]|any what it is used for -- ss passive add <name> <def|always> <ignore|delay> <aff> [aff...] -- ss defcmd <def> <command>[@bal] -- -- The starter entries are written from knowledge of Achaea and have not -- been checked against a live character: confirm the command and cooldown -- with AB <skillset> <ability> in game, and correct them with the commands -- above.
ss = ss or {} ss.data = ss.data or {} local D = ss.data
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Active cures: things you do that cure afflictions or restore vitals. -- cmd what to send -- cures list of afflictions it is worth using for; "any" for abilities -- that cure a random/several afflictions (used when min or more -- afflictions are waiting); "health" / "mana" for vitals heals -- at for health/mana: use under this percent -- bal what it needs: bal, eq, eqbal, free (see 03_engine.lua) -- cd seconds before it can be used again -- skill ability name as GMCP Char.Skills lists it -- blocked_by afflictions that make it fail; "a+b" means only when you -- have all of them -- Classes and balances checked against the wiki skill pages (2026-10-26); -- "classes" is only for listings, the skill decides whether it's used. D.actives = { fitness = { cmd = "fitness", cures = { "asthma" }, bal = "bal", cd = 20, skill = "fitness", classes = { "monk", "blademaster", "runewarden", "paladin", "infernal", "unnamable", "druid", "sentinel" }, note = "Clears asthma. Druids and Sentinels only in a morph that has it." }, shrugging = { cmd = "shrug", cures = "any", min = 3, bal = "eqbal", cd = 10, skill = "shrugging", classes = { "serpent" }, note = "Venom: cures a venom affliction." }, restore = { cmd = "restore", bal = "eqbal", cd = 20, skill = "restore", cures = { "brokenleftleg", "brokenrightleg", "brokenleftarm", "brokenrightarm", "crippledleftleg", "crippledrightleg", "crippledleftarm", "crippledrightarm" }, note = "Mends broken limbs (Survival, so anyone; Kaido too)." }, transmute = { cmd = "transmute 300", cures = "health", at = 45, bal = "free", cd = 3, skill = "transmute", classes = { "monk" }, note = "Turns mana into health." }, rage = { cmd = "rage", bal = "bal", cd = 10, skill = "rage", cures = { "pacifism", "peace", "inlove", "generosity", "justice" }, classes = { "runewarden", "paladin", "infernal", "unnamable", "sylvan" }, note = "Clears attitude afflictions. Sylvan: with bellwort propagated on the head." }, dragonheal = { cmd = "dragonheal", cures = "any", min = 3, bal = "eqbal", cd = 60, skill = "dragonheal", blocked_by = { "weariness+recklessness" }, classes = { "dragon" }, note = "Cures afflictions." }, bloodboil = { cmd = "cast bloodboil", cures = "any", min = 3, bal = "eqbal", cd = 30, skill = "bloodboil", blocked_by = { "haemophilia" }, classes = { "magi" }, note = "Elementalism: cures an affliction." }, fool = { cmd = "fling fool at me", cures = "any", min = 4, bal = "bal", cd = 35, skill = "fool", classes = { "occultist", "jester" }, note = "Tarot Fool: cures several afflictions." }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Passives: things that cure or prevent afflictions without you acting. -- While a passive is in effect SS stops spending curatives on its -- afflictions ("ignore"), or waits "wait" seconds before curing them itself -- ("delay", for passives that usually but not always clear it in time). -- def the GMCP defence that shows it is up, or nil if always on for -- characters who have the skill -- skill ability name, when there is no defence to watch D.passives = { constitution = { def = "constitution", affs = { "nausea" }, effect = "ignore", classes = { "monk" }, note = "Kaido: no nausea." }, insomnia = { def = "insomnia", affs = { "hypersomnia" }, effect = "delay", wait = 4, note = "Insomnia makes hypersomnia harmless for a while." }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Class skill defences: commands and balances for defences that keepup -- should raise. "ss keepup learn" adds whatever you have up; these entries -- only fix the command where it isn't simply the defence name. D.class_defs = { monk = { consciousness = { cmd = "consciousness on", bal = "free" }, constitution = { cmd = "constitution", bal = "eqbal" }, toughness = { cmd = "toughness", bal = "eqbal" }, resistance = { cmd = "resistance", bal = "eqbal" }, weathering = { cmd = "weathering", bal = "eqbal" }, vitality = { cmd = "vitality", bal = "eqbal" }, splitmind = { cmd = "split mind", bal = "eqbal" }, }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Views by class, for listings and for other packages.
function D.for_class(cls) cls = acs.norm(cls) local r = { actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = D.class_defs[cls] or {} } for kind, src in pairs({ actives = D.actives, passives = D.passives }) do for name, e in pairs(src) do local hit = false for _, c in ipairs(e.classes or {}) do if c == cls then hit = true end end if hit then r[kind][#r[kind] + 1] = name end end table.sort(r[kind]) end return r end
D.classes = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, cls) return D.for_class(cls) end })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Class scripts (src/classes/*.lua): one per class, each with slots for its -- subclasses. A script describes what curing should do differently while -- you play that class: -- -- ss.class_script("monk", { -- skills = { "tekura", "telepathy", "kaido" }, -- for reference -- aliases = { ... }, -- other GMCP class names it covers -- prios = { aff = prio }, -- this class's priority table, always on -- situations = { -- tables for when you're in a spot, in order -- { name = "shielded", when = { "shield" }, prios = { paralysis = 25 } }, -- }, -- (fields in 04_prio.lua; later wins) -- against = { prios = {}, situations = {}, subclasses = {}, default_sub, signs }, -- -- fighting someone of this class (11_opponent.lua) -- actives = { name = entry }, -- same fields as D.actives above -- passives = { name = entry }, -- same fields as D.passives above -- defs = { def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" } }, -- keepup commands -- subclasses = { shikudo = { prios = {}, situations = {}, actives = {}, ... } }, -- detect = function() return "shikudo" end, -- which subclass you are -- on_enter = function(sub) end, -- you switched to this class -- on_leave = function() end, -- on_tick = function() end, -- each heartbeat/prompt while this class -- }) -- -- "ss subclass <name>" overrides detect. Everything is optional. There's no -- group fight table: with more than one person hitting you the situations -- just stay off (04_prio.lua).
-- Situations for every class, under each class's own (AW, 2026-10-26). local LEGS = "brokenleftleg|brokenrightleg|damagedleftleg|damagedrightleg|mangledleftleg|mangledrightleg" local DAMAGED_LEGS = "damagedleftleg|damagedrightleg|mangledleftleg|mangledrightleg" local OTHER_LIMBS = { "brokenleftarm", "brokenrightarm", "damagedleftarm", "damagedrightarm", "mangledleftarm", "mangledrightarm", "damagedhead", "mangledhead", "mildtrauma", "serioustrauma" } local function all(list, p) local t = {} for _, a in ipairs(list) do t[a] = p end return t end local legs_first = all(OTHER_LIMBS, 25) for a in LEGS:gmatch("[^|]+") do legs_first[a] = 2 end D.situations = { -- Legs prepped or hurt: salves go on legs only, so you can stand and leave -- and won't get another damaged leg within 4s. Head, torso, arms wait. { name = "legs first", when = { "prepped:legs|" .. LEGS }, prios = legs_first }, -- Prone with damaged legs: paralysis waits until you can stand. -- (AW: ideally only when herb balance and the legs come back before the -- opponent's balance; SS doesn't know their balance yet.) { name = "stand up", when = { "prone", DAMAGED_LEGS }, prios = { paralysis = 25 } }, }
-- Helpers for class scripts' against blocks. -- ss.prios_of("a b c", 3) -> { a = 3, b = 3, c = 3 }; ss.merge(t1, t2, ...) function ss.prios_of(names, p) local t = {} for a in tostring(names):gmatch("[%w]+") do t[a] = p end return t end function ss.merge(...) local r = {} for _, t in ipairs({ ... }) do for k, v in pairs(t) do r[k] = v end end return r end ss.LIMBS = { legs_broken = "brokenleftleg brokenrightleg", legs_damaged = "damagedleftleg damagedrightleg mangledleftleg mangledrightleg", arms_broken = "brokenleftarm brokenrightarm", arms_damaged = "damagedleftarm damagedrightarm mangledleftarm mangledrightarm", head = "damagedhead mangledhead", torso = "mildtrauma serioustrauma", } -- the same as "when" terms (a|b|c) function ss.any(...) local parts = {} for _, k in ipairs({ ... }) do for a in (ss.LIMBS[k] or k):gmatch("[%w]+") do parts[#parts + 1] = a end end return table.concat(parts, "|") end
-- Knight weapon styles (AW, 2026-10-26; old dwb/snb/2h/dwc swaps). Infernal, -- Paladin, Runewarden and Unnamable use these as their against.subclasses, -- with their own changes on top (ss.knight_styles(overrides)). local L = ss.LIMBS function ss.knight_styles(over) local styles = { -- SNB: leg/torso disembowel. Leg breaks, torso first (AW: fake apply to -- the leg, restoration to torso). The legs are held (26) meanwhile. swordandshield = { prios = {}, situations = { { name = "disembowel", when = { ss.any("legs_broken", "legs_damaged"), "prepped:torso|torso>=85|serioustrauma|mildtrauma" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(L.torso, 1), ss.prios_of(L.legs_broken .. " " .. L.legs_damaged, 26)), fake = "legs", preapply = "torso" }, } }, -- 2H: damage. Health affs above 60, 100 once legs go (old: 50 / 99). twohanded = { prios = ss.merge({ torntendons = 1, skullfractures = 2, crackedribs = 3, wristfractures = 4 }, ss.prios_of(L.torso .. " " .. L.head, 25)), situations = { { name = "2h damage", when = {}, prios = {}, set = { health_affs_above = 60 } }, { name = "2h legs", when = { "torntendons>4|" .. ss.any("legs_damaged") }, prios = {}, set = { health_affs_above = 100 } }, { name = "2h prone", when = { "prone" }, prios = { sensitivity = 1 } }, } }, -- DWB: vivisect, pulp (6 skull fractures or mangled head), assault. dualblunt = { prios = ss.merge({ paralysis = 1, sensitivity = 2, skullfractures = 1, damagedhead = 23, mangledhead = 23 }, ss.prios_of(L.arms_damaged .. " frozen shivering torntendons crackedribs wristfractures", 25), ss.prios_of(L.legs_damaged, 15)), situations = { { name = "dwb damage", when = {}, prios = {}, set = { health_affs_above = 99 } }, { name = "skull fractured", when = { "skullfractures" }, prios = {}, set = { health_affs_above = 50 } }, -- pulp: head first, blindness up (AW: tumble if you can) { name = "head prepped", when = { "prepped:head|head>=60&!skullfractures|damagedhead|mangledhead" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(L.head, 1), ss.prios_of(L.legs_damaged, 25)), defs = { blindness = 1 } }, -- assault head (AW): legs break with head prepped: fake apply to -- legs, then restoration to head, and you usually beat the execute { name = "assault head", when = { ss.any("legs_broken", "legs_damaged"), "prepped:head|damagedhead|mangledhead" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(L.head, 1), ss.prios_of(L.legs_broken .. " " .. L.legs_damaged, 26)), fake = "legs", preapply = "head" }, -- assault torso is damage: stand up and shield, don't tumble { name = "torso prepped", when = { "prepped:torso|serioustrauma", "!prepped:head" }, prios = ss.prios_of(L.legs_broken .. " " .. L.legs_damaged, 1) }, } }, -- DWC (Infernal's, AW): impatience over all, then paralysis, then -- nausea/haemophilia/healthleech. Vivisect (arms and legs damaged or -- broken): restoration while you have eq, mending while restore has it. dualcutting = { prios = { impatience = 1, paralysis = 2, haemophilia = 3, nausea = 3, healthleech = 3, asthma = 4, damagedhead = 25 }, situations = { { name = "vivisect: restoration", when = { ss.any("legs_damaged", "arms_damaged"), "!off:eq" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(L.legs_damaged, 1), ss.prios_of(L.arms_damaged, 2), ss.prios_of(L.legs_broken .. " " .. L.arms_broken, 25)) }, { name = "vivisect: mending", when = { ss.any("legs_damaged", "arms_damaged"), "off:eq" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(L.legs_broken, 1), ss.prios_of(L.arms_broken, 2), ss.prios_of(L.legs_damaged .. " " .. L.arms_damaged, 25)) }, } }, } for style, o in pairs(over or {}) do local st = styles[style] if o.prios then st.prios = ss.merge(st.prios, o.prios) end for _, sit in ipairs(o.situations or {}) do st.situations[#st.situations + 1] = sit end end return styles end
ss.classes = ss.classes or {} local CL = ss.classes CL.scripts = CL.scripts or {} CL.aliases = CL.aliases or {} CL._merged = CL._merged or { actives = {}, passives = {} }
function ss.class_script(name, def) name = acs.norm(name) def = def or {} def.name = name def.subclasses = def.subclasses or {} CL.scripts[name] = def for _, a in ipairs(def.aliases or {}) do CL.aliases[acs.norm(a)] = name end return def end
function CL.key(cls) local n = acs.norm(cls or "none") return CL.aliases[n] or n end
function CL.current() return CL.scripts[CL.key(ss.class())] end
function CL.current_sub_name() local cs = CL.current() if not cs then return nil end local chosen = ss.settings and ss.settings.subclass[ss.class()] if chosen and cs.subclasses[chosen] then return chosen end if cs.detect then local ok, r = pcall(cs.detect) if ok and r and cs.subclasses[r] then return r end end return nil end
function CL.current_sub() local cs, n = CL.current(), CL.current_sub_name() return n and cs.subclasses[n] or nil end
function D.call(fn, ...) if not fn then return end local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...) if not ok then ss.err("class script: " .. tostring(err)) end end
-- Put the current class's (and subclass's) actives, passives and defence -- commands in place of the previous class's. Called on load and on every -- class or subclass change. function CL.apply(old) local prev = old and CL.scripts[CL.key(old)] if prev and prev ~= CL.current() then D.call(prev.on_leave) end -- put back whatever the last class script replaced for kind, list in pairs(CL._merged) do for i = #list, 1, -1 do D[kind][list[i].name] = list[i].prev end CL._merged[kind] = {} end local cs = CL.current() local cls = acs.norm(ss.class()) if cs then local layers = { cs, CL.current_sub() } D.class_defs[cls] = D.class_defs[cls] or {} for _, l in ipairs(layers) do for _, kind in ipairs({ "actives", "passives" }) do for n, e in pairs(l[kind] or {}) do table.insert(CL._merged[kind], { name = n, prev = D[kind][n] }) e.classes = e.classes or { cls } D[kind][n] = e end end for d, e in pairs(l.defs or {}) do D.class_defs[cls][d] = e end end if prev ~= cs then D.call(cs.on_enter, CL.current_sub_name()) end end if ss.prio then ss.prio.changed() end end
function CL.tick() local cs = CL.current() if cs then D.call(cs.on_tick) end end

Script.script:
-- SS class scripts, one per class (src/classes/).
do -- alchemist -- SS class script: Alchemist. What curing does differently while you play -- Alchemist. Empty on purpose: fill it in together, one class at a time. -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua.
ss.class_script("alchemist", { skills = { "alchemy", "physiology", "formulation" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- AW: paralysis first, then any humour, then everything else. prios = { paralysis = 1, temperedcholeric = 2, temperedmelancholic = 2, temperedphlegmatic = 2, temperedsanguine = 2 }, situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { ... }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- Cures are random among what a herb can cure: a humour prio only says -- how early to eat ginger while it's up, never which humour goes. subclasses = { formulation = { prios = {}, situations = { -- Inundate (AB): drains a tempered humour at once, more fluid, bigger -- hit. Choleric health, melancholic mana, sanguine bleeding, -- phlegmatic lethargy/anorexia/slickness/weariness. 100 mana, 1.7s. -- AW: phlegmatic 6 (8 with fitness) plus asthma or impatience, then -- inundate kills. Starts one stack early so ginger has time to land. { name = "phlegm kill", when = { "phlegmatic>=5&!has:fitness|phlegmatic>=7", "asthma|impatience" }, prios = { asthma = 1, impatience = 1 } }, -- AW: choleric 8 (6 with sensitivity), then inundate usually kills. -- Near 6 with sensitivity, sensitivity goes first: it's the cheap -- way out of the kill. Without it humours are already at 2. { name = "choler kill", when = { "choleric>=5", "sensitivity" }, prios = { sensitivity = 1 } }, } }, -- Sublimation (AW's AB text): inundate halved for choleric, melancholic, -- sanguine; phlegmatic inundate gives lethargy, anorexia, slickness at -- 2, 6, 8 tempers (no weariness). Residual wracks: choleric unblockable -- damage, melancholic mana damage, sanguine bleeding, phlegmatic over 2 -- ignores clumsiness and over 5 is faster. All scale with tempers. -- AW: Sublimation kills mostly through mana and health, so clotting -- (which costs mana) hurts: keep mana at 75% or more, which also keeps -- you out of disruption range. sublimation = { clot_min_mana = 75, sipmana = 75, prios = {}, situations = { { name = "phlegm lock", when = { "phlegmatic>=5" }, prios = { anorexia = 3, slickness = 3 } }, } }, }, default_sub = "formulation", -- when we can't tell which clot_min_mana = 61, -- aurification kills at 60% health and mana: don't clot mana under it signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = { formulation = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- Formulation (the usual third skill) sublimation = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- Sublimation (Hashan-aligned Alchemists can swap it in for Formulation) }, detect = nil, -- function() return "<subclass>" end
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end
do -- apostate -- SS class script: Apostate. What curing does differently while you play -- Apostate. Your own class tables are empty for now; the against block is -- AW's draft. -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua.
ss.class_script("apostate", { skills = { "apostasy", "necromancy", "evileye" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- AW: Apostates kill through locks nearly every time. They stack kelp -- affs (to bury asthma) and smoke affs, and use manaleech as the gate -- for slickness: sicken gives paralysis, then manaleech, then slickness. -- AW: realistically keep paralysis on top, and put curseward up (it -- stops evileye) when in trouble. The rest is the base table. -- Curseward (AB): CURSEWARD, 250 mana, 4.5s equilibrium. -- AW: parahold stays on: while paralysis waits, asthma and impatience -- come off faster, and those are what you want gone first. -- AW: manaleech comes a balance before slickness: smoking it off in that -- window means the next sicken has no gate. Valerian only competes with -- other smoke cures, so this is about manaleech before hellsight etc. prios = { paralysis = 1, asthma = 2, impatience = 2, manaleech = 3 }, situations = { -- AW: curseward up any time manaleech is stuck: asthma means you can't -- smoke valerian for it. "ss sit vs curseward off" if you'd rather do it by hand. { name = "curseward", when = { "manaleech", "asthma" }, prios = {}, defs = { curseward = 1 } }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = {}, detect = nil,
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end
do -- bard -- SS class script: Bard. What curing does differently while you play -- Bard. Empty on purpose: fill it in together, one class at a time. -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua. -- Cyrene's Bards can recite Woe.
ss.class_script("bard", { skills = { "bladedance", "composition", "sagas" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- Wiki (Bladedance, Composition, Sagas, Woe): Endbringer (Sagas) and -- Slith (Woe) are channelled kills, faster with crescendo, but AW: -- crescendo isn't a big deal any more. Most of the time it's a lock, so -- cure by what your limbs look like. -- AW: a Bard does 21% per limb hit. From 79% (one hit off a break) cure -- kelp affs; once a limb breaks, cure the lock affs: impatience or -- asthma, whichever herb has fewer affs on you (so the random cure is -- likelier to take it), impatience on a tie, kelp if you have fitness. limb_hit = 21, prios = { paralysis = 1, crescendo = 20 }, situations = { -- one hit off a break { name = "prebreak", when = { "limb>=79", "breaks=0" }, prios = { asthma = 2, clumsiness = 2, weariness = 2, sensitivity = 2, healthleech = 2 } }, -- broken: the lock pieces { name = "break: impatience", when = { "breaks>=1", "impatience", "goldenseal<=kelp&!has:fitness|!asthma" }, prios = { impatience = 1, asthma = 2 } }, { name = "break: asthma", when = { "breaks>=1", "asthma", "kelp<goldenseal|has:fitness|!impatience" }, prios = { asthma = 1, impatience = 2 } }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = {}, detect = nil,
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end
do -- blademaster -- SS class script: Blademaster. What curing does differently while you play -- Blademaster. The against block is from AW's notes (docs/aw-class-notes.md). -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua.
ss.class_script("blademaster", { skills = { "twoarts", "striking", "shindo" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- AW: three kill paths. Brokenstar (bleeding over 500; internalbleeding -- and a broken torso raise the clot's mana cost), the frozen limb route -- (leg and arm breaks with freezing), and locks (not real). For both -- real ones: legs only, so you can leave. Head, torso, arms and -- impaleslash (internalbleeding) wait. Old swaps: frozen 1, shivering 25. -- AW: limb damage depends on stance (and artefacts). Stance lines and -- AW's damage table (ar.blademaster.limbDamages) are below. Hits are -- logged by stance ("ss limbs log") to check the table. The table only -- gives "ss limbs hit" its default (slash1 in the current stance); -- real hits use the game's own "has dealt X%" numbers. limb_hit = 17.3, stance_lines = { { [[^([\w'\-]+) takes up the Arash stance\.$]], stance = "arash" }, { [[^([\w'\-]+) sinks into the Sanya stance\.$]], stance = "sanya" }, { [[^With a flourish\, ([\w'\-]+) enters the Thyr stance\.$]], stance = "thyr" }, { [[^([\w'\-]+) enters the flowing Mir stance\.$]], stance = "mir" }, { [[^([\w'\-]+) drops into the Doya stance\.$]], stance = "doya" }, { [[^([\w'\-]+) shifts [\w'\-]+ weight\, adopting a neutral stance\.$]], stance = "none" }, }, stance_damage = { none = { draw = 17.4, slash1 = 17.3, slash2 = 11.5, compass = 18.4 }, doya = { draw = 19, slash1 = 18.9, slash2 = 12.6, compass = 21 }, thyr = { draw = 15, slash1 = 14.9, slash2 = 10, compass = 15.8 }, mir = { draw = 16.6, slash1 = 16.5, slash2 = 11, compass = 17.5 }, arash = { draw = 19.9, slash1 = 19.8, slash2 = 13.2, compass = 21 }, sanya = { draw = 18.2, slash1 = 18.1, slash2 = 12.1, compass = 19.3 }, }, prios = ss.merge({ frozen = 1, hypochondria = 4, impatience = 5, shivering = 25, clumsiness = 25, internalbleeding = 25 }, ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_broken, 2), ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 3), ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.arms_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.arms_damaged .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.head .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.torso, 24)), situations = { -- old swaps: internal bleeding, sip mana over health { name = "internal bleeding", when = { "internalbleeding" }, prios = {}, set = { sip_priority = "mana" } }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = {}, detect = nil,
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end

AW's old -- swaps, which work well. prios = { paralysis = 1, timeloop = 2, hypochondria = 4, shadowmadness = 5, depression = 5, retribution = 5, parasite = 5, asthma = 6, clumsiness = 7, impatience = 8 }, situations = {}, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }

Apply to legs unless arm(s) and torso are prepped: -- they can swipe arm and torso together, so then torso, legs, arms. limb_hit = 25, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 2), ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.arms_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.arms_damaged, 6)) }, }, subclasses = { red = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, black = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, silver = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, golden = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, blue = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, green = { prios = {}, situations = {} }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = { red = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, black = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, silver = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, golden = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, blue = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, green = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, }, detect = nil, -- function() return "<subclass>" end

They kill with all four limbs broken and can -- break three at once; may not be survivable. Arms first (pre-apply to -- arms if they break a leg first), and shield. prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.arms_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.arms_damaged, 2), ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 3)), situations = { { name = "arms first", when = { ss.any("legs_broken", "legs_damaged", "arms_broken", "arms_damaged") }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.arms_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 3)) }, { name = "breaks: shield", when = { "breaks>=2" }, prios = {}, defs = { shield = 1 } }, -- a leg broke first: restoration on the arms before they go { name = "leg first: pre-apply arms", when = { ss.any("legs_broken", "legs_damaged"), "!" .. ss.any("arms_broken", "arms_damaged") }, prios = {}, preapply = "arms" }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }

ss.class_script("elementallord", { skills = { }, aliases = { "airlord", "earthlord", "firelord", "waterlord" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { prios = { paralysis = 1 }, situations = {}, subclasses = { -- AW: kills with smoking affs; get those off before pressure. do -- sylvan -- SS class script: Sylvan. What curing does differently while you play -- Sylvan. The against block is from AW's notes (docs/aw-class-notes.md). -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua.
ss.class_script("sylvan", { skills = { "groves", "propagation", "weatherweaving" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- AW: heartseed kills. 25% a hit (12.5 vinewreathed). Hold leg applies -- once torso is prepped; heartseed first. Off focus balance, dizziness -- or confusion over paralysis (lock). Damage kills: leave the room. -- Leg broken with torso prepped: fake apply to legs, legs held (26). -- Blackout with torso prepped: fake apply to legs, then restoration to -- torso twice (torso and heartseed); AW waits 1.8s, SS goes on salve -- balance. limb_hit = 25, prios = { brokenrightleg = 2, brokenleftleg = 2, heartseed = 3 }, situations = { { name = "torso prepped", when = { "torso>=75|prepped:torso" }, prios = ss.merge(ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 26), ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.arms_damaged, 25)), fake = "legs" }, { name = "blackout", when = { "blackout", "torso>=75|prepped:torso" }, prios = ss.prios_of(ss.LIMBS.legs_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, 26), fake = "legs", preapply = "torso" }, { name = "heartseed", when = { "heartseed" }, prios = { heartseed = 1 } }, { name = "off focus", when = { "off:focus" }, prios = { dizziness = 1, confusion = 1 } }, }, signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = {}, detect = nil,
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end
do -- unnamable -- SS class script: Unnamable. What curing does differently while you play -- Unnamable. The against block is from AW's notes (docs/aw-class-notes.md). -- Field reference is at the bottom of 02_classes.lua. -- Subclasses are the Weaponmastery specialisations. Pick yours with 'ss subclass <name>' until detect() is written.
ss.class_script("unnamable", { skills = { "anathema", "weaponmastery", "dominion" },
prios = {}, -- aff = prio, always on while you're this class situations = {}, -- { name = "...", when = { "aff", "def" }, prios = { aff = prio } }, in order -- against this class: what to cure when the person hitting you plays it -- (one on one; fields in 11_opponent.lua) against = { -- AW's old swaps: horror ahead of paralysis once a limb is damaged. prios = { paralysis = 1, nausea = 2, horror = 3, asthma = 4 }, situations = { { name = "damaged limb", when = { ss.any("legs_damaged", "arms_damaged", "head") }, prios = { horror = 1, addiction = 2, asthma = 3, paralysis = 25 } }, }, subclasses = ss.knight_styles(), signs = {}, -- subclass = { "lua pattern", ... }: lines that give it away }, actives = {}, -- class skill cures passives = {}, -- things that cure or prevent afflictions on their own defs = {}, -- def = { cmd = "...", bal = "eqbal" }
subclasses = { swordandshield = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- sword and shield twohanded = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- two-handed dualcutting = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- dual cutting dualblunt = { prios = {}, actives = {}, passives = {}, defs = {} }, -- dual blunt }, detect = nil, -- function() return "<subclass>" end
on_enter = nil, -- function(subclass) end on_leave = nil, on_tick = nil, -- each heartbeat/prompt while you're this class }) end

Script.name: state
Script.script:
-- SS state: settings, and everything GMCP tells us about you: vitals, -- balances, afflictions, defences, skills and rift contents. -- -- Other packages can read (but shouldn't write): -- ss.affs[aff] { since, cure, desc } ss.has(aff) -- ss.defs[def] true while up ss.def_up(def) -- ss.bals[name] balance, equilibrium, herb, salve, smoke, sip, moss, -- focus, tree, ... (false while used) -- ss.vitals hp, maxhp, hpp, mp, mpp, ep, wp, ... stats.bleed -- ss.skills[ability] true for abilities and skill groups you have -- Events: "ss.aff.gained"(aff), "ss.aff.lost"(aff), "ss.def.up"(def), -- "ss.def.down"(def), "ss.balance"(name, available), "ss.vitals".
ss = ss or {} ss.version = "0.5.0"
ss.default_settings = { enabled = true, -- master switch for automatic actions mode = "server", -- "server": Achaea's serverside curing cures, SS adds the rest -- "client": SS sends every cure itself -- curative items (client mode) outrift = true, -- "outr <herb>" before eating transmute = false, -- always use minerals instead of herbs pipes = {}, -- herb -> pipe id, if you need "smoke <id>" -- vitals, percent of max siphealth = 70, sipmana = 60, mosshealth = 50, mossmana = 40, clot_at = 60, clot_min_mana = 40, clot_health = 80, -- clot_health: with corrupted humours clot_to = 0, -- CURING CLOTTO (0 = leave serverside's) -- more serverside options (06_server.lua; "ss options") server_insomnia = true, server_reporting = true, focus_guilt = false, focus_fulminated = false, -- focus while guilt / fulminated server_rejection = "", server_aeonlikeret = "", -- "on" / "off", "" = leave serverside's def_preempt = {}, -- def -> true: CURING PRIORITY DEFENCE ... PREEMPT -- priorities: lower number is cured first (1..25, as serverside) prio_profile = "default", prio_profiles = {}, class_profile = {}, -- class -> profile name to switch to on class change swaps = {}, -- saved priority swaps: name -> { aff = prio } -- your own priority tables (04_prio.lua), "general", per class, or -- "vs <class>" for fighting that class: -- { prios = {}, sits = { name = { when, prios } }, order = { names }, off = { name = true } } prio_tables = {}, prio_echo = true, -- echo when situations come on or go off group_mode = "auto", -- "auto" (by attackers), "on", "off" group_size = 2, -- this many people hitting you is a group fight group_window = 15, -- seconds since their last hit vs = "auto", -- opponent class for the vs tables: "auto" (who's hitting you) or a class vs_sub = "", -- opponent subclass, when you set one ("" = detect) prio_batch = 50, -- aff/prio pairs per CURING PRIORITY command subclass = {}, -- class -> subclass you chose (else the class script detects it) -- afflictions not to spend cures on: aff -> true ignore = {}, -- afflictions that share a name with a defence you keep up (blindness, -- deafness, insomnia) are left alone when this is on ignore_def_affs = true, -- defences, per class (05_keepup.lua): def -> priority 1-25 keepup_enabled = true, keepup = {}, -- keepup[class][def]: kept up all the time defup = {}, -- defup[class][def]: raised by "ss defup", then left to drop -- kept up while on, whatever the class; ss deftoggle <def> def_toggles = { rebounding = false, shield = false, curseward = false, endure = true }, -- commands sent before "ss defup", per class, split by | predefup = { sentinel = "wear artefacts|wear mail114690|wield shield457012 spear117409|morph jaguar" }, def_echo = true, -- "Gained <def>" / "Lost <def>" -- paralysis waits at 25 while you couldn't act anyway (10_parahold.lua) para_hold = true, exec_secs = 8, -- ss exec: how long "executing" lasts unless stopped sip_priority = "", -- "health" or "mana": CURING PRIORITY HEALTH|MANA ("" leaves serverside's) health_affs_above = "", -- CURING HEALTHAFFSABOVE ("" leaves serverside's) para_hold_on = {}, -- class -> "balance" | "equilibrium" | "both" bal_times = {}, -- class -> "balance <command>" -> seconds, learned keepup_in_combat = false, -- client mode: keep raising bal/eq defences while afflicted def_cmds = {}, -- def -> "command[@bal]" (client mode) -- active cures, per class: actives[class][name] = true/false; -- unset means "on if you have the skill" while auto_actives is on auto_actives = true, actives = {}, custom_actives = {}, -- name -> entry, added in game -- passives, per class: passives[class][name] = true/false (same rule) passives = {}, custom_passives = {}, cure_overrides = {}, -- aff -> command server_focus = true, -- let serverside use FOCUS server_tree = true, -- let serverside use the tree tattoo synced = {}, ui = false, }
ss.settings = acs.store("ss", ss.default_settings)
function ss.save() acs.save("ss") end
-- Fill in what a fresh or older settings file lacks. function ss.prepare_settings() local s = ss.settings if next(s.prio_profiles) == nil then s.prio_profiles.default = acs.copy(ss.data.default_prios) end if not s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile] then s.prio_profile = "default" end s.prio_profiles.default = s.prio_profiles.default or acs.copy(ss.data.default_prios) if type(s.synced.default) == "table" then s.synced = {} end -- older per-set layout -- older keepup lists were def -> true, and serverside got priority 10 for _, t in pairs(s.keepup) do for d, p in pairs(t) do if p == true then t[d] = 25 end end end if type(s.synced.__defs) == "table" then s.synced.defs = s.synced.defs or {} for d in pairs(s.synced.__defs) do s.synced.defs[d] = 10 end s.synced.__defs = nil end s.keepup_server = nil for name, e in pairs(s.custom_actives) do ss.data.actives[name] = e end for name, e in pairs(s.custom_passives) do ss.data.passives[name] = e end end
function ss.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "ss") end function ss.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "ss") end function ss.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "ss") end function ss.class() return acs.me.class or "none" end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Balances
ss.vitals = ss.vitals or { stats = {} } ss.affs = ss.affs or {} ss.defs = ss.defs or {} ss.skills = ss.skills or {} ss.rift = ss.rift or {} ss.bals = ss.bals or {}
-- Seconds each curative balance takes. If the recovery line doesn't come, -- SS assumes the balance is back after this plus ss.bal_lag. -- From AW: herb, moss, salve, smoke, focus, tree, sip, restoration. Renew -- is still an estimate. ss.bal_timeouts = { herb = 1.5, salve = 1.0, smoke = 1.5, sip = 4.5, moss = 6.0, focus = 2.5, tree = 14.0, renew = 20.0, -- these aren't real balances, just anti-spam windows -- writhing again while writhing makes it take longer (HELP ENTANGLEMENT), -- so writhe waits for the entanglement to go (see ss.remove_aff) writhe = 12.0, stand = 1.0, wake = 2.0, concentrate = 2.0, clot = 1.0, } -- Items whose balance differs from the rest of their kind: item -> seconds. -- Restoration (reconstructive, its alchemy form) takes longer than other salves. ss.item_bal_timeouts = { restoration = 4.0, reconstructive = 4.0 } ss.bal_lag = 0.3 -- allowance for the trip to Achaea and back ss._bal_timers = ss._bal_timers or {}
ss.CURATIVE_BALS = { "herb", "salve", "smoke", "sip", "moss", "focus", "tree", "renew", "writhe", "stand", "wake", "concentrate", "clot" }
function ss.set_bal(b, v) if ss.bals[b] ~= v then ss.bals[b] = v raiseEvent("ss.balance", b, v) end end
function ss.reset_bals() for _, b in ipairs(ss.CURATIVE_BALS) do ss.bals[b] = true end if ss.bals.balance == nil then ss.bals.balance = true end if ss.bals.equilibrium == nil then ss.bals.equilibrium = true end end ss.reset_bals()
function ss.bal_ready(b) if b == "free" then return true end if b == "bal" then return ss.bals.balance ~= false end if b == "eq" then return ss.bals.equilibrium ~= false end if b == "eqbal" then return ss.bals.balance ~= false and ss.bals.equilibrium ~= false end return ss.bals[b] ~= false end
-- Mark a curative balance used. It comes back on its recovery line or after -- the timeout, whichever is first. function ss.use_bal(b, timeout) if b == "bal" or b == "eq" or b == "eqbal" or b == "free" then return end ss.set_bal(b, false) if ss._bal_timers[b] then killTimer(ss._bal_timers[b]) end ss._bal_timers[b] = tempTimer((timeout or ss.bal_timeouts[b] or 2) + ss.bal_lag, function() ss._bal_timers[b] = nil if ss.bals[b] == false then ss.debug(b .. " balance assumed back (timeout)") ss.set_bal(b, true) ss.schedule() end end) end
function ss.gain_bal(b) if ss._bal_timers[b] then killTimer(ss._bal_timers[b]) ss._bal_timers[b] = nil end ss.set_bal(b, true) ss.schedule() end
-- Your line shows a cure was used, whoever sent it. If SS sent it, the -- balance is already marked (maybe with a longer time, as for restoration), -- so it's left alone. function ss.saw_bal(b) if ss.bals[b] ~= false then ss.use_bal(b) end end
