-- "You eat ...": moss and potash have their own balance, and anything else -- counts only if it's a curative herb or mineral, so a meal doesn't. function ss.saw_eat(text) text = tostring(text or ""):lower() for herb, mineral in pairs(ss.data.transmute) do for _, item in ipairs({ herb, mineral }) do if text:find("%f[%a]" .. item .. "%f[%A]") then ss.saw_bal((item == "moss" or item == "potash") and "moss" or "herb") return end end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Afflictions and defences
function ss.has(aff) return ss.affs[ss.data.canon(aff)] ~= nil end function ss.def_up(def) return ss.defs[acs.norm(def)] == true end function ss.aff_count() return acs.count(ss.affs) end
function ss.add_aff(item) if type(item) == "string" then item = { name = item } end item = item or {} -- stacking afflictions can come as "temperedcholeric (3)" local raw, n = tostring(item.name or ""):match("^(.-)%s*%((%d+)%)%s*$") local name = ss.data.canon(raw or item.name) if not name or name == "" then return end if acs.not_aff and acs.not_aff(name) then return end -- defences GMCP lists as afflictions local old = ss.affs[name] ss.affs[name] = { since = old and old.since or acs.now(), cure = item.cure and tostring(item.cure):lower() or (old and old.cure), desc = item.desc, count = tonumber(n) or (old and old.count) } if not old then if not ss.data.info(name) and not item.cure then ss.echo("<yellow>unknown affliction '" .. name .. "'<reset>: teach me with 'ss cure " .. name .. " <command>'") end raiseEvent("ss.aff.gained", name) end end
function ss.remove_aff(name) name = tostring(type(name) == "table" and name.name or name or ""):gsub("%s*%(%d+%)%s*$", "") name = ss.data.canon(name) if ss.affs[name] then ss.affs[name] = nil local info = ss.data.info(name) if info and info.writhe and ss.bals.writhe == false then ss.gain_bal("writhe") end raiseEvent("ss.aff.lost", name) end end
function ss.def_name(d) return acs.norm(type(d) == "table" and d.name or d) end
function ss.add_def(d) d = ss.def_name(d) if d and not ss.defs[d] then ss.defs[d] = true raiseEvent("ss.def.up", d) end end
function ss.remove_def(d) d = ss.def_name(d) if d and ss.defs[d] then ss.defs[d] = nil raiseEvent("ss.def.down", d) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP handlers. Achaea sends every number as a string.
function ss.pct(cur, max) if not cur or not max or max == 0 then return 100 end return math.floor(cur * 100 / max) end
function ss.on_vitals() local v = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if not v then return end local me = ss.vitals for _, k in ipairs({ "hp", "mp", "ep", "wp" }) do me[k], me["max" .. k] = tonumber(v[k]), tonumber(v["max" .. k]) me[k .. "p"] = ss.pct(me[k], me["max" .. k]) end -- charstats: { "Bleed: 0", "Rage: 23", ... } me.stats = {} for _, st in ipairs(type(v.charstats) == "table" and v.charstats or {}) do local k, val = tostring(st):match("^%s*([^:]+):%s*(.-)%s*$") if k then me.stats[k:lower()] = tonumber((val:gsub("%%", ""))) or val end end ss.set_bal("balance", tostring(v.bal) == "1") ss.set_bal("equilibrium", tostring(v.eq) == "1") raiseEvent("ss.vitals") ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_aff_list() local old = ss.affs ss.affs = {} for _, item in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List or {}) do local n = ss.data.canon(item.name or item) if old[n] then ss.affs[n] = old[n] end ss.add_aff(item) end for n in pairs(old) do if not ss.affs[n] then raiseEvent("ss.aff.lost", n) end end ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_aff_add() ss.add_aff(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add) ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_aff_remove() local r = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove if type(r) ~= "table" then r = { r } end for _, name in ipairs(r) do ss.remove_aff(name) end ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_def_list() local now = {} for _, d in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Defences.List or {}) do now[ss.def_name(d)] = true end ss._def_listing = true -- a whole list isn't worth a "Gained" line each for d in pairs(ss.defs) do if not now[d] then ss.remove_def(d) end end for d in pairs(now) do ss.add_def(d) end ss._def_listing = false ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_def_add() ss.add_def(gmcp.Char.Defences.Add) ss.schedule() end
function ss.on_def_remove() local r = gmcp.Char.Defences.Remove if type(r) ~= "table" or r.name then r = { r } end for _, d in ipairs(r) do ss.remove_def(d) end ss.schedule() end
-- Skills: Char.Skills.Groups lists your skill groups; we ask for each -- group's abilities so actives and passives know what you can use. function ss.on_skill_groups() ss.skills = {} for _, g in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Skills.Groups or {}) do local name = g.name or g ss.skills[acs.norm(name)] = true sendGMCP(('Char.Skills.Get {"group": "%s"}'):format(tostring(name):lower())) end end
function ss.on_skill_list() local l = gmcp.Char.Skills.List if not l or not l.list then return end for _, a in ipairs(l.list) do ss.skills[acs.norm(a)] = true end ss.schedule() end
function ss.has_skill(name) return name ~= nil and ss.skills[acs.norm(name)] == true end
-- Rift: IRE.Rift.List / Change { name, amount, desc } function ss.on_rift_list() ss.rift = {} for _, it in ipairs(gmcp.IRE.Rift.List or {}) do ss.rift[acs.norm(it.name)] = tonumber(it.amount) end end
function ss.on_rift_change() local it = gmcp.IRE.Rift.Change if it and it.name then ss.rift[acs.norm(it.name)] = tonumber(it.amount) end end
ss.gmcp_modules = { "Char 1", "Char.Afflictions 1", "Char.Defences 1", "Char.Skills 1", "IRE.Rift 1" }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The engine runs at most once per batch of incoming data: many GMCP -- messages arrive together around each prompt. ss._tick_pending = false function ss.schedule() if ss._tick_pending then return end ss._tick_pending = true tempTimer(0, function() ss._tick_pending = false local ok, err = pcall(ss.tick) if not ok then ss.err("tick: " .. tostring(err)) end end) end
function ss.tick() if not acs.online() then return end -- nothing goes out before login if ss.prio then ss.prio.on_tick() end if ss.classes then ss.classes.tick() end if ss.engine then ss.engine.run() end if ss.keepup then ss.keepup.run() end raiseEvent("ss.tick") end

Script.name: cure engine
Script.script:
-- SS cure engine. -- Client mode: for each free curative balance, cures the highest priority -- affliction it can, then vitals, active class cures, focus, tree and clot. -- Server mode: Achaea cures; the engine only runs class active cures, which -- serverside curing doesn't use.
ss.engine = ss.engine or {} local E = ss.engine
function E.prio(aff) return ss.prio.get(aff) end
-- Returns the affliction stopping this kind of cure, or nil. function E.blocked(bal) local B = ss.data.blockers for _, a in ipairs(B.all) do if ss.has(a) then if bal == "wake" and a == "sleeping" then return nil end return a end end for _, a in ipairs(B[bal] or {}) do if ss.has(a) then return a end end return nil end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Curative forms. Herb or mineral: transmute forces minerals; otherwise the -- inventory package (IN) or our own rift counts pick whichever you have.
function E.form(herb) local D = ss.data herb = D.mineral_to_herb[herb] or herb local mineral = D.transmute[herb] if not mineral then return herb end if ss.settings.transmute then return mineral end local inv = rawget(_G, "IN") if inv and inv.best_form then local ok, f = pcall(inv.best_form, herb) if ok and f then return f end end local h, m = ss.rift[herb], ss.rift[mineral] if h == 0 and m and m > 0 then return mineral end return herb end
function E.pipe(herb) local D = ss.data herb = D.mineral_to_herb[herb] or herb local inv = rawget(_G, "IN") local id = inv and inv.pipes_by_herb and inv.pipes_by_herb[herb] if not id or id == "" then id = ss.settings.pipes[herb] end if id and id ~= "" then return tostring(id) end return E.form(herb) end
function E.with_outrift(item, cmd) if ss.settings.outrift then return { "outr " .. item, cmd } end return { cmd } end
-- Turn a cure command ("EAT GOLDENSEAL", "apply epidermal to head") into -- { bal = ..., cmds = {...} }. function E.parse(cure) local c = tostring(cure):lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") local verb, rest = c:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") if verb == "eat" then local item = rest:gsub("^irid ", "") if item == "moss" or item == "potash" then item = E.form("moss") return { bal = "moss", cmds = E.with_outrift(item, "eat " .. item) } end item = E.form(item) return { bal = "herb", cmds = E.with_outrift(item, "eat " .. item) } elseif verb == "apply" then local item = rest:match("^(%S+)") return { bal = "salve", cmds = { c }, wait = ss.item_bal_timeouts[item] } elseif verb == "smoke" then return { bal = "smoke", cmds = { "smoke " .. E.pipe(rest) } } elseif verb == "sip" or verb == "drink" then return { bal = "sip", cmds = { "sip " .. rest } } elseif verb == "focus" then return { bal = "focus", cmds = { "focus" } } elseif (verb == "touch" and rest:find("tree")) or verb == "tree" then return { bal = "tree", cmds = { "touch tree" } } elseif verb == "writhe" or verb == "stand" or verb == "wake" or verb == "concentrate" or verb == "clot" then return { bal = verb, cmds = { verb } } end -- anything else (a class skill) is treated as a balance+equilibrium action return { bal = "eqbal", cmds = { c } } end
-- Every way we know to cure an affliction, best first. function E.cures_for(aff) local list = {} local over = ss.settings.cure_overrides[aff] if over then list[#list + 1] = over end local a = ss.affs[aff] if a and a.cure and a.cure ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = a.cure end local info = ss.data.info(aff) for _, c in ipairs(info and info.cure or {}) do list[#list + 1] = c end return list end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Which afflictions to leave alone right now, and why.
function E.enabled_for_class(kind, name, entry) local t = ss.settings[kind][ss.class()] local v = t and t[name] if v ~= nil then return v end if not ss.settings.auto_actives then return false end return entry.skill ~= nil and ss.has_skill(entry.skill) end
function E.active_on(name) local e = ss.data.actives[name] return e ~= nil and E.enabled_for_class("actives", name, e) end
function E.passive_on(name) local p = ss.data.passives[name] if not p then return false end if p.def then -- a passive tied to a defence counts whenever that defence is up, -- unless it was switched off for this class local t = ss.settings.passives[ss.class()] if t and t[name] == false then return false end return ss.def_up(p.def) end return E.enabled_for_class("passives", name, p) end
-- Returns a reason string when the engine should not cure aff yet. function E.skip(aff) local s = ss.settings if s.ignore[aff] then return "ignored" end for _, b in ipairs(ss.data.cure_blocked_by[aff] or {}) do if ss.has(b) then return "can't cure while " .. b end end if s.ignore_def_affs and ss.keepup and ss.keepup.list()[aff] then return "kept as a defence" end for name, p in pairs(ss.data.passives) do for _, a in ipairs(p.affs or {}) do if a == aff and E.passive_on(name) then if p.effect ~= "delay" then return "passive " .. name end local since = ss.affs[aff] and ss.affs[aff].since or acs.now() if acs.now() - since < (p.wait or 3) then return "passive " .. name .. " (waiting)" end end end end end
function E.sorted_affs() local r = {} for aff in pairs(ss.affs) do if not E.skip(aff) then r[#r + 1] = aff end end table.sort(r, function(a, b) local pa, pb = E.prio(a), E.prio(b) if pa == pb then return a < b end return pa < pb end) return r end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function E.fire(plan, why) for _, cmd in ipairs(plan.cmds) do acs.send(cmd) end ss.use_bal(plan.bal, plan.wait) ss.debug(plan.bal .. " -> " .. table.concat(plan.cmds, "; ") .. (why and (" (" .. why .. ")") or "")) end
E.PHYSICAL = { bal = true, eq = true, eqbal = true }
function E.try(plan, used, why) if used[plan.bal] or not ss.bal_ready(plan.bal) or E.blocked(plan.bal) then return false end -- bal/eq actions share the same physical balance if E.PHYSICAL[plan.bal] and used.eqbal then return false end E.fire(plan, why) used[plan.bal] = true if E.PHYSICAL[plan.bal] then used.eqbal = true end return true end
function E.vitals(used) local s, v = ss.settings, ss.vitals if not v.maxhp then return end -- voyria wants the sip balance more than a health sip does if not (ss.has("voyria") and E.prio("voyria") <= 4) then if v.hpp < s.siphealth then E.try({ bal = "sip", cmds = { "sip health" } }, used, "hp " .. v.hpp .. "%") elseif v.mpp < s.sipmana then E.try({ bal = "sip", cmds = { "sip mana" } }, used, "mp " .. v.mpp .. "%") end end if v.hpp < s.mosshealth or v.mpp < s.mossmana then local moss = E.form("moss") E.try({ bal = "moss", cmds = E.with_outrift(moss, "eat " .. moss) }, used, "moss") end end
function E.clot(used) local s = ss.settings local bleed = tonumber(ss.vitals.stats.bleed) or 0 if bleed >= s.clot_at and ss.server.clot_ok() then E.try({ bal = "clot", cmds = { "clot" } }, used, "bleeding " .. bleed) end end
function E.cure_affs(used, order) local cured = {} for _, aff in ipairs(order) do for _, cure in ipairs(E.cures_for(aff)) do if E.try(E.parse(cure), used, aff) then cured[aff] = true break end end end return cured end
-- Focus and tree cure a random eligible affliction: use them when one is -- waiting that nothing else is curing this round. function E.random_cures(used, order, cured) for _, kind in ipairs({ "focus", "tree" }) do for _, aff in ipairs(order) do local info = ss.data.info(aff) if not cured[aff] and info and info[kind] and (kind ~= "focus" or (ss.vitals.mpp or 100) > 15) then if E.try({ bal = kind, cmds = { kind == "tree" and "touch tree" or "focus" } }, used, "for " .. aff) then cured[aff] = true end break end end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Active cures from class skills
ss._active_cd = ss._active_cd or {}
-- blocked_by entries: "a" fails with a, "a+b" fails only with both function E.active_blocked(ac) for _, b in ipairs(ac.blocked_by or {}) do local all = true for aff in tostring(b):gmatch("[^+]+") do if not ss.affs[ss.data.canon(aff)] then all = false end end if all then return b end end end
function E.actives(used, order, cured) if E.blocked("active") then return end local now = acs.now() for _, name in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.data.actives)) do local ac = ss.data.actives[name] if E.active_on(name) and (ss._active_cd[name] or 0) <= now and not E.active_blocked(ac) then local want if ac.cures == "any" then local n = 0 for _, aff in ipairs(order) do if not cured[aff] then n = n + 1 end end want = n >= (ac.min or 2) and ("stack of " .. n) or nil elseif ac.cures == "health" or ac.cures == "mana" then local p = ss.vitals[ac.cures == "health" and "hpp" or "mpp"] want = p and p < (ac.at or 50) and (ac.cures .. " " .. p .. "%") or nil else for _, aff in ipairs(ac.cures or {}) do aff = ss.data.canon(aff) if ss.affs[aff] and not cured[aff] and not E.skip(aff) then want = aff break end end end if want and E.try({ bal = ac.bal or "eqbal", cmds = { ac.cmd } }, used, name .. " for " .. want) then ss._active_cd[name] = now + (ac.cd or 10) if ss.affs[want] then cured[want] = true end end end end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function E.run() local s = ss.settings if not s.enabled then return end local used = {} local order = E.sorted_affs() if s.mode == "client" then E.vitals(used) local cured = E.cure_affs(used, order) E.actives(used, order, cured) E.random_cures(used, order, cured) E.clot(used) else E.actives(used, order, {}) end ss._last_used = used end

Script.name: priority table
Script.script:
-- SS priority table: the affliction priorities serverside curing should be -- using right now, as one live table of aff -> priority (1 = cured first). -- -- It's worked out fresh from where you are every time, never swapped in -- and back out, so nothing can be left behind at the wrong number. Tables -- stack, later ones winning: -- base default priorities + your saved profile ("ss prio <aff> <n>") -- class your class: the class script's table, its subclass's, then -- yours ("ss cprio"). What you can cure yourself (fitness...). -- vs your opponent's class: the table in that class script's -- "against" block, its subclass's, then yours ("ss vprio"). -- How that class kills you. The opponent is whoever is hitting -- you (11_opponent.lua), or one you set ("ss vs"). -- situations tables for when you're in a spot, in the order they're -- listed: your class's ("ss sit"), then the opponent's ("ss sit -- vs"), so the opponent's win. -- In a group fight, when more than one person is hitting you ("ss -- group"), the vs tables and every situation are off: you stand and fight -- on your class table. -- by hand "ss swap in <name>", ss.prio.set(), or a script's swap_in() -- parahold paralysis at 25 while you couldn't act anyway (10_parahold.lua) -- -- A situation is { name = "...", when = { ... }, prios = { aff = prio } }. -- "when" lists what has to be true, all of it. Each entry is -- asthma, shield an affliction you have or a defence you have up -- has:fitness a skill you have (GMCP Char.Skills) -- class:monk the class you're playing; vs:alchemist your opponent's -- phlegmatic>=6 a number: stacks of an affliction (0 without it; the -- humours by their short names), or hp / mp in percent. -- Compare with < <= > >= = -- !x not x; a|b either; a&b both (inside an either) -- so "phlegmatic>=6&!has:fitness|phlegmatic>=8" is "6, or 8 with fitness". -- "when" can also be a function returning true. -- -- Nothing is sent straight away. Whenever something changes (and once a -- second regardless), flush() compares the table with what serverside was -- last told and sends only the differences, up to 50 pairs per CURING -- PRIORITY command ("ss prio batch <n>"). Curing sets and PRIOAFF aren't -- used. -- -- Achaea allows CURING PRIORITY at most 5 times a second (ANNOUNCE NEWS -- #5450; CURING PRIORITY HEALTH/MANA and viewing don't count). Every -- CURING PRIORITY command SS sends, affliction or defence, goes through -- P.use(), which keeps to that limit. What doesn't fit goes out on the -- next beat that has room.
ss.prio = ss.prio or {} local P = ss.prio P.layers = P.layers or {} -- by hand: { { name = "...", tbl = { aff = prio } }, ... } P._dirty = true P.max = 26 -- 26: serverside leaves it alone (AW's old swaps used it to hold salves) P.limit = 5 -- CURING PRIORITY uses allowed per window P.window = 1.2 -- seconds; a little over one, to allow for lag P._uses = P._uses or {} -- when recent CURING PRIORITY commands went out P._names = P._names or {} -- situations on at the last check, to echo changes
function P.clamp(p) p = math.floor(tonumber(p) or 20) return math.max(1, math.min(P.max, p)) end
function P.base() local s = ss.settings local t = acs.copy(ss.data.default_prios) for aff, p in pairs(s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile] or {}) do t[aff] = p end return t end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Tables
-- Your own tables, made in game: general ones, one set per class, and one -- set per opponent class ("vs <class>"). function P.mine(key) local all = ss.settings.prio_tables key = key or ss.classes.key(ss.class()) all[key] = all[key] or {} local t = all[key] t.prios, t.sits, t.order, t.off = t.prios or {}, t.sits or {}, t.order or {}, t.off or {} return t end
-- An affliction by the name a "when" uses: the humours go by their short -- names (phlegmatic is temperedphlegmatic). function P.aff_name(name) local n = ss.data.canon(name) if not ss.data.affs[n] and not ss.affs[n] and ss.data.affs["tempered" .. n] then return "tempered" .. n end return n end
-- A number a "when" can compare: hp / mp in percent, or stacks of an -- affliction (1 when GMCP gives no count, 0 without it). function P.value(name) local v = ss.vitals or {} if name == "hp" or name == "health" then return v.hpp end if name == "mp" or name == "mana" then return v.mpp end -- your limbs (12_limbs.lua): one by name, "limb" the highest, "breaks" if ss.limbs then if name == "limb" then return ss.limbs.highest() end if name == "breaks" then return ss.limbs.breaks() end if ss.limbs.norm(name) then return ss.limbs.get(name) end end -- how many of these you have: n_haemophilia_lethargy_nausea>=2 local list = name:match("^n_(.+)$") if list then local n = 0 for a in list:gmatch("[^_]+") do if ss.affs[P.aff_name(a)] then n = n + 1 end end return n end -- how long you've had an affliction: darkshade_secs>10 local had = name:match("^(.+)_secs$") if had then local a = ss.affs[P.aff_name(had)] return a and a.since and (acs.now() - a.since) or 0 end -- a herb or other cure: how many afflictions you have that it cures local by = ss.data.AFF and ss.data.AFF.by_item[name] if by and not ss.data.affs[name] then local n = 0 for _, aff in ipairs(by) do if ss.affs[aff] then n = n + 1 end end return n end local a = ss.affs[P.aff_name(name)] return a and (a.count or 1) or 0 end
P.CMP = { ["<"] = function(a, b) return a < b end, ["<="] = function(a, b) return a <= b end, [">"] = function(a, b) return a > b end, [">="] = function(a, b) return a >= b end, ["="] = function(a, b) return a == b end, ["=="] = function(a, b) return a == b end, }
-- One piece: an affliction, defence, has:/class:/vs: check or a comparison. function P.piece(p) local neg = p:sub(1, 1) == "!" if neg then p = p:sub(2) end local hit local kind, arg = p:match("^(%a+):(.+)$") if kind == "has" then hit = ss.has_skill(arg) elseif kind == "off" then hit = not ss.bal_ready(arg) -- off:salve, off:focus, off:herb, off:bal, off:eq elseif kind == "flag" then hit = ss.flag_on(arg) -- flag:doll, set for a while by a line (ss.flag) elseif kind == "prepped" then hit = ss.limbs and ss.limbs.prepped(arg) or false elseif kind == "stance" then -- stance:willow, the opponent's stance or form local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() hit = ss.limbs ~= nil and ss.limbs.stance_of(o and o.name) == acs.norm(arg) elseif kind == "room" then hit = ss.room_has(arg) -- room:flying, the room's name has it elseif kind == "item" then hit = ss.item_here(arg) -- item:bomb, an item in the room has it in its name elseif kind == "class" then hit = ss.classes.key(ss.class()) == ss.classes.key(arg) elseif kind == "vs" then local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() hit = o ~= nil and (o.class == ss.classes.key(arg) or o.sub == acs.norm(arg)) else local name, op, rhs = p:match("^([%w_]+)%s*([<>=]=?)%s*([%w_%.%-]+)$") if name and P.CMP[op] then -- the right side is a number, or another value (goldenseal<kelp) local val, num = P.value(name), tonumber(rhs) or P.value(rhs) hit = val ~= nil and num ~= nil and P.CMP[op](val, num) else hit = ss.affs[P.aff_name(p)] ~= nil or ss.defs[acs.norm(p)] == true end end return (hit and true or false) ~= neg end
-- One term of a situation's "when". function P.term(term) term = tostring(term):lower() local neg = term:sub(1, 1) == "!" if neg then term = term:sub(2) end local hit = false for alt in term:gmatch("[^|]+") do local all = true for p in alt:gmatch("[^&]+") do p = p:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if p ~= "" and not P.piece(p) then all = false break end end if all then hit = true break end end return hit ~= neg end
function P.matches(sit) local when = sit.when if type(when) == "function" then local ok, r = pcall(when) return ok and r and true or false end if type(when) == "string" then when = { when } end for _, term in ipairs(when or {}) do if not P.term(term) then return false end end return true end
-- Scripted tables for an opponent { class, sub }: the "against" block of -- that class's script, and its subclass's. function P.against(vs) local cs = vs and ss.classes.scripts[vs.class] local ag = cs and cs.against or {} return ag, vs and vs.sub and (ag.subclasses or {})[vs.sub] or {} end
-- Your own tables for scripted situations: general and your class's, or the -- opponent class's ("vs <class>"). function P.mines(vs) if vs then return { P.mine("vs " .. vs.class) } end return { P.mine("general"), P.mine() } end
-- The situations that apply, in order. For your class: general ones, the -- class script's, its subclass's, then yours. With an opponent (vs): the -- "against" block's, its subclass's, then yours for that class. One of -- yours with the same name as a scripted one takes its place; "ss sit -- <name> off" skips one. function P.situations(vs) local r, at = {}, {} local mines = P.mines(vs) local function add(sit, where) if type(sit) ~= "table" or not sit.name then return end local e = { name = sit.name, when = sit.when, prios = sit.prios or {}, defs = sit.defs, hold = sit.hold, set = sit.set, fake = sit.fake, preapply = sit.preapply, preapply_salve = sit.preapply_salve, where = where } if at[sit.name] then r[at[sit.name]] = e else r[#r + 1] = e at[sit.name] = #r end end local lists if vs then local ag, sub = P.against(vs) lists = { { ag.situations, "vs " .. vs.class }, { sub.situations, "vs " .. tostring(vs.sub) } } else local cs, sub = ss.classes.current(), ss.classes.current_sub() lists = { { ss.data.situations, "general" }, { cs and cs.situations, "class" }, { sub and sub.situations, "subclass" } } end for _, l in ipairs(lists) do for _, sit in ipairs(l[1] or {}) do add(sit, l[2]) end end for _, t in ipairs(mines) do for _, name in ipairs(t.order) do local m = t.sits[name] if m then add({ name = name, when = m.when, prios = m.prios, hold = m.hold, defs = m.defs, set = m.set, fake = m.fake, preapply = m.preapply, preapply_salve = m.preapply_salve }, "yours") end end end local out = {} for _, e in ipairs(r) do local off = false for _, t in ipairs(mines) do if t.off[e.name] then off = true end end if not off then out[#out + 1] = e end end return out end
-- In a group fight? "ss group on|off" decides, or (auto) whether enough -- people have hit you recently (09_attackers.lua). function P.group() local mode = ss.settings.group_mode if mode == "on" then return true end if mode == "off" then return false end return ss.attackers and ss.attackers.group_count() >= (tonumber(ss.settings.group_size) or 2) or false end
local function canon_tbl(tbl) local t = {} for aff, p in pairs(tbl or {}) do t[ss.data.canon(aff)] = p end return t end
-- Every table on top of the base right now, lowest first: -- { { name = "...", kind = "class|vs|situation|hand|parahold", tbl = {} }, ... } function P.sources() local r = {} local function add(name, kind, tbl, defs, nohold, set) if (tbl and (next(tbl) or kind == "hand")) or (defs and next(defs)) or nohold or (set and next(set)) then r[#r + 1] = { name = name, kind = kind, tbl = canon_tbl(tbl), defs = defs, set = set } end end local cs, sub = ss.classes.current(), ss.classes.current_sub() add("class", "class", cs and cs.prios) add("subclass", "class", sub and sub.prios) add("class (yours)", "class", P.mine().prios) -- more than one person hitting you: no opponent table and no situation -- swaps, just the class table local group = P.group() local vs = not group and ss.opp and ss.opp.current() or nil if vs then local ag, sub = P.against(vs) add("vs " .. vs.class, "vs", ag.prios) if vs.sub then add("vs " .. vs.sub, "vs", sub.prios) end add("vs " .. vs.class .. " (yours)", "vs", P.mine("vs " .. vs.class).prios) end if not group then for _, sit in ipairs(P.situations()) do if P.matches(sit) then add(sit.name, "situation", sit.prios, sit.defs, sit.hold == false, sit.set) end end end if vs then for _, sit in ipairs(P.situations(vs)) do if P.matches(sit) then add(sit.name, "situation", sit.prios, sit.defs, sit.hold == false, sit.set) end end end for _, l in ipairs(P.layers) do add(l.name, "hand", l.tbl) end if not group and ss.parahold and ss.parahold.wanted() then add("parahold", "parahold", { paralysis = 25 }) end -- you're executing someone (13_execute.lua): paralysis first, over everything if ss.exec and ss.exec.on() then local t = P.base() for _, src in ipairs(r) do for aff, p in pairs(src.tbl) do t[aff] = p end end add("executing", "execution", ss.exec.layer(t)) end return r end
-- The whole table as it should be now. function P.table() local t = P.base() for _, src in ipairs(P.sources()) do for aff, p in pairs(src.tbl) do t[aff] = p end end for aff, p in pairs(t) do t[aff] = P.clamp(p) end return t end
-- Close to a kill: a situation on now with hold = false. Paralysis isn't -- held then (10_parahold.lua), so you're never chasing herb balance on -- something that can't wait. Goes through the situations, not P.sources(), -- which asks parahold. function P.nohold() if ss.exec and ss.exec.on() then return true end if P.group() then return false end local vs = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() for _, list in ipairs({ P.situations(), vs and P.situations(vs) or {} }) do for _, sit in ipairs(list) do if sit.hold == false and P.matches(sit) then return true end end end return false end
-- Serverside settings the situations on now change (a situation's set = -- { siphealth = 25, sip_priority = "mana", server_focus = false }), the -- later situation winning. 06_server.lua syncs them while they're on. function P.sit_sets() local r = {} for _, src in ipairs(P.sources()) do for k, v in pairs(src.set or {}) do r[k] = v end end return r end
-- Defences the situations on now want up: def -> priority (a situation's -- defs = { curseward = 1 }). Keepup adds them to what it keeps up. function P.sit_defs() local r = {} for _, src in ipairs(P.sources()) do for d, p in pairs(src.defs or {}) do r[d] = math.min(r[d] or p, p) end end return r end
function P.get(aff) aff = ss.data.canon(aff) local src = P.sources() for i = #src, 1, -1 do local p = src[i].tbl[aff] if p then return P.clamp(p) end end local s = ss.settings local prof = s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile] or {} return P.clamp(prof[aff] or ss.data.default_prios[aff] or 20) end
function P.changed() P._dirty = true if rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.mark then hb.mark("ss.prio") elseif ss.schedule then ss.schedule() end end
-- What's on now besides the base: "group fight" or "vs <opponent>", -- situations, swaps by hand, "parahold". Your class tables aren't listed. function P.vs_name() local o = not P.group() and ss.opp and ss.opp.current() return o and ("vs " .. (o.sub or o.class)) or nil end
function P.active_names() local r, seen = {}, {} if P.group() then r[1], seen["group fight"] = "group fight", true end local vn = P.vs_name() if vn then r[#r + 1], seen[vn] = vn, true end for _, src in ipairs(P.sources()) do if src.kind ~= "class" and src.kind ~= "vs" and not seen[src.name] then seen[src.name] = true r[#r + 1] = src.name end end return r end
function P.active(name) for _, n in ipairs(P.active_names()) do if n == name then return true end end return false end
-- For listings: "aff=prio aff=prio", lowest number first. function P.tbl_text(tbl) local keys = acs.sorted_keys(tbl or {}) table.sort(keys, function(a, b) if tbl[a] ~= tbl[b] then return tbl[a] < tbl[b] end return a < b end) local r = {} for _, a in ipairs(keys) do r[#r + 1] = a .. "=" .. tbl[a] end return #r > 0 and table.concat(r, " ") or "<dim_grey>empty<reset>" end
function P.when_text(when) if type(when) == "function" then return "(script)" end if type(when) == "string" then return when end return #(when or {}) > 0 and table.concat(when, " ") or "always" end
-- Find a situation by name for this class, or for an opponent (yours -- first, then scripted). function P.find_sit(name, vs) for _, sit in ipairs(P.situations(vs)) do if sit.name == name then return sit end end local lists if vs then local ag, sub = P.against(vs) lists = { ag.situations or {}, sub.situations or {} } else local cs, sub = ss.classes.current(), ss.classes.current_sub() lists = { ss.data.situations or {}, cs and cs.situations or {}, sub and sub.situations or {} } end for _, list in ipairs(lists) do for _, sit in ipairs(list) do if sit.name == name then return sit end end end end
-- Run whenever something changes, and once a second: echo situations that -- came on or went off, and have flush() look at the table again. function P.check() local now, was = {}, P._names for _, src in ipairs(P.sources()) do if src.kind == "situation" or src.kind == "execution" then now[src.name] = true end end if P.group() then now["group fight"] = true end local vn = P.vs_name() if vn then now[vn] = true end local on, off = {}, {} for n in pairs(now) do if not was[n] then on[#on + 1] = n end end for n in pairs(was) do if not now[n] then off[#off + 1] = n end end P._names = now if #on + #off > 0 and ss.server and ss.server.sets_changed then ss.server.sets_changed() end if #on + #off > 0 then table.sort(on) table.sort(off) for _, n in ipairs(off) do raiseEvent("ss.prio.swapped", n, false) end for _, n in ipairs(on) do raiseEvent("ss.prio.swapped", n, true) end if ss.settings.prio_echo then local list = acs.sorted_keys(now) ss.echo("priorities: " .. (#list > 0 and ("<yellow>" .. table.concat(list, ", ") .. "<reset>") or "class table")) end end P.changed() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Swaps by hand. Situations (above) are the way to change priorities as a -- fight goes; these stay on until taken off.
function P.find(name) for i, l in ipairs(P.layers) do if l.name == name then return i end end end
-- Add (or replace) a named table of aff -> prio on top of everything else. function P.swap_in(name, tbl) local i = P.find(name) local layer = { name = name, tbl = {} } for aff, p in pairs(tbl or {}) do layer.tbl[ss.data.canon(aff)] = p end if i then P.layers[i] = layer else P.layers[#P.layers + 1] = layer end P.changed() raiseEvent("ss.prio.swapped", name, true) end
function P.swap_out(name) local i = P.find(name) if not i then return false end table.remove(P.layers, i) P.changed() raiseEvent("ss.prio.swapped", name, false) return true end
-- One-off change, kept in a swap called "manual" until cleared. function P.set(aff, prio) local i = P.find("manual") if not i then P.swap_in("manual", {}) i = P.find("manual") end P.layers[i].tbl[ss.data.canon(aff)] = prio P.changed() end
function P.clear() P.layers = {} P.changed() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sending
-- What serverside was last told, saved because serverside keeps it. function P.sent() ss.settings.synced.prios = ss.settings.synced.prios or {} return ss.settings.synced.prios end
-- Health/mana swaps and viewing (LIST) don't count toward the limit. function P.exempt(cmd) local rest = cmd:lower():match("^%s*curing%s+prio%a*%s*(.*)$") if not rest then return true end return rest == "" or rest:find("^health") or rest:find("^mana") or rest:find("^list") or rest:find("^defence list") end
-- How many more CURING PRIORITY commands can go out right now. function P.budget() local now, keep = acs.now(), {} for _, t in ipairs(P._uses) do if now - t < P.window then keep[#keep + 1] = t end end P._uses = keep return P.limit - #keep end
-- Send one CURING PRIORITY command if the limit allows. Returns true if sent. function P.use(cmd) if not P.exempt(cmd) then if P.budget() <= 0 then return false end P._uses[#P._uses + 1] = acs.now() end P._sending = true -- so the send hook below doesn't count it twice acs.send(cmd) P._sending = false return true end
-- CURING PRIORITY sent any other way (typed, or another script's send()) -- counts too, so SS doesn't go over right after one. The afflictions it -- set are forgotten, so the next flush puts SS's numbers back. function P.count_send(cmd) if P._sending or P.exempt(cmd) then return end P._uses[#P._uses + 1] = acs.now() local rest = cmd:lower():match("^%s*curing%s+prio%a*%s+(.*)$") or "" if rest:find("^defence") then return end local sent, any = P.sent(), false for aff in rest:gmatch("(%a+)%s+%d+") do aff = ss.data.canon(aff) if ss.data.affs[aff] then sent[aff] = nil any = true end end if any then P.changed() end end
-- Come back when there's room: on the next beat if the heartbeat runs us, -- otherwise when the oldest use leaves the window. function P.later() if rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.get and hb.get("ss.prio") and hb.mark then hb.mark("ss.prio") return end if P._timer then return end local wait = P._uses[1] and (P._uses[1] + P.window - acs.now()) or 0 P._timer = tempTimer(math.max(wait, 0) + 0.05, function() P._timer = nil P.flush() end) end
-- aff/prio pairs per CURING PRIORITY command; AW found about 50 fit in one function P.batch() return math.max(1, tonumber(ss.settings.prio_batch) or 50) end
-- Affliction priorities that differ from what serverside was told, in as -- few commands as P.batch() allows, up to the limit, the most urgent first. The -- rest stay unsent and are worked out again next time, so they always go -- out with current values. function P.send_affs() local want, sent = P.table(), P.sent() local diffs = {} for aff, p in pairs(want) do if ss.data.affs[aff] and sent[aff] ~= p then diffs[#diffs + 1] = aff end end table.sort(diffs, function(a, b) if want[a] ~= want[b] then return want[a] < want[b] end return a < b end) local i, n, per = 1, 0, P.batch() while i <= #diffs and P.budget() > 0 do local parts, first = {}, i while i <= #diffs and #parts < per do parts[#parts + 1] = diffs[i] .. " " .. want[diffs[i]] i = i + 1 end P.use("curing priority " .. table.concat(parts, " ")) for j = first, i - 1 do sent[diffs[j]] = want[diffs[j]] end n = n + (i - first) end return n, #diffs - n end
-- What serverside was last told about defences: def -> priority. function P.sent_defs() ss.settings.synced.defs = ss.settings.synced.defs or {} return ss.settings.synced.defs end
-- Defence priorities: what defup/keepup want kept up (05_keepup.lua) against -- what serverside was told. Defences no longer wanted are reset. Batched -- like afflictions ("curing priority defence a 10 b reset ..."). function P.send_defs() local want = ss.keepup.wanted() local sent, sy = P.sent_defs(), ss.settings.synced local pre = ss.settings.def_preempt or {} -- what serverside should have: "10", or "10 preempt" to go ahead of the queue local function val(d) return want[d] and (tostring(want[d]) .. (pre[d] and " preempt" or "")) or nil end local diffs = {} for d in pairs(want) do if tostring(sent[d]) ~= val(d) then diffs[#diffs + 1] = d end end for d in pairs(sent) do if want[d] == nil then diffs[#diffs + 1] = d end end table.sort(diffs, function(a, b) local pa, pb = want[a] or 99, want[b] or 99 if pa ~= pb then return pa < pb end return a < b end) if #diffs > 0 and sy.__defs_on ~= true then acs.send(ss.server.cmds.defs_on) sy.__defs_on = true end local i, n, per = 1, 0, P.batch() while i <= #diffs and P.budget() > 0 do local parts, first = {}, i -- a preempt one goes on its own while i <= #diffs and #parts < per and not (#parts > 0 and pre[diffs[i]] and want[diffs[i]]) do parts[#parts + 1] = diffs[i] .. " " .. (val(diffs[i]) or "reset") i = i + 1 if pre[diffs[i - 1]] and want[diffs[i - 1]] then break end end P.use(ss.server.cmds.defs:format(table.concat(parts, " "))) for j = first, i - 1 do sent[diffs[j]] = val(diffs[j]) end n = n + (i - first) end return n, #diffs - n end
-- Send what changed, afflictions then defences, within the limit. -- force = recompute even if nothing was marked. Returns sent, still waiting. function P.flush(force) local s = ss.settings local n, left = 0, 0 if force then P._dirty = true end if not acs.online() then return 0, 0 end -- kept dirty; "acs.login" flushes if s.enabled and s.mode == "server" and P._dirty and P.budget() > 0 then P._dirty = false -- affliction priorities first: they matter most mid-fight local na, la = P.send_affs() local nd, ld = P.send_defs() n, left = na + nd, la + ld if left > 0 then P._dirty = true end if n > 0 then ss.save() raiseEvent("ss.prio.sent", n) end end if P._dirty and s.enabled and s.mode == "server" then P.later() end return n, left end
-- Forget what serverside was told, so the next flush sends everything. function P.resend() ss.settings.synced.prios = {} P.changed() end
-- Heartbeat when there is one; otherwise ss.tick (each prompt) calls flush. -- Situations are looked at again whenever afflictions, defences, class or -- attackers change, and once a second besides. function P.install(M) local function use_hb() if rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.register then -- watch: HB only runs this on beats where P.changed() marked it hb.register("ss.prio", function() P.flush() end, { priority = 10, owner = "ss", watch = "ss.prio" }) hb.register("ss.prio.check", P.check, { every = 1, owner = "ss", priority = 9 }) return true end end M.on("hb.ready", use_hb) use_hb() M.on("sysDataSendRequest", function(_, cmd) P.count_send(cmd) end) for _, ev in ipairs({ "ss.aff.gained", "ss.aff.lost", "ss.def.up", "ss.def.down", "ss.attackers.changed", "ss.limbs.changed", "ss.room.changed", "acs.class.changed" }) do M.on(ev, function() P.check() end) end local function loop() if not (rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.get and hb.get("ss.prio.check")) then P.check() end M.timer(1, loop) end M.timer(1, loop) end
function P.on_tick() if not (rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.get and hb.get("ss.prio")) then P.flush() end end

Script.name: defup and keepup
Script.script:
-- SS defup and keepup: which defences to raise, per class. -- -- keepup kept up all the time keepup[class][def] = priority -- defup raised by "ss defup", then left to drop defup[class][def] = priority -- toggles rebounding, shield, curseward, endure...: kept up while on, -- whatever the class ("ss deftoggle <def>") -- -- Priorities are serverside's 1-25 (1 is raised first), 25 by default. The -- defences to choose from are in ss.data.def_lists (02_classes.lua): general -- ones anyone can have, the class's own, and its weapon spec's. "ss defs" -- shows them as a grid you can click. -- -- Server mode: nothing is sent from here. K.wanted() says what serverside -- should keep up right now, and the priority sender (04_prio.lua) sends the -- difference as CURING PRIORITY DEFENCE, several pairs a command. A defup -- defence is wanted until it comes up, then reset, so serverside raises it -- once. Client mode: K.run() raises what's missing with the commands below.
ss.keepup = ss.keepup or {} local K = ss.keepup K._tried = K._tried or {} -- def -> time of last attempt (client mode) K._raising = K._raising or {} -- defup defences "ss defup" asked for that aren't up yet K.DEFAULT_PRIO = 25
local function class_key(cls) return acs.norm(cls or ss.class()) end
local function tbl(kind, cls) local t = ss.settings[kind] cls = class_key(cls) t[cls] = t[cls] or {} return t[cls] end
function K.keepup(cls) return tbl("keepup", cls) end function K.defup(cls) return tbl("defup", cls) end
-- Every defence this class raises (defup, keepup or a toggle that's on). -- Afflictions with the same name are left alone (04_engine.lua). function K.list() local r = {} for d in pairs(K.defup()) do r[d] = true end for d in pairs(K.keepup()) do r[d] = true end for d, on in pairs(ss.settings.def_toggles) do if on then r[d] = true end end return r end
function K.state(def, cls) if K.keepup(cls)[def] then return "keepup" end if K.defup(cls)[def] then return "defup" end return nil end
function K.prio(def, cls) return K.keepup(cls)[def] or K.defup(cls)[def] end
function K.changed() ss.save() if ss.prio then ss.prio.changed() end ss.schedule() end
-- Put a defence in "keepup", "defup" or neither (nil), keeping its priority. function K.set(kind, def, prio, cls) local up, kp = K.defup(cls), K.keepup(cls) local p = math.max(1, math.min(25, math.floor(tonumber(prio) or kp[def] or up[def] or K.DEFAULT_PRIO))) up[def], kp[def] = nil, nil if kind == "keepup" then kp[def] = p elseif kind == "defup" then up[def] = p end if kind ~= "defup" then K._raising[def] = nil end K.changed() end
-- Neither -> defup -> keepup -> neither, as the grid cycles. function K.cycle(def, cls) local st = K.state(def, cls) K.set(st == nil and "defup" or st == "defup" and "keepup" or nil, def, nil, cls) end
-- Change a chosen defence's priority. Returns false if it isn't chosen. function K.set_prio(def, prio, cls) local st = K.state(def, cls) if not st then return false end K.set(st, def, prio, cls) return true end
function K.toggle(def, on) local t = ss.settings.def_toggles if on == nil then on = not t[def] end t[def] = on and true or false K.changed() raiseEvent("ss.def.toggle", def, t[def]) if ss.settings.def_echo then ss.echo(def .. " is " .. (t[def] and "<pale_green>on" or "<sienna>off")) end return t[def] end
-- Raise a defence once, now (the "sh" and "cw" aliases). function K.up_now(def) local info = K.def_info(def) if not (info and info.cmd) then ss.err("don't know how to raise " .. def) return false end acs.send(info.cmd) return true end
-- Short aliases (AW): sh / cw raise shield / curseward once; ksh / kcw -- keep them up (toggle); reb keeps rebounding up (toggle). K.QUICK = { { [[^sh$]], function() K.up_now("shield") end }, { [[^ksh$]], function() K.toggle("shield") end }, { [[^cw$]], function() K.up_now("curseward") end }, { [[^kcw$]], function() K.toggle("curseward") end }, { [[^reb$]], function() K.toggle("rebounding") end }, } function K.install(M) for _, a in ipairs(K.QUICK) do M.alias(a[1], a[2]) end end
-- What should be kept up right now: def -> priority. A toggle decides for -- its defence even when keepup lists it, as in AW's old system. function K.wanted() local s = ss.settings local r = {} if not s.keepup_enabled then return r end for d, p in pairs(K.keepup()) do r[d] = p end for d, on in pairs(s.def_toggles) do if on and K.can_have(d) then r[d] = r[d] or K.DEFAULT_PRIO elseif not on then r[d] = nil end end for d in pairs(K._raising) do r[d] = r[d] or K.defup()[d] or K.DEFAULT_PRIO end -- a situation on now can want one up too (curseward against an Apostate) for d, p in pairs(ss.prio and ss.prio.sit_defs() or {}) do if K.can_have(d) then r[d] = math.min(r[d] or p, p) end end return r end
function K.missing() local r = {} for d in pairs(K.wanted()) do if not ss.defs[d] then r[#r + 1] = d end end table.sort(r) return r end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Defup
function K.predefup(cls) local r = {} for c in tostring(ss.settings.predefup[class_key(cls)] or ""):gmatch("[^|]+") do c = c:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if c ~= "" then r[#r + 1] = c end end return r end
-- Raise this class's defup defences that are down (after its pre-defup -- commands). Keepup ones that are down are sent to serverside again too, -- in case it lost them. Returns how many defup defences were asked for. function K.defup_now() for _, c in ipairs(K.predefup()) do acs.send(c) end local n = 0 for d in pairs(K.defup()) do if not ss.defs[d] then K._raising[d] = true n = n + 1 end end local sent = ss.prio.sent_defs() for d in pairs(K.wanted()) do if not ss.defs[d] then sent[d] = nil end end K.changed() return n end
-- A defup defence came up: serverside can stop raising it. function K.on_up(def) if K._raising[def] then K._raising[def] = nil if ss.prio then ss.prio.changed() end end end
-- Stop raising defup defences that haven't come up. function K.stop() K._raising = {} if ss.prio then ss.prio.changed() end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The defences to choose from
-- For a class: general, the class's own and (for the class you're playing) -- your weapon spec's. Returns { general, class, spec, spec_name }. function K.catalogue(cls) cls = class_key(cls) local L = ss.data.def_lists local r = { general = L.general or {}, class = L[cls] or L[ss.classes.key(cls)] or {}, spec = {} } local sub = cls == class_key() and ss.classes.current_sub_name() if sub and ss.data.def_specs[sub] then r.spec, r.spec_name = ss.data.def_specs[sub], sub end return r end
-- Can the class you're playing have this defence? Toggles and situations -- aren't per class, so a defence that's only on other classes' lists -- (rebounding is general, deathaura is Apostate only) is left out. One on no list -- at all, or while your class has no list, is let through. function K.can_have(def) local c = K.catalogue() if not K.known_class() then return true end for _, l in ipairs({ c.general, c.class, c.spec }) do for _, d in ipairs(l) do if d == def then return true end end end for name, l in pairs(ss.data.def_lists) do for _, d in ipairs(l) do if d == def then return false end end end for _, l in pairs(ss.data.def_specs or {}) do for _, d in ipairs(l) do if d == def then return false end end end return true end
function K.known_class(cls) cls = class_key(cls) return ss.data.def_lists[cls] ~= nil or ss.data.def_lists[ss.classes.key(cls)] ~= nil end
-- "ss defs": a grid of every defence for a class. Click a name to cycle it -- (white neither, red defup, orange keepup); U and D move its priority, -- the number puts it back to 25. A green * means it's up now. local COLOUR = { defup = "<red>", keepup = "<orange>" }
-- How wide a line can be before Mudlet wraps it: the main window's wrap -- setting, or its width in characters if that's narrower. function K.width() local w local wrap = rawget(_G, "getWindowWrap") if wrap then local ok, v = pcall(wrap, "main") if ok and tonumber(v) and v > 0 then w = v end end local cols = rawget(_G, "getColumnCount") if cols then local ok, v = pcall(cols) if ok and tonumber(v) and v > 0 then w = w and math.min(w, v) or v end end return w or 100 end
function K.grid(cls) cls = class_key(cls) local link = rawget(_G, "cechoLink") local cell = 30 local width = K.width() local per = math.max(1, math.floor(width / cell)) local shown = {} local function out(text, fn, hint) if link then link(text, fn, hint, true) else cecho(text) end end local function redraw() K.grid(cls) end local function section(title, list) cecho("\n<green>" .. title .. "\n") local n = 0 for _, def in ipairs(list) do if not shown[def] then shown[def] = true local st, p = K.state(def, cls), K.prio(def, cls) local name = def:sub(1, 19) out((ss.defs[def] and "<green>*" or " ") .. (COLOUR[st] or "<white>") .. name, function() K.cycle(def, cls) redraw() end, "white: neither, red: defup, orange: keepup") cecho(string.rep(" ", 20 - #name)) out(" <blue>U", function() if p then K.set_prio(def, p - 1, cls) end redraw() end, "raise its priority (lower number)") out(" <white>" .. (p and ("%02d"):format(p) or "--"), function() if p then K.set_prio(def, K.DEFAULT_PRIO, cls) end redraw() end, "back to 25") out(" <red>D", function() if p then K.set_prio(def, p + 1, cls) end redraw() end, "lower its priority (higher number)") n = n + 1 cecho(n % per == 0 and "\n" or " ") end end if n % per ~= 0 then cecho("\n") end end cecho("\n<yellow>" .. string.rep("-", math.min(width, per * cell)) .. "\n") cecho("<white>defences for " .. cls .. "<reset>: click a name for <white>neither<reset> -> <red>defup<reset> -> " .. "<orange>keepup<reset>. U/D move its priority. <green>*<reset> up now.\n") local cat = K.catalogue(cls) section("general", cat.general) section(cls, cat.class) if #cat.spec > 0 then section(cat.spec_name, cat.spec) end local other = {} for _, t in ipairs({ K.defup(cls), K.keepup(cls) }) do for d in pairs(t) do if not shown[d] then other[#other + 1] = d end end end table.sort(other) if #other > 0 then section("others you chose", other) end cecho("<yellow>" .. string.rep("-", math.min(width, per * cell)) .. "\n") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Client mode: SS raises missing defences itself.
-- Command and balance for a defence: your override, then this class's -- entry, then the general table, then the shared defence reference -- (achaea_defs), and last the defence name itself. Returns cmd = nil for -- defences that can't be raised by a command (passives, items, tattoos -- that are always on), so keepup leaves them alone. function K.ref_cmd(r) local c = r and r.cmd if not c or c:find("/", 1, true) or c:find("...", 1, true) or c:find("|", 1, true) or c:find("<", 1, true) then return nil end return c:lower() end
function K.def_info(def) local over = ss.settings.def_cmds[def] local base = (ss.data.class_defs[acs.norm(ss.class())] or {})[def] or ss.data.defs[def] if over then local cmd, bal = over:match("^(.-)@(%w+)$") return { cmd = cmd or over, bal = bal or (base and base.bal) or "eqbal" } end if base then return base end local REF = rawget(_G, "achaea_defs") local r = REF and REF.get(def) if r then if r.kind == "passive" or r.kind == "item" then return { bal = "free", passive = true, ref = r } end local cmd = K.ref_cmd(r) if cmd then return { cmd = cmd, bal = "eqbal", ref = r } end if r.verified == "unknown" or r.verified == "lost" then return { bal = "eqbal", unknown = true, ref = r } end end return { cmd = def, bal = "eqbal" } end
-- Defences the shared reference lists for a class (its own plus General). function K.suggest(cls) local REF = rawget(_G, "achaea_defs") if not REF then return {} end cls = tostring(cls or ss.class()) return REF.for_class(cls:sub(1, 1):upper() .. cls:sub(2):lower()) end
K.CURATIVE = { herb = true, salve = true, sip = true, smoke = true, moss = true }
function K.run() local s = ss.settings if not s.enabled or s.mode ~= "client" then return end local E = ss.engine local used = ss._last_used or {} local busy = ss.aff_count() > 0 and not s.keepup_in_combat local now = acs.now() local wanted = K.wanted() local order = K.missing() table.sort(order, function(a, b) if wanted[a] ~= wanted[b] then return wanted[a] < wanted[b] end return a < b end) for _, def in ipairs(order) do local info = K.def_info(def) local bal = info.bal or "eqbal" if info.cmd and (K._tried[def] or 0) + 3 <= now then if K.CURATIVE[bal] then local plan = E.parse(info.cmd) plan.bal = bal if E.try(plan, used, "keepup " .. def) then K._tried[def] = now end elseif not busy and ss.bal_ready(bal) and not E.blocked(bal) and not (bal ~= "free" and (used.eqbal or (K._last_eqbal or 0) + 1 > now)) then acs.send(info.cmd) K._tried[def] = now if bal ~= "free" then used.eqbal = true K._last_eqbal = now end end end end end
-- Add the defences you have up now to this class's keepup table. function K.learn() local list = K.keepup() local n = 0 for def in pairs(ss.defs) do local info = ss.data.defs[def] if not K.state(def) and not (info and info.nokeepup) then list[def] = K.DEFAULT_PRIO n = n + 1 end end K.changed() ss.echo(("learned %d defences for %s (%d kept up)"):format(n, ss.class(), acs.count(list))) return n end
function K.echo_def(def, up) if not ss.settings.def_echo or ss._def_listing then return end ss.echo(up and ("Gained <pale_green>" .. def) or ("Lost <sienna>" .. def)) end

Script.name: server
Script.script:
-- SS serverside curing integration. -- Pushes vitals thresholds and options to Achaea's CURING system, sending -- only what changed since the last sync. Affliction and defence priorities -- are sent by the priority sender (04_prio.lua; defup and keepup decide the -- defences, 05_keepup.lua). Command forms are from HELP CURINGSYSTEM (see -- docs/combat-help-notes.md); this table is the only place they live.
ss.server = ss.server or {} local S = ss.server
S.cmds = { on = "curing on", off = "curing off", prio = "curing priority %s %d", siphealth = "curing siphealth %d", sipmana = "curing sipmana %d", mosshealth = "curing mosshealth %d", mossmana = "curing mossmana %d", focus = "curing focus %s", -- on / off tree = "curing tree %s", -- on / off useclot = "curing useclot %s", -- on / off clotat = "curing clotat %d", clotto = "curing clotto %d", insomnia = "curing insomnia %s", -- on / off reporting = "curing reporting %s", -- on / off rejection = "curing rejection %s", -- on / off aeonlikeret = "curing aeonlikeret %s", -- on / off focusguilt = "curing focus %sguilt", -- with / without focusfulminated = "curing focus %sfulminated", manathreshold = "curing manathreshold %d", -- no mana-costing cures (clot) below this % clothealth = "curing clothealth %d", -- clot with corrupted humours only above this % health transmute = "curing transmutation %s", -- on / off sippriority = "curing priority %s", -- health / mana: which vital is favoured healthaffsabove = "curing healthaffsabove %d", defs_on = "curing defences on", defs_off = "curing defences off", defs = "curing priority defence %s", -- "<def> <1-25|reset> ..." pairs predict = "curing predict %s", unpredict = "curing unpredict %s", }
-- Options synced as on/off: setting -> command key S.toggles = { server_focus = "focus", server_tree = "tree", transmute = "transmute", server_insomnia = "insomnia", server_reporting = "reporting" } -- Options that are only sent once you've set them ("" = leave serverside's) S.optional = { server_rejection = "rejection", server_aeonlikeret = "aeonlikeret" }
S._queue = S._queue or {} S._draining = false
-- Spread a big sync out so we don't flood the server. Not for CURING -- PRIORITY, which has its own limit (ss.prio.use). function S.queue(cmd) S._queue[#S._queue + 1] = cmd if not S._draining then S.drain() end end
function S.drain() if not acs.online() then S._draining = false return end -- "acs.login" drains S._draining = true for _ = 1, 8 do local cmd = table.remove(S._queue, 1) if not cmd then S._draining = false return end acs.send(cmd) end tempTimer(0.6, S.drain) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Clotting guard, done by serverside itself: CURING MANATHRESHOLD keeps -- mana-costing cures (clotting) from running you dry, and CURING -- CLOTHEALTH only clots with corrupted humours (clotting drains health) -- while health is above that percent. The mana floor is clot_min_mana, or -- the opponent's clot_min_mana when higher (an Alchemist aurifies at 60% -- health and mana), re-sent when the opponent changes. Sipmana the same.
-- A number the opponent's class script (or its subclass) raises: the -- higher of yours and theirs. against.clot_min_mana, against.sipmana, and -- the same fields under against.subclasses.<sub>. function S.vs_raise(key, mine) local v = tonumber(mine) or 0 local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() local ag = o and ss.opp.against(o.class) if not ag then return v end local sub = o.sub and ag.subclasses and ag.subclasses[o.sub] for _, t in ipairs({ ag, sub or {} }) do if tonumber(t[key]) then v = math.max(v, tonumber(t[key])) end end return v end
function S.clot_floor() return S.vs_raise("clot_min_mana", ss.settings.clot_min_mana) end
-- Client mode: should we clot now? function S.clot_ok() local s = ss.settings if (tonumber(s.clot_at) or 0) <= 0 then return false end local v = ss.vitals or {} if v.mpp and v.mpp < S.clot_floor() then return false end if ss.affs.corruptedhumours and v.hpp and v.hpp <= (tonumber(s.clot_health) or 80) then return false end return true end
function S.clot_check() local s = ss.settings if s.mode ~= "server" or not s.enabled then return end local sy, floor = S.synced(), S.clot_floor() if sy.__manathreshold ~= floor then sy.__manathreshold = floor acs.send(S.cmds.manathreshold:format(floor)) end local sip = S.vs_raise("sipmana", s.sipmana) if sy.__sipmana ~= sip then sy.__sipmana = sip acs.send(S.cmds.sipmana:format(sip)) end end
-- A setting as it should be now: a situation on now can change it for as -- long as it's on (04_prio.lua, situation.set), otherwise yours. function S.eff(key) local sets = ss.prio and ss.prio.sit_sets and ss.prio.sit_sets() or {} if sets[key] ~= nil then return sets[key] end return ss.settings[key] end
-- Situations came on or went off: send what their settings changed. function S.sets_changed() local s = ss.settings if s.mode ~= "server" or not s.enabled or not acs.online() then return end S.sync(false, true) end
-- What serverside was last told (it keeps settings between logins). function S.synced() return ss.settings.synced end
function S.sync(full, quiet) local s = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) return S.eff(k) end }) if full then ss.settings.synced = {} end local sy = S.synced() local n = 0 if sy.__on ~= true then S.queue(S.cmds.on) sy.__on = true n = n + 1 end local function once(key, value, cmd) if sy[key] ~= value then S.queue(cmd) sy[key] = value n = n + 1 end end for _, k in ipairs({ "siphealth", "sipmana", "mosshealth", "mossmana" }) do local v = k == "sipmana" and S.vs_raise(k, s[k]) or s[k] once("__" .. k, v, S.cmds[k]:format(v)) end for setting, key in pairs(S.toggles) do local v = s[setting] and "on" or "off" once("__" .. key, v, S.cmds[key]:format(v)) end once("__useclot", s.clot_at > 0 and "on" or "off", S.cmds.useclot:format(s.clot_at > 0 and "on" or "off")) once("__manathreshold", S.clot_floor(), S.cmds.manathreshold:format(S.clot_floor())) once("__clothealth", s.clot_health, S.cmds.clothealth:format(s.clot_health)) if (tonumber(s.clot_to) or 0) > 0 then once("__clotto", s.clot_to, S.cmds.clotto:format(s.clot_to)) end if s.sip_priority == "health" or s.sip_priority == "mana" then once("__sippriority", s.sip_priority, S.cmds.sippriority:format(s.sip_priority)) end if tonumber(s.health_affs_above) then once("__healthaffsabove", tonumber(s.health_affs_above), S.cmds.healthaffsabove:format(tonumber(s.health_affs_above))) end local g, f = s.focus_guilt and "with" or "without", s.focus_fulminated and "with" or "without" once("__focusguilt", g, S.cmds.focusguilt:format(g)) once("__focusfulminated", f, S.cmds.focusfulminated:format(f)) for setting, key in pairs(S.optional) do local v = s[setting] if v == "on" or v == "off" then once("__" .. key, v, S.cmds[key]:format(v)) end end if s.clot_at > 0 then once("__clotat", s.clot_at, S.cmds.clotat:format(s.clot_at)) end if quiet then ss.save() return n end local sent, waiting = ss.prio.flush(true) -- affliction and defence priorities n = n + sent + waiting ss.save() ss.echo(("serverside sync: %d change%s"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s")) end
function S.set_mode(mode) local s = ss.settings if mode == "server" then s.mode = "server" S.sync() elseif mode == "client" then s.mode = "client" acs.send(S.cmds.off) s.synced.__on = false else ss.err("mode must be server or client") return end ss.save() ss.echo("curing mode: <white>" .. s.mode) end
-- Tell serverside about an affliction GMCP hasn't shown (hidden ones). function S.predict(aff, off) aff = ss.data.canon(aff) acs.send((off and S.cmds.unpredict or S.cmds.predict):format(aff)) end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- SS commands, all under "ss <command>". Type "ss help" in game.
ss.commands = {} local C = ss.commands
function ss._cmd(word, help, fn) C[word] = { fn = fn, help = help } end
function ss.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
function ss.show(title, list) ss.echo("<white>" .. title .. "<reset>: " .. (#list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "<dim_grey>none")) end
function ss.resync() if ss.settings.mode == "server" then ss.server.sync() end end
function ss.toggle(key, label) return function(w) ss.settings[key] = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings[key]) ss.save() ss.echo((label or key) .. " " .. (ss.settings[key] and "on" or "off")) end end
ss._cmd("on", "on|off resume or pause all automatic actions", function() ss.settings.enabled = true ss.save() ss.echo("<green>on") ss.schedule() end) ss._cmd("off", nil, function() ss.settings.enabled = false ss.save() ss.echo("<red>off") end)
ss._cmd("mode", "mode server|client serverside curing, or SS sends every cure", function(w) ss.server.set_mode(w[1]) end) ss._cmd("sync", "sync [full] push priorities and thresholds to serverside", function(w) ss.server.sync(w[1] == "full") end)
ss._cmd("status", "status mode, balances, afflictions, missing defences", function() local s, v = ss.settings, ss.vitals ss.echo(("<white>%s<reset> | mode <white>%s<reset> | class <white>%s<reset> | profile <white>%s"):format( s.enabled and "<green>ON" or "<red>OFF", s.mode, ss.class(), s.prio_profile)) local bals = {} for _, b in ipairs({ "balance", "equilibrium", "herb", "salve", "smoke", "sip", "moss", "focus", "tree" }) do bals[#bals + 1] = (ss.bals[b] ~= false and "<green>" or "<red>") .. b .. "<reset>" end ss.echo("balances: " .. table.concat(bals, " ")) if v.maxhp then ss.echo(("hp %d%% mp %d%% bleed %s"):format(v.hpp, v.mpp, tostring(v.stats.bleed or 0))) end local affs, skipped = {}, {} for _, a in ipairs(ss.engine.sorted_affs()) do affs[#affs + 1] = a .. "(" .. ss.engine.prio(a) .. ")" end for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.affs)) do local why = ss.engine.skip(a) if why then skipped[#skipped + 1] = a .. " <dim_grey>(" .. why .. ")<reset>" end end ss.show("afflictions", affs) if #skipped > 0 then ss.show("left alone", skipped) end ss.show("missing defences", ss.keepup.missing()) local sub = ss.classes.current_sub_name() if ss.classes.current() or sub then ss.echo("class script: <white>" .. ss.class() .. (sub and (" / " .. sub) or "")) end if #ss.prio.active_names() > 0 then ss.show("priority tables on", ss.prio.active_names()) end end)
ss._cmd("subclass", "subclass [name|auto] which subclass you are for this class (scripts in src/classes/)", function(w) local cls = ss.class() local cs = ss.classes.current() if not w[1] then local names = cs and acs.sorted_keys(cs.subclasses or {}) or {} ss.echo(("%s subclass: <white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)"):format(cls, tostring(ss.classes.current_sub_name() or "none"), #names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "no subclasses")) return end if w[1] == "auto" then ss.settings.subclass[cls] = nil elseif not (cs and cs.subclasses and cs.subclasses[w[1]]) then ss.err(cls .. " has no subclass '" .. w[1] .. "'") return else ss.settings.subclass[cls] = w[1] end ss.save() ss.classes.apply() ss.echo(cls .. " subclass: " .. tostring(ss.classes.current_sub_name() or "none")) end)
ss._cmd("prio", { "prio <aff> <1-25> set a priority in the current profile", "prio list show priorities changed from default", "prio batch [n] pairs sent per CURING PRIORITY command (default 50)" }, function(w) local s = ss.settings local prof = s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile] if w[1] == "batch" then local n = tonumber(w[2]) if n and n >= 1 then s.prio_batch = math.floor(n) ss.save() end ss.echo("up to <white>" .. ss.prio.batch() .. "<reset> pairs per CURING PRIORITY command") return end if w[1] == "list" or not w[1] then local r = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(prof)) do if prof[a] ~= ss.data.default_prios[a] then r[#r + 1] = a .. "=" .. prof[a] end end ss.show("changed from default (" .. s.prio_profile .. ")", r) return end local aff, p = ss.data.canon(w[1]), tonumber(w[2]) if not p then ss.err("usage: ss prio <aff> <1-25>") return end prof[aff] = p ss.save() ss.prio.changed() ss.echo(aff .. " priority " .. p .. " in profile " .. s.prio_profile .. (ss.prio.get(aff) ~= p and (" <dim_grey>(a table has it at " .. ss.prio.get(aff) .. " right now)") or "")) end)
ss._cmd("swap", { "swap swaps in effect, and the saved ones", "swap in|out <name> put a saved swap on top of your priorities, or take it off", "swap set <name> <aff> <prio> add to a saved swap ('ss swap set <name> <aff> clear' removes)", "swap clear take every swap off" }, function(w) local s = ss.settings local sub, name = w[1], w[2] if (sub == "in" or sub == "out") and name then if sub == "in" then if not s.swaps[name] then ss.err("no saved swap '" .. name .. "' (make one with ss swap set)") return end ss.prio.swap_in(name, s.swaps[name]) else ss.prio.swap_out(name) end ss.echo("swap " .. name .. " " .. sub) elseif sub == "set" and name and w[3] and w[4] then s.swaps[name] = s.swaps[name] or {} local aff = ss.data.canon(w[3]) s.swaps[name][aff] = w[4] ~= "clear" and tonumber(w[4]) or nil ss.save() if ss.prio.active(name) then ss.prio.swap_in(name, s.swaps[name]) end ss.echo(("swap %s: %s %s"):format(name, aff, tostring(s.swaps[name][aff] or "removed"))) elseif sub == "clear" then ss.prio.clear() ss.echo("all swaps off") else ss.show("swaps in effect", ss.prio.active_names()) local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(s.swaps)) do local parts = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(s.swaps[n])) do parts[#parts + 1] = a .. "=" .. s.swaps[n][a] end r[#r + 1] = n .. " (" .. table.concat(parts, " ") .. ")" end ss.show("saved swaps", r) end end)
ss._cmd("cprio", { "cprio this class's priority table (the class script's, then yours)", "cprio <aff> <prio|clear> set one in your table for this class" }, function(w) local P, cls = ss.prio, ss.classes.key(ss.class()) local mine = P.mine() if w[1] and w[2] then local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. w[1] .. "'") return end mine.prios[aff] = w[2] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[2]) or nil ss.save() P.check() end local cs, sub = ss.classes.current(), ss.classes.current_sub() if cs then ss.echo("class script (" .. cls .. "): " .. P.tbl_text(cs.prios)) end if sub then ss.echo("subclass " .. ss.classes.current_sub_name() .. ": " .. P.tbl_text(sub.prios)) end ss.echo("yours (" .. cls .. "): " .. P.tbl_text(mine.prios)) end)
ss._cmd("sit", { "sit situation tables for this class, and which are on now", "sit <name> when <a> [b ...] when it's on: afflictions or your defences, all of them (!x not, x|y either)", "sit <name> <aff> <prio|clear> what it sets", "sit <name> on|off|del use it, skip it, or delete one of yours", "sit <name> hold off|on close to a kill: don't hold paralysis while it's on (ss parahold)", "sit general <name> ... the same, for every class", "sit vs [<name> ...] the same, against the class you're fighting (ss vs)", " when can also use has:<skill>, class:<c>, vs:<c>, phlegmatic>=6, hp<60, a&b" }, function(w) local P = ss.prio local key = ss.classes.key(ss.class()) local vs if w[1] == "general" then key = "general" table.remove(w, 1) elseif w[1] == "vs" then vs = ss.opp.current() if not vs then ss.err("no opponent now (ss vs <class> sets one)") return end key = "vs " .. vs.class table.remove(w, 1) end local name, sub = w[1], w[2] if not name then local on = {} for _, n in ipairs(P.active_names()) do on[n] = true end if P.group() then ss.echo("<yellow>group fight<reset>: situations are off, the class table is on (ss group)") end local list = P.situations(vs) if vs then ss.echo("against " .. vs.class .. (vs.sub and (" " .. vs.sub) or "") .. ":") end if #list == 0 then ss.echo("no situations for " .. key .. " yet") end for i, sit in ipairs(list) do ss.echo(("%2d. %s%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)<reset> when %s: %s%s"):format(i, on[sit.name] and "<yellow>" or "<white>", sit.name, sit.where, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios), sit.hold == false and " <dim_grey>(no hold)<reset>" or "")) end local off = {} for _, t in ipairs(P.mines(vs)) do for n in pairs(t.off) do off[#off + 1] = n end end if #off > 0 then table.sort(off) ss.show("skipped", off) end return end local mine = P.mine(key) local function own() if not mine.sits[name] then local sc = P.find_sit(name, vs) local prios = {} if sc and type(sc.when) ~= "function" then for a, p in pairs(sc.prios or {}) do prios[a] = p end end mine.sits[name] = { when = sc and type(sc.when) == "table" and acs.copy(sc.when) or {}, prios = prios, hold = sc and sc.hold, defs = sc and sc.defs and acs.copy(sc.defs) or nil, set = sc and sc.set and acs.copy(sc.set) or nil, fake = sc and sc.fake, preapply = sc and sc.preapply, preapply_salve = sc and sc.preapply_salve } mine.order[#mine.order + 1] = name end return mine.sits[name] end if sub == "when" then local sit = own() sit.when = {} for i = 3, #w do sit.when[#sit.when + 1] = w[i]:lower() end elseif sub == "hold" and (w[3] == "on" or w[3] == "off") then local sit = own() if w[3] == "off" then sit.hold = false else sit.hold = nil end elseif sub == "off" or sub == "on" then mine.off[name] = sub == "off" or nil elseif sub == "del" then if not mine.sits[name] then ss.err(name .. " isn't one of yours (ss sit " .. name .. " off skips it)") return end mine.sits[name] = nil for i = #mine.order, 1, -1 do if mine.order[i] == name then table.remove(mine.order, i) end end ss.echo("deleted " .. name) elseif sub and w[3] then local aff = P.aff_name(sub) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. sub .. "'") return end own().prios[aff] = w[3] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[3]) or nil elseif sub then ss.err("usage: ss sit <name> when <terms> | <aff> <prio|clear> | hold off|on | on | off | del") return end if sub then ss.save() P.check() end local sit = P.find_sit(name, vs) if sit then local skipped = false for _, t in ipairs(P.mines(vs)) do if t.off[name] then skipped = true end end ss.echo(("%s when %s: %s%s"):format(name, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios), skipped and " <red>(skipped)" or (P.active(name) and " <yellow>(on now)" or ""))) elseif sub ~= "del" then ss.echo("no situation " .. name .. " (make one with ss sit " .. name .. " when <aff> ...)") end end)
ss._cmd("group", { "group group fight now? (situations and paralysis hold are off in one)", "group auto|on|off by who's hitting you (auto), or set it yourself", "group size <n> | window <sec> how many people, hitting you in how long, make a group fight" }, function(w) local s, P = ss.settings, ss.prio local a = w[1] if a == "auto" or a == "on" or a == "off" then s.group_mode = a elseif a == "size" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.group_size = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(w[2]))) elseif a == "window" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.group_window = tonumber(w[2]) elseif a then ss.err("usage: ss group auto|on|off | size <n> | window <sec>") return end if a then ss.save() P.check() end ss.echo(("group fight: %s <dim_grey>(%s; %d of %d people in %ss)<reset>"):format( P.group() and "<yellow>yes<reset>, situations off" or "no", s.group_mode, ss.attackers.group_count(), s.group_size, tostring(s.group_window))) end)
ss._cmd("prioecho", "prioecho on|off a line when situations come on or go off", ss.toggle("prio_echo", "situation echoes"))
ss._cmd("profile", { "profile <name> switch to (or create) a priority profile", "profile copy <name> copy the current profile to a new name", "profile class [name] use this profile whenever you switch to this class" }, function(w) local s = ss.settings if w[1] == "copy" and w[2] then s.prio_profiles[w[2]] = acs.copy(s.prio_profiles[s.prio_profile]) s.prio_profile = w[2] elseif w[1] == "class" then s.class_profile[ss.class()] = w[2] or s.prio_profile ss.save() ss.echo(ss.class() .. " uses profile " .. s.class_profile[ss.class()]) return elseif w[1] then s.prio_profiles[w[1]] = s.prio_profiles[w[1]] or acs.copy(ss.data.default_prios) s.prio_profile = w[1] else ss.show("profiles (current " .. s.prio_profile .. ")", acs.sorted_keys(s.prio_profiles)) return end ss.save() ss.prio.changed() ss.echo("priority profile: <white>" .. s.prio_profile) end)
for _, k in ipairs({ "siphealth", "sipmana", "mosshealth", "mossmana" }) do ss._cmd(k, k == "siphealth" and "siphealth|sipmana|mosshealth|mossmana <pct>" or nil, function(w) local v = tonumber(w[1]) if not v then ss.echo(k .. " = " .. ss.settings[k]) return end ss.settings[k] = v ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " = " .. v) ss.resync() end) end
ss._cmd("clot", { "clot <amount> clot at this much bleeding (0 = off)", "clot mana <pct> never clot below this much mana (CURING MANATHRESHOLD)", "clot health <pct> with corrupted humours, clot only above this much health" }, function(w) local s = ss.settings local which, v = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) if which == "mana" and v then s.clot_min_mana = v elseif which == "health" and v then s.clot_health = v elseif tonumber(which) then s.clot_at = tonumber(which) elseif which then ss.err("usage: ss clot <amount> | mana <pct> | health <pct>") return end if which then ss.save() ss.resync() end local floor = ss.server.clot_floor() ss.echo(("clot at bleeding %d, not below %d%% mana%s, with corrupted humours only above %d%% health"):format( s.clot_at, floor, floor ~= s.clot_min_mana and " (raised for your opponent)" or "", s.clot_health)) end)
ss._cmd("cure", "cure <aff> <command> teach or override a cure ('clear' to undo)", function(w, rest) local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not aff then ss.err("usage: ss cure <aff> <command>") return end local c = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s*(.*)$") or "" if c == "clear" or c == "" then ss.settings.cure_overrides[aff] = nil ss.echo(aff .. ": using default cure") else ss.settings.cure_overrides[aff] = c ss.echo(aff .. " is cured by: " .. c) end ss.save() end)
ss._cmd("predict", "predict <aff> [off] tell serverside you have an affliction GMCP hasn't shown", function(w) if not w[1] then ss.err("usage: ss predict <affliction> [off]") return end ss.server.predict(w[1], w[2] == "off") end)
ss._cmd("focus", "focus|tree on|off let serverside use focus / the tree tattoo", function(w) ss.toggle("server_focus", "serverside focus")(w) ss.resync() end) ss._cmd("tree", nil, function(w) ss.toggle("server_tree", "serverside tree")(w) ss.resync() end)
-- The rest of the serverside options: name -> setting, kind ss.OPTIONS = { insomnia = { "server_insomnia", "bool", "use the insomnia ability" }, reporting = { "server_reporting", "bool", "show what serverside curing sends" }, guilt = { "focus_guilt", "bool", "focus while you have guilt" }, fulminated = { "focus_fulminated", "bool", "focus while you're fulminated" }, rejection = { "server_rejection", "opt", "reject lust automatically" }, aeonlikeret = { "server_aeonlikeret", "opt", "treat aeon like a retardation room" }, clotto = { "clot_to", "num", "clot bleeding down to this (0 = leave it)" }, }
ss._cmd("options", { "options the other serverside curing options", "options <name> on|off|<n> set one (synced to serverside)", "options preempt <def> toggle: this defence goes ahead of the curing queue" }, function(w) local s = ss.settings local name, v = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), w[2] and w[2]:lower() if name == "preempt" and v then s.def_preempt[acs.norm(v)] = not s.def_preempt[acs.norm(v)] or nil ss.save() ss.prio.changed() elseif name then local o = ss.OPTIONS[name] if not o or not v then ss.err("usage: ss options <" .. table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(ss.OPTIONS), "|") .. "> <value>") return end if o[2] == "num" then if not tonumber(v) then ss.err(name .. " takes a number") return end s[o[1]] = tonumber(v) elseif v ~= "on" and v ~= "off" and not (o[2] == "opt" and v == "unset") then ss.err(name .. " takes on or off" .. (o[2] == "opt" and " (or unset)" or "")) return elseif o[2] == "bool" then s[o[1]] = v == "on" else s[o[1]] = v == "unset" and "" or v end ss.save() ss.resync() end for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.OPTIONS)) do local o = ss.OPTIONS[k] local val = s[o[1]] if o[2] == "bool" then val = val and "on" or "off" elseif val == "" then val = "unset" end ss.echo(("%-12s <white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>%s<reset>"):format(k, tostring(val), o[3])) end ss.show("preempt", acs.sorted_keys(s.def_preempt)) end)
ss._cmd("ignore", "ignore <aff> toggle: never spend cures on this affliction", function(w) local aff = ss.data.canon(w[1]) if not aff then ss.show("ignored", acs.sorted_keys(ss.settings.ignore)) return end ss.settings.ignore[aff] = not ss.settings.ignore[aff] or nil ss.save() ss.echo(aff .. (ss.settings.ignore[aff] and " ignored" or " cured again")) end)
ss._cmd("transmute", "transmute|outrift on|off use minerals (synced to serverside) / outrift first", function(w) ss.toggle("transmute")(w) ss.resync() end) ss._cmd("outrift", nil, ss.toggle("outrift"))
ss._cmd("pipe", "pipe <herb> <id> smoke this pipe id for that herb", function(w) if not w[2] then ss.err("usage: ss pipe <valerian|elm|skullcap> <id>") return end ss.settings.pipes[w[1]] = w[2] ss.save() ss.echo(w[1] .. " pipe: " .. w[2]) end)
-- Defup and keepup (05_keepup.lua)
function ss.def_list_echo(title, t) local r = {} for _, d in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(t)) do r[#r + 1] = (ss.defs[d] and "<green>" or "<red>") .. d .. "<reset> " .. t[d] end ss.show(title, r) end
-- "ss keepup|defup add|del <def> [prio]" and the listing function ss.def_table_cmd(kind, w) local K, sub, def = ss.keepup, w[1], acs.norm(w[2]) if sub == "add" and def then K.set(kind, def, w[3]) ss.echo(kind ..
