" " .. def .. " at " .. K.prio(def)) elseif (sub == "del" or sub == "remove") and def then if K.state(def) == kind then K.set(nil, def) end ss.echo(def .. " is off your " .. kind) else ss.def_list_echo(kind .. " for " .. ss.class() .. " <dim_grey>(green = up)<reset>", kind == "keepup" and K.keepup() or K.defup()) return false end return true end
ss._cmd("defs", "defs [class] every defence for a class: click to choose defup or keepup", function(w) local cls = w[1] or ss.class() if not ss.keepup.known_class(cls) then ss.err("no defence list for " .. cls) return end ss.keepup.grid(cls) end)
ss._cmd("defup", { "defup raise this class's defup defences that are down", "defup add|del <def> [prio] edit this class's defup table", "defup list show it", "defup stop stop raising ones that haven't come up" }, function(w) local K = ss.keepup if w[1] == "stop" then K.stop() ss.echo("defup stopped") return end if w[1] then ss.def_table_cmd("defup", w) return end local n = K.defup_now() ss.echo(("defup: raising %d defence%s"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s")) end)
ss._cmd("keepup", { "keepup show this class's keepup table", "keepup add|del <def> [prio] edit it", "keepup learn add the defences you have up now", "keepup on|off switch defup and keepup off entirely", "keepup combat on|off client mode: keep raising bal/eq defences while afflicted", "keepup suggest defences the shared reference lists for your class" }, function(w) local K, sub, s = ss.keepup, w[1], ss.settings if sub == "learn" then K.learn() elseif sub == "on" or sub == "off" then s.keepup_enabled = sub == "on" K.changed() ss.echo("defup and keepup " .. sub) elseif sub == "combat" then ss.toggle("keepup_in_combat", "keepup while afflicted")({ w[2] }) elseif sub == "suggest" then local r = {} for _, d in ipairs(K.suggest(w[2])) do local st = K.state(d) r[#r + 1] = (st == "keepup" and "<orange>" or st == "defup" and "<red>" or "<white>") .. d .. "<reset>" end ss.show("defences for " .. (w[2] or ss.class()) .. " <dim_grey>(red = defup, orange = keepup)<reset>", r) else ss.def_table_cmd("keepup", w) if #K.missing() > 0 then ss.show("missing now", K.missing()) end end end)
ss._cmd("defprio", "defprio <def> <1-25> priority of a defup or keepup defence (1 first)", function(w) local def, p = acs.norm(w[1]), tonumber(w[2]) if not def or not p then ss.err("usage: ss defprio <def> <1-25>") return end if not ss.keepup.set_prio(def, p) then ss.err(def .. " isn't on your defup or keepup") return end ss.echo(def .. " priority " .. ss.keepup.prio(def)) end)
ss._cmd("deftoggle", "deftoggle [def] [on|off] keep a defence up while on (rebounding, shield...)", function(w) local def = acs.norm(w[1]) if not def then local r = {} for _, d in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.settings.def_toggles)) do r[#r + 1] = (ss.settings.def_toggles[d] and "<green>" or "<grey>") .. d .. "<reset>" end ss.show("toggles", r) return end local on = nil if w[2] == "on" then on = true elseif w[2] == "off" then on = false end ss.keepup.toggle(def, on) end)
ss._cmd("predefup", "predefup [cmd|cmd|... | clear] commands sent before defup for this class", function(w, rest) local cls = acs.norm(ss.class()) local cmds = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if cmds == "clear" then ss.settings.predefup[cls] = "" ss.save() elseif cmds ~= "" then ss.settings.predefup[cls] = cmds ss.save() end ss.show("before defup (" .. cls .. ")", ss.keepup.predefup()) end)
ss._cmd("defecho", "defecho on|off Gained/Lost lines for your defences", ss.toggle("def_echo", "defence echoes"))
ss._cmd("parahold", "parahold [on|off|balance|eq|both] paralysis waits at 25 while you can't act anyway", function(w) local s, H = ss.settings, ss.parahold local cls = acs.norm(ss.class()) local need = ({ balance = "balance", bal = "balance", eq = "equilibrium", equilibrium = "equilibrium", both = "both" })[w[1] or ""] if need then s.para_hold_on[cls] = need ss.save() elseif w[1] == "on" or w[1] == "off" then s.para_hold = w[1] == "on" ss.save() H.check() end ss.echo(("paralysis hold %s, waiting on %s for %s (now %s)"):format(s.para_hold and "<green>on<reset>" or "<red>off<reset>", H.needs() == "both" and "balance and equilibrium" or H.needs(), cls, ss.prio.active(H.SWAP) and "<yellow>holding<reset>" or "not holding")) end)
ss._cmd("baltimes", "baltimes [clear] how long your actions take, learned per class", function(w) local t = ss.parahold.times() if w[1] == "clear" then for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = nil end ss.save() end local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(t)) do r[#r + 1] = ("%s %.2fs"):format(k, t[k]) end ss.show("balance times for " .. ss.class(), r) end)
ss._cmd("defcmd", "defcmd <def> <cmd>[@bal] how to raise a defence (@bal, @eq, @eqbal, @free, @herb, @salve, @sip, @smoke)", function(w, rest) local def = acs.norm(w[1]) local c = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s*(.*)$") or "" if not def or c == "" then ss.err("usage: ss defcmd <def> <command>[@bal]") return end ss.settings.def_cmds[def] = c ss.save() ss.echo(def .. " raised with: " .. c) end)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Actives and passives
function ss.state_word(on, has_skill) if on then return "<green>on " end return has_skill and "<grey>off" or "<dim_grey>n/a" end
ss._cmd("active", { "active list class skill cures and which are on for this class", "active on|off|auto <name>", "active add <name> <bal> <cd> <command> a new active cure", "active cures <name> <aff>...|any|health|mana" }, function(w, rest) local cls = ss.class() local s = ss.settings s.actives[cls] = s.actives[cls] or {} local t = s.actives[cls] local sub, name = w[1], w[2] local A = ss.data.actives if (sub == "on" or sub == "off" or sub == "auto") and name then if not A[name] then ss.err("unknown active cure " .. name) return end if sub == "auto" then t[name] = nil else t[name] = sub == "on" end ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " " .. sub .. " for " .. cls) elseif sub == "add" and w[5] then local c = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+%S+%s+%S+%s+(.*)$") A[name] = { cmd = c, cures = "any", bal = w[3], cd = tonumber(w[4]) or 10, classes = { cls } } s.custom_actives[name] = A[name] t[name] = true ss.save() ss.echo("added active cure " .. name .. " (cures any; narrow it with 'ss active cures " .. name .. " <affs>')") elseif sub == "cures" and name and w[3] then if not A[name] then ss.err("unknown active cure " .. name) return end local list = {} for i = 3, #w do list[#list + 1] = ss.data.canon(w[i]) end A[name].cures = (#list == 1 and (list[1] == "any" or list[1] == "health" or list[1] == "mana")) and list[1] or list s.custom_actives[name] = A[name] ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " now used for: " .. (type(A[name].cures) == "table" and table.concat(A[name].cures, ", ") or A[name].cures)) else ss.echo("<white>active cures<reset> for " .. cls .. " <dim_grey>(n/a = skill not found on this character)") for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(A)) do local ac = A[n] local cures = type(ac.cures) == "table" and table.concat(ac.cures, ",") or tostring(ac.cures) cecho(("\n %s<reset> %-11s %-18s <dim_grey>%s, %ss %s"):format( ss.state_word(ss.engine.active_on(n), ac.skill == nil or ss.has_skill(ac.skill)), n, ac.cmd, ac.bal or "eqbal", tostring(ac.cd or 10), cures:sub(1, 40))) end end end)
ss._cmd("passive", { "passive list passives, and which are in effect now", "passive on|off|auto <name>", "passive add <name> <def|always> <ignore|delay> <aff>... a new passive" }, function(w) local cls = ss.class() local s = ss.settings s.passives[cls] = s.passives[cls] or {} local t = s.passives[cls] local sub, name = w[1], w[2] local P = ss.data.passives if (sub == "on" or sub == "off" or sub == "auto") and name then if not P[name] then ss.err("unknown passive " .. name) return end if sub == "auto" then t[name] = nil else t[name] = sub == "on" end ss.save() ss.echo(name .. " " .. sub .. " for " .. cls) elseif sub == "add" and w[5] then local affs = {} for i = 5, #w do affs[#affs + 1] = ss.data.canon(w[i]) end local def = w[3] ~= "always" and acs.norm(w[3]) or nil P[name] = { def = def, skill = not def and name or nil, affs = affs, effect = w[4] == "delay" and "delay" or "ignore", wait = 3, classes = { cls } } s.custom_passives[name] = P[name] if not def then t[name] = true end ss.save() ss.echo("added passive " .. name) else ss.echo("<white>passives<reset> for " .. cls) for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(P)) do local p = P[n] cecho(("\n %s<reset> %-13s %-8s <dim_grey>%s %s"):format( ss.engine.passive_on(n) and "<green>in effect" or "<grey>inactive ", n, p.effect or "ignore", p.def and ("while " .. p.def .. " is up,") or "always,", table.concat(p.affs or {}, ","))) end end end)
ss._cmd("class", "class [name] actives, passives and defences known for a class", function(w) local cls = w[1] or ss.class() local v = ss.data.for_class(cls) ss.echo("<white>" .. cls) ss.show("actives", v.actives) ss.show("passives", v.passives) ss.show("defences with known commands", acs.sorted_keys(v.defs)) end)
ss._cmd("skills", "skills [text] abilities GMCP says you have (filter by text)", function(w) local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.skills)) do if not w[1] or k:find(w[1], 1, true) then r[#r + 1] = k end end ss.show(#r .. " skills", r) end)
ss._cmd("autoactive", "autoactive on|off turn on actives/passives you have the skill for", ss.toggle("auto_actives", "automatic actives")) ss._cmd("defaffs", "defaffs on|off (no effect: blindness, deafness and insomnia are never treated as afflictions)", ss.toggle("ignore_def_affs", "defence-named afflictions left alone")) ss._cmd("ui", "ui on|off status window", function(w) ss.settings.ui = ss.onoff(w[1], ss.settings.ui) ss.save() ss.ui.toggle(ss.settings.ui) end)
function ss.cmd(line) ss.M.run(line) end

Script.name: status window
Script.script:
-- SS status window: your afflictions and missing defences. Toggle with -- "ss ui". Uses Geyser, which ships with Mudlet.
ss.ui = ss.ui or {} local U = ss.ui
function U.create() if U.box or not Geyser then return end U.box = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "ss_ui", x = "-26%", y = "0%", width = "25%", height = "30%", fontSize = 9, color = "black", autoWrap = true, }) end
function U.toggle(on) if on then U.create() if U.box then U.box:show() U.refresh() end elseif U.box then U.box:hide() end end
function U.line(text) U.box:cecho(text .. "\n") end
function U.refresh() if not ss.settings.ui or not U.box then return end U.box:clear() local s = ss.settings U.line(("<cyan>SS<reset> %s <dim_grey>%s / %s / %s"):format(s.enabled and "<green>on" or "<red>off", s.mode, ss.class(), s.prio_profile)) U.line("") U.line("<white>Afflictions") local order = ss.engine.sorted_affs() if #order == 0 then U.line(" <dim_grey>none") end for _, a in ipairs(order) do U.line((" <orange_red>%-16s<dim_grey>%d"):format(a, ss.engine.prio(a))) end for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ss.affs)) do local why = ss.engine.skip(a) if why then U.line((" <dim_grey>%-16s%s"):format(a, why)) end end local miss = ss.keepup.missing() if #miss > 0 then U.line("") U.line("<white>Missing defences") U.line(" <yellow>" .. table.concat(miss, ", ")) end local atk = ss.attackers and ss.attackers.list() or {} if #atk > 0 then U.line("") U.line("<white>Attackers") local now = acs.now() for _, r in ipairs(atk) do U.line((" <orange_red>%-11s<grey>%-11s %-9s <dim_grey>%dx %ds"):format(r.name, r.class or "?", r.city or "?", r.hits, math.floor(now - r.last))) end end end
-- Refresh at most a few times a second. U._pending = false function U.queue_refresh() if U._pending or not ss.settings.ui then return end U._pending = true tempTimer(0.2, function() U._pending = false U.refresh() end) end

Script.name: attackers
Script.script:
-- SS attackers: everyone who has hit you recently, with their class and -- city, dropped 30 seconds (ss.settings.attack_window) after their last hit. -- -- Works for every class without knowing their attack lines: a line that -- starts with a player's name and mentions you ("Bob slashes into you", -- "Bob's dart strikes your neck") counts as a hit when it comes with harm -- within half a second either side of it: lost health or mana, a new -- affliction, or a lost defence. Afflictions that arrive with the hit are -- noted against the attacker. Friendly lines (says, tells, bows, waves...) -- are skipped; add more with "ss attackers skip <word>". With harm_required -- off, every matching line from someone in the room counts. -- -- Class and city come from the people tracker (PT) when it's installed: -- what PT has seen someone do first, then the Achaea API (looked up on the -- first hit). Expiry runs on the heartbeat (HB) when it's installed, and on -- a one-second timer of our own when it isn't. -- -- For other packages: -- ss.attackers.list() current attackers, most recent hit first -- ss.attackers.get(name) { name, class, city, hits, first, last, affs } -- events "ss.attacker.hit"(name, record), "ss.attacker.expired"(name), -- "ss.attackers.changed"
ss.attackers = ss.attackers or {} local AT = ss.attackers AT.people = AT.people or {} -- key -> record AT._lines = AT._lines or {} -- recent candidate lines { at, key, name } AT._harm = AT._harm or {} -- recent harm { at, aff }
AT.match_gap = 0.5
for k, v in pairs({ attack_track = true, attack_window = 30, harm_required = true, attack_echo = true, attack_skip = {}, }) do ss.default_settings[k] = v end acs.merge_defaults(ss.settings, ss.default_settings)
-- Words after the name that mean the line isn't an attack. AT.default_skip = { "says", "say", "tells", "asks", "exclaims", "whispers", "yells", "shouts", "bows", "waves", "nods", "smiles", "grins", "hugs", "kisses", "winks", "laughs", "greets", "thanks", "pats", "pokes", "salutes", "curtsies", "beams", "chuckles", "giggles", "cheers", "embraces", "hands", "gives", "offers", "follows", "begins", "leads", "beckons", "invites", "accepts", }
AT.NOT_NAMES = { you = true, your = true, the = true, a = true, an = true, it = true, he = true, she = true, they = true, someone = true, something = true }
function AT.key(name) return name and tostring(name):lower() end function AT.cap(k) return k:sub(1, 1):upper() .. k:sub(2) end
function AT.pt_loaded() return rawget(_G, "pt") and pt.class and pt.get end
-- Is this name a player who could have hit us? function AT.is_player(name) local k = AT.key(name) if not k or AT.NOT_NAMES[k] or k == AT.key(acs.me.name) then return false end if rawget(_G, "rm") and rm.players then for n in pairs(rm.players) do if AT.key(n) == k then return true end end end local here = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players if type(here) == "table" then for _, p in ipairs(here) do if AT.key(p.name) == k then return true end end end if AT.pt_loaded() then if pt.is_here and pt.is_here(name) then return true end if pt.get(name) then return true end end return AT.people[k] ~= nil -- already attacking us (may have left the room) end
function AT.skip_word(word) word = AT.key(word) if not word then return false end for _, w in ipairs(AT.default_skip) do if w == word then return true end end return ss.settings.attack_skip[word] == true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Records
function AT.fill(rec) if AT.pt_loaded() then rec.class = pt.class(rec.name) or rec.class rec.city = pt.city(rec.name) or rec.city end end
function AT.hit(name, aff) local k = AT.key(name) local now = acs.now() local rec = AT.people[k] local new = rec == nil if new then rec = { name = AT.cap(k), hits = 0, first = now, affs = {} } AT.people[k] = rec end rec.last = now rec.hits = rec.hits + 1 if aff then rec.affs[aff] = (rec.affs[aff] or 0) + 1 end AT.fill(rec) if new and AT.pt_loaded() and pt.api and pt.api.lookup and not (rec.class and rec.city) then pt.api.lookup(rec.name, false, function() if AT.people[k] then AT.fill(AT.people[k]) raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end end) end if new and ss.settings.attack_echo then ss.echo(("<orange_red>%s<reset> is attacking you %s"):format(rec.name, AT.describe(rec))) end raiseEvent("ss.attacker.hit", rec.name, rec) raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") return rec end
-- An affliction that turned up with a hit we already counted. function AT.add_aff(name, aff) local rec = AT.people[AT.key(name)] if rec and aff then rec.affs[aff] = (rec.affs[aff] or 0) + 1 raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end end
function AT.describe(rec) return ("(%s, %s)"):format(rec.class or "class ?", rec.city or "city ?") end
function AT.get(name) return AT.people[AT.key(name)] end
function AT.list() local r = {} for _, rec in pairs(AT.people) do r[#r + 1] = rec end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.last > b.last end) return r end
-- How many people have hit you in the last group_window seconds (a group -- fight at group_size, 04_prio.lua). function AT.group_count() local now, window, n = acs.now(), tonumber(ss.settings.group_window) or 15, 0 for _, rec in pairs(AT.people) do if now - rec.last < window then n = n + 1 end end return n end
function AT.expire() local now = acs.now() local window = ss.settings.attack_window local gone = false for k, rec in pairs(AT.people) do if now - rec.last >= window then AT.people[k] = nil gone = true raiseEvent("ss.attacker.expired", rec.name) end end -- forget old candidate lines and harm for _, t in ipairs({ AT._lines, AT._harm }) do for i = #t, 1, -1 do if now - t[i].at > 2 then table.remove(t, i) end end end if gone then raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end end
function AT.clear() AT.people, AT._lines, AT._harm = {}, {}, {} raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Matching lines with harm
function AT.recent(list, now) local r = {} for _, e in ipairs(list) do if math.abs(now - e.at) <= AT.match_gap then r[#r + 1] = e end end return r end
-- A line naming a player and mentioning you. function AT.on_line(name, word) if not ss.settings.attack_track then return end if AT.skip_word(word) or not AT.is_player(name) then return end local now = acs.now() local harm = AT.recent(AT._harm, now) if #harm > 0 or not ss.settings.harm_required then local rec = AT.hit(name) for _, h in ipairs(harm) do if h.aff then AT.add_aff(rec.name, h.aff) end end AT._lines[#AT._lines + 1] = { at = now, key = AT.key(name), counted = true } else AT._lines[#AT._lines + 1] = { at = now, key = AT.key(name) } end end
-- Something bad happened to you. function AT.on_harm(aff) if not ss.settings.attack_track then return end local now = acs.now() AT._harm[#AT._harm + 1] = { at = now, aff = aff } for _, l in ipairs(AT.recent(AT._lines, now)) do if l.counted then if aff then AT.add_aff(l.key, aff) end else l.counted = true AT.hit(l.key, aff) end end end
AT._last = AT._last or {} function AT.on_vitals() local v = ss.vitals local hurt = (AT._last.hp and v.hp and v.hp < AT._last.hp) or (AT._last.mp and v.mp and v.mp < AT._last.mp - 50) AT._last.hp, AT._last.mp = v.hp, v.mp if hurt then AT.on_harm(nil) end end
-- Name at the start of the line (possibly possessive), the next word, and -- "you"/"your" somewhere after it. AT.line_pattern = [[^([A-Z][a-z]+)(?:'s)? (\w+).*\b(?:you|your|yourself)\b]]
function AT.install(M) M.trigger(AT.line_pattern, function(m) AT.on_line(m[2], m[3]) end) M.on("ss.aff.gained", function(_, aff) AT.on_harm(aff) end) M.on("ss.def.down", function() AT.on_harm(nil) end) M.on("ss.vitals", AT.on_vitals) M.on("ss.attackers.changed", function() if ss.ui then ss.ui.queue_refresh() end end) -- expiry: heartbeat when there is one, otherwise our own timer local function use_hb() if rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.register then hb.register("ss.attackers", AT.expire, { every = 1, owner = "ss", priority = 15 }) return true end end M.on("hb.ready", use_hb) use_hb() -- our own timer always runs and stands down while HB is doing the work, -- so expiry carries on if HB is uninstalled later local function loop() if not (rawget(_G, "hb") and hb.get and hb.get("ss.attackers")) then AT.expire() end M.timer(1, loop) end M.timer(1, loop) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Command
ss.commands.attackers = { help = { "attackers who has hit you in the last 30s, with class and city", "attackers window <s> how long someone stays listed after their last hit", "attackers on|off tracking on or off", "attackers harm on|off only count lines that came with damage or an affliction", "attackers echo on|off announce each new attacker", "attackers skip <word> toggle a word that marks a line as friendly", "attackers clear" }, fn = function(w) local s = ss.settings local sub = w[1] if sub == "window" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.attack_window = tonumber(w[2]) ss.save() ss.echo("attackers drop off after " .. s.attack_window .. "s") elseif sub == "on" or sub == "off" then s.attack_track = sub == "on" ss.save() ss.echo("attacker tracking " .. sub) elseif sub == "harm" or sub == "echo" then local k = sub == "harm" and "harm_required" or "attack_echo" if w[2] == "on" then s[k] = true elseif w[2] == "off" then s[k] = false else s[k] = not s[k] end ss.save() ss.echo(k .. " " .. (s[k] and "on" or "off")) elseif sub == "skip" and w[2] then local word = w[2]:lower() s.attack_skip[word] = not s.attack_skip[word] or nil ss.save() ss.echo("'" .. word .. "' " .. (s.attack_skip[word] and "marks a friendly line" or "no longer skipped")) elseif sub == "clear" then AT.clear() ss.echo("attackers cleared") else local list = AT.list() ss.echo(("<white>attackers<reset> (last %ds): %s"):format(s.attack_window, #list == 0 and "<dim_grey>none" or "")) local now = acs.now() for _, rec in ipairs(list) do local affs = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(rec.affs)) do affs[#affs + 1] = a end cecho(("\n <orange_red>%-12s<reset> %-12s %-10s %2d hit%s, %2ds ago <dim_grey>%s"):format( rec.name, rec.class or "?", rec.city or "?", rec.hits, rec.hits == 1 and " " or "s", math.floor(now - rec.last), table.concat(affs, ", "))) end end end, }

Script.name: paralysis hold
Script.script:
-- SS paralysis hold: while paralysis can wait, eat for something else. -- -- Paralysis only matters once you could act again. So while you're -- paralysed, off balance (or equilibrium, see "ss parahold"), have other -- afflictions to eat for, and balance isn't due back until after one more -- herb balance, paralysis is swapped down to 25. It goes back to its own -- priority one herb balance (plus lag) before balance is due, so it's eaten -- in time; at once if balance comes back early or nothing else needs eating. -- Works in both modes: serverside gets the swap, client mode sorts by it. -- -- The game says how long each action takes ("Balance used: 0.9s.", -- "Equilibrium used: 3.00s."), and that's what's used. For actions that -- don't say, it's learned as you play: each time balance or equilibrium goes -- and comes back, SS remembers how long it took after the command that used -- it ("ss baltimes"), per class. Some times change with afflictions -- (restoring with broken limbs, tumbling with damaged ones, confusion, -- lethargy): while one of those is on, nothing is learned, so a slow -- balance doesn't make SS think your usual one is slow. The game's line -- still counts for that balance; without it SS uses your usual time, which -- is the safe side (paralysis goes back early, never late).
ss.parahold = ss.parahold or {} local H = ss.parahold H.SWAP = "parahold" -- its name in ss.prio.active_names() H.MARGIN = 0.2 -- seconds of slack on top of herb balance and lag H.DEFAULT = 3.0 -- seconds, before anything is learned H._lost = H._lost or {} -- balance/equilibrium -> { at, key, due, shown, variable } while it's gone
-- Commands that don't use balance themselves (SS's own, queueing, config). H.IGNORE = { curing = true, cure = true, queue = true, config = true, ss = true, outr = true, outrift = true, eat = true, apply = true, sip = true, drink = true, smoke = true, touch = true, focus = true, ql = true, look = true, score = true, who = true }
-- The word a balance time is learned under: the command's first word, or -- the queued command's ("queue addclear eb jab x" is "jab"). function H.cmd_key(cmd) cmd = tostring(cmd or ""):lower() cmd = cmd:match("^%s*queue%s+add%a*%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") or cmd local w = cmd:match("^%s*([%a]+)") if not w or H.IGNORE[w] then return nil end return w end
-- Afflictions that make balance take longer than usual. H.VARIABLE_AFFS = { lethargy = true, confusion = true } H.LIMB_PREFIX = { "broken", "damaged", "mangled" }
-- The first such affliction you have, or nil. function H.variable() for aff in pairs(ss.affs) do if H.VARIABLE_AFFS[aff] then return aff end local tail = aff:sub(-3) if tail == "arm" or tail == "leg" then for _, p in ipairs(H.LIMB_PREFIX) do if aff:sub(1, #p) == p then return aff end end end end end
function H.on_send(cmd) local k = H.cmd_key(cmd) if k then H._last = { key = k, at = acs.now() } end end
function H.times(cls) local t = ss.settings.bal_times cls = acs.norm(cls or ss.class()) t[cls] = t[cls] or {} return t[cls] end
-- How long balance (or equilibrium) usually takes after a command. function H.estimate(b, key) local t = H.times() return t[b .. " " .. (key or "?")] or t[b .. " *"] or H.DEFAULT end
local function save_soon() if H._save_pending then return end H._save_pending = true tempTimer(30, function() H._save_pending = false ss.save() end) end
function H.on_balance(b, available) if b ~= "balance" and b ~= "equilibrium" then return end local now = acs.now() if not available then local last = H._last local key = last and now - last.at < 1.5 and last.key or nil local l = H._lost[b] -- the "used" line can come just before GMCP says it's gone if l and l.due and now - l.at < 1 then l.key = l.key or key else H._lost[b] = { at = now, key = key, variable = H.variable() } end else local l = H._lost[b] H._lost[b] = nil local d = l and not l.shown and not l.variable and not H.variable() and now - l.at if d and d > 0.3 and d < 15 then local t = H.times() local k = b .. " " .. (l.key or "?") t[k] = t[k] and (t[k] + d) / 2 or d t[b .. " *"] = t[b .. " *"] and (t[b .. " *"] * 3 + d) / 4 or d save_soon() end end H.check() end
-- Which balance you need to act, for this class: "balance" (default), -- "equilibrium", or "both" (only held while both are gone). function H.needs() return ss.settings.para_hold_on[acs.norm(ss.class())] or "balance" end
-- The game said how long this balance will take: use that, and remember -- it for the command in case the line doesn't show next time (unless an -- affliction made this one longer than usual). function H.set_time(b, seconds) seconds = tonumber(seconds) if not seconds then return end local now = acs.now() local l = H._lost[b] if not l or now - l.at > 1 then local last = H._last l = { at = now, key = last and now - last.at < 1.5 and last.key or nil } H._lost[b] = l end l.due = now + seconds l.shown = true l.variable = l.variable or H.variable() if l.key and not l.variable then H.times()[b .. " " .. l.key] = seconds save_soon() end H.check() end
-- "Balance used: 0.9s." / "Equilibrium used: 3.00s." function H.used_line(which, seconds) H.set_time(tostring(which):lower() == "equilibrium" and "equilibrium" or "balance", seconds) end
-- Seconds until you can act again (0 = now, or not known to be gone). function H.time_left() local now = acs.now() local function left(b) local l = H._lost[b] if ss.bals[b] ~= false or not l then return 0 end return math.max(0, (l.due or (l.at + H.estimate(b, l.key))) - now) end local need = H.needs() if need == "both" then return math.min(left("balance"), left("equilibrium")) end return left(need) end
-- One herb balance plus lag: how early paralysis has to go back. function H.window() return (ss.bal_timeouts.herb or 1.5) + ss.bal_lag + H.MARGIN end
-- Anything besides paralysis that serverside would eat for? function H.other_herb_affs() for aff in pairs(ss.affs) do if aff ~= "paralysis" and not ss.engine.skip(aff) then local cure = ss.engine.cures_for(aff)[1] if cure and ss.engine.parse(cure).bal == "herb" then return true end end end return false end
-- Should paralysis be at 25 right now? (A table in 04_prio.lua asks.) -- Not in a group fight: there you just want paralysis cured. function H.wanted() local s = ss.settings if not (s.enabled and s.para_hold and ss.affs.paralysis) then return false, 0 end -- you're executing someone, or close to a kill (a situation with -- hold = false): cure it, don't wait if ss.prio.nohold() then return false, 0 end if ss.prio.group() then return false, 0 end local left = H.time_left() return left > H.window() and H.other_herb_affs(), left end
-- Look again now, and again when paralysis has to go back. function H.check() local want, left = H.wanted() if want ~= (H._on or false) then H._on = want ss.debug(("paralysis %s (%.1fs to act)"):format(want and "held at 25" or "back", left)) ss.prio.changed() ss.prio.flush() ss.schedule() end if H._timer then killTimer(H._timer) H._timer = nil end if want then H._timer = tempTimer(math.max(0.05, left - H.window()), function() H._timer = nil H.check() end) end end
function H.install(M) M.on("ss.balance", function(_, b, available) H.on_balance(b, available) end) M.on("ss.aff.gained", function() H.check() end) M.on("ss.aff.lost", function() H.check() end) M.on("sysDataSendRequest", function(_, cmd) H.on_send(cmd) end) end

Script.name: opponent
Script.script:
-- SS opponent: whose class the vs tables are for (04_prio.lua). -- -- One on one, it's whoever hit you most recently, within the group window -- (ss group window), and whose class we know: the people tracker or the -- Achaea API fills it in (09_attackers.lua). In a group fight there's no -- opponent: you fight on your class table. "ss vs <class> [subclass]" sets -- one by hand until "ss vs auto". -- -- The subclass (Formulation or Sublimation Alchemist, say) comes from, in -- order: one you set, the people tracker's "subclass" field, lines the -- opponent's class script lists under against.signs, then the script's -- against.default_sub. -- -- A class script's "against" block: -- against = { -- prios = { aff = prio }, -- always on against this class -- situations = { { name, when, prios }, ... }, -- subclasses = { formulation = { prios = {}, situations = {} } }, -- default_sub = "formulation", -- when we can't tell -- signs = { sublimation = { "lua pattern", ... } }, -- lines that give it away -- } -- -- For other packages: ss.opp.current() -> { class, sub, name } or nil.
ss.opp = ss.opp or {} local O = ss.opp
function O.against(cls) local cs = cls and ss.classes.scripts[ss.classes.key(cls)] return cs and cs.against end
-- A class name that is itself a subclass ("airlord" for Elemental Lord): -- that subclass, or nil. function O.name_sub(name, cls) local ag = O.against(cls) local n = acs.norm(tostring(name or "")) return ag and ag.subclasses and ag.subclasses[n] and n or nil end
-- The subclass we can tell for an attacker record, or nil. function O.sub_of(rec, cls) if rec.subclass then return rec.subclass end if O.name_sub(rec.class, cls) then return O.name_sub(rec.class, cls) end if rawget(_G, "pt") and pt.field then local s = pt.field(rec.name, "subclass") if s then return acs.norm(s) end end local ag = O.against(cls) return ag and ag.default_sub or nil end
function O.current() local s = ss.settings if ss.prio and ss.prio.group() then return nil end if s.vs and s.vs ~= "auto" and s.vs ~= "" then local cls = ss.classes.key(s.vs) local ag = O.against(cls) local sub = s.vs_sub ~= "" and acs.norm(s.vs_sub) or (ag and ag.default_sub) or nil return { class = cls, sub = sub, name = nil } end if not ss.attackers then return nil end local now, window = acs.now(), tonumber(s.group_window) or 15 for _, rec in ipairs(ss.attackers.list()) do if now - rec.last >= window then break end if rec.class then local cls = ss.classes.key(rec.class) local sub = s.vs_sub ~= "" and acs.norm(s.vs_sub) or O.sub_of(rec, cls) return { class = cls, sub = sub, name = rec.name } end end return nil end
-- A line from someone hitting you: does it give their subclass away? function O.on_line(name, text) local rec = ss.attackers and ss.attackers.get(name) if not (rec and rec.class) then return end local ag = O.against(rec.class) for sub, pats in pairs(ag and ag.signs or {}) do for _, pat in ipairs(pats) do if tostring(text):find(pat) then if rec.subclass ~= sub then rec.subclass = sub raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end return end end end end
function O.install(M) M.trigger(ss.attackers.line_pattern, function(m) O.on_line(m[2], rawget(_G, "line") or m[1]) end) end
ss._cmd("vs", { "vs who you're fighting, and the vs tables on now", "vs <class> [subclass] fight on that class's tables until 'ss vs auto'", "vs sub <subclass>|auto set the opponent's subclass, or detect it again", "vs auto go by who's hitting you" }, function(w) local s, P = ss.settings, ss.prio local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "auto" then s.vs, s.vs_sub = "auto", "" elseif a == "sub" and w[2] then s.vs_sub = w[2]:lower() == "auto" and "" or acs.norm(w[2]) elseif a then local cls = ss.classes.key(a) if not ss.classes.scripts[cls] then ss.err("no class script for " .. a) return end s.vs, s.vs_sub = cls, w[2] and acs.norm(w[2]) or O.name_sub(a, cls) or "" end if a then ss.save() P.check() ss.server.clot_check() if ss.land_check then ss.land_check() end end local o = O.current() if P.group() then ss.echo("<yellow>group fight<reset>: no opponent table, just your class table") return end if not o then ss.echo("no opponent (nobody with a known class has hit you lately; ss vs <class> sets one)") return end ss.echo(("vs <yellow>%s%s<reset>%s <dim_grey>(%s)<reset>"):format(o.class, o.sub and (" " .. o.sub) or "", o.name and (": " .. o.name) or "", s.vs == "auto" and "auto" or "set by hand")) local ag, sub = P.against(o) ss.echo("table: " .. P.tbl_text(ag.prios or {})) if o.sub then ss.echo(o.sub .. ": " .. P.tbl_text(sub.prios or {})) end ss.echo("yours: " .. P.tbl_text(P.mine("vs " .. o.class).prios)) for _, sit in ipairs(P.situations(o)) do ss.echo((" %s%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%s)<reset> when %s: %s"):format(P.active(sit.name) and "<yellow>" or "<white>", sit.name, sit.where, P.when_text(sit.when), P.tbl_text(sit.prios))) end end)
ss._cmd("vprio", "vprio <aff> <prio|clear> your own number against the current opponent's class", function(w) local P = ss.prio local o = O.current() if not o then ss.err("no opponent now (ss vs <class> sets one)") return end local mine = P.mine("vs " .. o.class) if w[1] and w[2] then local aff = P.aff_name(w[1]) if not ss.data.affs[aff] then ss.err("no affliction '" .. w[1] .. "'") return end mine.prios[aff] = w[2] ~= "clear" and P.clamp(w[2]) or nil ss.save() P.check() elseif w[1] then ss.err("usage: ss vprio <aff> <prio|clear>") return end ss.echo(("vs %s, yours: %s"):format(o.class, P.tbl_text(mine.prios))) end)

Script.name: limbs
Script.script:
-- SS limbs: how close each of your own limbs is to breaking. -- -- From AW's old system (myLimbs): every hit on a limb adds its percent, and -- the count goes back to what your limb afflictions say after 120 seconds -- without a hit. A limb affliction sets the count when it comes (broken -- 100, damaged 200, mangled 300; head and torso one level lower, as they -- have no "broken") and when it's cured. -- -- The game says how much every hit does, whatever the class (AW's old -- triggers): "<someone> has dealt 21% damage to your left leg." and "The -- pain plaguing your left leg subsides." when it heals. Those are what -- count. Without one, the opponent's class script's against.limb_hit (a -- Bard is 21%) is what "ss limbs hit" adds. Extra hit lines are listed -- per class under against.limb_lines = { { [[regex]], limb = "torso" } or -- { [[regex]], limb = 1 } (the capture with the limb name), pct = 2 (the -- capture with the percent, optional) }, counted while that class is the -- one hitting you. -- -- "when" terms (04_prio.lua): leftleg>=79 and so on, limb>=79 (the -- highest), breaks>=1 (limbs at 100 or more).
ss.limbs = ss.limbs or {} local L = ss.limbs L.NAMES = { "head", "torso", "leftarm", "rightarm", "leftleg", "rightleg" } L.DECAY = 120 L._hits = L._hits or {} -- limb -> { pct, at }
-- What the afflictions say: limb -> percent. L.LEVELS = { brokenleftarm = { "leftarm", 100 }, brokenrightarm = { "rightarm", 100 }, brokenleftleg = { "leftleg", 100 }, brokenrightleg = { "rightleg", 100 }, damagedleftarm = { "leftarm", 200 }, damagedrightarm = { "rightarm", 200 }, damagedleftleg = { "leftleg", 200 }, damagedrightleg = { "rightleg", 200 }, mangledleftarm = { "leftarm", 300 }, mangledrightarm = { "rightarm", 300 }, mangledleftleg = { "leftleg", 300 }, mangledrightleg = { "rightleg", 300 }, damagedhead = { "head", 100 }, mangledhead = { "head", 200 }, mildtrauma = { "torso", 100 }, serioustrauma = { "torso", 200 }, }
function L.norm(limb) limb = tostring(limb or ""):lower():gsub("[%s_]", "") for _, n in ipairs(L.NAMES) do if n == limb then return n end end return nil end
function L.level(limb) local v = 0 for aff, t in pairs(L.LEVELS) do if t[1] == limb and ss.affs[aff] then v = math.max(v, t[2]) end end return v end
function L.get(limb) limb = L.norm(limb) if not limb then return nil end local lv, h = L.level(limb), L._hits[limb] if h and acs.now() - h.at < L.DECAY then return math.max(lv, h.pct) end return lv end
function L.highest() local v = 0 for _, n in ipairs(L.NAMES) do v = math.max(v, L.get(n)) end return v end
function L.breaks() local n = 0 for _, l in ipairs(L.NAMES) do if L.get(l) >= 100 then n = n + 1 end end return n end
-- Prepped: one more hit breaks it (AW). A limb at 85% or more, or both of -- a pair (legs, arms) at 80% or more, not broken yet. Head and torso the -- same at 85%. what: leftleg..., "legs", "arms", "head", "torso", "any". L.PREP, L.PREP_PAIR = 85, 80 function L.prepped(what) what = tostring(what or ""):lower() local function one(l) local v = L.get(l) return v >= L.PREP and v < 100 end local function pair(a, b) local va, vb = L.get(a), L.get(b) return one(a) or one(b) or (va >= L.PREP_PAIR and vb >= L.PREP_PAIR and va < 100 and vb < 100) end if what == "legs" then return pair("leftleg", "rightleg") end if what == "arms" then return pair("leftarm", "rightarm") end if what == "any" then return pair("leftleg", "rightleg") or pair("leftarm", "rightarm") or one("head") or one("torso") end local l = L.norm(what) return l and one(l) or false end
-- Stances (Blademaster): a class script's against.stance_lines = -- { { [[regex]], stance = "arash" } } (capture 1: who), and -- against.stance_damage = { arash = { slash1 = 19.8, ... } }. L._stances = L._stances or {} -- name -> stance function L.set_stance(who, stance) L._stances[tostring(who)] = stance L._last_stance = stance end function L.stance_of(who) return who and L._stances[tostring(who)] or L._last_stance end
-- The opponent's percent per hit, if their script gives one (slash1 in -- their stance, if their script has stance_damage). function L.default_pct() local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() local ag = o and ss.opp.against(o.class) if not ag then return nil end local st = ag.stance_damage and ag.stance_damage[L.stance_of(o.name) or "none"] return st and st.slash1 or tonumber(ag.limb_hit) end
-- Hits by stance, to check the stance_damage tables against the game's -- numbers (kept in settings, the last 300). function L.log_hit(who, limb, pct) local stance = who and L._stances[tostring(who)] if not stance then return end local log = ss.settings.limb_log or {} ss.settings.limb_log = log log[#log + 1] = { who = tostring(who), stance = stance, limb = limb, pct = tonumber(pct) } while #log > 300 do table.remove(log, 1) end end
function L.hit(limb, pct) limb = L.norm(limb) pct = tonumber(pct) or L.default_pct() if not (limb and pct) then return end local was = L.get(limb) L._hits[limb] = { pct = was + pct, at = acs.now() } -- torso over 100: mild trauma, which GMCP doesn't show (AW's old swaps) if limb == "torso" and was < 100 and was + pct >= 100 and ss.predict_line then ss.predict_line("mildtrauma") end raiseEvent("ss.limbs.changed", limb, L._hits[limb].pct) end
-- A limb affliction came or went: the count is what's left. function L.on_aff(name) local t = L.LEVELS[name] if not t then return end L._hits[t[1]] = { pct = L.level(t[1]), at = acs.now() } raiseEvent("ss.limbs.changed", t[1], L._hits[t[1]].pct) end
function L.reset() L._hits = {} raiseEvent("ss.limbs.changed") end
-- A limb line from a class's script matched (m: the trigger's matches, -- m[1] the whole line). Counted only while that class is the opponent. function L.on_line(cls, l, m) local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() if not (o and o.class == cls) then return end local limb = type(l.limb) == "number" and m[l.limb + 1] or l.limb L.hit(limb, l.pct and m[l.pct + 1] or nil) end
-- The limb healed: back to what the afflictions say. function L.healed(limb) limb = L.norm(limb) if not limb then return end L._hits[limb] = nil raiseEvent("ss.limbs.changed", limb, L.get(limb)) end
L.patterns = { { [[^(.*) has dealt ([\d.]+)\% damage to your (.*)\.$]], function(m) L.log_hit(m[2], L.norm(m[4]), m[3]) L.hit(m[4], m[3]) end }, { [[^.* you perceive that you have dealt ([\d.]+)\% damage to your (.*)\.$]], function(m) L.hit(m[3], m[2]) end }, { [[^The pain plaguing your (.*) subsides\.$]], function(m) L.healed(m[2]) end }, }
function L.install(M) for _, p in ipairs(L.patterns) do M.trigger(p[1], p[2]) end M.on("ss.aff.gained", function(_, name) L.on_aff(name) end) M.on("ss.aff.lost", function(_, name) L.on_aff(name) end) for cls, cs in pairs(ss.classes.scripts) do for _, l in ipairs(cs.against and cs.against.limb_lines or {}) do M.trigger(l[1], function(m) L.on_line(cls, l, m) end) end for _, l in ipairs(cs.against and cs.against.stance_lines or {}) do M.trigger(l[1], function(m) L.set_stance(m[2], l.stance) end) end end end
ss._cmd("limbs", { "limbs how close each of your limbs is to breaking", "limbs hit <limb> [pct] count a hit by hand (pct: the opponent's, if known)", "limbs reset forget the hits (afflictions still count)", "limbs log [clear] average hit by stance (Blademaster), from the game's numbers" }, function(w) local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "log" then if w[2] == "clear" then ss.settings.limb_log = {} ss.save() ss.echo("limb log cleared") return end local sum = {} for _, e in ipairs(ss.settings.limb_log or {}) do local t = sum[e.stance] or { n = 0, total = 0 } sum[e.stance] = t if e.pct then t.n, t.total = t.n + 1, t.total + e.pct end end local keys = acs.sorted_keys(sum) if #keys == 0 then ss.echo("limb log: no hits with a known stance yet") return end for _, k in ipairs(keys) do ss.echo(("%-6s %3d hits, average %.1f%%"):format(k, sum[k].n, sum[k].n > 0 and sum[k].total / sum[k].n or 0)) end return end if a == "reset" then L.reset() elseif a == "hit" then if not L.norm(w[2]) then ss.err("usage: ss limbs hit <head|torso|leftarm|rightarm|leftleg|rightleg> [pct]") return end if not (tonumber(w[3]) or L.default_pct()) then ss.err("no percent: give one, or fight a class whose script has limb_hit") return end L.hit(w[2], w[3]) end local parts = {} for _, n in ipairs(L.NAMES) do local v = L.get(n) parts[#parts + 1] = (v >= 100 and "<red>" or v >= 79 and "<yellow>" or "<white>") .. n .. " " .. v .. "<reset>" end ss.echo("limbs: " .. table.concat(parts, " ")) end)

Script.name: executing
Script.script:
-- SS executing: while YOU are executing someone, cure paralysis and let -- everything else wait (AW), so you're never stuck chasing herb balance -- on a kill that can't wait. Paralysis goes to 1, anything else at 1 drops -- to 2, and paralysis isn't held (10_parahold.lua). On in group fights too. -- -- It's on from when you start until you stop it, the kill lands, or -- ss.settings.exec_secs pass (8 by default). Start it: -- ss exec [secs] by hand, or from your kill alias: -- ss.exec.start([secs]) in Lua (and ss.exec.stop()) -- your class script's exec_lines = { [[regex]], ... }: lines that show -- you've started a kill; exec_end_lines end it early. "You have slain" -- always ends it.
ss.exec = ss.exec or {} local X = ss.exec X.DEFAULT = 8
function X.on() return X._until ~= nil and acs.now() < X._until end
function X.start(secs) secs = tonumber(secs) or tonumber(ss.settings.exec_secs) or X.DEFAULT local was = X.on() X._until = acs.now() + secs if X._timer then killTimer(X._timer) end X._timer = tempTimer(secs + 0.05, function() X._timer = nil X.stop() end) if not was then ss.echo("<yellow>executing<reset>: paralysis first, the rest waits") raiseEvent("ss.exec", true) end end
function X.stop() if X._timer then killTimer(X._timer) X._timer = nil end local was = X.on() X._until = nil if was then raiseEvent("ss.exec", false) end end
-- The layer on top of everything (04_prio.lua): paralysis 1, and whatever -- else is at 1 (in t, the table so far) goes to 2. function X.layer(t) local r = { paralysis = 1 } for aff, p in pairs(t) do if aff ~= "paralysis" and tonumber(p) and tonumber(p) <= 1 then r[aff] = 2 end end return r end
function X.install(M) M.on("ss.exec", function() ss.prio.check() ss.prio.flush() end) M.trigger([[^You have slain ]], function() X.stop() end) for cls, cs in pairs(ss.classes.scripts) do local function mine() return ss.classes.key(ss.class()) == cls end for _, pat in ipairs(cs.exec_lines or {}) do M.trigger(pat, function() if mine() then X.start() end end) end for _, pat in ipairs(cs.exec_end_lines or {}) do M.trigger(pat, function() if mine() then X.stop() end end) end end end
ss._cmd("exec", { "exec [secs] you're executing someone: cure paralysis, the rest waits (default 8s)", "exec off stop", "exec time <secs> how long it lasts by default" }, function(w) local a = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if a == "off" or a == "stop" then X.stop() ss.echo("executing off") elseif a == "time" and tonumber(w[2]) then ss.settings.exec_secs = tonumber(w[2]) ss.save() ss.echo("executing lasts " .. w[2] .. "s") elseif a == nil or tonumber(a) then X.start(a) else ss.err("usage: ss exec [secs] | off | time <secs>") end end)

Script.name: class lines
Script.script:
-- SS class lines: attack lines that tell you the attacker's class (and -- sometimes subclass), from AW's old SS triggers (ss.enemyclass / -- ss.enemysubclass). Only fills in what the people tracker doesn't know, -- so the vs tables (04_prio.lua) work on someone PT has never seen. -- -- Each entry: { class, [sub = "..."], who = capture with the name (1 by -- default), patterns... }. Weapon-style lines from the old triggers -- (dual cutting, dual blunt, two-handed, sword and shield) don't name a -- class and are left out, except a rapier jab, which is a Bard.
ss.class_lines = { { "alchemist", [[^(\S+) glowers at you with a look of repressed disgust before making a slight gesture toward you\.$]] }, { "apostate", [[^(\S+) stares at you, giving you the evil eye\.$]] }, { "bard", [[^(\S+) darts out with a .* in a lightning-fast jab towards your .*\.$]], [[^With a flourish of a .* (\S+) steps in close, \w+ blade slicing at your .*\.$]], [[^The staccato song of a .* punctuates a flurry of blows as (\S+)'s blade pursues you relentlessly\.$]], [[^(\S+) flicks out with a .* towards you, a keening note raising from the blade's lunge\.$]], [[^(\S+)'s blade sings with a metallic song as \w+ directs a deep cut towards your .*\.$]], [[^Like a rising sun does the blade of (\S+) move from low to high, cutting across your .* hip\.$]], [[^Lightning-quick, (\S+) jabs you(?:r .*)? with .*(?:rapier|Soulpiercer).*\.$]] }, { "blademaster", who = 2, [[^With a smooth lunge to the (\S+), (\S+) draws .* from its scabbard and delivers a powerful slash across your legs\.$]], [[^Spinning to the (\S+) as \w+ draws .* from its sheath, (\S+) delivers a precise slash across your arms\.]] }, { "blademaster", [[^Whispering a prayer to the .* winds, (\S+) draws .* and unleashes a slash towards your .*\.$]], [[^In a single motion, (\S+) draws .* from its scabbard and looses a vicious \S+ slash at your \S+\.$]] }, { "depthswalker", [[^(\S+) delivers a lightning-fast strike to you with .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) reaches past you, plunging .* into your shadow\.$]] }, { "druid", [[^(\S+)'s many serpentine heads lunge towards your .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) cocks back \w+ arm and throws .* at your .*\.$]] }, { "dragon", [[^(\S+) lunges forward with long, flashing claws extended, tearing down to the bones of your .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) viciously swipes at your body, coating your skin in a slick substance\.$]], [[^You double over and hack up water beneath the pitiless gaze of (\S+)\.$]], [[^A sudden deluge of shockingly cold water drenches you, robbing you of strength by the will of (\S+)\.$]], [[^As (\S+) waves a hand in your direction a wave of nausea overcomes you, your head beginning to swim\.$]] }, { "elementallord", sub = "earthlord", [[^With a terrible roar (\S+) whips a colossal fist at your .*\.$]], [[^The magma-wreathed fist of (\S+) slams into your .* with a terrible impact\.$]] }, { "elementallord", sub = "airlord", [[^As the dark intent of (\S+) falls upon you, you feel the air surrounding you begin to thrum with tension\.$]], [[^(\S+) studies you intently, the howling winds that surround \S+ stilling for a moment\.$]] }, { "jester", [[^With one hand ominously pointed towards you, (\S+) rubs a finger over the heart of a puppet\.$]], [[^(\S+) looks at your eyes and makes some alterations to \w+ puppet\.$]], [[^(\S+) Suddenly your movement through the time stream is slowed\.$]] }, { "infernal", [[^You feel sickened and weak by the aura of death emanating from (\S+)\.$]], [[^.* trembles in the hand of (\S+) as it strikes you, a sanguine mist writhing about its wielder\.$]] }, { "runewarden", [[^Cold blue flames wreathe (\w+)'s runeblade, emanating an icy chill that penetrates you to the bone\.$]] }, { "paladin", [[^As fire surges about the righteous (\S+), a terrible heat fills your chest, a scorching pain that threatens to scour you from Creation\.$]] }, { "unnamable", [[^The profane nature of (\S+) becomes too much to withstand\.$]], [[^The air shudders about (\S+), a keening whine on the edge of hearing\.$]], [[^Each of the myriad mouths that have torn open upon the body of (\S+) croon in terrible symphony to you]], [[^The profane presence of (\S+) washes over you, and your courage is torn asunder\.$]] }, { "magi", [[^(\S+) weaves fire and water as \w+ directs \w+ arcane might against you\.$]], [[^(\S+) clicks \w+ fingers and a bolt of lightning strikes from the air in a fulminous flash to transfix you\.$]], [[^(\S+) sweeps an elemental staff over \w+ head and a great wind rises, picking you up]], [[^(\S+) raises a hand towards you and blasts you with cold, frigid air\.$]], [[^(\S+) weaves fire and earth in a complex pattern and magma boils into existence]], [[^(\S+) points a primordial staff at you, ]] }, { "monk", sub = "tekura", [[^(\S+) drops to the floor and sweeps \w+ legs round at you\.$]], [[^(\S+) launches a powerful uppercut at you\.$]], [[^(\S+) lets fly at you with a snap kick\.$]], [[^(\S+) balls up one fist and hammerfists you\.$]], [[^(\S+) pumps out at you with a powerful side kick\.$]], [[^(\S+) unleashes a powerful hook towards you\.$]], [[^(\S+) spins into the air and throws a whirlwind kick towards you\.$]] }, { "monk", sub = "shikudo", [[^(\S+) lashes out with a straight kick at you\.$]], [[^Bracing \w+ feet, (\S+) drives .* towards you\.$]], [[^(\S+) whips .* at the side of your neck\.$]], [[^(\S+) lashes out with a high kick at your head\.$]], [[^Lunging off \S+ back foot, (\S+) viciously drives the end of .* into your solar plexus\.$]] }, { "occultist", [[^(\S+) makes a sudden, quick gesture in front of you, almost hitting your nose\.$]], [[^(\S+) makes a quick, sharp gesture toward you\.$]], [[^(\S+) passes \w+ hand in front of you\. You feel an invisible claw brush the back of your skull\.$]] }, { "priest", [[^(\S+) utters a prayer and smites you(?:r .*)? with .*\.$]] }, { "psion", [[^Pain explodes through your skull as (\S+) brings a translucent mace around]], [[^Stars explode in front of your eyes as (\S+) smashes a translucent mace into the side of your head\.$]], [[^A sharp pain across your throat and a sudden lack of breath comes moments before you register the retreat of (\S+), bloody dagger in hand\.$]], [[^Horrific pain overcomes you as (\S+) slashes a translucent dagger across your eyes]], [[^(\S+) delivers a series of lashes against you with a translucent lash]], [[^(\S+) brings a translucent battleaxe down in a powerful overhanded blow upon you\.$]], [[^Golden chains of light coalesce in the hands of (\S+), and \w+ casts them out to bind you to \w+\.$]], [[^A terrible weariness overcomes you as (\S+) darts out \w+ blade and drives the tip into you just beneath your \S+ shoulder\.$]], [[^(\S+) ducks low, \w+ blade slicing into your .*\.$]], [[^With a brutal thrust of a translucent sword, (\S+) sinks \w+ weapon into your guts]] }, { "psion", who = 2, [[^Your (\S+) arm flops uselessly as (\S+) severs the muscles in it with a precise blow of \w+ translucent sword\.$]] }, { "sentinel", [[^(\S+) draws .* in an expert lateral slice ]], [[^Turning with the motion of \w+ strike, (\S+) comes back around to slam the haft of \w+ weapon into your temple\.$]] }, { "serpent", [[^(\S+) quickly pricks you with \w+ dirk\.$]], [[^(\S+) flays away your .* defence\.$]] }, { "shaman", [[^(\w+) points an imperious finger at you\.$]], [[^(\S+) gestures imperiously at you\.$]] }, { "sylvan", [[^The thorny vines of the Viridian (\S+) lash out and rip into your .*\.$]] }, { "pariah", [[^(\S+) traces.*logograph.*you.*$]] }, }
-- Knight weapon styles (the old dwc/dwb/2h/snb lines): the subclass of a -- knight class. who = capture with the name. ss.style_lines = { { "dualcutting", [[^Lightning-quick, (\S+) jabs you(?:r .*)? with .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) slashes into you(?:r .*)? with .*[.!]$]], [[^(\S+) swings .* at you(?:r .*)? with all \w+ might\.$]] }, { "dualblunt", [[^(\S+) skilfully whirls .* toward your .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) whips .* toward your .*\.$]] }, { "twohanded", [[^(\S+) comes around with a terrible swing of .* toward your .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) brings .* down upon you with a brutal overhand blow\.$]], [[^(\S+) explodes upward from a low crouch, driving .* toward your torso\.$]], [[^(\S+) unleashes a terrible blow at your .* with .*\.$]], [[^(\S+) brings .* down in a single diagonal stroke, carving cleanly through your aura of rebounding\.$]] }, { "swordandshield", [[^The blade of (\S+) is a blur as \w+ moves forward, slicing into your .*\.$]] }, } ss.KNIGHTS = { infernal = true, paladin = true, runewarden = true, unnamable = true }
function ss.attackers.saw_style(name, style) local AT = ss.attackers if not name or not AT.is_player(name) then return end local rec = AT.get(name) or AT.hit(name) -- a rapier jab is a Bard, not a knight (class_lines has it) if rec.class and not ss.KNIGHTS[ss.classes.key(rec.class)] then return end if rec.subclass ~= style then rec.subclass = style raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end end
-- A line gave away someone's class. function ss.attackers.saw_class(name, cls, sub) local AT = ss.attackers if not name or not AT.is_player(name) then return end local rec = AT.get(name) or AT.hit(name) local changed = false if not rec.class then rec.class, rec.class_from = cls, "line" changed = true end if sub and rec.subclass ~= sub and ss.classes.key(rec.class) == cls then rec.subclass = sub changed = true end if changed then raiseEvent("ss.attackers.changed") end end
function ss.attackers.install_class_lines(M) for _, e in ipairs(ss.style_lines) do for i = 2, #e do M.trigger(e[i], function(m) ss.attackers.saw_style(m[2], e[1]) end) end end for _, e in ipairs(ss.class_lines) do local cls, sub, who = e[1], e.sub, (e.who or 1) + 1 for i = 2, #e do M.trigger(e[i], function(m) ss.attackers.saw_class(m[who], cls, sub) end) end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Flags: something a line showed, for a few seconds ("flag:doll" in a -- situation's when). ss._flags = ss._flags or {} function ss.flag(name, secs) ss._flags[name] = acs.now() + (tonumber(secs) or 8) if ss.prio then ss.prio.check() end tempTimer((tonumber(secs) or 8) + 0.05, function() if ss.prio then ss.prio.check() end end) end function ss.flag_on(name) local t = ss._flags[name] return t ~= nil and acs.now() < t end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Other lines from AW's old triggers.
-- DIAGNOSE: "your phlegmatic humour has been tempered a total of 6 times." function ss.humour_line(humour, n) local name = "tempered" .. tostring(humour):lower() n = tonumber(n) if not (ss.data.affs[name] and n) then return end if ss.affs[name] then if ss.affs[name].count ~= n then ss.affs[name].count = n ss.prio.check() end else ss.add_aff({ name = name .. " (" .. n .. ")" }) end end
-- Afflictions GMCP doesn't show: tell serverside (server mode only). function ss.predict_line(aff) if ss.settings.mode ~= "server" or not ss.settings.enabled then return end if ss.affs[aff] then return end ss.server.predict(aff) end
ss.extra_lines = { { [[^your (\w+) humour has been tempered a total of (\d+) times\.$]], function(m) ss.humour_line(m[2], m[3]) end }, -- Magi: cracked ribs, mild trauma then serious { [[^You feel your ribs twisting and cracking under some great strain\.$]], function() ss.predict_line(ss.affs.mildtrauma and "serioustrauma" or "mildtrauma") end }, { [[^You feel a terrible chill as you are drawn ever closer to the Finality's unforgiving grasp\.$]], function() ss.predict_line("unweavingspirit") end }, -- Shaman: cursed (predict what Blight hides), and the doll: they're -- about to force an apply (situations use flag:doll) { [[^The knowledge that you've been cursed floods your mind\.$]], function() for _, a in ipairs({ "manaleech", "recklessness", "asthma" }) do ss.predict_line(a) end end }, { [[^(\S+) whispers something to a Vodun doll of ]], function() ss.flag("doll", 8) end }, { [[^Your mental faculties scatter even as you attempt to bring your psionic might to bare\.$]], function() ss.predict_line("confusion") end }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The room, from GMCP: its name (Room.Info) and the items in it -- (Char.Items, location "room"). "when" terms room:<text> and item:<text> -- (04_prio.lua), e.g. item:bomb or item:mouse for a Jester's concussion -- bomb and mouse (AW: both show in GMCP). ss.room = ss.room or { name = "", items = {} }
function ss.room_has(text) return ss.room.name:lower():find(tostring(text):lower(), 1, true) ~= nil end
function ss.item_here(text) text = tostring(text):lower() for _, name in pairs(ss.room.items) do if name:lower():find(text, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
local function room_changed() raiseEvent("ss.room.changed") end
function ss.on_room_info() local r = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info ss.room.name = r and tostring(r.name or "") or "" room_changed() ss.land_check() end
local function in_room(t) return t and t.location == "room" end function ss.on_items_list() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.List if not in_room(t) then return end ss.room.items = {} for _, it in ipairs(t.items or {}) do ss.room.items[tostring(it.id)] = tostring(it.name or "") end room_changed() end function ss.on_items_add() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.Add if not (in_room(t) and t.item) then return end ss.room.items[tostring(t.item.id)] = tostring(t.item.name or "") room_changed() end function ss.on_items_remove() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.Remove if not (in_room(t) and t.item) then return end local id = type(t.item) == "table" and t.item.id or t.item ss.room.items[tostring(id)] = nil room_changed() end
-- Air Lord: land if you're in the air, no matter what (AW). The room's -- name says "flying" (AW's old script). Tries every 1.5s until you're down. function ss.land_check() local o = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() if not (o and o.sub == "airlord" and ss.room_has("flying")) then return end if ss._land_at and acs.now() - ss._land_at < 1.5 then return end ss._land_at = acs.now() acs.send("land") tempTimer(1.6, function() ss.land_check() end) end
function ss.install_extra_lines(M) ss.attackers.install_class_lines(M) for _, l in ipairs(ss.extra_lines) do M.trigger(l[1], l[2]) end -- a defence stripped: flag:lost_<def> for 4s ("when" terms) M.on("ss.def.down", function(_, d) if d then ss.flag("lost_" .. d, 4) end end) M.on("gmcp.Room.Info", ss.on_room_info) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.List", ss.on_items_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Add", ss.on_items_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", ss.on_items_remove) end

Script.name: salves
Script.script:
-- SS salves: fake applying and pre-applying (AW). -- -- Fake apply: APPLY MENDING to a broken limb. The room only sees you apply -- to it, not which salve, so it looks like restoration; mending resolves -- sooner and the real restoration goes where it's needed (torso after a -- leg break against SNB or a Sylvan). The limb's afflictions have to be -- held at 26 meanwhile (the situation's prios), or serverside would -- restore it itself. At most once every 20s, like AW's old "juke". -- -- Pre-apply: APPLY RESTORATION to a limb before it's damaged. Restoration -- resolves 4s after the apply, so a break that lands in between is fixed -- on that timer. Again every 4.5s while it's wanted. -- -- Situations ask for them (04_prio.lua): fake = "legs", preapply = "head" -- (preapply_salve = "mending" to apply that instead). A fake goes first -- when both are wanted. By hand: ss fake <limb>, ss preapply <limb>. -- Limbs: head, torso, legs, arms, left leg (or leftleg) and so on.
ss.salves = ss.salves or {} local V = ss.salves V.FAKE_EVERY = 20 V.PRE_EVERY = 4.5 V._last = V._last or {} -- "fake" / "pre" -> when
-- What the limb's afflictions are called, for "is there something to fake". V.AFFS = { legs = ss.LIMBS.legs_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.legs_damaged, arms = ss.LIMBS.arms_broken .. " " .. ss.LIMBS.arms_damaged, head = ss.LIMBS.head, torso = ss.LIMBS.torso, }
-- "leftleg" -> "left leg"; legs, arms, head, torso as they are. function V.target(limb) limb = tostring(limb or ""):lower():gsub("_", " ") if V.AFFS[limb] then return limb end local n = ss.limbs.norm(limb) return n and (n:gsub("^(left)", "%1 "):gsub("^(right)", "%1 ")) or nil end
-- Afflictions on that limb right now? function V.hurt(limb) local key = V.AFFS[limb] and limb or (limb:match("leg$") and "legs") or (limb:match("arm$") and "arms") or limb local side = limb:match("^(%a+) ") or "" for a in (V.AFFS[key] or ""):gmatch("%S+") do if ss.affs[a] and (side == "" or a:find(side, 1, true)) then return true end end return false end
local function since(k) return acs.now() - (V._last[k] or -1e9) end
function V.apply(salve, limb, kind) if not ss.bal_ready("salve") then return false end V._last[kind] = acs.now() acs.send(("apply %s to %s"):format(salve, limb)) ss.use_bal("salve", ss.item_bal_timeouts[salve]) raiseEvent("ss.salves." .. kind, limb) return true end
function V.fake(limb) limb = V.target(limb) if not limb then return false end return V.apply("mending", limb, "fake") end
function V.preapply(limb, salve) limb = V.target(limb) if not limb then return false end return V.apply(salve or "restoration", limb, "pre") end
-- What the situations on now want: the last one asking wins. function V.wanted() local fake, pre, salve local P = ss.prio local vs = ss.opp and ss.opp.current() local lists = { P.situations() } if vs and not P.group() then lists[2] = P.situations(vs) end for _, list in ipairs(lists) do for _, sit in ipairs(list) do if (sit.fake or sit.preapply) and P.matches(sit) then fake = sit.fake or fake if sit.preapply then pre, salve = sit.preapply, sit.preapply_salve end end end end return fake, pre, salve end
function V.check() local s = ss.settings if not (s.enabled and acs.online()) or not ss.bal_ready("salve") then return end local fake, pre, salve = V.wanted() fake = fake and V.target(fake) if fake and V.hurt(fake) and since("fake") >= V.FAKE_EVERY then V.apply("mending", fake, "fake") elseif pre and since("pre") >= V.PRE_EVERY and since("fake") >= 1 then V.preapply(pre, salve) end end
function V.install(M) M.on("ss.balance", function(_, b, v) if b == "salve" and v then V.check() end end) for _, ev in ipairs({ "ss.aff.gained", "ss.aff.lost", "ss.limbs.changed" }) do M.on(ev, V.check) end local function loop() V.check() M.timer(0.5, loop) end loop() end
ss._cmd("fake", { "fake <limb> apply mending to a limb, to look like restoration (legs, arms, head, torso, left leg...)" }, function(w) local limb = V.target(table.concat(w, " ")) if not limb then ss.err("usage: ss fake <legs|arms|head|torso|left leg|...>") return end if not V.fake(limb) then ss.err("no salve balance") end end)
ss._cmd("preapply", { "preapply <limb> [salve] apply restoration (or that salve) before the limb is damaged" }, function(w) local salve if w[#w] and (w[#w]:lower() == "mending" or w[#w]:lower() == "restoration") and #w > 1 then salve = table.remove(w):lower() end local limb = V.target(table.concat(w, " ")) if not limb then ss.err("usage: ss preapply <legs|arms|head|torso|left leg|...> [salve]") return end if not V.preapply(limb, salve) then ss.err("no salve balance") end end)

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- SS startup: wires GMCP, balance-recovery triggers and the "ss" command. -- Safe to run again; acs.module removes what the last run set up.
-- Curative balance lines. "You may ... another" gives a balance back. If one -- doesn't fire for you, the balance still comes back after its time in -- ss.bal_timeouts (plus ss.bal_lag). The eat/apply/drink/smoke/focus/tree -- lines at the end mark a balance used whoever sent the cure, so SS knows -- your balances under serverside curing too. ss.bal_patterns = { { [[^You may eat another]], function() local l = (line or ""):lower() if l:find("moss") or l:find("potash") then ss.gain_bal("moss") else ss.gain_bal("herb") end end }, { [[^You may apply another salve]], function() ss.gain_bal("salve") end }, { [[^You may drink another]], function() ss.gain_bal("sip") end }, { [[^You may smoke another]], function() ss.gain_bal("smoke") end }, { [[^(?:You can focus your mind once more|Your mind is able to focus once again|You may focus again)]], function() ss.gain_bal("focus") end }, { [[tree tattoo (?:again|once more)]], function() ss.gain_bal("tree") end }, -- how long your action takes (from AW) { [[^(Balance|Equilibrium) used: ([\d.]+)s\.$]], function(m) ss.parahold.used_line(m[2], m[3]) end }, -- balance used (not yet checked in game) { [[^You eat ]], function() ss.saw_eat(line) end }, { [[^You take out some salve and quickly rub it]], function() ss.saw_bal("salve") end }, { [[^You take a drink ]], function() ss.saw_bal("sip") end }, { [[^You take a long drag off your pipe]], function() ss.saw_bal("smoke") end }, { [[^You focus your mind intently on curing]], function() ss.saw_bal("focus") end }, { [[^You touch the tree of life tattoo]], function() ss.saw_bal("tree") end }, }
function ss.init() local M = acs.module("ss", { prefix = "ss" }) ss.M = M M.title = "SS curing " .. ss.version ss.prepare_settings() for word, c in pairs(ss.commands) do M.command(word, c.fn, c.help) end
M.on("gmcp.Char.Vitals", ss.on_vitals) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List", ss.on_aff_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add", ss.on_aff_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", ss.on_aff_remove) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.List", ss.on_def_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.Add", ss.on_def_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.Remove", ss.on_def_remove) M.on("gmcp.Char.Skills.Groups", ss.on_skill_groups) M.on("gmcp.Char.Skills.List", ss.on_skill_list) M.on("gmcp.IRE.Rift.List", ss.on_rift_list) M.on("gmcp.IRE.Rift.Change", ss.on_rift_change) acs.gmcp_support(ss.gmcp_modules)
M.on("acs.char.loaded", function() ss.prepare_settings() ss.prio.changed() ss.echo("settings loaded for " .. tostring(acs.me.name)) end) M.on("acs.class.changed", function(_, cls, old) ss.skills = {} sendGMCP("Char.Skills.Get") local p = ss.settings.class_profile[cls] if p and ss.settings.prio_profiles[p] then ss.settings.prio_profile = p end ss.keepup.stop() -- an unfinished defup belongs to the old class ss.classes.apply(old) ss.schedule() end) -- anything set up before login (priorities, a queued sync) goes out now M.on("acs.login", function() ss.prio.changed() ss.server.drain() ss.schedule() end) M.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() ss.affs, ss.defs = {}, {} ss.reset_bals() end)
for _, ev in ipairs({ "ss.aff.gained", "ss.aff.lost", "ss.def.up", "ss.def.down" }) do M.on(ev, function() ss.ui.queue_refresh() end) end M.on("ss.def.up", function(_, d) ss.keepup.on_up(d) ss.keepup.echo_def(d, true) end) M.on("ss.def.down", function(_, d) ss.keepup.echo_def(d, false) end)
for _, p in ipairs(ss.bal_patterns) do M.trigger(p[1], p[2]) end ss.attackers.install(M) ss.prio.install(M) ss.parahold.install(M) ss.opp.install(M) ss.limbs.install(M) ss.exec.install(M) ss.install_extra_lines(M) ss.salves.install(M) ss.keepup.install(M) -- the mana floor for clotting follows the opponent (06_server.lua) M.on("ss.attackers.changed", function() ss.server.clot_check() end) ss.classes.apply()
if ss.settings.ui then ss.ui.toggle(true) end if acs.online() and gmcp.Char then if gmcp.Char.Vitals then ss.on_vitals() end sendGMCP("Char.Skills.Get") end ss.echo(("SS curing v%s loaded, mode <white>%s<reset>. Type <white>ss help<reset>."):format(ss.version, ss.settings.mode)) end
ss.init()

Script.name: offense core
Script.script:
-- AR: the offense half of the Achaea system (curing is SS). -- Class-agnostic targeting, enemy affliction/defence tracking, cure and lock -- detection, hit confirmation, and per-class attack modules. -- -- Loads after the shared core (acs_core). Everything AR registers goes -- through ar.M, so reloading the package cleans up after itself.
ar = ar or {} ar.version = "0.5.0"
ar.M = acs.module("ar", { prefix = "ar" }) ar.M.title = "AR offense" local M = ar.M
ar.default_settings = { target = nil, enabled = true, -- master switch for automatic offense (hit tracking still runs) optimistic = true, -- an attack with no learned hit line counts as a hit unless a miss is seen show = true, -- echo the target's afflictions when they change queue = "eqbal", -- default queue type for attacks enemy_bal = {}, -- overrides for ar.data.enemy_bal class_cures = {}, -- overrides/additions for ar.data.class_cures hitlines = {}, -- hitlines[class][attack] = regex (learned or set) afflines = {}, -- list of { pattern = regex with %t, affs = {...}, strip = def } enemy_classes = {}, -- name -> class seen in action, remembered between fights class_signs = {}, -- list of { class, pattern with %p }: lines that show a class mods = {}, -- per class module settings sure = {}, -- aff -> chance needed to count as on (see ar.data.sure) lines_off = {}, -- class -> true: ignore that class's attack lines call_affs = true, -- tell the party the affs you land, one call per prompt call_window = 0.5, -- seconds: an ally's call for an aff we just saw land is an echo } ar.settings = acs.store("ar", ar.default_settings)
function ar.save() acs.save("ar") end
function ar.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "ar") end function ar.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "ar") end function ar.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "ar") end function ar.send(cmd) acs.send(cmd) end
-- Turn a user/regex pattern containing %t (the target's name) into a -- regex that captures the name as the first group. function ar.tpat(pattern) return (pattern:gsub("%%t", [[(\w+)]])) end
-- Escape a literal line so it can be used as a regex. function ar.regex_escape(s) return (s:gsub("[%^%$%(%)%%%.%[%]%*%+%-%?%{%}%|\\]", function(c) return "\\" .. c end)) end
function ar.class() return acs.me.class end
function ar.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end

Script.name: data
enemy tracker
Script.script:
-- AR enemy tracker. Every person you fight gets their own record: their -- afflictions, defences, curing balances, class cures on cooldown and lock -- state, so cures seen from anyone you're tracking keep their record right -- (not only your current target's). -- -- ar.person(name, create) a person's record (create = start tracking) -- ar.enemy always the current target's record, so -- ar.enemy.has("asthma") etc. just work -- -- Every affliction has a chance, 0 to 100. A seen affliction is 100. A cure -- we can't see (eating kelp while they have asthma and weariness) is random -- in Achaea, so it takes the chance down evenly across what that herb could -- have cured: both go to 50. has(aff) is true while the chance is at or above -- that aff's "sure" bar: 50 for most, higher for the ones you lock with, so -- an uncertain asthma counts as gone and gets reapplied. -- -- Records are objects: p:give(aff), p:cure(aff), p:has(aff)... ar.enemy -- forwards to the target, so ar.enemy.give(aff) is the same as -- ar.person(target):give(aff). -- -- Events: "ar.enemy.aff"(aff, gained, name), "ar.enemy.def"(def, up, name), -- "ar.enemy.lock"(level or nil, name), "ar.enemy.reset"(name)
local D = ar.data
ar.Person = ar.Person or {} local P = ar.Person P.__index = P
ar.people = ar.people or {}
function P.cap(name) name = tostring(name) if name:match("^%d+$") then return name end return name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2):lower() end ar.cap = P.cap
function P:fresh() self.affs = {} -- aff -> epoch given, for affs we count as on (has()) self.prob = {} -- aff -> chance 0..100, for every aff that might be on self.seen = {} -- aff -> epoch we last saw it land (kept after a cure) self.defs = {} -- def -> epoch seen up self.used = {} -- eat/apply/smoke/focus/tree -> epoch last used self.cds = {} -- class cure -> epoch last used self.hist = {} -- recent cure guesses, for backtracking self._lock = nil end
function ar.person(name, create) if not name or name == "" then return nil end name = P.cap(name) local p = ar.people[name] if not p and create then p = setmetatable({ name = name }, P) p:fresh() p.class = ar.classes and ar.classes.of(name) or nil ar.people[name] = p end return p end
-- Stand-in record for "no target", so ar.enemy never errors. ar._nobody = setmetatable({}, P) ar._nobody:fresh()
function ar.current_person() return (ar.target and ar.target.name and ar.people[ar.target.name]) or ar._nobody end
-- ar.enemy: forwards to the current target's record. ar.enemy = setmetatable({}, { __index = function(_, k) local p = ar.current_person() local v = p[k] if type(v) == "function" and P[k] == v then return function(...) return v(p, ...) end end return v end, __newindex = function(_, k, v) ar.current_person()[k] = v end, })
function P:is_target() return self.name ~= nil and ar.target.name == self.name end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Afflictions
-- Chance needed to count an aff as on. function P.sure(aff) aff = D.canon(aff) return (ar.settings.sure or {})[aff] or D.sure[aff] or D.sure_default end
function P:has(aff) return self.affs[D.canon(aff)] ~= nil end function P:chance(aff) return self.prob[D.canon(aff)] or 0 end
function P:count() local n = 0 for _ in pairs(self.affs) do n = n + 1 end return n end
function P:changed(aff, gained) raiseEvent("ar.enemy.aff", aff, gained, self.name) self:check_lock() if self:is_target() then ar.show_soon() end end
-- Set the chance they have aff, keeping affs (what has() sees) in step. function P:set_chance(aff, n) aff = D.canon(aff) local had = self.affs[aff] ~= nil if n <= 0.5 then self.prob[aff], self.affs[aff] = nil, nil else self.prob[aff] = math.min(100, n) if n >= P.sure(aff) then self.affs[aff] = self.affs[aff] or acs.now() else self.affs[aff] = nil end end local has = self.affs[aff] ~= nil if has ~= had then self:changed(aff, has) end end
function P:give(aff) aff = D.canon(aff) if not aff or aff == "" then return end if aff == "crippledarm" then aff = self:has("brokenleftarm") and "brokenrightarm" or "brokenleftarm" end if aff == "crippledleg" then aff = self:has("brokenleftleg") and "brokenrightleg" or "brokenleftleg" end -- a defence that blocks this aff is stripped by it instead for def, info in pairs(D.defs) do if info.blocks == aff and self.defs[def] then self:def_down(def) return end end local isnew = self.affs[aff] == nil self.prob[aff] = 100 self.seen[aff] = acs.now() self.affs[aff] = acs.now() if isnew then self:changed(aff, true) end end
function P:venom(v) v = acs.norm(v) if v == "delphinium" and self.defs.insomnia then self:def_down("insomnia") return end local aff = D.venoms[v] if type(aff) == "table" then for _, a in ipairs(aff) do self:give(a) end elseif aff then self:give(aff) else ar.debug("unknown venom " .. tostring(v)) end end
-- Certain cure (a line said so). function P:cure(aff) aff = D.canon(aff) if self.prob[aff] or self.affs[aff] then local had = self.affs[aff] ~= nil self.prob[aff], self.affs[aff] = nil, nil if had then self:changed(aff, false) end return aff end end
-- A cure we couldn't see, that cures one of list at random. Each aff they -- might have loses chance in proportion to how likely they had it; one -- candidate means it's certain. Remembered so a later proof can correct -- it (see backtrack). Returns the aff most likely cured. function P:cure_split(list) local w, total, n = {}, 0, 0 for _, aff in ipairs(list or {}) do aff = D.canon(aff) local c = self.prob[aff] if c and not w[aff] then w[aff] = c total = total + c n = n + 1 end end if n == 0 then return nil end local shares, best, bestshare = {}, nil, -1 for aff, c in pairs(w) do local share = (n == 1) and c or math.min(c, 100 * c / total) shares[aff] = share if share > bestshare then best, bestshare = aff, share end end for aff, share in pairs(shares) do self:set_chance(aff, w[aff] - share) end table.insert(self.hist, { w = w, total = total, shares = shares, at = acs.now() }) if #self.hist > 12 then table.remove(self.hist, 1) end return best end P.cure_first = P.cure_split
-- A cure of anything at all (tree, random class cures): split across all. function P:cure_any() local list = {} for aff in pairs(self.prob) do list[#list + 1] = aff end return self:cure_split(list) end
-- Evidence says they do NOT have aff (fitness can't be used while weary, -- standing means no paralysis...). Drop it, and if our last split cure -- gave it a share, that share really belonged to the others: take it off -- them instead. function P:backtrack(aff) aff = D.canon(aff) self:cure(aff) for i = #self.hist, 1, -1 do local h = self.hist[i] if h.shares[aff] and acs.now() - h.at < 30 then local rest = h.total - h.w[aff] h.shares[aff], h.w[aff], h.total = nil, nil, rest if rest > 0 then for other, c in pairs(h.w) do local share = math.min(c, 100 * c / rest) local extra = share - h.shares[other] h.shares[other] = share if extra > 0 and self.prob[other] then self:set_chance(other, self.prob[other] - extra) end end end ar.debug(("%s: backtracked %s"):format(tostring(self.name), aff)) return end end end
function P:reset(quiet) local name, class = self.name, self.class self:fresh() self.class = name and ar.classes.of(name) or class raiseEvent("ar.enemy.reset", self.name) if not quiet and self:is_target() then ar.show_soon() end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Defences
function P:def_up(def) def = acs.norm(def) local isnew = not self.defs[def] self.defs[def] = acs.now() if isnew then raiseEvent("ar.enemy.def", def, true, self.name) if self:is_target() then ar.show_soon() end end end
function P:def_down(def) def = acs.norm(def) if self.defs[def] then self.defs[def] = nil raiseEvent("ar.enemy.def", def, false, self.name) if self:is_target() then ar.show_soon() end end end
function P:has_def(def) return self.defs[acs.norm(def)] ~= nil end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Curing balances: when did they last eat/apply/smoke/focus/tree?
function P:bal_time(kind) return ar.settings.enemy_bal[kind] or D.enemy_bal[kind] or 2 end
function P:used_cure(kind) self.used[kind] = acs.now() end
