-- Seconds until they can use that kind of cure again (0 = ready now). function P:bal_left(kind) local left = (self.used[kind] or 0) + self:bal_time(kind) - acs.now() return left > 0 and left or 0 end
-- Can they cure this way at all right now (balance and not blocked)? function P:can(kind) for _, aff in ipairs(D.blocks[kind] or {}) do if self:has(aff) then return false end end return self:bal_left(kind) == 0 end
function P:tree_down() return self:bal_left("tree") > 0 end function P:focus_down() return self:bal_left("focus") > 0 end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Class cures
function P:class_cure(name) return ar.settings.class_cures[name] or D.class_cures[name] end
function P:class_cure_names() local r = {} for n in pairs(D.class_cures) do r[n] = true end for n in pairs(ar.settings.class_cures) do r[n] = true end return acs.sorted_keys(r) end
-- Class cures this person could use right now. If we don't know their -- class, we only count ones we've seen them use. function P:ready_class_cures() local r = {} for _, name in ipairs(self:class_cure_names()) do local cc = self:class_cure(name) local has if self.class then for _, c in ipairs(cc.classes or {}) do if c == self.class then has = true end end else has = self.cds[name] ~= nil end if cc.passive then has = false end if has and cc.unless then local blocked = true for _, aff in ipairs(cc.unless) do if not self:has(aff) then blocked = false end end if blocked then has = false end end if has and acs.now() - (self.cds[name] or -1e9) >= (cc.cd or 20) then r[#r + 1] = name end end return r end
function P:used_class_cure(name) local cc = self:class_cure(name) if not cc then return end self.cds[name] = acs.now() if cc.classes and #cc.classes == 1 and self.name then ar.classes.seen(self.name, cc.classes[1]) end for _, aff in ipairs(cc.proves or {}) do self:backtrack(aff) end local list = cc.cures == "any" and {} or cc.cures or {} if cc.cures == "any" then for aff in pairs(self.prob) do list[#list + 1] = aff end end -- curing as many as could be there: they're all gone local n = 0 for _, aff in ipairs(list) do if self.prob[D.canon(aff)] then n = n + 1 end end if n > 0 and n <= (cc.count or 1) then local got for _, aff in ipairs(list) do got = self:cure(aff) or got end return got end local got for _ = 1, cc.count or 1 do got = self:cure_split(list) or got end return got end
function P:set_class(cls, quiet) self.class = cls and acs.norm(cls) or nil if self.name then ar.settings.enemy_classes[self.name] = self.class ar.save() if pt and pt.observe and self.class then pt.observe(self.name, "class", self.class) end end if not quiet then ar.echo((self.name or "target") .. " is a <white>" .. tostring(self.class)) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Locks -- soft anorexia + asthma + slickness: no eating, smoking or salves -- hard soft + impatience (or sandfever): no focus either (tree still works) -- true hard + paralysis: no tree. They need a class cure to escape.
function P:lock() if not (self:has("anorexia") and self:has("asthma") and self:has("slickness")) then return nil end if not (self:has("impatience") or self:has("sandfever")) then return "soft" end if not self:has("paralysis") and not self:tree_down() then return "hard" end return "true" end
-- Lock level plus which class cures could break it. function P:lock_info() local l = self:lock() if not l then return nil end local outs = self:ready_class_cures() return l, (#outs > 0 and outs or nil) end
function P:check_lock() local l = self:lock() if l ~= self._lock then self._lock = l raiseEvent("ar.enemy.lock", l, self.name) if l and ar.settings.show and self:is_target() then ar.echo("<red>" .. self:name_or() .. " is " .. l .. " locked") end end end
function P:name_or() return self.name or "target" end
-- How many affs they have from a list (for kill conditions). function P:count_of(list) local n = 0 for _, a in ipairs(list) do if self:has(a) then n = n + 1 end end return n end

Script.name: target
Script.script:
-- AR target: who we're fighting, their health from GMCP, whether they're -- in the room, and the server queue helper. -- -- Events: "ar.target"(name)
ar.target = ar.target or {} local T = ar.target local EN = ar.enemy
-- Player names are capitalised; NPC targets from GMCP are item ids. function T.tidy(name) name = tostring(name) if name:match("^%d+$") then return name end return name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2):lower() end
function T.set(name, from_gmcp) if not name or name == "" then return end name = T.tidy(name) local changed = T.name ~= name T.name = name T.is_npc = name:match("^%d+$") ~= nil ar.person(name, true) -- keeps what we already know about them if changed then T.hp = nil end ar.settings.target = name target = name -- the conventional Mudlet global many scripts expect if not from_gmcp then sendGMCP('IRE.Target.Set "' .. name .. '"') end if changed then ar.echo("target: <white>" .. name .. (EN.class and (" <grey>(" .. EN.class .. ")") or "")) raiseEvent("ar.target", name) raiseEvent("acs.target", name) -- shared name other packages (people tracker) listen for ar.show_soon() end end
function T.clear() T.name, T.hp = nil, nil ar.settings.target = nil ar.echo("target cleared") raiseEvent("ar.target", nil) end
function T.is(who) return T.name ~= nil and who ~= nil and tostring(who):lower() == T.name:lower() end ar.is_target = T.is
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- GMCP: IRE.Target.Set (target changed in game), IRE.Target.Info (health), -- Room.Players / AddPlayer / RemovePlayer (is the target here?)
function T.on_target_set() local t = gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target and gmcp.IRE.Target.Set -- a numeric id is a denizen you tab-targeted while bashing: leave the -- PvP target alone (use "t <id>" if you really want to fight it) if t and t ~= "" and not tostring(t):match("^%d+$") and not T.is(t) then T.set(t, true) end end
function T.on_target_info() local i = gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target and gmcp.IRE.Target.Info if not i then return end local id = i.id and tostring(i.id) if id and id:match("^%d+$") and not T.is(id) then return end -- health of a denizen, not our target local hp = tonumber((tostring(i.hpperc or ""):gsub("%%", ""))) if hp then T.hp = hp end end
T.room = T.room or {} -- True when the target is in the room (or we can't tell yet). function T.here() if not T.name then return false end if T.is_npc or not T.room_known then return true end return T.room[T.name:lower()] == true end
function T.on_room_players() T.room, T.room_known = {}, true for _, p in ipairs(gmcp.Room.Players or {}) do T.room[tostring(p.name):lower()] = true end end function T.on_add_player() local p = gmcp.Room.AddPlayer if p and p.name then T.room[tostring(p.name):lower()] = true end end function T.on_remove_player() local p = gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer if type(p) == "table" then p = p.name end if p then T.room[tostring(p):lower()] = nil end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Server queue. qtype: bal, eq, eqbal, free (see HELP QUEUE). Several -- commands go in order; the first one replaces whatever was queued.
function ar.queue(cmds, qtype) qtype = qtype or ar.settings.queue or "eqbal" -- with QM installed the attack is the game alias "qmar", queued once; a -- new plan before it runs (something got cured) just rewrites the alias if qm and qm.queue then return qm.queue(cmds, { type = qtype, mode = "addclear", key = "ar", alias = true }) end if type(cmds) == "string" then cmds = { cmds } end for i, c in ipairs(cmds) do ar.send(("queue %s %s %s"):format(i == 1 and "addclear" or "add", qtype, c)) end end

Script.name: watchers
Script.script:
-- AR watchers: lines that show someone curing, raising or losing defences, -- or showing an affliction. They apply to everyone AR is tracking (anyone -- you've targeted), not only your current target. -- -- Lines come from AW's old system, seen in play. -- -- Eat, tree, focus, salve and active cures are settled at the prompt: if a -- line naming what they cured arrives first ("straightens, as if some great -- burden had been lifted" = guilt), that's the cure; otherwise AR guesses -- from the curative's cure order.
ar.watch = ar.watch or {} local W = ar.watch local D = ar.data
W.pending = {} -- name -> list of { kind, arg }
-- Herbs that raise a defence instead of curing. W.def_items = { cohosh = "insomnia", gypsum = "insomnia", hawthorn = "deafness", calamine = "deafness", bayberry = "blindness", arsenic = "blindness", }
function W.who(m) return ar.person(m[2]) end
-- Anything they did proves they weren't blocked from doing it. function W.not_blocked(p, kind) for _, aff in ipairs(D.blocks[kind] or {}) do p:backtrack(aff) end end
function W.defer(p, kind, arg) local list = W.pending[p.name] or {} list[#list + 1] = { kind = kind, arg = arg } W.pending[p.name] = list W.undo = function() table.remove(list) end end
-- A specific cure line: that is what their last action cured. function W.cured(p, aff) local list = W.pending[p.name] if list and #list > 0 then table.remove(list) end if aff then p:cure(aff) end end
function W.settle(p, a) if a.kind == "eat" then return p:cure_first(D.herb_cures[a.arg]) elseif a.kind == "apply" then return p:cure_first(D.salve_cures[a.arg] or D.salve_cures.body) elseif a.kind == "focus" then return p:cure_split(D.focus_cures) elseif a.kind == "tree" then if ar.settings.tree_guess ~= false then return p:cure_any() end elseif a.kind == "active" then return p:used_class_cure(a.arg) end end
function W.on_prompt() local pend = W.pending W.pending, W.undo = {}, nil for name, list in pairs(pend) do local p = ar.person(name) if p then for _, a in ipairs(list) do W.settle(p, a) end end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Actions
function W.ate(p, text) text = tostring(text):lower() W.not_blocked(p, "eat") for item, def in pairs(W.def_items) do if text:find(item, 1, true) then W.def_later(p, def, def == "deafness" and 4 or 0) return end end if text:find("moss", 1, true) or text:find("potash", 1, true) then return end -- separate balance local h = D.herb_from_text(text) if not h then return end p:used_cure("eat") W.defer(p, "eat", h) end
function W.applied(p, loc) loc = acs.norm(loc or "body") if loc == "ears" then return end W.not_blocked(p, "apply") p:used_cure("apply") W.defer(p, "apply", loc) end
function W.smoked(p) W.not_blocked(p, "smoke") p:used_cure("smoke") return p:cure_first(D.smoke_cures) end
function W.focused(p) W.not_blocked(p, "focus") p:used_cure("focus") W.defer(p, "focus") end
function W.treed(p) W.not_blocked(p, "tree") p:used_cure("tree") W.defer(p, "tree") end
-- Some defences come up a moment after the action (deafness after hawthorn). function W.def_later(p, def, delay) if not delay or delay <= 0 then p:def_up(def) W.undo = function() p:def_down(def) end return end ar.M.timer(delay, function() p:def_up(def) end) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Patterns. m[2] is always the person.
function W.A(fn) return function(m) local p = W.who(m) if p then fn(p, m) end end end
W.stupid_procs = { [[^(\S+) stumbles and pokes \w+ in the eye\.$]], [[^(\S+) flaps \w+ arms madly\.$]], [[^(\S+) picks \w+ nose absently\.$]], [[^(\S+) grunts a bit and then lets out a loud "OINK!"$]], [[^(\S+) giggles happily\.$]], [[^(\S+) burps obscenely\.$]], [[^(\S+) wails like an old woman\.$]], [[^(\S+) hugs \w+ compassionately\.$]], [[^(\S+) gives up a round of applause\.$]], [[^(\S+) drops to one knee\.$]], [[^(\S+) lets out a loud, long "MOOOOOOOOOOO!"$]], [[^(\S+) gets down on one knee and serenades the world\.$]], [[^(\S+) waggles \w+ eyebrows comically\.$]], [[^(\S+) fondles \w+ absently\.$]], [[^(\S+) blinks\.$]], [[^(\S+) makes a strangled meowing noise and quickly shuts up, blushing\.$]], [[^(\S+) twitches spasmodically\.$]], }
W.patterns = { -- curing actions { [[^(\S+)\s*eats (.*)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) W.ate(p, m[3]) end) }, { [[^(\S+) takes some salve from a vial and rubs it on \w+ (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) W.applied(p, m[3]) end) }, { [[^(\S+) takes a long drag off .* pipe\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.smoked(p) end) }, { [[^A great gurgling sound is heard as (\S+) takes a long drag from an enamel bubble pipe\.]], W.A(function(p) W.smoked(p) end) }, { [[^(\S+) takes a few short puffs from \w+ pipe\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.smoked(p) end) }, { [[^A look of extreme focus crosses the face of (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.focused(p) end) }, { [[^(\S+) touches a (\w+) of life tattoo\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.treed(p) end) }, { [[^(\S+) takes some elixir from .* and rubs it into \w+ (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) local by_loc = { torso = "crackedribs", legs = "torntendons", arms = "wristfractures", head = "skullfractures" } if by_loc[m[3]] then p:cure(by_loc[m[3]]) end end) },
-- lines that name what was cured (these settle a pending eat/tree/focus/active) { [[^(\S+) straightens, as if some great burden had been lifted from \w+ shoulders\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "guilt") end) }, { [[^(\S+) shakes \w+ head and a look of clarity returns to \w+ eyes\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "inlove") end) }, { [[^The light behind the eyes of (\S+) reignites\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "unweavingmind") end) }, { [[^(\S+) suddenly seems much more vital\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "unweavingbody") end) }, { [[^(\S+) seems suddenly unburdened, clarity reasserting itself upon \w+ features\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "unweavingspirit") end) }, { [[^(\S+) ceases \w+ violent trembling\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "whisperingmadness") end) }, { [[^The orange sparks playing across the skin of (\S+) go out\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "horror") end) }, { [[^The orange sparks playing across the skin of (\S+) begin to gutter out\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, nil) end) }, { [[^The skin of (\S+) ceases secreting slime\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "rebbies") end) }, { [[^(\S+) ceases \w+ nervous trembling\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.cured(p, "mycalium") end) }, { [[^Blood begins to run from the pores of (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:give("flushings") end) }, { [[^The unnatural flames that burn upon the skin of (\S+) wink out\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("bloodfire") p:backtrack("haemophilia") end) },
-- other cures and proofs { [[^(\S+) stands up\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("prone") p:backtrack("paralysis") end) }, { [[^(\S+) rolls smoothly back to \w+ feet\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("prone") p:backtrack("paralysis") end) }, { [[^(\S+) inhales and begins holding \w+ breath\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:backtrack("asthma") end) }, { [[^(\S+)'s eyes lose their focus suddenly\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("disrupted") p:backtrack("confusion") end) }, { [[^(\S+) regains consciousness with a start\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("unconsciousness") end) }, { [[^(\S+) has writhed free of \w+ state of transfixation\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("transfixation") end) }, { [[^With a look of agony on \w+ face, (\S+) manages to writhe \w+ free of the weapon which impaled \w+\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("impaled") end) }, { [[^(\S+) has writhed free of \w+ entanglement by (?:tied )?ropes\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:cure_first({ "bound", "entangled" }) end) }, { [[^As (\S+) wrenches away from you, your blade rips through]], W.A(function(p) p:cure("impaled") end) }, { [[^(\S+) applies an? (?:sileris berry|quicksilver droplet) to \w+\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:backtrack("slickness") W.def_later(p, "fangbarrier", 10.1) end) },
-- afflictions showing { [[^(\S+) staggers and falls to the ground\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:give("dizziness") p:give("prone") end) }, { [[^(\S+) begins to jerk and shake violently, foaming at the mouth\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:give("epilepsy") end) }, { [[^With the heel of \w+ palm, (\S+) smacks \w+ upside the head\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:give("masochism") end) }, { [[^(\S+) lets out a piercing scream, as if wounded by the very sunlight\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:give("darkshade") end) }, { [[^You sense that (\S+) has been struck down with (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) p:give(m[3]) end) },
-- defences { [[^A shimmering barrier of crystal forms about (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "shield") end) }, { [[^A gentle hum arises from (\S+)'s angel, as it raises a shield to protect h(?:im|er)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "shield") end) }, { [[^A nearly invisible magical shield forms around (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "shield") end) }, { [[^The magical shield surrounding (\S+) makes that impossible\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "shield") end) }, { [[^A hulking stoneback makes a deep rumbling sound from deep within itself, and a magical shield flares into being surrounding (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "shield") end) }, { [[^\S+ sends myriad russet streams towards (\S+), which whip around h(?:im|er) ineffectually\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") end) }, { [[^\S+ razes (\S+)'s magical shield with .+\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") end) }, { [[^\S+ whips .+ through the air in front of (\S+), to no effect\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^\S+'s cantata shatters the defences surrounding (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^\S+ lets the grace of h(?:is|er) voice shine forth with a Scarlattan cantata at (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^(\S+) seems to jolt to a halt suddenly as .* flays \S+\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("shield") p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^You suddenly perceive the vague outline of an aura of rebounding around (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "rebounding") end) }, { [[^(\S+)'s aura of weapons rebounding disappears\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^\S+ razes (\S+)'s aura of rebounding with (.+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^\S+ whirls .+ above h(?:is|er) head, before delivering a single terrible blow to (\S+)'s aura of rebounding\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^The falcon dives at (\S+), ripping apart \w+ aura of rebounding with its talons\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("rebounding") end) }, { [[^A great weight seems to have been lifted from (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_down("mass") end) }, { [[^A shimmering curseward appears around (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "curseward") end) }, { [[^(\S+) clenches \w+ fists and grits \w+ teeth\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "insomnia") end) }, { [[^A brief look of concentration crosses the face of (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) W.def_later(p, "deafness", 4) end) }, { [[^You try to bite (\S+), but your fangs are stopped by an odd \w+ coating\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_up("fangbarrier") p:backtrack("slickness") end) }, { [[^A supple (?:metallic shell of quicksilver|purple shell of sileris berry juice) has formed around (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p) p:def_up("fangbarrier") p:backtrack("slickness") end) },
-- movement { [[^(\S+) begins to tumble towards the (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) p.tumbling = m[3] end) }, { [[^(\S+) tumbles out to the (\S+)\.$]], W.A(function(p, m) p.tumbling = nil p.left_dir = m[3] end) },
-- lifevision marks the line before as an illusion: undo what it did { [[^\*\* Illusion \*\*$]], function() if W.undo then W.undo() W.undo = nil ar.echo("<yellow>illusion ignored") end end }, } for _, pat in ipairs(W.stupid_procs) do table.insert(W.patterns, { pat, W.A(function(p) p:give("stupidity") end) }) end
-- Active and passive cure lines come from ar.data.class_cures (+ your overrides). function W.install_class_cures() for _, name in ipairs(ar.Person.class_cure_names()) do local cc = ar.Person.class_cure(nil, name) local pats = cc.patterns or (cc.pattern and { cc.pattern }) or {} for _, pat in ipairs(pats) do ar.M.trigger((pat:gsub("%%t", [[(\S+)]])), function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if not p then return end for _, aff in ipairs(cc.proves or {}) do p:backtrack(aff) end W.defer(p, "active", name) end) end end end
-- Party target calls: "(Party): Dunn says, "TARGET Bob."" Follow with -- "ar follow on" (or "ar follow <leader>" to only take one person's calls). function W.on_party_call(m) local caller, tgt = m[2], m[3] local f = ar.settings.follow if not f then return end if f ~= true and acs.norm(f) ~= acs.norm(caller) then return end if not ar.target.is(tgt) then ar.target.set(tgt) end end
function W.install() for _, p in ipairs(W.patterns) do ar.M.trigger(p[1], p[2]) end W.install_class_cures() ar.M.trigger([[^\(Party\): (\w+) says?, "[Tt][Aa][Rr][Gg][Ee][Tt] (\w+)\.?"$]], W.on_party_call) end

Script.name: hit confirmation
Script.script:
-- AR hit confirmation. An attack module says what an attack should do -- (ar.hits.expect), then AR waits for the game's answer before marking the -- target afflicted: -- * a hit line for that attack (learned with "ar learn <attack>", or set -- by the module) confirms it, -- * a parry/dodge/miss/rebound/shield line cancels it, -- * a fangbarrier line keeps the hit but drops the venoms. -- With no hit line known yet, "optimistic" mode counts the attack as a hit -- once it fires (you lose balance/eq) and nothing said it missed. -- -- Also: "afflines", your own lines that afflict or cure the target, for any -- class ability: "ar affline add <regex with %t> = aff1 aff2 -curedaff".
ar.hits = ar.hits or {} local H = ar.hits local EN = ar.enemy local D = ar.data
H.log = H.log or {} -- last results, newest last
function H.T(m) return ar.is_target(m[2]) end
-- Lines that mean the attack didn't land (from AW's old system). Group 1 -- (m[2]) is the target's name where there is one. H.miss_patterns = { { [[^(\S+) parries the attack with a deft manoeuvre\.$]], "parry" }, { [[^(\S+) moves into your attack, knocking your blow aside before viciously countering with a strike to your head\.$]], "parry" }, { [[^(\S+) steps into the attack, grabs your arm, and throws you violently to the ground\.$]], "parry" }, { [[^(\S+) dodges nimbly out of the way\.$]], "dodge" }, { [[^(\S+) quickly jumps back, avoiding the attack\.$]], "dodge" }, { [[^(\S+) twists \w+ body out of harm's way\.$]], "dodge" }, { [[^You lash out at (\S+) with .*, but miss\.$]], "miss" }, { [[^A reflection of (\S+) blinks out of existence\.$]], "reflection" }, { [[^The attack harmlessly passes through one of (\S+)'s reflections\.$]], "reflection" }, { [[^The attack rebounds back onto you!$]], "rebounding", true }, { [[^You may not strike one protected by an aura of rebounding, warrior\.$]], "rebounding", true }, { [[^You suddenly perceive the vague outline of an aura of rebounding around (\w+)]], "rebounding" }, { [[^A dizzying beam of energy strikes you as your attack rebounds off of (\S+)'s shield\.$]], "shield" }, { [[^You are prevented from doing that by the magical shield around (\S+)\.$]], "shield" }, { [[^The magical shield surrounding (\S+) makes that impossible\.$]], "shield" }, }
H.venom_block_patterns = { [[^(\w+)'s? fangbarrier]], [[fails? to penetrate (\w+)'s]], [[^Your venom is (?:repelled|blocked)]], }
function H.hitline(key) local cls = ar.class() or "none" local learned = ar.settings.hitlines[cls] if learned and learned[key] then return learned[key] end local mod = ar.offense.module() return mod and mod.hitlines and mod.hitlines[key] end
-- plan = { key = "dstab", venoms = {...}, affs = {...}, strip = "shield", -- weapon = true (rebounding stops it), on_hit = fn(plan), on_miss = fn(plan, why) } function H.expect(plan) plan.at = acs.now() plan.who = ar.current_person() -- the target when the attack was sent plan.key = plan.key or "attack" H.pending = plan end
function H.mark_hit() if H.pending then H.pending.hit = true end end
function H.mark_miss(why, name) -- parrying takes a clear head: a parry proves they aren't nauseous local seen = name and ar.person(name) if why == "parry" and seen then seen:backtrack("nausea") end if why == "miss" then raiseEvent("ar.missed", name) end -- clumsiness, for the curing side local p = H.pending if not p then return end local who = p.who or ar.current_person() if why == "rebounding" then who:def_up("rebounding") if p.weapon == false then return end elseif why == "shield" then who:def_up("shield") if p.strip == "shield" then return end end p.missed = why end
function H.record(p, result) H.log[#H.log + 1] = { key = p.key, result = result, at = acs.now(), venoms = p.venoms, affs = p.affs, target = p.who and p.who.name or EN.name } if #H.log > 30 then table.remove(H.log, 1) end ar.debug(("%s: %s"):format(p.key, result)) end
function H.resolve() local p = H.pending if not p then return end if not (p.hit or p.missed or p.fired) then if acs.now() - p.at > 10 then H.pending = nil H.record(p, "expired") end return end H.pending = nil if p.missed then H.record(p, "missed (" .. p.missed .. ")") if p.on_miss then p.on_miss(p, p.missed) end return end if not p.hit then if H.hitline(p.key) or not ar.settings.optimistic then H.record(p, "no hit line seen") if p.on_miss then p.on_miss(p, "unseen") end return end end local who = p.who or ar.current_person() if p.strip then who:def_down(p.strip) end H.calling(who, function() if p.venoms and not p.vblocked and not who:has_def("fangbarrier") then for _, v in ipairs(p.venoms) do who:venom(v) end end for _, a in ipairs(p.affs or {}) do who:give(a) end end) H.record(p, p.hit and "hit" or "assumed hit") if p.on_hit then p.on_hit(p) end raiseEvent("ar.hit", p.key, p) end
-- Balance or equilibrium going away while an attack is pending means it fired. function H.on_vitals() local v = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals local p = H.pending if v and p and (tostring(v.bal) == "0" or tostring(v.eq) == "0") then p.fired = true end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Learning hit lines: "ar learn dstab", then attack. The first line that -- names your target becomes the hit line for that attack, for this class.
function H.learn(key) if not EN.name then ar.err("set a target first") return end H.stop_learning() H.learning = key ar.echo(("attack now; the next line naming %s becomes the <white>%s<reset> hit line for %s") :format(EN.name, key, tostring(ar.class()))) H._learn_id = ar.M.trigger([[^(.+)$]], function(m) H.learn_line(m[2]) end) end
function H.stop_learning() if H._learn_id then killTrigger(H._learn_id) H._learn_id = nil end H.learning = nil end
function H.learn_line(text) if not H.learning or not EN.name then return end local s, e = text:find(EN.name, 1, true) if not s then return end if text:find("^%s*queue") or text:find("^%[") then return end local before, after = text:sub(1, s - 1), text:sub(e + 1) local pattern = "^" .. ar.regex_escape(before) .. "%t" .. ar.regex_escape(after) .. "$" H.set_hitline(H.learning, pattern) H.stop_learning() end
function H.set_hitline(key, pattern) local cls = ar.class() or "none" ar.settings.hitlines[cls] = ar.settings.hitlines[cls] or {} ar.settings.hitlines[cls][key] = pattern ar.save() ar.echo(("hit line for <white>%s<reset> (%s): %s"):format(key, cls, pattern)) H.install_hitlines() end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Triggers
H._hit_ids = H._hit_ids or {} function H.install_hitlines() for _, id in ipairs(H._hit_ids) do killTrigger(id) end H._hit_ids = {} local seen = {} local function add(key, pattern) if seen[key] then return end seen[key] = true H._hit_ids[#H._hit_ids + 1] = ar.M.trigger(ar.tpat(pattern), function(m) if H.pending and H.pending.key == key and ar.is_target(m[2]) then H.mark_hit() end end) end local cls = ar.class() or "none" for key, pat in pairs(ar.settings.hitlines[cls] or {}) do add(key, pat) end local mod = ar.offense.module() for key, pat in pairs(mod and mod.hitlines or {}) do add(key, pat) end end
H._aff_ids = H._aff_ids or {} function H.install_afflines() for _, id in ipairs(H._aff_ids) do killTrigger(id) end H._aff_ids = {} for _, al in ipairs(ar.settings.afflines) do H._aff_ids[#H._aff_ids + 1] = ar.M.trigger(ar.tpat(al.pattern), function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if not p then return end for _, a in ipairs(al.affs or {}) do if a:sub(1, 1) == "-" then p:cure(a:sub(2)) else p:give(a) end end if al.strip then p:def_down(al.strip) end end) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Limbs, health, kills and party calls (from AW's old system).
-- Limb damage you dealt, as a running total per limb. function H.limb(name, limb, pct) local p = ar.person(name) pct = tonumber(pct) if not p or not pct or not limb then return end limb = limb:lower() p.limbs = p.limbs or {} p.limbs[limb] = (p.limbs[limb] or 0) + pct raiseEvent("ar.enemy.limb", limb, p.limbs[limb], p.name) if p:is_target() then ar.show_soon() end end
-- Afflictions named in a party call: affliction names or venom names. -- A call that names an aff we saw land on them in the last few seconds is -- the ally echoing a hit we already counted. If they've cured it since, -- taking the call would put it back, so it's skipped ("ar callwindow"). function H.party_affs(name, text) local p = ar.person(name) if not p then return end local window = ar.settings.call_window or 0.5 local function take(aff) aff = D.canon(aff) if acs.now() - (p.seen[aff] or -1e9) < window then return end p:give(aff) end for word in tostring(text):lower():gmatch("%a+") do if word == "paralyse" then word = "curare" end local v = D.venoms[word] if v then if word == "delphinium" and p.defs.insomnia then p:def_down("insomnia") elseif type(v) == "table" then for _, a in ipairs(v) do take(a) end else take(v) end elseif D.known_aff(word) then take(word) end end end
H.info_patterns = { { [[^As you carve into (\S+), you perceive that you have dealt (.*)% damage to \w+ (.*)\.$]], function(m) H.limb(m[2], m[4], m[3]) end }, { [[^As your blow lands with a crunch, you perceive that you have dealt (.*)% damage to (\S+)'s (.*)\.$]], function(m) H.limb(m[3], m[4], m[2]) end }, { [[^\(Party\): \S+ says?, "Hit (\S+) (.*) for (.*)%\."$]], function(m) H.limb(m[2], m[3], m[4]) end }, { [[^You glance over (\S+) and see that \w+ health is at (\d+)/(\d+)]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p.hp, p.maxhp = tonumber(m[3]), tonumber(m[4]) end if ar.is_target(m[2]) then ar.target.hp = math.floor(100 * tonumber(m[3]) / math.max(1, tonumber(m[4]))) end end }, { [[^(\S+) is attempting to parry blows directed at \w+ (.*)\.$]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p.parrying = m[3] end end }, { [[^(\S+) does not seem to be parrying\b]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p.parrying = nil end end }, { [[^You have slain (\S+)\.$]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p:reset() p.limbs = nil end end }, { [[^(\S+) attempts to defend against your attack but you bat \w+ weak attempt aside\.$]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p:give("nausea") end end }, -- generic venom reveals, whoever landed them { [[^Horror overcomes (\S+)'s face as \w+ body stiffens into paralysis\.$]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p:give("paralysis") end end }, { [[^The protective coating covering the skin of (\S+) sloughs off\.$]], function(m) local p = ar.person(m[2]) if p then p:give("slickness") end end }, -- party calls: "venoms/affs on X" and "Afflicted X: affs." { [[^\(Party\): \S+ says?, "(.*) on (\w+)\.?"$]], function(m) H.party_affs(m[3], m[2]) end }, { [[^\(Party\): \S+ says?, "Afflicted (\w+): (.*?)\.?"$]], function(m) H.party_affs(m[2], m[3]) end }, }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Party calls for affs you land: everything you gave one person before the -- prompt goes out as one call, "pt asthma, slickness on Bob." (the format -- AR reads back from allies). "ar call off" stops them.
H.calls = H.calls or {} -- name -> ordered list of affs
-- Run fn(); any aff p didn't surely have before and does after gets called. function H.calling(p, fn) if not p or not p.name then return fn() end local before = {} for aff, c in pairs(p.prob) do before[aff] = c end fn() if ar.settings.call_affs == false then return end for aff, c in pairs(p.prob) do if c >= 100 and (before[aff] or 0) < 100 then local list = H.calls[p.name] or {} list[#list + 1] = aff H.calls[p.name] = list end end end
function H.flush_calls() for name, list in pairs(H.calls) do table.sort(list) ar.send(("pt %s on %s."):format(table.concat(list, ", "), name)) end H.calls = {} end
function H.on_prompt() ar.watch.on_prompt() H.resolve() ar.lines.on_prompt() H.flush_calls() end
function H.install() for _, mp in ipairs(H.miss_patterns) do local pat, why, nameless = mp[1], mp[2], mp[3] ar.M.trigger(pat, function(m) if nameless or H.T(m) then H.mark_miss(why, not nameless and m[2] or nil) elseif why == "parry" and ar.person(m[2]) then ar.person(m[2]):backtrack("nausea") end end) end for _, ip in ipairs(H.info_patterns) do ar.M.trigger(ip[1], ip[2]) end for _, pat in ipairs(H.venom_block_patterns) do ar.M.trigger(pat, function(m) local p = (m[2] and m[2] ~= "") and ar.person(m[2]) or ar.current_person() if not p then return end if H.pending and H.pending.who == p then H.pending.vblocked = true end p:def_up("fangbarrier") end) end ar.M.on("gmcp.Char.Vitals", function() H.on_vitals() if not H._prompt then ar.M.timer(0.05, H.on_prompt) end end) if tempPromptTrigger then if H._prompt then killTrigger(H._prompt) end H._prompt = tempPromptTrigger(function() local ok, err = pcall(H.on_prompt) if not ok then ar.err("hits: " .. tostring(err)) end end) end H.install_hitlines() H.install_afflines() end

Script.name: offense
Script.script:
-- AR offense: picking what to give next, and the class module registry. -- -- A class module is a table registered with ar.offense.register(class, mod): -- mod.attack(target, args) called by "k"; decide and send (usually ar.queue) -- mod.hitlines = { key = "regex with %t" } optional built-in hit lines -- mod.on_load(), mod.on_unload() optional -- Inside attack(), call ar.hits.expect{...} so AR knows what to track.
ar.offense = ar.offense or {} local O = ar.offense local EN = ar.enemy local D = ar.data
O.modules = O.modules or {}
function O.register(class, mod) O.modules[acs.norm(class)] = mod mod.class = acs.norm(class) if acs.norm(ar.class() or "") == mod.class and ar._ready then O.activate() end end
function O.module(cls) return O.modules[acs.norm(cls or ar.class() or "none")] end
-- Called when the class changes: swap in that class's hit lines. function O.activate(old) local prev = old and O.modules[acs.norm(old)] if prev and prev.on_unload then prev.on_unload() end local mod = O.module() if mod and mod.on_load then mod.on_load() end ar.hits.install_hitlines() end
-- Per-class module settings, saved: ar.offense.mod_settings("serpent", {defaults}) function O.mod_settings(cls, defaults) cls = acs.norm(cls) ar.settings.mods[cls] = acs.merge_defaults(ar.settings.mods[cls] or {}, defaults or {}) return ar.settings.mods[cls] end
function O.attack(args) local cls = ar.class() or "none" if not EN.name then ar.err("no target: use 't <name>'") return end if not ar.settings.enabled then ar.err("offense is off ('ar on')") return end local mod = O.module() if not mod or not mod.attack then ar.err("no attack module for '" .. cls .. "' yet ('ar mods' lists them)") return end if not ar.target.here() then ar.echo("<yellow>" .. EN.name .. " doesn't seem to be here") end mod.attack(EN.name, args) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Helpers for modules
-- First aff in a priority list the target doesn't have (and isn't in skip). -- Entries can be a function(EN) returning an aff or nil, for conditions. function O.next_aff(list, skip) for _, aff in ipairs(list) do if type(aff) == "function" then aff = aff(EN) end if aff and not EN.has(aff) and not (skip and skip[aff]) then return aff end end end
-- Up to n distinct venoms for the missing affs in list. function O.next_venoms(list, n) local r, skip = {}, {} while #r < (n or 1) do local aff = O.next_aff(list, skip) if not aff then break end skip[aff] = true local v = D.aff_to_venom[aff] if v then r[#r + 1] = v end end return r end
-- Afflictions that would be wasted right now because the target will -- just cure them before we can stack on top. Skip kelp affs if they can eat -- and already have one kelp aff pending, etc. Modules may use or ignore it. function O.cure_pressure() local r = {} for kind in pairs(D.blocks) do r[kind] = EN.can(kind) end return r end
-- What does the target need stripped before an attack can land? -- Returns "shield", "rebounding" or nil. function O.blocker(weapon) if EN.has_def("shield") then return "shield" end if weapon ~= false and EN.has_def("rebounding") then return "rebounding" end end
-- Standard serpent-style venom lock order; any venom class can use it. O.lock_order = { "paralysis", function(e) return (e.has("asthma") and e.has("anorexia")) and "slickness" or nil end, "asthma", "anorexia", "slickness", function(e) return e.lock() and "impatience" or nil end, "clumsiness", "weariness", "stupidity", "sensitivity", "nausea", "darkshade", "recklessness", "haemophilia", "addiction", "dizziness", "shyness", "disloyalty", }

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- AR commands ("ar <word> ...") and the target status line.
local M = ar.M local EN = ar.enemy local D = ar.data
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Status line: one line with the target's state, at most once per batch.
ar.SHORT = { paralysis = "para", asthma = "asth", slickness = "slick", anorexia = "ano", impatience = "imp", clumsiness = "clumsy", weariness = "weary", stupidity = "stupid", sensitivity = "sens", haemophilia = "haemo", recklessness = "reck", darkshade = "dark", addiction = "addict", dizziness = "dizzy", disloyalty = "disloy", }
function ar.status_line() if not EN.name then return "no target" end local affs = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(EN.prob)) do local c = EN.prob[a] if c >= 100 then affs[#affs + 1] = ar.SHORT[a] or a elseif EN.affs[a] then affs[#affs + 1] = ("%s<grey>%d<reset>"):format(ar.SHORT[a] or a, c) else affs[#affs + 1] = ("<grey>%s%d<reset>"):format(ar.SHORT[a] or a, c) end end local defs = acs.sorted_keys(EN.defs) local parts = { "<white>" .. EN.name .. "<reset>" } if ar.target.hp then parts[#parts + 1] = ("<grey>%d%%<reset>"):format(ar.target.hp) end parts[#parts + 1] = #affs > 0 and table.concat(affs, " ") or "<grey>no affs" if #defs > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "<magenta>[" .. table.concat(defs, " ") .. "]<reset>" end local l, outs = EN.lock_info() if l then parts[#parts + 1] = "<red>" .. l .. " lock" .. (outs and (" (outs: " .. table.concat(outs, ",") .. ")") or "") .. "<reset>" end return table.concat(parts, " ") end
ar._show_pending = false function ar.show_soon() if not ar.settings.show or ar._show_pending or not ar._ready then return end ar._show_pending = true M.timer(0, function() ar._show_pending = false ar.echo(ar.status_line()) end) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Commands -- Registered by ar.init (acs.module resets the command table on reload).
function ar.install_commands()
local function onoff_cmd(key, label, help) M.command(key, function(w) ar.settings[key] = ar.onoff(w[1], ar.settings[key]) ar.save() ar.echo(label .. " " .. (ar.settings[key] and "on" or "off")) end, help) end
M.command("call", function(w) ar.settings.call_affs = ar.onoff(w[1], ar.settings.call_affs ~= false) ar.save() ar.echo("party aff calls " .. (ar.settings.call_affs and "on" or "off")) end, "call [on|off] tell the party the affs you land (one call per prompt)")
M.command("callwindow", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1] or "") if n then ar.settings.call_window = n ar.save() end ar.echo(("an ally's call for an aff seen landing within %gs is ignored as an echo"):format(ar.settings.call_window or 0.5)) end, "callwindow [seconds] ignore ally calls for affs you saw land this recently")
M.command("sure", function(w) ar.settings.sure = ar.settings.sure or {} local aff, n = w[1] and D.canon(w[1]), tonumber(w[2] or "") if aff and n then ar.settings.sure[aff] = n ar.save() ar.echo(("%s counts as on at %d%% or more"):format(aff, n)) elseif aff and w[2] == "default" then ar.settings.sure[aff] = nil ar.save() ar.echo(("%s back to %d%%"):format(aff, ar.Person.sure(aff))) else local keys = {} for k in pairs(D.sure) do keys[k] = true end for k in pairs(ar.settings.sure) do keys[k] = true end ar.echo(("affs count as on at %d%% unless set here:"):format(D.sure_default)) for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(keys)) do ar.echo((" %-14s %d%%"):format(k, ar.Person.sure(k))) end end end, "sure [aff n|default] chance an aff needs to count as on")
M.command("ta", function() ar.echo(ar.status_line()) local bals = {} for _, k in ipairs({ "eat", "apply", "smoke", "focus", "tree" }) do local left = EN.bal_left(k) local blocked = not EN.can(k) and left == 0 bals[#bals + 1] = k .. (blocked and "<red>x<reset>" or (left > 0 and ("<yellow>" .. ("%.1f"):format(left) .. "<reset>") or "<green>ok<reset>")) end cecho("\n cures: " .. table.concat(bals, " ")) cecho("\n class: " .. tostring(EN.class or "unknown") .. " class cures ready: " .. (table.concat(EN.ready_class_cures(), ", ") ~= "" and table.concat(EN.ready_class_cures(), ", ") or "none known")) if EN.limbs and next(EN.limbs) then local l = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(EN.limbs)) do l[#l + 1] = ("%s %.0f%%"):format(k, EN.limbs[k]) end cecho("\n limbs: " .. table.concat(l, " ") .. (EN.parrying and (" parrying " .. EN.parrying) or "")) end end, "ta target status: afflictions, defences, lock, cure balances")
M.command("give", function(w) for _, a in ipairs(w) do EN.give(a) end end, "give <aff> [aff...] mark the target afflicted") M.command("cure", function(w) for _, a in ipairs(w) do EN.cure(a) end end, "cure <aff> [aff...] remove afflictions from the target") M.command("reset", function() EN.reset() end, "reset forget the target's afflictions and defences") M.command("def", function(w) if not w[1] then ar.err("ar def <def> up|down") return end if w[2] == "down" or w[2] == "off" then EN.def_down(w[1]) else EN.def_up(w[1]) end end, "def <def> up|down mark a target defence (shield, rebounding, fangbarrier...)") M.command("eclass", function(w) EN.set_class(w[1]) end, "eclass <class> tell AR the target's class (for their class cures)")
M.command("on", function() ar.settings.enabled = true ar.save() ar.echo("offense on") end, "on | off allow or stop attacks from 'k'") M.command("off", function() ar.settings.enabled = false ar.save() ar.echo("offense off") end) onoff_cmd("optimistic", "optimistic hits", "optimistic on|off count unconfirmed attacks as hits unless they missed") onoff_cmd("show", "status line", "show on|off echo the target status when it changes") M.command("treeguess", function(w) ar.settings.tree_guess = ar.onoff(w[1], ar.settings.tree_guess ~= false) ar.save() ar.echo("tree guess " .. (ar.settings.tree_guess and "on" or "off")) end, "treeguess on|off guess which aff the target's tree cured")
-- hit lines M.command("learn", function(w) if not w[1] then ar.err("ar learn <attack name, as your module calls it>") return end ar.hits.learn(w[1]:lower()) end, "learn <attack> use the next line naming your target as that attack's hit line") M.command("hitline", function(w, rest) local key = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not key then ar.err("ar hitline <attack> <regex with %t> | clear") return end local pat = rest:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if pat == "clear" then local cls = ar.class() or "none" if ar.settings.hitlines[cls] then ar.settings.hitlines[cls][key] = nil end ar.save() ar.hits.install_hitlines() ar.echo("cleared hit line for " .. key) elseif pat then ar.hits.set_hitline(key, pat) end end, "hitline <attack> <regex with %t>|clear set an attack's hit line by hand") M.command("hitlines", function() local cls = ar.class() or "none" ar.echo("hit lines for " .. cls) local mod = ar.offense.module() for key, pat in pairs(mod and mod.hitlines or {}) do cecho("\n " .. key .. " <grey>(module)<reset> " .. pat) end for key, pat in pairs(ar.settings.hitlines[cls] or {}) do cecho("\n " .. key .. " <grey>(yours)<reset> " .. pat) end end, "hitlines show hit lines for your class") M.command("log", function() ar.echo("recent attacks") for _, e in ipairs(ar.hits.log) do cecho(("\n %s %s -> %s %s"):format(e.key, e.target or "?", e.result, table.concat(e.venoms or {}, " ") .. " " .. table.concat(e.affs or {}, " "))) end end, "log recent attacks and whether they hit")
-- afflines M.command("affline", function(w, rest) local sub = (w[1] or "list"):lower() local list = ar.settings.afflines if sub == "add" then local pat, affs = rest:match("^%S+%s+(.-)%s*=%s*(.+)$") if not pat then ar.err("ar affline add <regex with %t> = aff1 aff2 -curedaff") return end list[#list + 1] = { pattern = pat, affs = acs.words(affs) } ar.save() ar.hits.install_afflines() ar.echo("added affline #" .. #list) elseif sub == "del" then local n = tonumber(w[2]) if n and list[n] then table.remove(list, n) ar.save() ar.hits.install_afflines() ar.echo("removed #" .. n) end else ar.echo("afflines (lines that afflict or cure the target)") for i, al in ipairs(list) do cecho(("\n %d. %s = %s"):format(i, al.pattern, table.concat(al.affs, " "))) end end end, { "affline add <regex with %t> = aff1 aff2 -cured any line that afflicts/cures the target", "affline list | del <n>" })
-- enemy class cures M.command("ecure", function(w, rest) local name, field = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), w[2] and w[2]:lower() if not name or name == "list" then ar.echo("enemy class cures") for _, n in ipairs(EN.class_cure_names()) do local cc = EN.class_cure(n) cecho(("\n %s <grey>cd %ss, cures %s, %s<reset>\n %s"):format(n, cc.cd or "?", type(cc.cures) == "table" and table.concat(cc.cures, ",") or tostring(cc.cures), table.concat(cc.classes or {}, ","), table.concat(cc.patterns or { tostring(cc.pattern) }, "\n "))) end return end local cc = acs.copy(EN.class_cure(name) or { cures = "any", cd = 20, classes = {} }) local val = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") if field == "pattern" then cc.patterns = cc.patterns or {} table.insert(cc.patterns, val) cc.pattern = nil elseif field == "cd" then cc.cd = tonumber(val) elseif field == "cures" then cc.cures = val == "any" and "any" or acs.words((val or ""):gsub(",", " ")) elseif field == "classes" then cc.classes = acs.words((val or ""):gsub(",", " ")) else ar.err("ar ecure <name> pattern|cd|cures|classes <value>") return end ar.settings.class_cures[name] = cc ar.save() ar.reinstall() ar.echo("updated class cure " .. name) end, { "ecure list class cures enemies can use", "ecure <name> pattern|cd|cures|classes <value> add a line or fix one" })
M.command("ebal", function(w) local k, sec = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) if not (k and sec) then ar.err("ar ebal eat|apply|smoke|focus|tree <seconds>") return end ar.settings.enemy_bal[k] = sec ar.save() ar.echo(k .. " balance for enemies: " .. sec .. "s") end, "ebal <kind> <seconds> how long enemy curing balances take")
M.command("mods", function() ar.echo("attack modules: " .. table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(ar.offense.modules), ", ")) end, "mods classes with an attack module")
M.command("venoms", function() local r = {} for _, v in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(D.venoms)) do r[#r + 1] = v .. "=" .. D.venoms[v] end ar.echo(table.concat(r, " ")) end, "venoms venom to affliction table") M.command("follow", function(w) local v = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if v == "off" then ar.settings.follow = nil elseif v == "on" or not v then ar.settings.follow = true else ar.settings.follow = v end ar.save() ar.echo("party target calls: " .. (ar.settings.follow == true and "anyone" or tostring(ar.settings.follow or "off"))) end, "follow on|off|<leader> switch target when the party calls TARGET <name>")
M.command("people", function(w) if w[1] == "forget" then ar.people = {} ar.echo("forgot everyone") return end ar.echo("tracking") for _, name in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(ar.people)) do local p = ar.people[name] cecho(("\n %s%s <grey>%s<reset> %s"):format(name, p:is_target() and " <red>*<reset>" or "", tostring(p.class or ""), table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(p.affs), " "))) end end, "people [forget] everyone AR is tracking and their afflictions") end

Script.name: class detection
Script.script:
-- AR class detection: work out what class a person is from what they do. -- Seen attacks/abilities are the primary source; the people tracker's -- API/honours class is only the fallback (it can be stale or wrong). -- -- Each sign is { pattern = regex with %p for the person's name, class = "..." }. -- Add them as you meet them: -- ar sign add <class> <regex with %p> -- ar sign learn <class> <person> (the next line naming them becomes the sign) -- Class cures that only one class has (dragonheal, shrugging...) count too. -- -- Event: "ar.class.seen"(name, class)
ar.classes = ar.classes or {} local C = ar.classes local EN = ar.enemy
-- Starter signs. Empty on purpose until lines are confirmed in game; add -- yours with "ar sign add" (they're saved per character). ar.data.class_signs = ar.data.class_signs or {}
function C.signs() local r = {} for _, s in ipairs(ar.data.class_signs) do r[#r + 1] = s end for _, s in ipairs(ar.settings.class_signs or {}) do r[#r + 1] = s end return r end
-- Record a class seen in action, for anyone (not only the target). function C.seen(name, cls) if not name or not cls then return end name = name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2):lower() cls = acs.norm(cls) local known = ar.settings.enemy_classes[name] ar.settings.enemy_classes[name] = cls if known ~= cls then ar.save() if pt and pt.observe then pt.observe(name, "class", cls) end raiseEvent("ar.class.seen", name, cls) end if ar.is_target(name) and EN.class ~= cls then EN.class = cls ar.echo(name .. " fights like a <white>" .. cls) end end
-- Class of a person: what we've seen first, then the people tracker. function C.of(name) if not name then return nil end name = name:sub(1, 1):upper() .. name:sub(2):lower() return ar.settings.enemy_classes[name] or (pt and pt.class and pt.class(name)) or nil end
C._ids = C._ids or {} function C.install() for _, id in ipairs(C._ids) do killTrigger(id) end C._ids = {} for _, s in ipairs(C.signs()) do C._ids[#C._ids + 1] = ar.M.trigger((s.pattern:gsub("%%p", [[(\w+)]])), function(m) if m[2] and m[2] ~= "" and m[2]:lower() ~= tostring(acs.me.name):lower() then C.seen(m[2], s.class) end end) end end
function C.add(cls, pattern) ar.settings.class_signs = ar.settings.class_signs or {} table.insert(ar.settings.class_signs, { class = acs.norm(cls), pattern = pattern }) ar.save() C.install() ar.echo(("sign #%d for <white>%s<reset>: %s"):format(#ar.settings.class_signs, cls, pattern)) end
function C.learn(cls, who) if C._learn_id then killTrigger(C._learn_id) end who = who:sub(1, 1):upper() .. who:sub(2):lower() ar.echo(("the next line naming %s becomes a <white>%s<reset> sign"):format(who, cls)) C._learn_id = ar.M.trigger([[^(.+)$]], function(m) local text = m[2] local s, e = text:find(who, 1, true) if not s then return end killTrigger(C._learn_id) C._learn_id = nil C.add(cls, "^" .. ar.regex_escape(text:sub(1, s - 1)) .. "%p" .. ar.regex_escape(text:sub(e + 1)) .. "$") end) end
function C.install_commands() ar.M.command("sign", function(w, rest) local sub = (w[1] or "list"):lower() local list = ar.settings.class_signs or {} if sub == "add" and w[2] then local pat = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") if pat then C.add(w[2], pat) end elseif sub == "learn" and w[2] and w[3] then C.learn(w[2], w[3]) elseif sub == "del" and tonumber(w[2]) and list[tonumber(w[2])] then table.remove(list, tonumber(w[2])) ar.save() C.install() ar.echo("removed") else ar.echo("class signs (lines that show someone's class)") for i, s in ipairs(list) do cecho(("\n %d. %s %s"):format(i, s.class, s.pattern)) end end end, { "sign add <class> <regex with %p> a line that shows someone's class", "sign learn <class> <person> next line naming them becomes a sign", "sign list | del <n>" }) ar.M.command("class", function(w) if w[1] then ar.echo(w[1] .. ": " .. tostring(C.of(w[1]) or "unknown")) end end, "class <person> the class AR thinks someone is") end

Script.name: module builder
Script.script:
-- AR module builder: most class modules are data. ar.offense.simple(class, spec) -- turns a spec into a module whose attack() does, in order: -- 1. strip a shield or rebounding the attack can't get through -- 2. a kill move, if its condition holds -- 3. for each channel (bal, eq, ...): the first affliction in the order -- that the target lacks and a move can give, or the venom attack -- 4. the fallback attack -- "k <move>" forces a named move (spec.manual or any move key). -- -- Templates: %t target, %a affliction word, %a2 second affliction word, -- %v1 %v2 venoms. -- -- spec = { -- strip = { shield = { cmd, q }, rebounding = { cmd, q } } -- kill = { { key, cmd, q, when = function(EN, T) ... end }, ... } -- order = { aff, aff, function(EN) return aff end, ... } -- moves = { aff = { cmd, q, key, word = "game word for %a", affs = {...} } } -- pair = { cmd, q, key } -- two move words in one command (%a %a2) -- venom = { cmd, q, key, n = 1|2, weapon = true } -- fallback = { cmd, q, key } -- manual = { key = { cmd, q } } -- channels = { "bal" } | { "bal", "eq" } (default: one action per k) -- pre = function(tgt, plan) end -- runs before sending (e.g. temper) -- }
local O = ar.offense local EN = ar.enemy local D = ar.data
function ar.fill(tpl, tgt, t) t = t or {} local s = tpl:gsub("%%t", tgt) s = s:gsub("%%a2", t.a2 or ""):gsub("%%a", t.a or "") s = s:gsub("%%v1", t.v1 or ""):gsub("%%v2", t.v2 or "") return (s:gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("%s%s+", " ")) end
-- q is the game's queue type: "bal", "eq", "eqbal" or "free". function ar.chan_of(q) return q or "eqbal" end
function ar._send(spec, tgt, m, extra, plan) plan = plan or {} plan.key = plan.key or m.key or "attack" local cmd = ar.fill(m.cmd or m[1], tgt, extra) if spec.pre then spec.pre(tgt, plan, m) end ar.queue(cmd, m.q or m[2] or spec.q) if not ar._expect_set then ar.hits.expect(plan) ar._expect_set = true else -- a second action this round: give its affs on the same confirmation local p = ar.hits.pending if p then for _, a in ipairs(plan.affs or {}) do p.affs = p.affs or {} p.affs[#p.affs + 1] = a end end end return cmd end
function ar.in_channel(m, spec, ch) if not spec.channels then return true end local q = m.q or m[2] or spec.q or "eqbal" return q == ch or (ch == "bal" and q == "eqbal") end
-- Pick the move for the first missing aff on this channel. function ar.pick(spec, ch, skip) for _, entry in ipairs(spec.order or {}) do local aff = entry if type(entry) == "function" then aff = entry(EN) end if aff and not EN.has(aff) and not skip[aff] then local m = spec.moves and spec.moves[aff] if m and ar.in_channel(m, spec, ch) and not (m.when and not m.when(EN, ar.target)) then return aff, m end if spec.venom and D.aff_to_venom[aff] and ar.in_channel(spec.venom, spec, ch) then return aff, "venom" end end end end
function O.simple(class, spec) local mod = { spec = spec, hitlines = spec.hitlines }
function mod.attack(tgt, args) ar._expect_set = false local word = args and args:match("^(%S+)") if word then local m = (spec.manual and spec.manual[word]) or (spec.moves and spec.moves[word]) if not m and spec.kill then for _, k in ipairs(spec.kill) do if k.key == word then m = k end end end if not m then ar.err("no move '" .. word .. "' for " .. class) return end ar._send(spec, tgt, m, {}, { key = m.key or word, affs = m.affs }) return end
local blocker = O.blocker(spec.weapon or (spec.venom and spec.venom.weapon) or false) if blocker and spec.strip then local m = spec.strip[blocker] or spec.strip.any if m then ar._send(spec, tgt, m, {}, { key = m.key or ("strip" .. blocker), strip = blocker, weapon = false }) return end end
for _, k in ipairs(spec.kill or {}) do if k.when(EN, ar.target) then ar._send(spec, tgt, k, {}, { key = k.key or "kill" }) return end end
local sent_any = false for _, ch in ipairs(spec.channels or { "any" }) do local skip = {} local aff, m = ar.pick(spec, ch, skip) if m == "venom" then local vs = O.next_venoms(spec.order, spec.venom.n or 1) if #vs > 0 then ar._send(spec, tgt, spec.venom, { v1 = vs[1], v2 = vs[2] or vs[1] }, { key = spec.venom.key, venoms = vs, weapon = spec.venom.weapon }) sent_any = true end elseif m then skip[aff] = true -- a second missing aff on the same channel can ride along in a pair move local aff2, m2 = nil, nil if spec.pair and ar.in_channel(spec.pair, spec, ch) then aff2, m2 = ar.pick(spec, ch, skip) end if spec.pair and m2 and m2 ~= "venom" then ar._send(spec, tgt, spec.pair, { a = m.word or aff, a2 = m2.word or aff2 }, { key = spec.pair.key, affs = { aff, aff2 } }) else ar._send(spec, tgt, m, { a = m.word or aff }, { key = m.key or aff, affs = m.affs or { aff } }) end sent_any = true end end if not sent_any and spec.fallback then ar._send(spec, tgt, spec.fallback, {}, { key = spec.fallback.key or "fallback", affs = spec.fallback.affs }) elseif not sent_any then ar.echo("nothing left to give " .. tgt .. " from this module") end end
O.register(class, mod) return mod end
-- Shorthand: a move table where the game word differs from AR's aff name. -- O.words("stare %t %a", "bal", { deafness = "deaf", clumsiness = "clumsy" }, { "fear", ... }) function O.words(cmd, q, map, plain) local r = {} for aff, word in pairs(map or {}) do r[aff] = { cmd = cmd, q = q, word = word, key = word } end for _, aff in ipairs(plain or {}) do r[aff] = { cmd = cmd, q = q, word = aff, key = aff } end return r end
function O.merge(...) local r = {} for _, t in ipairs({ ... }) do for k, v in pairs(t) do r[k] = v end end return r end

Script.name: serpent
Script.script:
-- AR attack module: Serpent. Doublestab two venoms down the lock order, -- bite when they're locked. Use it as the pattern for other classes. -- -- Hit lines: run "ar learn dstab" once and doublestab your target; AR saves -- the line it sees. Until then hits are assumed unless a miss is seen.
ar.serpent = {} local O = ar.offense local EN = ar.enemy
ar.serpent.settings = O.mod_settings("serpent", { dirk = "dirk", -- weapon word for dstab/flay kill_venom = "voyria", -- bite venom once true locked })
function ar.serpent.attack(tgt) local s = O.mod_settings("serpent") local blocker = O.blocker(true) if blocker then ar.queue("flay " .. tgt .. " " .. blocker) ar.hits.expect { key = "flay", strip = blocker, weapon = false } return end if EN.lock() == "true" then ar.queue("bite " .. tgt .. " " .. s.kill_venom) ar.hits.expect { key = "bite", venoms = { s.kill_venom } } return end local v = O.next_venoms(O.lock_order, 2) v[1], v[2] = v[1] or "curare", v[2] or "kalmia" if v[1] == v[2] then v[2] = "kalmia" end ar.queue(("dstab %s %s %s"):format(tgt, v[1], v[2])) ar.hits.expect { key = "dstab", venoms = { v[1], v[2] }, weapon = true } end
O.register("serpent", ar.serpent)

Script.name: class modules
Script.script:
-- AR class modules built from the Achaea wiki's skill pages (October 2026). -- Each is a starting routine, not a finished combo: it strips what blocks -- it, kills when the kill condition is known to AR, and otherwise stacks the -- lock afflictions the class can give. Tune the order per class in game. -- -- Not verified in play yet. Hit lines: "ar learn <move key>" per attack. -- Forced moves: "k <key>", e.g. "k devour".
local O = ar.offense local EN = ar.enemy local LOCK = O.lock_order
function ar.hp_below(n) return function(_, T) return T.hp ~= nil and T.hp <= n end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Knights: Runewarden, Paladin, Infernal, Unnamable share Weaponmastery. -- Style per class: "ar style dualcut|dualblunt|twohanded|snb".
ar.KNIGHT_STYLES = { dualcut = { venom = { cmd = "dsl %t %v1 %v2", key = "dsl", n = 2, weapon = true }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "raze %t shield", key = "raze" }, rebounding = { cmd = "raze %t rebounding", key = "raze" } } }, dualblunt = { fallback = { cmd = "doublewhirl %t", key = "doublewhirl" }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "fracture %t shield", key = "fracture" }, rebounding = { cmd = "fracture %t rebounding", key = "fracture" } } }, twohanded = { venom = { cmd = "slaughter %t %v1", key = "slaughter", n = 1, weapon = true }, strip = { any = { cmd = "carve %t", key = "carve" } } }, snb = { venom = { cmd = "slice %t %v1", key = "slice", n = 1, weapon = true }, strip = { any = { cmd = "raze %t", key = "raze" } } }, }
function ar.knight(class, extra) local st = O.mod_settings(class, { style = "dualcut" }) local style = ar.KNIGHT_STYLES[st.style] or ar.KNIGHT_STYLES.dualcut local spec = { order = LOCK, venom = style.venom, fallback = style.fallback, strip = style.strip, kill = extra.kill, moves = extra.moves, manual = extra.manual, } if extra.strip then spec.strip = O.merge(spec.strip, extra.strip) end return O.simple(class, spec) end ar.knight_styles = ar.KNIGHT_STYLES ar.build_knight = ar.knight
function ar.build_knights()
function ar.install_style_command() ar.M.command("style", function(w) local cls = acs.norm(ar.class() or "") local style = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not ({ runewarden = 1, paladin = 1, infernal = 1, unnamable = 1 })[cls] then ar.err("style is for knight classes (runewarden, paladin, infernal, unnamable)") return end if not ar.KNIGHT_STYLES[style or ""] then ar.err("ar style dualcut|dualblunt|twohanded|snb") return end O.mod_settings(cls).style = style ar.save() ar.build_knights() ar.echo(cls .. " style: " .. style) end, "style <dualcut|dualblunt|twohanded|snb> knight weapon style") end -- Runelore: Bisect slays at 20% health or less (edged runeblade with Hugalaz). ar.knight("runewarden", { kill = { { key = "bisect", cmd = "bisect %t", when = ar.hp_below(20) } }, }) -- Excision: Denounce strips rebounding; Damnation kill needs burning states AR doesn't track yet. ar.knight("paladin", { strip = { rebounding = { cmd = "perform denounce %t", key = "denounce" } }, manual = { damnation = { cmd = "perform damnation %t" }, pyre = { cmd = "perform pyre %t" } }, }) -- Oppression: Quash strips shields; Cripple breaks two limbs. ar.knight("infernal", { strip = { shield = { cmd = "quash %t", q = "eq", key = "quash" } }, manual = { cripple = { cmd = "cripple %t left leg right leg" }, vivisect = { cmd = "vivisect %t", q = "eq" } }, }) -- Anathema: horror stacks, catastrophe slays with two mangled limbs. ar.knight("unnamable", { manual = { horror = { cmd = "unnamable horror %t" }, catastrophe = { cmd = "unnamable catastrophe %t" } }, }) end ar.build_knights()
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Jester: Tarot cards (balance), Pranks. Moon names its affliction.
O.simple("jester", { order = { "aeon", "stupidity", "epilepsy", "confusion", "entangled", "hallucinations", "stuttering", "masochism", "claustrophobia", "agoraphobia", "hypersomnia", "inlove" }, moves = O.merge( O.words("fling moon at %t %a", "bal", nil, { "stupidity", "masochism", "hallucinations", "hypersomnia", "confusion", "epilepsy", "claustrophobia", "agoraphobia" }), { aeon = { cmd = "fling aeon at %t", q = "bal", key = "aeon" }, entangled = { cmd = "fling hangedman at %t", q = "bal", key = "hangedman" }, inlove = { cmd = "fling lovers at %t", q = "bal", key = "lovers" }, stuttering = { cmd = "vent %t", q = "bal", key = "vent" }, }), strip = { any = { cmd = "badjoke", q = "eq", key = "badjoke" } }, fallback = { cmd = "bop %t", q = "bal", key = "bop" }, -- amnesia, stupidity or epilepsy: can't tell which manual = { rub = { cmd = "rub death on %t", q = "eq" }, death = { cmd = "fling death at %t", q = "bal" }, itch = { cmd = "slip %t itchpowder", q = "bal" }, mickey = { cmd = "slip %t mickey", q = "bal" }, liberate = { cmd = "liberate tongue of %t", q = "bal" }, }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Occultist: Occultism instill (eq), Tarot (balance), Domination entities.
O.simple("occultist", { channels = { "eq", "bal" }, order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "slickness", "aeon", "clumsiness", "sensitivity", "darkshade", "healthleech", "stupidity", "epilepsy", "confusion", "disloyalty", "entangled" }, moves = O.merge( O.words("instill %t with %a", "eq", nil, { "asthma", "clumsiness", "healthleech", "sensitivity", "slickness", "paralysis", "darkshade" }), O.words("fling moon at %t %a", "bal", nil, { "stupidity", "epilepsy", "confusion" }), { aeon = { cmd = "fling aeon at %t", q = "bal", key = "aeon" }, entangled = { cmd = "fling hangedman at %t", q = "bal", key = "hangedman" }, disloyalty = { cmd = "devolve %t", q = "eq", key = "devolve", affs = { "disloyalty", "shyness" } }, }), strip = { shield = { cmd = "command gremlin at %t", q = "eq", key = "gremlin" } }, manual = { truename = { cmd = "utter truename %t", q = "eq" }, warp = { cmd = "warp %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Apostate: Evileye stares (balance); Deadeyes gives two at once.
ar.STARE = { deafness = "deaf", clumsiness = "clumsy", dizziness = "dizzy", blindness = "blind", recklessness = "reckless", paralysis = "sicken", voyria = "plague", stupidity = "stupid", nausea = "vomiting", asleep = "sleep" } ar.STARE_PLAIN = { "impatience", "asthma", "anorexia", "weariness", "sensitivity", "addiction", "confusion", "epilepsy", "paranoia", "masochism", "dementia", "agoraphobia", "claustrophobia", "vertigo", "amnesia", "manaleech", "fear", "peace" } O.simple("apostate", { order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "anorexia", "impatience", "clumsiness", "weariness", "stupidity", "sensitivity", "nausea", "addiction", "recklessness", "dizziness", "confusion", "epilepsy" }, moves = O.merge(O.words("stare %t %a", "bal", ar.STARE, ar.STARE_PLAIN)), pair = { cmd = "deadeyes %t %a %a2", q = "bal", key = "deadeyes" }, manual = { daegger = { cmd = "daegger puncture %t" }, strip = { cmd = "demon strip %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Shaman: Curses (balance); Jinx gives two at once. Vodun needs a doll.
ar.CURSE = { deafness = "deaf", clumsiness = "clumsy", dizziness = "dizzy", blindness = "blind", recklessness = "reckless", paralysis = "paralyse", voyria = "plague", stupidity = "stupid", nausea = "vomiting", asleep = "sleep", pacifism = "peace" } ar.CURSE_PLAIN = { "impatience", "asthma", "anorexia", "weariness", "sensitivity", "addiction", "haemophilia", "healthleech", "epilepsy", "paranoia", "masochism", "dementia", "agoraphobia", "claustrophobia", "vertigo", "amnesia", "manaleech", "fear" } O.simple("shaman", { order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "anorexia", "impatience", "clumsiness", "weariness", "stupidity", "sensitivity", "haemophilia", "nausea", "addiction", "healthleech", "recklessness", "dizziness" }, moves = O.words("curse %t %a", "bal", ar.CURSE, ar.CURSE_PLAIN), pair = { cmd = "jinx %a %a2 %t", q = "bal", key = "jinx" }, manual = { tzantza = { cmd = "curse %t tzantza" }, breach = { cmd = "curse %t breach" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Alchemist: Physiology wrack/truewrack (balance) on tempered humours; -- Alchemy educe copper strips shields; Aurify at 60% health AND mana.
ar.HUMOUR = { nausea = "choleric", sensitivity = "choleric", slickness = "choleric", stupidity = "melancholic", anorexia = "melancholic", impatience = "melancholic", clumsiness = "phlegmatic", weariness = "phlegmatic", asthma = "phlegmatic", haemophilia = "sanguine", recklessness = "sanguine", paralysis = "sanguine" } ar.alch_tempered = {} O.simple("alchemist", { order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "anorexia", "slickness", "impatience", "clumsiness", "weariness", "stupidity", "sensitivity", "nausea", "haemophilia", "recklessness" }, moves = O.words("wrack %t %a", "bal", nil, { "nausea", "sensitivity", "slickness", "stupidity", "anorexia", "impatience", "clumsiness", "weariness", "asthma", "haemophilia", "recklessness", "paralysis" }), pair = { cmd = "truewrack %t %a %a2", q = "bal", key = "truewrack" }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "educe copper %t", q = "eq", key = "copper" } }, -- the target's mana isn't visible: aurify is offered at 60% health, it fails harmlessly otherwise kill = { { key = "aurify", cmd = "aurify %t", q = "eq", when = ar.hp_below(60) } }, manual = { reave = { cmd = "reave %t", q = "free" } }, -- temper the humour the wrack needs (humour balance is separate from balance) pre = function(tgt, plan) local aff = plan.affs and plan.affs[1] local h = aff and ar.HUMOUR[aff] if h and acs.now() - (ar.alch_tempered[h] or 0) > 1.8 then ar.send("temper " .. tgt .. " " .. h) ar.alch_tempered[h] = acs.now() end end, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Magi: Elementalism (eq). Destroy kills at 40% health with conflagration.
O.simple("magi", { order = { "clumsiness", "slickness", "nausea", "weariness", "transfixation", "fulminated", "epilepsy", "conflagration", "shivering" }, moves = { clumsiness = { cmd = "cast bombard %t", q = "eq", key = "bombard" }, slickness = { cmd = "cast mudslide at %t", q = "eq", key = "mudslide", affs = { "slickness", "prone" } }, nausea = { cmd = "cast dehydrate at %t", q = "eq", key = "dehydrate", affs = { "nausea", "weariness" } }, weariness = { cmd = "cast dehydrate at %t", q = "eq", key = "dehydrate", affs = { "nausea", "weariness" } }, transfixation = { cmd = "cast transfix at %t", q = "eq", key = "transfix", when = function(e) return not e.has_def("blindness") end }, fulminated = { cmd = "cast fulminate at %t", q = "eq", key = "fulminate" }, epilepsy = { cmd = "cast fulminate at %t", q = "eq", key = "fulminate", when = function(e) return e.has("fulminated") end }, conflagration = { cmd = "cast conflagrate at %t", q = "eq", key = "conflagrate" }, shivering = { cmd = "cast freeze at %t", q = "eq", key = "freeze" }, }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "cast erode at %t shield", q = "eq", key = "erode" } }, kill = { { key = "destroy", cmd = "cast destroy at %t", q = "eq", when = function(e, T) return e.has("conflagration") and T.hp ~= nil and T.hp <= 40 end } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sylvan: Weatherweaving (eq), Propagation thornrend with a venom (eq).
O.simple("sylvan", { order = { "paralysis", "clumsiness", "dizziness", "healthleech", "asthma", "slickness", "anorexia", "impatience", "sensitivity", "transfixation", "weariness", "stupidity" }, moves = { paralysis = { cmd = "cast static at %t", q = "eq", key = "static" }, clumsiness = { cmd = "cast hailstone at %t", q = "eq", key = "hailstone" }, dizziness = { cmd = "cast cyclone at %t", q = "eq", key = "cyclone" }, healthleech = { cmd = "cast razorwind at %t", q = "eq", key = "razorwind" }, sensitivity = { cmd = "cast thunderclap at %t", q = "eq", key = "thunderclap", when = function(e) return not e.has_def("deafness") end }, transfixation = { cmd = "cast flash at %t", q = "eq", key = "flash", when = function(e) return not e.has_def("blindness") end }, }, venom = { cmd = "thornrend %t %v1", q = "eq", key = "thornrend", n = 1 }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "cast shear at %t", q = "eq", key = "shear" } }, manual = { heartseed = { cmd = "heartseed %t", q = "eq" }, bolt = { cmd = "cast bolt at %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Psion: Weaving (balance), Psionics splinter strips shields (eq).
O.simple("psion", { weapon = true, order = { "asthma", "weariness", "clumsiness", "stupidity", "dizziness", "nausea", "prone", "entangled" }, moves = { asthma = { cmd = "weave deathblow %t", q = "bal", key = "deathblow" }, weariness = { cmd = "weave puncture %t", q = "bal", key = "puncture" }, clumsiness = { cmd = "weave sever %t", q = "bal", key = "sever" }, stupidity = { cmd = "weave backhand %t", q = "bal", key = "backhand", affs = { "stupidity", "dizziness" } }, dizziness = { cmd = "weave backhand %t", q = "bal", key = "backhand", affs = { "stupidity", "dizziness" } }, nausea = { cmd = "weave exsanguinate %t", q = "bal", key = "exsanguinate" }, prone = { cmd = "weave overhand %t", q = "bal", key = "overhand", affs = { "prone", "stupidity" } }, entangled = { cmd = "weave entwine %t", q = "bal", key = "entwine", when = function(e) return e.has("prone") end }, }, strip = { any = { cmd = "weave cleave %t", q = "bal", key = "cleave" } }, manual = { deconstruct = { cmd = "weave deconstruct %t" }, excise = { cmd = "psi excise %t", q = "eq" }, unweave = { cmd = "weave unweave %t mind" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Pariah: Memorium logographs (balance).
O.simple("pariah", { order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "impatience", "clumsiness", "weariness", "epilepsy", "haemophilia", "addiction" }, moves = { paralysis = { cmd = "trace serpent %t", q = "bal", key = "serpent" }, asthma = { cmd = "trace jackal %t", q = "bal", key = "jackal" }, impatience = { cmd = "trace skein %t", q = "bal", key = "skein" }, clumsiness = { cmd = "trace scales %t", q = "bal", key = "scales" }, weariness = { cmd = "trace nest %t", q = "bal", key = "nest" }, epilepsy = { cmd = "trace sun %t", q = "bal", key = "sun" }, haemophilia = { cmd = "trace bear %t", q = "bal", key = "bear", affs = { "haemophilia", "bleeding" } }, addiction = { cmd = "trace scarab %t", q = "bal", key = "scarab" }, }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "trace fissure %t", q = "bal", key = "fissure" } }, manual = { scorpion = { cmd = "trace scorpion %t" }, wrack = { cmd = "blood wrack %t" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Priest: Zeal verses (prayer balance) and Spirituality angel (eq).
O.simple("priest", { channels = { "bal", "eq" }, order = { "paralysis", "justice", "guilt", "ablaze", "spiritburn", "tenderskin", "blindness" }, moves = { paralysis = { cmd = "recite penance %t", q = "bal", key = "penance" }, justice = { cmd = "recite condemnation %t", q = "bal", key = "condemnation" }, guilt = { cmd = "recite guilt %t", q = "bal", key = "guilt" }, spiritburn = { cmd = "recite ash %t", q = "bal", key = "ash" }, tenderskin = { cmd = "recite burn %t", q = "bal", key = "burn" }, ablaze = { cmd = "angel sear %t", q = "eq", key = "sear" }, blindness = { cmd = "angel shine %t", q = "eq", key = "shine", when = function(e) return not e.has_def("blindness") end }, }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "angel strip %t", q = "eq", key = "angelstrip" }, rebounding = { cmd = "hunt heresy", q = "eq", key = "heresy" } }, fallback = { cmd = "smite %t", q = "bal", key = "smite" }, manual = { judge = { cmd = "judge %t", q = "eq" }, absolve = { cmd = "angel absolve %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Depthswalker: Shadowmancy reap with a venom, Aeonics aeon.
ar.DW_ORDER = { "aeon" } for _, a in ipairs(LOCK) do ar.DW_ORDER[#ar.DW_ORDER + 1] = a end O.simple("depthswalker", { order = ar.DW_ORDER, moves = { aeon = { cmd = "chrono aeon %t", q = "eq", key = "aeon" } }, venom = { cmd = "shadow reap %t %v1", q = "bal", key = "reap", n = 1, weapon = true }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "shadow strike %t", q = "bal", key = "shadowstrike" } }, manual = { dictate = { cmd = "shadow dictate %t" }, doom = { cmd = "chrono doom %t" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sentinel: Skirmishing spear/trident with venoms.
O.simple("sentinel", { order = LOCK, moves = { impatience = { cmd = "doublestrike %t torso", q = "bal", key = "doublestrike" }, weariness = { cmd = "gouge %t torso", q = "bal", key = "gouge" }, haemophilia = { cmd = "lacerate %t torso", q = "bal", key = "lacerate", affs = { "haemophilia", "bleeding" } }, }, venom = { cmd = "thrust %t torso %v1", q = "bal", key = "thrust", n = 1, weapon = true }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "rive %t", q = "bal", key = "rive" } }, manual = { trip = { cmd = "trip %t left" }, impale = { cmd = "impale %t" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Blademaster: Striking. Effects named from the skill descriptions.
O.simple("blademaster", { weapon = true, order = { "paralysis", "asthma", "anorexia", "clumsiness", "weariness", "stupidity", "blindness", "prone" }, moves = { paralysis = { cmd = "strike %t neck", q = "bal", key = "neck" }, asthma = { cmd = "strike %t throat", q = "bal", key = "throat" }, anorexia = { cmd = "strike %t stomach", q = "bal", key = "stomach" }, clumsiness = { cmd = "strike %t ears", q = "bal", key = "ears" }, weariness = { cmd = "strike %t shoulder", q = "bal", key = "shoulder" }, stupidity = { cmd = "strike %t temple", q = "bal", key = "temple" }, blindness = { cmd = "strike %t eyes", q = "bal", key = "eyes" }, prone = { cmd = "strike %t knees", q = "bal", key = "knees" }, }, strip = { rebounding = { cmd = "flamefist %t", q = "bal", key = "flamefist" } }, manual = { icefist = { cmd = "icefist %t" }, burst = { cmd = "burst %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Monk: Tekura combo (kick, punch, punch); Roundhouse breaks shields.
O.simple("monk", { order = { "impatience", "dizziness" }, moves = { impatience = { cmd = "combo %t sdk pmp blp", q = "bal", key = "combo", affs = { "impatience", "dizziness" } }, dizziness = { cmd = "combo %t sdk blp blp", q = "bal", key = "combo", affs = { "dizziness" } }, }, fallback = { cmd = "combo %t sdk ucp ucp", q = "bal", key = "combo" }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "rhk %t", q = "bal", key = "roundhouse" } }, manual = { sweep = { cmd = "swk %t" }, backbreaker = { cmd = "bbt %t" }, choke = { cmd = "kai choke %t", q = "eq" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Druid: Metamorphosis (basilisk gaze/glare), Reclamation.
O.simple("druid", { order = { "paralysis", "impatience", "stupidity", "confusion" }, moves = { paralysis = { cmd = "gaze %t paralysis", q = "eq", key = "gaze" }, confusion = { cmd = "gaze %t confusion", q = "eq", key = "gaze" }, impatience = { cmd = "glare %t impatience", q = "eq", key = "glare" }, stupidity = { cmd = "glare %t stupidity", q = "eq", key = "glare" }, }, strip = { any = { cmd = "negate %t", q = "eq", key = "negate" } }, manual = { petrify = { cmd = "petrify %t", q = "eq" }, embrace = { cmd = "reclamation embrace %t" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Bard: Bladedance. Jab/highsun effects depend on your position in the -- dance, which AR doesn't track, so this module only strips and attacks.
O.simple("bard", { weapon = true, order = {}, strip = { any = { cmd = "blade punctuate %t", q = "eq", key = "punctuate" } }, fallback = { cmd = "blade highsun %t head", q = "bal", key = "highsun" }, manual = { jab = { cmd = "blade jab %t torso" }, flourish = { cmd = "blade flourish %t" }, endbringer = { cmd = "recite endbringer %t" } }, })
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Dragon: Dragoncraft rend with claw venoms; tailsmash breaks shields.
O.simple("dragon", { order = LOCK, venom = { cmd = "rend %t %v1", q = "bal", key = "rend", n = 1, weapon = true }, strip = { shield = { cmd = "tailsmash %t", q = "bal", key = "tailsmash" }, rebounding = { cmd = "breathstrip %t", q = "bal", key = "breathstrip" } }, manual = { devour = { cmd = "devour %t" }, enmesh = { cmd = "enmesh %t", q = "eq" }, gust = { cmd = "breathgust %t", q = "eq" } }, })

Script.name: attack line helpers
attack lines
Script.script:
-- AR attack lines: runs ar.lines.data (12_lines_data.lua) against the game. -- A line names a victim; if AR is tracking them (anyone you've targeted), -- their record gets the afflictions, defence changes and so on.
