Lines that -- name the attacker also note the attacker's class. -- -- Some lines only mean something right after another one (a generic "X -- lets out a choked gasp" after your jab). Those have win = <opener>: the -- opener's line opens a window that closes at the next prompt. -- -- ar lines how many lines are loaded, per class -- ar lines off <class> ignore a class's lines (on to undo)
ar.lines = ar.lines or {} local L = ar.lines local D = ar.data
L.live = {} -- opener id -> { who = victim name or nil }
function L.is_me(name) if not name or name == "" then return true end local n = name:lower() return n == "you" or n == "yourself" or (acs.me.name and n == acs.me.name:lower()) end
function L.cap(m, i) return i and m[i + 1] or nil end
-- Whoever the opener's line named, while its window is open. function L.window_who(win) local w = win and L.live[win] return w and w.who or nil end
function L.victim(e, m) if e.v == "target" then return L.window_who(e.win) or ar.target.name end if e.v == "window" then return L.window_who(e.win) end return L.cap(m, e.v) end
-- Tracked people only, plus your target (who gets a record on sight). function L.record_for(name) if L.is_me(name) then return nil end return ar.person(name) or (ar.is_target(name) and ar.person(name, true)) or nil end
function L.off(cls) return cls and (ar.settings.lines_off or {})[cls] end
-- The start of every attack line: nil unless the line counts (its class -- isn't switched off, its opener's window is open) and the victim is -- someone AR is tracking; notes the attacker's class on the way. function L.start(cls, who, win, by) if L.off(cls) then return end if win and not L.live[win] then return end if by and cls and not L.is_me(by) and ar.classes then ar.classes.seen(by, cls) end return L.record_for(who) end
function L.fire(e, m) local p = L.start(e[1], L.victim(e, m), e.win, e.by and L.cap(m, e.by)) if not p then return end if e.mine then ar.hits.calling(p, function() L.apply(p, e, m) end) else L.apply(p, e, m) end end
-- An affliction that wears off by itself after sec seconds (unless it was -- cured and given again in between). function L.wears_off(p, aff, sec) local at = p.affs[D.canon(aff)] ar.M.timer(sec, function() if p.affs[D.canon(aff)] == at then p:cure(aff) end end) end
function L.apply(p, e, m) for _, d in ipairs(e.strip or {}) do p:def_down(d) end for _, d in ipairs(e.up or {}) do p:def_up(d) end for _, a in ipairs(e.bt or {}) do p:backtrack(a) end for _, a in ipairs(e.cure or {}) do p:cure(a) end for _, a in ipairs(e.give or {}) do p:give(a) end if e.pick then for _, a in ipairs(e.pick) do if not p:has(a) then p:give(a) break end end end if e.cond then local has = false for _, a in ipairs(e.cond.has) do if p:has(a) then has = true end end for _, a in ipairs(has and e.cond.give or e.cond.alt) do p:give(a) end end if e.venomcap and m then p:venom(L.cap(m, e.venomcap)) end if e.affcap and m then p:give(L.cap(m, e.affcap)) end for aff, sec in pairs(e.dur or {}) do L.wears_off(p, aff, sec) end if e.fn then e.fn(p, m) end if e.dead then p:reset() end end
function L.on_prompt() if next(L.live) then L.live = {} end end
function L.pats(x) return type(x) == "table" and x or { x } end
function L.install() L.live = {} for id, o in pairs(L.openers or {}) do for _, pat in ipairs(L.pats(o[2])) do ar.M.trigger(pat, function(m) if L.off(o[1]) then return end L.live[id] = { who = (o.v and o.v > 0) and L.cap(m, o.v) or nil } end) end end for _, e in ipairs(L.data or {}) do for _, pat in ipairs(L.pats(e[2])) do ar.M.trigger(pat, function(m) L.fire(e, m) end) end end end
-- In the Achaea bundle the lines are trigger items (Triggers / Achaea / AR / -- attack lines) and L.data isn't loaded; the bundle leaves L.index, one -- { class } per line, for counting. function L.counts() local by, n = {}, 0 local list = (L.data and #L.data > 0) and L.data or L.index or {} for _, e in ipairs(list) do local c = e[1] or "anyone" by[c] = (by[c] or 0) + 1 n = n + 1 end return n, by end
function L.install_commands() ar.M.command("lines", function(w) local sub, cls = w[1], w[2] and acs.norm(w[2]) if (sub == "off" or sub == "on") and cls then ar.settings.lines_off = ar.settings.lines_off or {} ar.settings.lines_off[cls] = (sub == "off") or nil ar.save() ar.echo(("%s lines %s"):format(cls, sub)) return end local n, by = L.counts() ar.echo(("%d attack lines loaded:"):format(n)) for _, c in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(by)) do ar.echo((" %-14s %3d%s"):format(c, by[c], L.off(c) and " (off)" or "")) end end, "attack lines per class; ar lines off|on <class>") end

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- AR startup: (re)registers everything. Safe to run again.
function ar.init() ar._ready = false ar.M = acs.module("ar", { prefix = "ar" }) -- removes whatever AR registered before ar.M.title = "AR offense" local M = ar.M local T = ar.target
ar.install_commands() ar.classes.install_commands() ar.classes.install() ar.install_style_command() ar.watch.install() ar.hits.install() ar.lines.install() ar.lines.install_commands()
M.on("gmcp.IRE.Target.Set", T.on_target_set) M.on("gmcp.IRE.Target.Info", T.on_target_info) M.on("gmcp.Room.Players", T.on_room_players) M.on("gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", T.on_add_player) M.on("gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer", T.on_remove_player) M.on("acs.class.changed", function(_, new, old) ar.offense.activate(old) end) M.on("acs.char.loaded", function() if ar.settings.target then T.set(ar.settings.target, true) end ar.build_knights() -- per-character weapon styles end) acs.gmcp_support({ "Char 1", "Room 1", "IRE.Target 1" })
M.alias([[^t\s+(\S+)$]], function(m) T.set(m[2]) end) M.alias([[^tc$]], function() T.clear() end) M.alias([[^k(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function(m) ar.offense.attack(m[2]) end)
ar._ready = true ar.offense.activate() if ar.settings.target and not ar.enemy.name then T.set(ar.settings.target, true) end ar.echo(("loaded v%s. <white>t <name><reset> to target, <white>k<reset> to attack, <white>ar help<reset> for more.") :format(ar.version)) end ar.reinstall = ar.init
ar.init()

Script.name: room tracker
Script.script:
-- RM: room tracker for Achaea (Mudlet). Built on the shared ACS core -- (00_acs_core.lua), so it installs side by side with ss, ar, bs, pt, in. -- -- The global `rm` is this package's acs.module registry, so rm.on, -- rm.trigger, rm.timer and rm.command come from the core, and the "rm" -- alias is set up by it.
rm = acs.module("rm", { prefix = "room", tag = "rm" }) rm.title = "RM room tracker" rm.version = "0.1.0"
rm.default_settings = { echo = false, -- print a one-line summary after each move ui = false, -- room window history_size = 50, city_areas = {}, -- area name (lowercase) -> city, or "none"; see rm.area_city } rm.settings = acs.store("rm", rm.default_settings)
-- "room ..." is shared with the mapper's own "room mark", "room find", -- "room look" etc. Mudlet runs every alias that matches, so a word that -- isn't one of RM's commands is left to the mapper without an error. local core_run = rm.run function rm.run(line) local word = (tostring(line):match("^%s*(%S+)") or "help"):lower() if word ~= "help" and not rm.commands[word] then return end return core_run(line) end
function rm.save_settings() acs.save("rm") end function rm.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "rm") end function rm.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "rm") end function rm.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "rm") end function rm.send(cmd) acs.send(cmd) end function rm.now() return acs.now() end function rm.myname() return acs.me.name end
-- Raise a Mudlet event other packages can listen to. function rm.raise(event, ...) rm.debug("event " .. event) raiseEvent(event, ...) end

Script.name: room state
Script.script:
-- RM room state: Room.Info, players present, movement history. -- -- Public state (read it, don't write it): -- rm.room current room: num, name, area, environment, coords, map, desc, -- exits (dir -> room number), details (set: indoors, shop, bank...) -- rm.prev the room before this one (same shape), or nil -- rm.players name -> fullname of other players here (you're left out) -- rm.history recent room numbers, newest first -- -- Events (all are normal Mudlet events; register with -- registerAnonymousEventHandler): -- rm.moved (num, prev_num) you entered a different room -- rm.area (area, prev_area) you entered a different area -- rm.info (num) Room.Info arrived (moved or not) -- rm.player.entered (name, fullname) -- rm.player.left (name) -- rm.players.changed () -- rm.wrongdir (dir) Room.WrongDir: no exit that way
rm.room = rm.room or { num = 0, name = "", area = "", exits = {}, details = {} } rm.players = rm.players or {} rm.history = rm.history or {} rm.dir_order = { "n", "ne", "e", "se", "s", "sw", "w", "nw", "u", "d", "in", "out" } rm.dir_long = { n = "north", ne = "northeast", e = "east", se = "southeast", s = "south", sw = "southwest", w = "west", nw = "northwest", u = "up", d = "down", ["in"] = "in", out = "out", } rm.dir_short = {} for k, v in pairs(rm.dir_long) do rm.dir_short[v] = k rm.dir_short[k] = k end
-- A Room.Players / Char.Items list this recent is assumed to belong to the -- room that a Room.Info is about to announce, so a move doesn't wipe it. rm.LIST_GRACE = 0.25 rm._players_at = rm._players_at or 0
function rm.parse_details(d) local r = {} for _, v in ipairs(d or {}) do r[tostring(v):lower()] = true end return r end
function rm.on_room_info() local info = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not info then return end local num = tonumber(info.num) or 0 local exits = {} for dir, to in pairs(info.exits or {}) do exits[dir] = tonumber(to) or to end local room = { num = num, name = info.name or "", area = info.area or "", environment = info.environment or "", coords = info.coords or "", desc = info.desc or "", map = info.map or "", exits = exits, details = rm.parse_details(info.details), arrived = (rm.room.num == num and rm.room.arrived) or rm.now(), } local moved = num ~= rm.room.num if moved then rm.prev = rm.room.num ~= 0 and rm.room or rm.prev rm.room = room table.insert(rm.history, 1, num) while #rm.history > (rm.settings.history_size or 50) do table.remove(rm.history) end if rm.now() - rm._players_at > rm.LIST_GRACE then rm.set_players({}) end rm.items_moved() local prev_num = rm.prev and rm.prev.num or 0 rm.raise("rm.moved", num, prev_num) local prev_area = rm.prev and rm.prev.area or "" if room.area ~= prev_area then rm.raise("rm.area", room.area, prev_area) end rm.map_moved() if rm.settings.echo then rm.summary() end else rm.room = room end rm.raise("rm.info", num) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Players
function rm.is_me(name) local me = rm.myname() return me and name and me:lower() == name:lower() end
-- Replace the whole player list, raising entered/left for the difference. function rm.set_players(new) local old = rm.players rm.players = new for name in pairs(old) do if not new[name] then rm.raise("rm.player.left", name) end end for name, full in pairs(new) do if not old[name] then rm.raise("rm.player.entered", name, full) end end rm.raise("rm.players.changed") end
function rm.on_room_players() local list = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players or {} local new = {} for _, p in ipairs(list) do if p.name and not rm.is_me(p.name) then new[p.name] = p.fullname or p.name end end rm._players_at = rm.now() rm.set_players(new) end
function rm.on_add_player() local p = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.AddPlayer if type(p) ~= "table" or not p.name or rm.is_me(p.name) then return end local was = rm.players[p.name] rm.players[p.name] = p.fullname or p.name if not was then rm.raise("rm.player.entered", p.name, rm.players[p.name]) end rm.raise("rm.players.changed") end
function rm.on_remove_player() local p = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer local name = type(p) == "table" and (p.name or p[1]) or p if type(name) ~= "string" or not rm.players[name] then return end rm.players[name] = nil rm.raise("rm.player.left", name) rm.raise("rm.players.changed") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Queries other packages can call
function rm.here() return rm.room.num end
-- Sorted list of other players here. function rm.player_list() return acs.sorted_keys(rm.players) end
function rm.has_player(name) if not name then return false end name = name:lower() for n in pairs(rm.players) do if n:lower() == name then return true end end return false end
-- Exits in compass order: { {dir="n", to=1234}, ... } function rm.exit_list(room) room = room or rm.room local r, seen = {}, {} for _, d in ipairs(rm.dir_order) do if room.exits[d] then r[#r + 1] = { dir = d, to = room.exits[d] } seen[d] = true end end for _, d in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(room.exits)) do if not seen[d] then r[#r + 1] = { dir = d, to = room.exits[d] } end end return r end
function rm.has_exit(dir) dir = rm.dir_short[dir] or dir return rm.room.exits[dir] ~= nil end
-- Direction from here that leads to room num, if there is one. function rm.dir_to(num) num = tonumber(num) for dir, to in pairs(rm.room.exits) do if to == num then return dir end end end
-- The direction you came from (back the way you came), if it's an exit here. function rm.back_dir() return rm.prev and rm.dir_to(rm.prev.num) end
function rm.on_wrongdir() local dir = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.WrongDir if type(dir) == "table" then dir = dir[1] end rm.raise("rm.wrongdir", dir) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Which city an area belongs to (for auto-follow and anything else that -- cares about enemy ground). The mapper has no city data, so this is the -- city name appearing in the area name ("Mhaldor", "the City of Ashtan"), -- plus areas you've tagged with "room city" (defendable areas around a -- city, or anything whose name doesn't say).
rm.cities = { "ashtan", "cyrene", "eleusis", "hashan", "mhaldor", "targossas" }
-- City name (lowercase) for an area, or nil. Defaults to this room's area. function rm.area_city(area) area = tostring(area or rm.room.area or ""):lower() if area == "" then return nil end local tagged = rm.settings.city_areas[area] if tagged then return tagged ~= "none" and tagged or nil end for _, c in ipairs(rm.cities) do if area:find(c, 1, true) then return c end end end
-- Tag an area as part of a city's ground ("none" to say it isn't). function rm.set_area_city(area, city) area = tostring(area):lower() city = city and tostring(city):lower() or nil rm.settings.city_areas[area] = city rm.save_settings() end

Script.name: items
Script.script:
-- RM room items and denizens, from GMCP Char.Items (location "room"). -- Your inventory is left to the inventory package (in). -- -- Public state: -- rm.items id -> { id, name, icon, attrib, seq } everything in the room -- -- attrib letters Achaea uses: m = monster/denizen, d = dead, x = shouldn't be -- attacked, t = takeable, c = container, g = groupable, w = wearable. -- -- Events: -- rm.items.changed () -- rm.denizen.added (id, name) -- rm.denizen.removed (id, name) -- rm.item.added (id, name) anything, denizens included -- rm.item.removed (id, name)
rm.items = rm.items or {} rm._items_at = rm._items_at or 0 rm._seq = rm._seq or 0
function rm.has(item, letter) return (item.attrib or ""):find(letter, 1, true) ~= nil end
function rm.is_denizen(item) return item ~= nil and rm.has(item, "m") and not rm.has(item, "d") end
function rm.make(it) rm._seq = rm._seq + 1 return { id = tostring(it.id), name = it.name or "", icon = it.icon, attrib = it.attrib or "", seq = rm._seq } end
function rm.added(item) rm.raise("rm.item.added", item.id, item.name) if rm.is_denizen(item) then rm.raise("rm.denizen.added", item.id, item.name) end end
function rm.removed(item) rm.raise("rm.item.removed", item.id, item.name) if rm.is_denizen(item) then rm.raise("rm.denizen.removed", item.id, item.name) end end
function rm.for_room(data) return type(data) == "table" and data.location == "room" end
function rm.on_items_list() local data = gmcp.Char.Items.List if not rm.for_room(data) then return end local old = rm.items rm.items = {} for _, it in ipairs(data.items or {}) do local id = tostring(it.id) local item = old[id] or rm.make(it) item.name, item.attrib, item.icon = it.name or item.name, it.attrib or "", it.icon rm.items[id] = item if not old[id] then rm.added(item) end end for id, item in pairs(old) do if not rm.items[id] then rm.removed(item) end end rm._items_at = rm.now() rm.raise("rm.items.changed") end
function rm.on_items_add() local data = gmcp.Char.Items.Add if not rm.for_room(data) or not data.item then return end local item = rm.make(data.item) local was = rm.items[item.id] rm.items[item.id] = item if was then item.seq = was.seq else rm.added(item) end rm.raise("rm.items.changed") end
function rm.on_items_remove() local data = gmcp.Char.Items.Remove if not rm.for_room(data) then return end local id = type(data.item) == "table" and data.item.id or data.item id = id and tostring(id) local item = id and rm.items[id] if not item then return end rm.items[id] = nil rm.removed(item) rm.raise("rm.items.changed") end
function rm.on_items_update() local data = gmcp.Char.Items.Update if not rm.for_room(data) or not data.item then return end local id = tostring(data.item.id) local item = rm.items[id] if not item then return rm.on_items_add_item(data.item) end local was = rm.is_denizen(item) item.name = data.item.name or item.name item.attrib = data.item.attrib or "" local now = rm.is_denizen(item) if was and not now then rm.raise("rm.denizen.removed", id, item.name) end if now and not was then rm.raise("rm.denizen.added", id, item.name) end rm.raise("rm.items.changed") end
function rm.on_items_add_item(it) gmcp.Char.Items.Add = { location = "room", item = it } rm.on_items_add() end
-- Called by the room code when you move. Clears the old room's items unless -- a list for the new room already arrived, and asks for one if none comes. function rm.items_moved() local moved_at = rm.now() if moved_at - rm._items_at > rm.LIST_GRACE then rm.items = {} rm.raise("rm.items.changed") end rm.timer(0.5, function() if rm._items_at < moved_at - rm.LIST_GRACE then rm.request_items() end end) end
function rm.request_items() sendGMCP("Char.Items.Room") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Queries (for bashing and anything else)
function rm.sorted(filter) local r = {} for _, item in pairs(rm.items) do if filter(item) then r[#r + 1] = item end end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.seq < b.seq end) return r end
-- Denizens here, in the order they appeared. Skips ones marked "x" -- (shouldn't be attacked) unless include_protected is true. function rm.denizens(include_protected) return rm.sorted(function(i) return rm.is_denizen(i) and (include_protected or not rm.has(i, "x")) end) end
-- Non-denizen items here, in the order they appeared. function rm.item_list() return rm.sorted(function(i) return not rm.is_denizen(i) end) end
function rm.matches_name(item, pat) local name = item.name:lower() pat = pat:lower() return name == pat or name:find(pat, 1, true) ~= nil end
-- First denizen matching any name in `names` (plain substrings, checked in -- list order, so put the ones you want first). Returns the item or nil. function rm.find_denizen(names) if type(names) == "string" then names = { names } end local list = rm.denizens() for _, pat in ipairs(names or {}) do for _, item in ipairs(list) do if rm.matches_name(item, pat) then return item end end end end
function rm.count_denizens(name) local n = 0 for _, item in ipairs(rm.denizens()) do if not name or rm.matches_name(item, name) then n = n + 1 end end return n end
function rm.find_item(name) for _, item in ipairs(rm.sorted(function() return true end)) do if rm.matches_name(item, name) or item.id == tostring(name) then return item end end end
-- Group names with counts: { {name="a rat", n=2, ids={...}}, ... } function rm.grouped(list) local r, by = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(list) do local g = by[item.name] if not g then g = { name = item.name, n = 0, ids = {} } by[item.name] = g r[#r + 1] = g end g.n = g.n + 1 g.ids[#g.ids + 1] = item.id end return r end

Script.name: map
Script.script:
-- RM and the IRE mapping script (mmp, "Mudlet Mapper"). -- -- The mapper owns the map, walking (goto, mstop, mpp), room marks -- (room mark/marks/unmark), room search (rf / room find), room look (rl) -- and centring the map. RM doesn't duplicate any of that: it gives the -- other packages one small API over it, and turns the mapper's own events -- into rm.walk.* so they only listen in one place. -- -- Events: -- rm.walk.start (dest) rm.walk.arrived (dest) -- rm.walk.stop (dest, reason) reason: "no path" | "stopped"
rm.walk = rm.walk or {} local W = rm.walk
function rm.mapper() return type(mmp) == "table" and type(mmp.gotoRoom) == "function" end
-- Walk to a room number, or anything the mapper's goto takes (a mark, -- an area, a feature). dash: nil | "sprint" | "dash" | "gallop". function rm.go_to(dest, dash) if not rm.mapper() then return rm.err("the IRE mapping script isn't loaded") end if dest == nil or dest == "" then return rm.err("go_to: where?") end local num = tonumber(dest) W.dest = num or dest rm.raise("rm.walk.start", W.dest) if num then return mmp.gotoRoom(num, dash) end expandAlias("goto " .. tostring(dest) .. (dash and (" " .. dash) or ""), false) end
function rm.stop() if rm.mapper() and type(mmp.stop) == "function" and mmp.autowalking then mmp.stop() end end
-- { dest, steps_left } while the mapper is walking, else nil. function rm.walking() if not (rm.mapper() and mmp.autowalking) then return nil end local path, dirs = mmp.speedWalkPath or {}, mmp.speedWalkDir or {} return { dest = tonumber(path[#path]) or W.dest, steps_left = math.max(0, #dirs - math.max(1, mmp.speedWalkCounter or 1) + 1), } end
-- Path from here (or `from`) to a room: dirs, rooms; or nil and why. function rm.path_to(to, from) to, from = tonumber(to), tonumber(from) or rm.room.num if not to then return nil, "need a room number" end if to == from then return {}, {} end local ok if rm.mapper() and mmp.getPath then ok = mmp.getPath(from, to) elseif getPath then ok = getPath(from, to) else return nil, "no map loaded" end if not ok then return nil, "no known path to " .. to end local dirs, rooms = {}, {} for i, d in ipairs(speedWalkDir or {}) do dirs[i] = d rooms[i] = tonumber((speedWalkPath or {})[i]) end return dirs, rooms end
-- The mapper's room marks: name -> room number (public and private). function rm.marks() local r = {} if rm.mapper() and mmp.getAllRoomMarks then for _, m in ipairs(mmp.getAllRoomMarks()) do r[m.name] = tonumber(m.location) end end return r end
-- Name of a room from the map, if it's mapped. function rm.room_name(num) if num == rm.room.num then return rm.room.name end if getRoomName and roomExists and roomExists(num) then return getRoomName(num) end end
-- Called on every move by the room code. Nothing to do: the mapper centres -- the map and steps the walk itself. Kept as the hook point for later. function rm.map_moved() end
function rm.on_mapper_arrived() local dest = W.dest or rm.room.num W.dest = nil rm.raise("rm.walk.arrived", dest) end
function rm.on_mapper_failed(event) local dest = W.dest W.dest = nil rm.raise("rm.walk.stop", dest, event == "mmapper failed path" and "no path" or "stopped") end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- RM commands: "room <command>" (not "rm", which is a game command). "room help" lists them. -- Walking, marks, room search and room look are the mapper's: goto, mstop, -- room mark/marks/unmark, rf, rl. Don't add a command with one of the -- mapper's "room" words (mark, unmark, marks, find, look, list, label, -- create, link, delete, unlink, area, coords): both would run.
function rm.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
function rm.exits_text() local r = {} for _, e in ipairs(rm.exit_list()) do r[#r + 1] = e.dir end return #r > 0 and table.concat(r, " ") or "none" end
function rm.group_text(list, color) local r = {} for _, g in ipairs(rm.grouped(list)) do r[#r + 1] = color .. g.name .. (g.n > 1 and ("<dim_grey> x" .. g.n) or "") .. "<reset>" end return #r > 0 and table.concat(r, ", ") or "<dim_grey>none" end
-- One line after a move (rm echo on), and the top of "rm". function rm.summary() local players = rm.player_list() rm.echo(("<white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>(%d, %s)<reset> exits: <cyan>%s<reset> mobs: %s players: %s"):format( rm.room.name, rm.room.num, rm.room.area, rm.exits_text(), rm.group_text(rm.denizens(true), "<orange>"), #players > 0 and ("<yellow>" .. table.concat(players, ", ")) or "<dim_grey>none")) end
rm.command("status", function() local r = rm.room rm.echo(("<white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>#%d"):format(r.name, r.num)) cecho(("\n area <white>%s<reset>, %s, coords %s"):format(r.area, r.environment, r.coords)) local d = acs.sorted_keys(r.details) if #d > 0 then cecho("\n details: " .. table.concat(d, ", ")) end cecho("\n exits: <cyan>" .. rm.exits_text()) cecho("\n denizens: " .. rm.group_text(rm.denizens(true), "<orange>")) cecho("\n items: " .. rm.group_text(rm.item_list(), "<light_grey>")) local p = rm.player_list() cecho("\n players: " .. (#p > 0 and ("<yellow>" .. table.concat(p, ", ")) or "<dim_grey>none")) local w = rm.walking() if w then cecho(("\n walking to <white>%s<reset>, %d step%s left"):format(tostring(w.dest), w.steps_left, w.steps_left == 1 and "" or "s")) end end, "status this room: exits, denizens, items, players")
rm.command("mobs", function() local list = rm.denizens(true) rm.echo(#list .. " denizen" .. (#list == 1 and "" or "s")) for _, i in ipairs(list) do local flag = i.attrib:find("x", 1, true) and " <dim_grey>(don't attack)" or "" cecho(("\n <dim_grey>%-8s<reset> <orange>%s%s"):format(i.id, i.name, flag)) end end, "mobs denizens here with ids")
rm.command("items", function() local list = rm.item_list() rm.echo(#list .. " item" .. (#list == 1 and "" or "s") .. " (click get/skip to set auto-pickup)") for _, i in ipairs(list) do local act = rm.pickup_decide(i) cecho(("\n <dim_grey>%-8s<reset> %s <dim_grey>%s "):format(i.id, i.name, i.attrib)) if cechoLink then local name = i.name cechoLink(act == "get" and "<green>[get]" or "<dim_grey>[get]", function() rm.pk.answer(name, "get") end, "always pick up " .. name, true) cechoLink(act == "skip" and "<red>[skip]" or "<dim_grey>[skip]", function() rm.pk.answer(name, "skip") end, "never pick up " .. name, true) else cecho(act and ("[" .. act .. "]") or "") end end end, "items items on the ground with ids; click get/skip for auto-pickup")
rm.command("players", function() local p = rm.player_list() rm.echo(#p .. " other player" .. (#p == 1 and "" or "s") .. " here") for _, n in ipairs(p) do cecho("\n <yellow>" .. rm.players[n]) end end, "players other players here")
rm.command("hist", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) or 10 rm.echo("last rooms, newest first") for i = 1, math.min(n, #rm.history) do local num = rm.history[i] cecho(("\n %2d. %-7d %s"):format(i, num, rm.room_name(num) or "")) end end, "hist [n] recent rooms")
rm.command("city", function(w, rest) local area = rm.room.area local city = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not city then return rm.echo(("<white>%s<reset>: %s"):format(area, rm.area_city(area) or "<dim_grey>no city")) end if city == "clear" then rm.set_area_city(area, nil) else rm.set_area_city(area, city) end rm.echo(("<white>%s<reset> is now %s"):format(area, rm.area_city(area) or "no city's ground")) end, { "city which city this area belongs to", "city NAME|none|clear tag this area as NAME's ground (e.g. a defendable area), not a city's, or back to the default" })
rm.command("cities", function() rm.echo("areas you've tagged") for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(rm.settings.city_areas)) do cecho(("\n %-30s %s"):format(a, rm.settings.city_areas[a])) end end, "cities list areas you've tagged with room city")
rm.command("refresh", function() rm.request_items() rm.echo("asked the game for the room's items") end, "refresh re-request the room item list")
rm.command("echo", function(w) rm.settings.echo = rm.onoff(w[1], rm.settings.echo) rm.save_settings() rm.echo("summary after each move " .. (rm.settings.echo and "on" or "off")) end, "echo on|off one-line summary after each move")
rm.command("ui", function(w) rm.settings.ui = rm.onoff(w[1], rm.settings.ui) rm.save_settings() rm.ui.toggle(rm.settings.ui) end, "ui on|off room window")

Script.name: room window
Script.script:
-- RM room window: room, exits, denizens, items, players. "room ui" toggles it.
rm.ui = rm.ui or {} local U = rm.ui
function U.create() if U.box or not Geyser then return end U.box = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "rm_ui", x = "-26%", y = "67%", width = "25%", height = "30%", fontSize = 9, color = "black", autoWrap = true, }) end
function U.toggle(on) if on then U.create() if U.box then U.box:show() U.refresh() end elseif U.box then U.box:hide() end end
function U.line(text) U.box:cecho(text .. "\n") end
function U.refresh() if not rm.settings.ui or not U.box then return end U.box:clear() local r = rm.room U.line(("<white>%s<reset> <dim_grey>#%d"):format(r.name, r.num)) U.line(("<dim_grey>%s, %s"):format(r.area, r.environment)) local ex = {} for _, e in ipairs(rm.exit_list()) do ex[#ex + 1] = e.dir end U.line("<cyan>" .. (#ex > 0 and table.concat(ex, " ") or "no exits")) U.line("") local p = rm.player_list() if #p > 0 then U.line("<white>Players") for _, n in ipairs(p) do U.line(" <yellow>" .. n) end end local mobs = rm.grouped(rm.denizens(true)) if #mobs > 0 then U.line("<white>Denizens") for _, g in ipairs(mobs) do U.line((" <orange>%s%s"):format(g.name, g.n > 1 and (" <dim_grey>x" .. g.n) or "")) end end local items = rm.grouped(rm.item_list()) if #items > 0 then U.line("<white>Items") for _, g in ipairs(items) do U.line((" <light_grey>%s%s"):format(g.name, g.n > 1 and (" <dim_grey>x" .. g.n) or "")) end end end
-- With the heartbeat package (hb) loaded, the window redraws on the beat -- after room, item or player changes; without it, a short timer does it. function U.hb_register() if not hb then return end hb.register("rm.ui", function() U.refresh() end, { owner = "rm", priority = 85, watch = { "room", "items", "players" } }) end
U._pending = false function U.queue_refresh() if hb then return hb.mark("room") end if U._pending or not rm.settings.ui then return end U._pending = true tempTimer(0.2, function() U._pending = false U.refresh() end) end

Script.name: auto-pickup
Script.script:
-- RM auto-pickup: picks up room items you've said yes to (gold and corpses -- by default) and asks about anything new with clickable [always] [never] -- links. Your answers are saved in one file for all your characters: -- <Mudlet home>/acs_pickup.lua. -- -- Bashing (bs) and inventory (IN autogold) leave picking up to this when -- RM is loaded and pickup is on, so nothing is grabbed twice. -- -- Public: -- rm.pickup_on() true when auto-pickup is running -- rm.pickup_decide(item) "get" | "skip" | nil (not decided yet) -- rm.pickup_set(name, act) save a decision for an item name ("get", "skip", nil) -- rm.pickup_now() pick up everything here that's a "get" -- Events: -- rm.pickup.sent (id, name)
rm.pk = rm.pk or {} local P = rm.pk
P.defaults = { on = true, ask = true, -- offer [always] [never] for new takeable items names = {}, -- exact item name (lowercase) -> "get" | "skip" patterns = { -- text in the name -> "get" | "skip"; names win over these { text = "sovereign", act = "get" }, { text = "corpse", act = "get" }, }, }
P.asked = P.asked or {} -- names offered this session (asked once each) P.tried = P.tried or {} -- ids we sent "get" for P.waiting = P.waiting or {} -- ids to get once we have balance and equilibrium
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The saved table (shared by every character)
function P.path() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/acs_pickup.lua" end
function P.load() local t = {} local f = io.open(P.path(), "r") if f then f:close() if not pcall(table.load, P.path(), t) then rm.err("could not read " .. P.path()) t = {} end end P.data = acs.merge_defaults(t, P.defaults) end
function P.save() local ok, err = pcall(table.save, P.path(), P.data) if not ok then rm.err("could not save pickup list: " .. tostring(err)) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Deciding
local function takeable(item) return item and not rm.is_denizen(item) and (rm.has(item, "t") or item.icon == "coin") end
function rm.pickup_on() return P.data ~= nil and P.data.on end
function rm.pickup_decide(item) local name = item.name:lower() local act = P.data.names[name] if act then return act end for _, p in ipairs(P.data.patterns) do if name:find(p.text:lower(), 1, true) then return p.act end end -- what you told bashing to pick up ("bs pickup add") counts too for _, t in ipairs(bs and bs.settings and bs.settings.pickup or {}) do if name:find(tostring(t):lower(), 1, true) then return "get" end end end
function rm.pickup_set(name, act) P.data.names[name:lower()] = act P.save() end
-- Clickable offer in the main window. Without cechoLink it's a plain line -- telling you the command. function P.offer(item) local name = item.name P.asked[name:lower()] = true rm.echo("<white>" .. name .. "<reset> here. Pick these up? ") if not cechoLink then return cecho(("<dim_grey>(room pickup always %s / room pickup never %s)"):format(name, name)) end cechoLink("<green>[always]", function() P.answer(name, "get") end, "always pick up " .. name, true) cecho(" ") cechoLink("<red>[never]", function() P.answer(name, "skip") end, "never pick up " .. name, true) end
function P.answer(name, act) rm.pickup_set(name, act) rm.echo(("%s <white>%s<reset> from now on"):format(act == "get" and "<green>picking up" or "<red>leaving", name)) if act == "get" then rm.pickup_now() end end
-- An item appeared on the ground (or was here when you arrived). function P.consider(item) if not (rm.pickup_on() and takeable(item)) or P.tried[item.id] then return end local act = rm.pickup_decide(item) if act == "get" then P.waiting[#P.waiting + 1] = item.id P.drain() elseif act == nil and P.data.ask and not P.asked[item.name:lower()] then P.offer(item) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sending: "get" needs balance and equilibrium, so wait for them.
local function ready() local v = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if not v then return true end return tostring(v.bal) == "1" and tostring(v.eq) == "1" end
function P.drain() if #P.waiting == 0 or not ready() then return end local list = P.waiting P.waiting = {} for _, id in ipairs(list) do local item = rm.items[id] if item and not P.tried[id] then P.tried[id] = true rm.send("get " .. id) rm.raise("rm.pickup.sent", id, item.name) end end end
function rm.pickup_now() local n = 0 for _, item in ipairs(rm.item_list()) do if takeable(item) and not P.tried[item.id] and rm.pickup_decide(item) == "get" then P.waiting[#P.waiting + 1] = item.id n = n + 1 end end P.drain() return n end
function P.on_item_added(_, id) P.consider(rm.items[id]) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Commands
function P.show_list() rm.echo(("auto-pickup %s, asking about new items %s"):format( P.data.on and "<green>on<reset>" or "<red>off<reset>", P.data.ask and "on" or "off")) cecho("\n <white>by text in the name") for _, p in ipairs(P.data.patterns) do cecho(("\n %s %s"):format(p.act == "get" and "<green>get " or "<red>skip", p.text)) end cecho("\n <white>by item name") for _, n in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(P.data.names)) do cecho(("\n %s %s"):format(P.data.names[n] == "get" and "<green>get " or "<red>skip", n)) end end
function P.set_pattern(text, act) text = text:lower() for i, p in ipairs(P.data.patterns) do if p.text == text then if act then p.act = act else table.remove(P.data.patterns, i) end return P.save() end end if act then P.data.patterns[#P.data.patterns + 1] = { text = text, act = act } end P.save() end
rm.command("pickup", function(w, rest) local sub = (w[1] or ""):lower() local arg = (rest or ""):match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if sub == "" or sub == "list" then return P.show_list() end if sub == "on" or sub == "off" then P.data.on = sub == "on" P.save() return rm.echo("auto-pickup " .. sub) end if sub == "ask" then P.data.ask = rm.onoff(w[2], P.data.ask) P.save() return rm.echo("asking about new items " .. (P.data.ask and "on" or "off")) end if sub == "now" then return rm.echo(rm.pickup_now() .. " to pick up") end if not arg then return rm.err("room pickup " .. sub .. " TEXT") end if sub == "always" then rm.pickup_set(arg, "get") return rm.echo("always picking up " .. arg) end if sub == "never" then rm.pickup_set(arg, "skip") return rm.echo("never picking up " .. arg) end if sub == "forget" then rm.pickup_set(arg, nil) P.set_pattern(arg, nil) return rm.echo("forgot " .. arg) end if sub == "add" then P.set_pattern(arg, "get") return rm.echo("picking up anything with '" .. arg .. "'") end if sub == "skip" then P.set_pattern(arg, "skip") return rm.echo("leaving anything with '" .. arg .. "'") end rm.err("room pickup [on|off|now|ask on|off|always NAME|never NAME|add TEXT|skip TEXT|forget NAME|TEXT]") end, { "pickup what gets picked up, and whether it's on", "pickup on|off auto-pickup", "pickup now pick up everything here that's on the list", "pickup always NAME always pick up this item (exact name)", "pickup never NAME never pick it up, and stop asking", "pickup add TEXT pick up anything with TEXT in its name", "pickup skip TEXT leave anything with TEXT in its name", "pickup forget NAME|TEXT drop a saved rule", "pickup ask on|off offer [always] [never] for new items", })
function P.init() P.load() rm.on("rm.item.added", P.on_item_added) rm.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() P.tried, P.waiting = {}, {} end) rm.on("gmcp.Char.Vitals", P.drain) end

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- RM startup: wires GMCP events, the mapper's events and the UI. -- Re-importing is safe: acs.module in 01_rm.lua removes the old handlers first.
function rm.init() acs.gmcp_support({ "Room 1", "Char.Items 1" })
rm.on("gmcp.Room.Info", rm.on_room_info) rm.on("gmcp.Room.Players", rm.on_room_players) rm.on("gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", rm.on_add_player) rm.on("gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer", rm.on_remove_player) rm.on("gmcp.Room.WrongDir", rm.on_wrongdir) rm.on("gmcp.Char.Items.List", rm.on_items_list) rm.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Add", rm.on_items_add) rm.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", rm.on_items_remove) rm.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Update", rm.on_items_update) rm.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() rm.items, rm.players, rm.history = {}, {}, {} rm.walk.dest = nil end) -- Your own name decides which settings file is used; once it's known, -- drop yourself from the player list if GMCP got there first. rm.on("acs.char.loaded", function(_, name) if name and rm.players[name] then rm.players[name] = nil rm.raise("rm.players.changed") end if rm.settings.ui then rm.ui.toggle(true) end end)
for _, ev in ipairs({ "rm.info", "rm.items.changed", "rm.players.changed" }) do rm.on(ev, function() rm.ui.queue_refresh() end) end
rm.on("mmapper arrived", rm.on_mapper_arrived) rm.on("mmapper failed path", rm.on_mapper_failed) rm.on("mmapper stopped", rm.on_mapper_failed)
rm.pk.init()
rm.ui.hb_register() rm.on("hb.ready", rm.ui.hb_register) rm.on("hb.removed", function() rm.ui.queue_refresh() end) -- back to its own timer
if gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info then rm.on_room_info() if gmcp.Room.Players then rm.on_room_players() end rm.request_items() end if rm.settings.ui then rm.ui.toggle(true) end rm.echo(("loaded v%s. Type <white>room help<reset>."):format(rm.version)) end
rm.init()

Script.name: auto follow
Script.script:
-- AF: safe auto follow for Achaea (Mudlet). Built on the shared ACS core -- (00_acs_core.lua), so it installs side by side with the other packages. -- -- Follows one person room by room by watching them leave ("Bob leaves to -- the north."), and won't step into an enemy city, one of its defendable -- areas, or a room with a totem (or guards) in it. It doesn't use the -- game's FOLLOW, so nothing moves you without these checks. -- -- The global `af` is this package's acs.module registry. Commands start -- with "afol" ("follow" and "af" are left to the game).
af = acs.module("af", { prefix = "afol", tag = "af" }) af.title = "AF safe auto follow" af.version = "0.1.0"
af.default_settings = { squint = true, -- squint into the room first (when you can) guards = true, -- guards seen by squinting stop you too (not in your own city) enemies = "all", -- "all": every city but yours; "list": only enemy_cities enemy_cities = {}, -- city -> true, used when enemies = "list" city = nil, -- your city, when GMCP doesn't give it areas = {}, -- extra areas that belong to a city: area name (lower case) -> city echo = true, -- say each step retries = 2, -- resend a step that didn't happen this many times step_timeout = 2, -- seconds to wait for a step squint_timeout = 2, -- seconds to wait for squint output cache = 30, -- seconds a squint result is reused for the same room } af.settings = acs.store("af", af.default_settings)
function af.save_settings() acs.save("af") end function af.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "af") end function af.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "af") end function af.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "af") end function af.now() return acs.now() end
function af.raise(event, ...) af.debug("event " .. event) raiseEvent(event, ...) end
af.dir_long = { n = "north", ne = "northeast", e = "east", se = "southeast", s = "south", sw = "southwest", w = "west", nw = "northwest", u = "up", d = "down", ["in"] = "in", out = "out", } af.dir_short = {} for k, v in pairs(af.dir_long) do af.dir_short[v] = k af.dir_short[k] = k end
-- The room you're in: from RM when it's loaded, otherwise straight from GMCP. -- { num, area, exits = dir -> num } function af.room() if rm and rm.room and (rm.room.num or 0) ~= 0 then return rm.room end local info = gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not info then return { num = 0, area = "", exits = {} } end local exits = {} for dir, to in pairs(info.exits or {}) do exits[dir] = tonumber(to) or to end return { num = tonumber(info.num) or 0, area = info.area or "", exits = exits } end
-- Is name in the room with you? (RM's list, or GMCP Room.Players) function af.is_here(name) if not name then return false end if rm and rm.has_player then return rm.has_player(name) end name = name:lower() for _, p in ipairs((gmcp and gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players) or {}) do if p.name and p.name:lower() == name then return true end end return false end

Script.name: areas
Script.script:
-- AF areas: which city an area belongs to, and which cities are enemies. -- -- An area belongs to a city when its name has the city's name in it -- ("Mhaldor", "the City of Mhaldor"), or when you've added it with -- "afol area add CITY AREA" (defendable areas around a city, its ports and -- so on). "afol area add none AREA" says an area with a city's name in it -- isn't that city's.
af.cities = { "ashtan", "cyrena", "eleusis", "hashan", "mhaldor", "targossas" } af.is_city = {} for _, c in ipairs(af.cities) do af.is_city[c] = true end
-- "Mhaldor", "the City of Mhaldor" -> "mhaldor"; nil if it isn't one. function af.city_name(s) s = tostring(s or ""):lower() for _, c in ipairs(af.cities) do if s:find(c, 1, true) then return c end end end
-- Your city: the setting, else GMCP Char.Status ("Mhaldor (1)"), else nil. function af.my_city() if af.settings.city then return af.settings.city end local st = gmcp and gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status return st and af.city_name(st.city) end
-- The city an area belongs to, or nil: the room tracker's answer first -- (rm.area_city: your "room city" tags and city names), then the areas -- you added here, then the name. function af.area_city(area) if not area or area == "" then return nil end if rm and type(rm.area_city) == "function" then local ok, c = pcall(rm.area_city, area) if ok and c and c ~= "none" then return af.city_name(c) or tostring(c):lower() end end local key = tostring(area):lower() local set = af.settings.areas[key] if set then return set ~= "none" and set or nil end return af.city_name(key) end
-- Is city an enemy? Never your own. PT's hostile cities always count. function af.is_enemy_city(city) if not city or city == af.my_city() then return false end if pt and pt.settings and pt.settings.hostile_cities and pt.settings.hostile_cities[city] then return true end if af.settings.enemies == "list" then return af.settings.enemy_cities[city] == true end return true end
-- Area name of a room number from the Mudlet map, if it's mapped. function af.room_area(num) num = tonumber(num) if not num then return nil end if num == af.room().num then return af.room().area end if not (getRoomArea and getRoomAreaName) then return nil end local ok, id = pcall(getRoomArea, num) if not ok or not id or id == -1 then return nil end local ok2, name = pcall(getRoomAreaName, id) if ok2 and type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then return name end end
-- Where an exit from here leads: { num, area, city, enemy, guessed }. -- An unmapped room is taken to be in the area you're in now (guessed). function af.dest_info(dir) local here = af.room() local short = af.dir_short[dir] or dir local num = here.exits[short] or here.exits[dir] local area = num and af.room_area(num) local guessed = false if not area then area, guessed = here.area, true end local city = af.area_city(area) return { num = num, area = area, city = city, enemy = af.is_enemy_city(city), guessed = guessed } end

Script.name: squint
Script.script:
-- AF squint: look into the next room for a totem or guards before stepping in. -- -- The game's reply looks like this, one room after another in that -- direction until it can't see further: -- Narrowing your eyes, you squint off toward the east. -- Along the Oaken Way. <- room title -- Nature's fecundity floods ... A corpse swings here, ... <- description, -- Junction on the Oaken Way. people and items -- ... -- You can see no further. -- Only the first room (the one your leader went into) is checked. -- -- af.squint(dir, fn, num) sends "squint <dir>", collects the lines up to "You -- can see no further." (or the prompt, or squint_timeout seconds) and calls -- fn(result): -- { ok = true, totem = bool, guards = bool, title = "...", lines = {...} } -- { ok = false, why = "..." } couldn't squint (no skill, blind, no exit...) -- If the game says you don't have the skill, squinting stops for this -- session ("afol squint on" tries again).
af.sq = af.sq or { cache = {} } local S = af.sq
-- Lines that mean the squint didn't work. "skill" ones turn squinting off -- until you turn it back on. af.squint_fail = { { "^Huh%?", "skill" }, { "^I do not understand", "skill" }, { "^You don't know how", "skill" }, { "^You do not know how", "skill" }, { "^You lack the skill", "skill" }, { "^You have no idea how", "skill" }, { "^You are blind", "blind" }, { "^You cannot see", "blind" }, { "^You can't see", "blind" }, { "^You see no exit", "exit" }, { "^There is no exit", "exit" }, { "^You cannot squint", "exit" }, } -- Words in squint output that mean guards. Matched as whole words, any case. af.guard_words = { "guard", "guards", "guardsman", "guardsmen", "guardswoman", "sentry", "sentries", "soldier", "soldiers", "centurion", "watchman", "watchmen", "legionnaire", "legionary" }
function af.has_word(text, word) return (" " .. text:lower() .. " "):find("[^%a]" .. word .. "[^%a]") ~= nil end
af.squint_start = "^Narrowing your eyes, you squint" af.squint_end = "^You can see no further"
-- Read the collected squint lines. Where the first room ends: -- * at next_name, the second room's title, when the map knows it; -- * otherwise, when the game sends each description as one long line -- (no wrapping), after that one line; -- * otherwise (wrapped lines, so a title can't be told from the end of a -- sentence) every room seen is checked, to be safe. r.whole says so. function af.read_squint(lines, next_name) local start for i, l in ipairs(lines) do if l:find(af.squint_start) then start = i break end end if not start then for _, l in ipairs(lines) do for _, f in ipairs(af.squint_fail) do if l:find(f[1]) then return { ok = false, why = f[2], lines = lines } end end end return { ok = false, why = #lines > 0 and "unknown reply" or "no reply", lines = lines } end local title = lines[start + 1] if not title or title:find(af.squint_end) then return { ok = false, why = "nothing seen", lines = lines } end local r = { ok = true, totem = false, guards = false, title = title, lines = {} } local want = next_name and next_name:lower():gsub("%.$", "") local single = not want and #(lines[start + 2] or "") > 100 r.whole = not want and not single for i = start + 2, #lines do local l = lines[i] if l:find(af.squint_end) then break end if want and l:lower():gsub("%.$", "") == want then break end if single and i > start + 2 then break end r.lines[#r.lines + 1] = l if l:lower():find("totem", 1, true) then r.totem = true end for _, w in ipairs(af.guard_words) do if af.has_word(l, w) then r.guards = true break end end end return r end
-- Name of the room past num in direction dir, from the Mudlet map. function af.next_room_name(num, dir) if not (num and getRoomExits and getRoomName) then return nil end local ok, exits = pcall(getRoomExits, num) if not ok or type(exits) ~= "table" then return nil end local to = exits[af.dir_long[dir] or dir] or exits[dir] if not to then return nil end local ok2, name = pcall(getRoomName, to) if ok2 and type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then return name end end
function af.can_squint() return af.settings.squint and not S.no_skill end
function S.finish(job) if S.job ~= job then return end S.job = nil if job.trig then killTrigger(job.trig) end if job.timer then killTimer(job.timer) end local r = af.read_squint(job.lines, job.next_name) if r.why == "skill" then S.no_skill = true af.echo("<yellow>you can't squint<reset>; following by area only (<white>afol squint on<reset> to try again)") end if r.ok and job.num then S.cache[job.num] = { at = af.now(), r = r } end job.fn(r) end
function af.squint(dir, fn, num) if not af.can_squint() then return fn({ ok = false, why = "off" }) end local c = num and S.cache[num] if c and af.now() - c.at <= af.settings.cache then return fn(c.r) end if S.job then S.finish(S.job) end local job = { lines = {}, fn = fn, num = num, next_name = af.next_room_name(num, dir) } S.job = job if not acs.send("squint " .. (af.dir_long[dir] or dir)) then S.job = nil return fn({ ok = false, why = "not sent" }) end job.trig = af.trigger("^", function() -- a prompt before any reply belongs to something else if isPrompt and isPrompt() then if #job.lines > 0 then S.finish(job) end return end local l = line or "" if l:find("%S") then job.lines[#job.lines + 1] = l end if l:find(af.squint_end) then S.finish(job) end end) job.timer = af.timer(af.settings.squint_timeout, function() job.timer = nil S.finish(job) end) end
function af.squint_cancel() local job = S.job if not job then return end S.job = nil if job.trig then killTrigger(job.trig) end if job.timer then killTimer(job.timer) end end

Script.name: following
Script.script:
-- AF following: watch the leader leave, check where they went, step after them. -- -- af.leader is who you're following (nil when off). When they leave your -- room in a direction: -- 1. the room that way is looked up on the map; an enemy city or one of -- its areas stops you (an unmapped room counts as the area you're in); -- 2. otherwise you squint that way; a totem, or guards outside your own -- city, stops you. If you can't squint, there's taken to be nothing -- there (an enemy city has already stopped you at step 1); -- 3. otherwise you step after them. -- When stopped you stay put and keep watching: if they come back into your -- room, following carries on from there. -- -- Events: af.start(name), af.stop(name, reason), af.moved(dir, num), -- af.blocked(name, dir, reason), af.lost(name)
af.f = af.f or {} local F = af.f
-- How someone leaving looks: "<Name> leaves to the north.", "<Name> rides -- off up.", "<Name> swims away to the southwest."... Anything with one of -- these verbs followed by a direction counts. af.leave_verbs = { "leaves", "heads", "walks", "runs", "swims", "flies", "climbs", "crawls", "rides", "gallops", "limps", "stumbles", "slithers", "scurries", "creeps", "strides", "trudges", "wanders", "marches", "dashes", "sprints", "jogs", "skips", "flits", "glides", "lumbers", "hobbles", "staggers", "struggles", "dives", "squeezes", "steps", "moves", "departs", "goes" } af.dir_words = { "northeast", "northwest", "southeast", "southwest", "north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down", "in", "out" }
-- Direction (short form) a "<name> leaves ..." line names, or nil. function af.parse_leave(text, name) text = tostring(text or "") if name and text:sub(1, #name + 1):lower() ~= (name .. " "):lower() then return nil end local rest = name and text:sub(#name + 2):lower() or text:lower() for _, v in ipairs(af.leave_verbs) do local s, e = rest:find("^" .. v .. "[%s,]") if not s then s, e = rest:find("^.-%s" .. v .. "[%s,]") end -- "Bob quickly leaves..." if s then local tail = " " .. rest:sub(e + 1):gsub("[%.,!]", " ") .. " " for _, d in ipairs(af.dir_words) do if tail:find("%s" .. d .. "%s") or tail:find("%s" .. d .. "wards?%s") then return af.dir_short[d] end end return nil end end end
function af.following() return F.leader end
function af.say(msg) if af.settings.echo then af.echo(msg) end end
function af.start(name) name = tostring(name):lower():gsub("^%l", string.upper) af.stop(nil, true) F.leader = name F.state = "watching" F.trig = af.trigger("^" .. name .. " ", function() af.on_leader_line(line or matches[1] or "") end) local where = af.is_here(name) and "" or " <dim_grey>(not here; waiting for them)" af.echo("following <white>" .. name .. "<reset>" .. where) if af.settings.enemies == "all" and not af.my_city() then af.echo("<yellow>your city isn't known yet<reset>, so every city counts as an enemy (<white>afol city NAME<reset>)") end af.raise("af.start", name) end
function af.stop(reason, quiet) local name = F.leader af.squint_cancel() if F.trig then killTrigger(F.trig) end if F.timer then killTimer(F.timer) end F.leader, F.state, F.trig, F.timer, F.step = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil if name then if not quiet then af.echo("stopped following <white>" .. name .. "<reset>" .. (reason and (": " .. reason) or "")) end af.raise("af.stop", name, reason or "stopped") end end
function af.block(dir, why) F.state = "blocked" local d = af.dir_long[dir] or dir af.echo(("<red>not following %s %s<reset>: %s. Waiting here."):format(F.leader, d, why)) af.raise("af.blocked", F.leader, dir, why) end
-- Decide about one direction: calls fn(true) or fn(false, why). function af.check(dir, fn) local info = af.dest_info(dir) if info.enemy then local what = (info.area or ""):lower():find(info.city, 1, true) and "enemy city" or ("an area of " .. info.city) return fn(false, ("%s is %s"):format(info.area ~= "" and info.area or "that way", what), info) end if not af.can_squint() then return fn(true, nil, info) end local mine = info.city and info.city == af.my_city() af.squint(dir, function(r) if not r.ok then return fn(true, nil, info, r) end if r.totem then return fn(false, "there's a totem there", info, r) end if r.guards and af.settings.guards and not mine then return fn(false, "there are guards there", info, r) end fn(true, nil, info, r) end, info.num) end
function af.on_leader_line(text) if not F.leader or F.step or F.state == "checking" then return end local dir = af.parse_leave(text, F.leader) if not dir then return end local here = af.room() if next(here.exits) and not here.exits[dir] then return af.debug("no exit " .. dir .. " here, ignoring") end F.state = "checking" local leader = F.leader af.check(dir, function(ok, why) if F.leader ~= leader then return end if not ok then return af.block(dir, why) end af.step(dir) end) end
function af.step(dir) local from = af.room().num F.step = { dir = dir, from = from, tries = 0 } F.state = "moving" local function try() local s = F.step if not s then return end if s.tries > af.settings.retries then F.step, F.state = nil, "watching" return af.echo("<yellow>couldn't go " .. (af.dir_long[dir] or dir) .. "<reset>; still following " .. F.leader) end s.tries = s.tries + 1 acs.send(af.dir_long[dir] or dir) F.timer = tempTimer(af.settings.step_timeout, function() F.timer = nil try() end) end try() end
-- Every Room.Info: did our step land? function af.on_room() local s = F.step if not s then return end local num = af.room().num if num == s.from then return end F.step = nil if F.timer then killTimer(F.timer) F.timer = nil end F.state = "watching" af.say(("followed %s %s"):format(F.leader, af.dir_long[s.dir] or s.dir)) af.raise("af.moved", s.dir, num) -- the player list comes just after the room; look a moment later local leader = F.leader af.timer(1, function() if F.leader == leader and not F.step and not af.is_here(leader) then af.echo("<yellow>" .. leader .. " isn't here<reset>; waiting for them to show up") F.state = "lost" af.raise("af.lost", leader) end end) end
function af.on_wrongdir() if F.step then F.step.tries = af.settings.retries + 1 end end
-- The leader walked back in: carry on from here. function af.on_player_entered(name) if F.leader and name and name:lower() == F.leader:lower() and F.state ~= "watching" and not F.step then if F.state == "checking" then af.squint_cancel() end F.state = "watching" af.say(F.leader .. " is here again; following") end end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- AF commands: "afol <command>", or "afol NAME" to follow someone. -- "afol" on its own shows the status; "afol help" lists the commands.
function af.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
-- "afol NAME" follows NAME; anything else goes to the commands. local run = af.run function af.run(text) local w = acs.words(text) local first = (w[1] or ""):lower() if first == "" then return af.commands.status.fn({}, "") end if not af.commands[first] and first ~= "help" and #w == 1 and first:match("^%a+$") then return af.start(first) end return run(text) end
af.command("status", function() local st = af.f.state if af.f.leader then af.echo(("following <white>%s<reset> (%s)"):format(af.f.leader, st or "?")) else af.echo("not following anyone (<white>afol NAME<reset>)") end local enemies = {} for _, c in ipairs(af.cities) do if af.is_enemy_city(c) then enemies[#enemies + 1] = c end end cecho(("\n your city <white>%s<reset>; enemy cities: <red>%s"):format(af.my_city() or "unknown", #enemies > 0 and table.concat(enemies, ", ") or "none")) cecho(("\n squint %s%s<reset>, guards %s"):format(af.settings.squint and "on" or "off", af.sq.no_skill and " <yellow>(you can't squint)" or "", af.settings.guards and "on" or "off")) local n = acs.count(af.settings.areas) if n > 0 then cecho(("\n %d extra area%s (<white>afol areas<reset>)"):format(n, n == 1 and "" or "s")) end end, "status who you're following and the safety settings")
af.command("follow", function(w) if not w[1] then return af.err("follow whom?") end af.start(w[1]) end, { "NAME follow NAME, room by room, with the safety checks", "follow NAME the same" })
af.command("off", function() af.stop() end, "off stop following") af.command("stop", function() af.stop() end)
af.command("check", function(w) local dir = af.dir_short[(w[1] or ""):lower()] if not dir then return af.err("check which direction?") end af.check(dir, function(ok, why, info, r) local where = ("%s (%s%s)"):format(af.dir_long[dir], info.area ~= "" and info.area or "?", info.guessed and ", guessed" or "") local seen = r and (r.ok and " <dim_grey>(squinted)" or (" <dim_grey>(no squint: " .. tostring(r.why) .. ")")) or "" if ok then af.echo("<green>would follow<reset> " .. where .. seen) else af.echo("<red>wouldn't follow<reset> " .. where .. ": " .. why .. seen) end end) end, "check DIR what would happen if your leader went DIR (squints)")
af.command("squint", function(w) af.settings.squint = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.squint) af.sq.no_skill, af.sq.cache = nil, {} af.save_settings() af.echo("squint before following " .. (af.settings.squint and "on" or "off")) end, "squint on|off squint for totems and guards before stepping in")
af.command("guards", function(w) af.settings.guards = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.guards) af.save_settings() af.echo("guards " .. (af.settings.guards and "stop you (outside your city)" or "are ignored")) end, "guards on|off stop for guards seen by squinting (never in your own city)")
af.command("echo", function(w) af.settings.echo = af.onoff(w[1], af.settings.echo) af.save_settings() af.echo("step messages " .. (af.settings.echo and "on" or "off")) end, "echo on|off a line for every step you follow")
af.command("city", function(w) local c = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not c then return af.echo("your city: " .. (af.my_city() or "unknown")) end if c == "auto" then af.settings.city = nil elseif c == "none" then af.settings.city = "none" elseif af.is_city[c] then af.settings.city = c else return af.err("not a city: " .. c) end af.save_settings() af.echo("your city: " .. (af.my_city() or "unknown")) end, "city NAME|none|auto your city (auto: from GMCP)")
af.command("enemies", function(w) local m = (w[1] or ""):lower() if m ~= "all" and m ~= "list" then return af.echo("enemies: <white>" .. af.settings.enemies .. "<reset> (afol enemies all|list)") end af.settings.enemies = m af.save_settings() af.echo(m == "all" and "every city but yours is an enemy" or "only your enemy list counts (afol enemy CITY)") end, "enemies all|list all: every city but yours; list: only your enemy cities")
af.command("enemy", function(w) local c = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not c then return af.echo("enemy list: " .. (next(af.settings.enemy_cities) and table.concat(acs.sorted_keys(af.settings.enemy_cities), ", ") or "empty")) end if not af.is_city[c] then return af.err("not a city: " .. c) end af.settings.enemy_cities[c] = (w[2] ~= "off") or nil af.save_settings() af.echo(c .. (af.settings.enemy_cities[c] and " added to" or " removed from") .. " the enemy list" .. (af.settings.enemies == "all" and " (used after <white>afol enemies list<reset>)" or "")) end, "enemy CITY [off] add a city to (or take it off) your enemy list")
af.command("area", function(w, rest) local sub = (w[1] or ""):lower() if sub == "add" then local c = (w[2] or ""):lower() local name = rest:match("^%S+%s+%S+%s+(.+)$") if not (af.is_city[c] or c == "none") then return af.err("afol area add CITY|none AREA NAME") end if not name or name:lower() == "here" then name = af.room().area end if not name or name == "" then return af.err("which area?") end af.settings.areas[name:lower()] = c af.save_settings() return af.echo(("<white>%s<reset> %s"):format(name, c == "none" and "belongs to no city" or ("belongs to " .. c))) elseif sub == "remove" then local name = rest:match("^%S+%s+(.+)$") if not name or name:lower() == "here" then name = af.room().area end if not af.settings.areas[(name or ""):lower()] then return af.err("not on the list: " .. tostring(name)) end af.settings.areas[name:lower()] = nil af.save_settings() return af.echo("removed " .. name) end local area = af.room().area af.echo(("this area: <white>%s<reset> -> %s"):format(area ~= "" and area or "?", af.area_city(area) or "no city")) end, { "area which city this area counts as", "area add CITY AREA AREA (or \"here\") belongs to CITY; CITY none: to no city", "area remove AREA forget an area you added" })
af.command("areas", function() local keys = acs.sorted_keys(af.settings.areas) af.echo(#keys .. " area" .. (#keys == 1 and "" or "s") .. " added (city names in area names count on their own)") for _, k in ipairs(keys) do cecho(("\n %-32s %s"):format(k, af.settings.areas[k])) end end, "areas the areas you've added")

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- AF startup. Re-importing is safe: acs.module in 01_af.lua removes the old -- handlers first. Nothing is sent until you start following someone, and -- acs.send holds everything until you're logged in.
function af.init() acs.gmcp_support({ "Room 1" }) af.on("gmcp.Room.Info", af.on_room) af.on("gmcp.Room.WrongDir", af.on_wrongdir) af.on("gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", function() local p = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.AddPlayer if type(p) == "table" then af.on_player_entered(p.name) end end) af.on("gmcp.Room.Players", function() local leader = af.f.leader if leader and af.is_here(leader) then af.on_player_entered(leader) end end) af.on("acs.logout", function() af.stop("logged out", true) end) af.echo(("loaded v%s. Type <white>afol help<reset>."):format(af.version)) end
af.init()

Script.name: inventory
items
Script.script:
-- IN items: GMCP Char.Items for inventory ("inv"), room ("room") and -- containers ("rep<id>"). -- -- Achaea attrib letters: w worn, W wearable, l wielded left, L wielded right, -- g groupable, c container, t takeable, m monster, d dead, x don't target, -- e edible, r riftable. Containers don't always carry "c" (a cage shows only -- "t"), so icon "container" counts too.
function IN._make_item(raw, loc) if type(raw) ~= "table" then return nil end local a = raw.attrib or "" local name = raw.name or "" local it = { id = tostring(raw.id), name = name, attrib = a, icon = raw.icon or "", loc = loc, qty = tonumber(name:match("^(%d+)%s")) or 1, worn = a:find("w", 1, true) ~= nil, wearable = a:find("W", 1, true) ~= nil, groupable = a:find("g", 1, true) ~= nil, container = a:find("c", 1, true) ~= nil or raw.icon == "container", takeable = a:find("t", 1, true) ~= nil, monster = a:find("m", 1, true) ~= nil, dead = a:find("d", 1, true) ~= nil, notarget = a:find("x", 1, true) ~= nil, gold = raw.icon == "coin" or name:lower():find("sovereign") ~= nil, } if a:find("l", 1, true) then it.wielded = "left" elseif a:find("L", 1, true) then it.wielded = "right" end it.curative = IN.curative_key(name) return it end IN.make_item = IN._make_item
function IN.where(loc) if loc == "inv" then return IN.inv, "inv" end if loc == "room" then return IN.room, "room" end local cid = loc and loc:match("^rep(%d+)$") if cid then local c = IN.containers[cid] if not c then local src = IN.inv[cid] or IN.room[cid] c = { id = cid, name = src and src.name or ("container " .. cid), items = {} } IN.containers[cid] = c end return c.items, "container", cid end end
-- Recompute wielded/worn from inventory and raise an event if wielding changed. function IN.refresh_gear() local oldl, oldr = IN.wielded.left, IN.wielded.right local left, right = nil, nil for k in pairs(IN.worn) do IN.worn[k] = nil end for id, it in pairs(IN.inv) do if it.wielded == "left" then left = it elseif it.wielded == "right" then right = it end if it.worn then IN.worn[id] = it end end IN.wielded.left, IN.wielded.right = left, right local function key(i) return i and i.id or "" end if key(oldl) ~= key(left) or key(oldr) ~= key(right) then raiseEvent("IN.wield.changed", left, right) end end
function IN.changed(kind, cid, action, it) if kind == "inv" then IN.refresh_gear() raiseEvent("IN.inv.changed", action, it) elseif kind == "room" then raiseEvent("IN.room.changed", action, it) if it and it.gold and (action == "add" or action == "list") then IN.maybe_autogold() end else raiseEvent("IN.container.changed", cid) end end
function IN.on_list() local d = gmcp.Char.Items.List if not d then return end local store, kind, cid = IN.where(d.location) if not store then return end for k in pairs(store) do store[k] = nil end local sawgold = false for _, raw in ipairs(d.items or {}) do local it = IN._make_item(raw, d.location) if it then store[it.id] = it sawgold = sawgold or it.gold end end if kind == "container" then IN.containers[cid].fetched = acs.now() end if kind == "room" then IN._gold_tried = {} end IN.changed(kind, cid, "list", nil) if kind == "room" and sawgold then IN.maybe_autogold() end if kind == "inv" and IN.settings.autocontents then IN.fetch_containers() end end
function IN.on_add() local d = gmcp.Char.Items.Add if not d then return end local store, kind, cid = IN.where(d.location) local it = store and IN._make_item(d.item, d.location) if not it then return end store[it.id] = it IN.changed(kind, cid, "add", it) end
function IN.on_update() local d = gmcp.Char.Items.Update if not d then return end local store, kind, cid = IN.where(d.location) local it = store and IN._make_item(d.item, d.location) if not it then return end store[it.id] = it IN.changed(kind, cid, "update", it) end
function IN.on_remove() local d = gmcp.Char.Items.Remove if not d then return end local store, kind, cid = IN.where(d.location) if not store then return end local id = type(d.item) == "table" and d.item.id or d.item id = id and tostring(id) if not id then return end local it = store[id] store[id] = nil if kind == "inv" and IN.containers[id] then IN.containers[id] = nil end IN.changed(kind, cid, "remove", it or { id = id }) end
-- Ask the server what's inside each container you carry. function IN.fetch_containers() for id, it in pairs(IN.inv) do if it.container then sendGMCP("Char.Items.Contents " .. id) end end end
-- With MCCP on, IRE answers GMCP requests promptly only after a line of -- input, so commands typed by the user follow requests with send(" "). function IN.request_all(flush) sendGMCP("Char.Items.Inv") sendGMCP("Char.Items.Room") sendGMCP("IRE.Rift.Request") if flush then send(" ", false) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Queries
function IN.matches(it, text) if not text or text == "" then return true end text = tostring(text):lower() return it.id == text or it.name:lower():find(text, 1, true) ~= nil end
-- Items you carry (and, with deep, inside your containers) matching text. function IN.find(text, deep) local r = {} for _, it in pairs(IN.inv) do if IN.matches(it, text) then r[#r + 1] = it end end if deep ~= false then for cid, c in pairs(IN.containers) do if IN.inv[cid] then for _, it in pairs(c.items) do if IN.matches(it, text) then r[#r + 1] = it end end end end end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) return r end
function IN.has(text, deep) return IN.find(text, deep)[1] ~= nil end
-- Total quantity of a curative (short key) loose in inventory and containers. function IN.inv_count(key) key = IN.curative_key(key) or key local n = 0 for _, it in ipairs(IN.find(nil, true)) do if it.curative == key then n = n + it.qty end end return n end
-- Room contents. what: "items" (default, no mobs), "mobs", "all", or a -- function(item) -> bool. function IN.room_items(what) local r = {} for _, it in pairs(IN.room) do local ok if type(what) == "function" then ok = what(it) elseif what == "mobs" then ok = it.monster and not it.dead elseif what == "all" then ok = true else ok = not it.monster end if ok then r[#r + 1] = it end end table.sort(r, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) return r end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Picking things up
-- Pick up room items whose name contains text (or matching a function). -- Returns how many get commands were sent. function IN.pickup(text) local n = 0 for _, it in ipairs(IN.room_items()) do local ok if type(text) == "function" then ok = text(it) else ok = IN.matches(it, text) end if ok and (it.takeable or it.gold) then IN.send("get " .. it.id) n = n + 1 end end return n end
IN._gold_tried = IN._gold_tried or {} function IN.pickup_gold() local n = 0 for _, it in ipairs(IN.room_items()) do if it.gold and not IN._gold_tried[it.id] then IN._gold_tried[it.id] = true IN.send("get " .. it.id) n = n + 1 end end return n end
function IN.maybe_autogold() -- RM's auto-pickup handles gold when it's loaded and on if rm and rm.pickup_on and rm.pickup_on() then return end if IN.settings.autogold then IN.pickup_gold() end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Gold from Char.Status
function IN.on_status() local s = gmcp.Char.Status if not s then return end local g, b = IN.tonum(s.gold), IN.tonum(s.bank) if b then IN.bank = b end if g and g ~= IN.gold then local old = IN.gold IN.gold = g raiseEvent("IN.gold.changed", g, old and (g - old) or 0) end end

Script.name: supplies
Script.script:
-- IN supplies: rift counts (GMCP IRE.Rift), vials (ELIXLIST) and pipes -- (PIPELIST). Vials and pipes have no GMCP, so their counts are as of the -- last list; "in vials" / "in pipes" refresh them.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Rift
IN._low_warned = IN._low_warned or {}
function IN.low_threshold(key) local t = IN.settings.low[key] if t == nil then t = IN.settings.low_default end return t or 0 end
function IN.check_low(key, amount, old) local thr = IN.low_threshold(key) if thr <= 0 then return end if amount < thr then -- warn when crossing down, so things you never stock stay quiet if old and old >= thr and not IN._low_warned[key] then IN._low_warned[key] = true IN.echo(("<orange>low on %s: %d left"):format(key, amount)) raiseEvent("IN.low", key, amount, thr) end else IN._low_warned[key] = nil end end
function IN.set_rift(name, amount, desc, quiet) local key = IN.rift_key(name) amount = IN.tonum(amount) or 0 local old = IN.rift[key] and IN.rift[key].amount IN.rift[key] = { name = name, amount = amount, desc = desc } if not quiet then IN.check_low(key, amount, old) end if old ~= amount then raiseEvent("IN.rift.changed", key, amount, old) end end
function IN.on_rift_list() local l = gmcp.IRE.Rift.List if type(l) ~= "table" then return end local seen = {} for _, r in ipairs(l) do IN.set_rift(r.name, r.amount, r.desc, true) seen[IN.rift_key(r.name)] = true end for k in pairs(IN.rift) do if not seen[k] then local old = IN.rift[k].amount IN.rift[k] = nil raiseEvent("IN.rift.changed", k, 0, old) end end end
function IN.on_rift_change() local r = gmcp.IRE.Rift.Change if type(r) ~= "table" or not r.name then return end IN.set_rift(r.name, r.amount, r.desc) end
function IN.rift_count(name) local r = IN.rift[IN.rift_key(name)] return r and r.amount or 0 end
-- Herb or its mineral: everything you can use for that cure, rift plus -- loose items. IN.count("kelp") == IN.count("aurum"). function IN.count(name) local key = IN.curative_key(name) or tostring(name):lower() local herb = IN.mineral_to_herb[key] or key local min = IN.herb_to_mineral[herb] local n = IN.rift_count(herb) + IN.inv_count(herb) if min then n = n + IN.rift_count(min) + IN.inv_count(min) end return n end
-- Which form to eat/apply/smoke for a herb: "kelp" or "aurum". Picks the one -- you have; if both or neither, IN.settings.prefer decides. Stable API used -- by the curing package. function IN.best_form(herb) local key = IN.curative_key(herb) or tostring(herb):lower() local h = IN.mineral_to_herb[key] or key local m = IN.herb_to_mineral[h] if not m then return h end local hn = IN.rift_count(h) + IN.inv_count(h) local mn = IN.rift_count(m) + IN.inv_count(m) if hn > 0 and mn == 0 then return h end if mn > 0 and hn == 0 then return m end return IN.settings.prefer == "mineral" and m or h end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Line capture for ELIXLIST, PIPELIST, WEAPONLIST and ARMOURLIST. A capture -- starts when we send the command (or see a list header), parses lines until -- they stop coming, then hands the rows to that kind's done function. -- IN.capture_kinds[kind] = { parse = fn(line) -> row|nil, done = fn(rows, loud) }
IN._cap = nil IN.capture_kinds = IN.capture_kinds or {}
function IN.finish_capture() local cap = IN._cap IN._cap = nil if cap.trig then killTrigger(cap.trig) end if not cap.got then if cap.loud then IN.err("no " .. cap.kind .. " lines recognised; check the format (see README)") end return end IN.capture_kinds[cap.kind].done(cap.rows, cap.loud) end
function IN.arm(cap, sec) if cap.timer then killTimer(cap.timer) end cap.timer = tempTimer(sec, function() if IN._cap == cap then IN.finish_capture() end end) end
function IN.start_capture(kind, loud) if IN._cap then if IN._cap.kind == kind then IN._cap.loud = IN._cap.loud or loud return end IN.finish_capture() end local cap = { kind = kind, rows = {}, loud = loud } IN._cap = cap cap.trig = tempRegexTrigger("^(.*)$", function() if IN._cap ~= cap then return end local row = IN.capture_kinds[kind].parse(matches[2] or "") if row then cap.rows[#cap.rows + 1] = row cap.got = true IN.arm(cap, 0.5) end end) IN.arm(cap, 3) end
IN.capture_kinds.vials = { parse = function(l) return IN.parse_vial(l) end, done = function(rows, loud) IN.vials = rows IN.check_low_sips() raiseEvent("IN.vials.changed") if loud then IN.show_vials() end end, }
IN.capture_kinds.pipes = { parse = function(l) return IN.parse_pipe(l) end, done = function(rows, loud) IN.pipes = rows for k in pairs(IN.pipes_by_herb) do IN.pipes_by_herb[k] = nil end for _, p in ipairs(IN.pipes) do if p.herb and not IN.pipes_by_herb[p.herb] then IN.pipes_by_herb[p.herb] = p.id end end raiseEvent("IN.pipes.changed") if loud then IN.show_pipes() end end, }
-- One ELIXLIST row, as Achaea prints it: -- A glazed runic vial173863 elixir of the ogre 4 --- -- Heartwood vial617927 an elixir of health 199 124 -- Heartwood vial578681 empty 0 125 -- i.e. the vial's name run into its id, contents, sips, months (or ---). function IN.parse_vial(l) local id, fluid, sips, months = l:match("^%s*.-%a(%d%d%d%d+)%s+(.-)%s+(%d+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") if not id then id, fluid, sips = l:match("^%s*.-%a(%d%d%d%d+)%s+(.-)%s+(%d+)%s*$") end if not id or fluid == "" then return nil end return { id = id, fluid = fluid, kind = IN.fluid_kind(fluid), sips = tonumber(sips) or 0, months = tonumber(months) } end
-- One PIPELIST row, as Achaea prints it: -- artf pipe264579 a skullcap flower 4 n/a -- Needs an id, and either a smokable or "empty". -- Puffs is the number next to the word "puffs", else the last number. function IN.parse_pipe(l) local low = l:lower() local id = low:match("^%s*%a*(%d%d%d+)") or low:match("pipe%s*(%d%d%d+)") or low:match("%((%d%d%d+)%)") if not id then return nil end local herb for w in pairs(IN.smokables) do if low:find("%f[%a]" .. w .. "%f[%A]") then herb = w break end end local empty = low:find("empty") ~= nil if not herb and not empty then return nil end local rest = low:gsub(id, "", 1) local puffs = tonumber(rest:match("(%d+)%s*puffs") or rest:match("puffs%D*(%d+)")) if not puffs then for n in rest:gmatch("%f[%d](%d+)%f[%D]") do puffs = tonumber(n) end end local lit = (low:find("%f[%a]lit%f[%A]") or low:find("%f[%a]yes%f[%A]")) and not low:find("unlit") or false if herb and IN.mineral_to_herb[herb] then herb = IN.mineral_to_herb[herb] end return { id = id, herb = herb, puffs = empty and 0 or (puffs or 0), lit = lit and true or false } end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Vials
function IN.vials_of(kind) local r = {} for _, v in ipairs(IN.vials) do if v.kind == kind then r[#r + 1] = v end end return r end
function IN.vial_sips(kind) local n = 0 for _, v in ipairs(IN.vials_of(kind)) do n = n + v.sips end return n end
function IN.check_low_sips() local thr = IN.settings.low_sips or 0 if thr <= 0 then return end for _, k in ipairs(IN.cure_fluids) do local have = IN.vials_of(k) if #have > 0 then local n = IN.vial_sips(k) local key = "sips:" .. k if n < thr then if not IN._low_warned[key] then IN._low_warned[key] = true IN.echo(("<orange>low on %s: %d sips"):format(k, n)) raiseEvent("IN.low", k, n, thr) end else IN._low_warned[key] = nil end end end end
function IN.request_vials(loud) IN.start_capture("vials", loud) IN.send("elixlist") end function IN.request_pipes(loud) IN.start_capture("pipes", loud) IN.send("pipelist") end
