--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Weapons and armour (WEAPONLIST / ARMOURLIST), as Achaea prints them: -- spear117409 106 224 210 n/a -- chain mail488790 34 28 n/a 60 -- the item's name run into its id, then four columns ("n/a" -> nil).
IN.weapons = IN.weapons or {} IN.armour = IN.armour or {}
local function stat_row(l) local name, id, a, b, c, d = l:match("^%s*(.-%a)(%d%d%d%d+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s+(%S+)%s*$") if not id then return nil end return { id = id, name = name, tonumber(a), tonumber(b), tonumber(c), tonumber(d) } end
function IN.parse_weapon(l) local r = stat_row(l) if not r or not r[1] then return nil end -- damage is always a number return { id = r.id, name = r.name, dmg = r[1], tohit = r[2], speed = r[3], months = r[4] } end
function IN.parse_armour(l) local r = stat_row(l) if not r or not (r[1] or r[2]) then return nil end local t, slot = IN.armour_type(r.name) return { id = r.id, name = r.name, cutting = r[1], blunt = r[2], magical = r[3], months = r[4], type = t, slot = slot } end
-- Armour and shield types from HELP ARMOUR AND SHIELDS, weakest first, and -- the best each class may use. Names are matched on the item's name. IN.armour_types = { "cloth", "leather", "ringmail", "scalemail", "chainmail", "splintmail", "field plate", "full plate" } IN.shield_types = { "buckler", "cavalry", "banded", "kite", "tower" } local A = { cloth = { "dragon", "magi", "horkval", "psion", "pariah", "elemental lord" }, leather = { "monk", "bard" }, ringmail = { "alchemist", "apostate" }, scalemail = { "serpent", "jester", "shaman", "occultist", "depthswalker", "blademaster" }, chainmail = { "druid", "sentinel", "sylvan", "classless" }, splintmail = { "priest" }, ["full plate"] = { "paladin", "infernal", "runewarden", "unnamable" } } local S = { none = { "dragon", "magi", "monk", "blademaster", "pariah", "elemental lord" }, buckler = { "serpent", "sylvan", "bard", "psion" }, cavalry = { "alchemist", "occultist", "apostate", "shaman", "depthswalker", "classless" }, banded = { "jester" }, kite = { "priest", "druid", "sentinel" }, tower = { "runewarden", "infernal", "paladin", "unnamable" } } IN.best_armour, IN.best_shield = {}, {} for t, l in pairs(A) do for _, c in ipairs(l) do IN.best_armour[c] = t end end for t, l in pairs(S) do for _, c in ipairs(l) do IN.best_shield[c] = t end end
-- "chain mail" -> "chainmail", "a kite shield" -> "kite"; nil if unknown. function IN.armour_type(name) local n = tostring(name or ""):lower():gsub("%s*mail", "mail"):gsub("chain%-mail", "chainmail") for _, t in ipairs(IN.shield_types) do if n:find("%f[%a]" .. t .. "%f[%A]") then return t, "shield" end end for _, t in ipairs(IN.armour_types) do if n:find(t, 1, true) then return t, "armour" end end if n:find("shield") then return "shield", "shield" end if n:find("leather") then return "leather", "armour" end return nil end
-- The stats for an item id, from either list. function IN.weapon(id) for _, w in ipairs(IN.weapons) do if w.id == tostring(id) then return w end end end function IN.armour_piece(id) for _, a in ipairs(IN.armour) do if a.id == tostring(id) then return a end end end
IN.capture_kinds.weapons = { parse = function(l) return IN.parse_weapon(l) end, done = function(rows, loud) IN.weapons = rows raiseEvent("IN.weapons.changed") if loud then IN.show_weapons() end end, } IN.capture_kinds.armour = { parse = function(l) return IN.parse_armour(l) end, done = function(rows, loud) IN.armour = rows raiseEvent("IN.armour.changed") if loud then IN.show_armour() end end, }
function IN.request_weapons(loud) IN.start_capture("weapons", loud) IN.send("weaponlist") end function IN.request_armour(loud) IN.start_capture("armour", loud) IN.send("armourlist") end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- IN commands and display. Registered on the module in 99_init.
function IN.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
function IN.tags(it) local t = {} if it.wielded then t[#t + 1] = "<yellow>wielded " .. it.wielded end if it.worn then t[#t + 1] = "<green>worn" end if it.container then local c = IN.containers[it.id] local n = c and acs.count(c.items) t[#t + 1] = "<cyan>container" .. (n and (" (" .. n .. ")") or "") end if it.monster then t[#t + 1] = it.dead and "<grey>dead" or "<red>mob" end return #t > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(t, "<grey>, ")) or "" end
function IN.line(it, indent) cecho(("\n%s<grey>%-8s <reset>%s%s"):format(indent or " ", it.id, it.name, IN.tags(it))) end
function IN.show_inv(filter) local list = IN.find(filter, false) IN.echo(("<white>inventory<reset> (%d)%s"):format(#list, filter and (" matching '" .. filter .. "'") or "")) for _, it in ipairs(list) do IN.line(it) local c = it.container and IN.containers[it.id] if c then local inner = {} for _, x in pairs(c.items) do inner[#inner + 1] = x end table.sort(inner, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) for _, x in ipairs(inner) do IN.line(x, " ") end end end if IN.gold then cecho(("\n <gold>%d gold<grey>, %d in bank"):format(IN.gold, IN.bank or 0)) end end
function IN.show_room() local items, mobs = IN.room_items("items"), IN.room_items("mobs") IN.echo(("<white>room<reset>: %d items, %d mobs"):format(#items, #mobs)) for _, it in ipairs(mobs) do IN.line(it) end for _, it in ipairs(items) do IN.line(it) end end
function IN.show_rift(filter) local pairs_done, rows = {}, {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(IN.rift)) do if not pairs_done[k] and (not filter or k:find(filter, 1, true)) then local herb = IN.mineral_to_herb[k] or k local min = IN.herb_to_mineral[herb] if min then pairs_done[herb], pairs_done[min] = true, true rows[#rows + 1] = (" <white>%-11s<reset>%6d <white>%-10s<reset>%6d <grey>total %d"):format( herb, IN.rift_count(herb), min, IN.rift_count(min), IN.count(herb)) else pairs_done[k] = true rows[#rows + 1] = (" <white>%-11s<reset>%6d"):format(k, IN.rift_count(k)) end end end IN.echo("<white>rift<reset> (" .. #rows .. ")") for _, r in ipairs(rows) do cecho("\n" .. r) end end
function IN.show_vials() IN.echo(("<white>vials<reset> (%d)"):format(#IN.vials)) local kinds = {} for _, v in ipairs(IN.vials) do kinds[v.kind] = (kinds[v.kind] or 0) + 1 end for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(kinds)) do local thr = IN.settings.low_sips or 0 local n = IN.vial_sips(k) local col = (k ~= "empty" and thr > 0 and n < thr) and "<orange>" or "<reset>" cecho(("\n <white>%-12s<reset>%2d vials %s%d sips"):format(k, kinds[k], col, n)) end end
function IN.show_pipes() IN.echo(("<white>pipes<reset> (%d)"):format(#IN.pipes)) for _, p in ipairs(IN.pipes) do cecho(("\n <grey>%-8s <reset>%-10s %3d puffs%s"):format(p.id, p.herb or "empty", p.puffs, p.lit and " <yellow>lit" or "")) end end
local function stat(v) return v and tostring(v) or "-" end
function IN.show_weapons() IN.echo(("<white>weapons<reset> (%d) dmg to-hit speed months"):format(#IN.weapons)) for _, w in ipairs(IN.weapons) do local it = IN.inv[w.id] local hand = it and it.wielded and (" <yellow>" .. it.wielded) or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%-8s <reset>%-14s %5s %7s %6s %7s%s"):format(w.id, w.name, stat(w.dmg), stat(w.tohit), stat(w.speed), stat(w.months), hand)) end end
function IN.show_armour() IN.echo(("<white>armour<reset> (%d) cutting blunt magical months"):format(#IN.armour)) for _, a in ipairs(IN.armour) do local it = IN.inv[a.id] local worn = it and it.worn and " <green>worn" or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%-8s <reset>%-14s %7s %6s %8s %7s%s"):format(a.id, a.name, stat(a.cutting), stat(a.blunt), stat(a.magical), stat(a.months), worn)) end local cls = acs.me.class if cls and (IN.best_armour[cls] or IN.best_shield[cls]) then cecho(("\n <grey>best for %s: %s armour, %s shield"):format(cls, IN.best_armour[cls] or "?", IN.best_shield[cls] or "?")) end end
function IN.show_gear() IN.echo("<white>gear") local l, r = IN.wielded.left, IN.wielded.right cecho("\n <grey>left hand <reset>" .. (l and (l.name .. " <grey>" .. l.id) or "-")) cecho("\n <grey>right hand <reset>" .. (r and (r.name .. " <grey>" .. r.id) or "-")) local worn = {} for _, it in pairs(IN.worn) do worn[#worn + 1] = it end table.sort(worn, function(a, b) return a.name < b.name end) for _, it in ipairs(worn) do IN.line(it) end end
function IN.register_commands(M) M.command("inv", function(_, rest) IN.show_inv(rest ~= "" and rest or nil) end, "inv [text] what you carry, with container contents") M.command("find", function(_, rest) local r = IN.find(rest, true) IN.echo(("%d match '%s'"):format(#r, rest)) for _, it in ipairs(r) do local loc = it.loc ~= "inv" and (" <grey>in " .. ((IN.containers[it.loc:match("%d+") or ""] or {}).name or it.loc)) or "" cecho(("\n <grey>%-8s <reset>%s%s"):format(it.id, it.name, loc)) end end, "find <text> search inventory and containers") M.command("room", function() IN.show_room() end, "room items and mobs here") M.command("rift", function(_, rest) IN.show_rift(rest ~= "" and rest:lower() or nil) end, "rift [text] herb/mineral counts") M.command("count", function(w) if not w[1] then return IN.err("count <herb or mineral>") end IN.echo(("%s: %d (use %s)"):format(w[1], IN.count(w[1]), IN.best_form(w[1]))) end, "count <herb> herb + mineral total, and which to use") M.command("vials", function(w) if w[1] == "show" then IN.show_vials() else IN.request_vials(true) end end, "vials [show] ELIXLIST and summarise ('show' = last list)") M.command("pipes", function(w) if w[1] == "show" then IN.show_pipes() else IN.request_pipes(true) end end, "pipes [show] PIPELIST and summarise") M.command("gear", function() IN.show_gear() end, "gear wielded and worn") M.command("gold", function() IN.echo(("%d gold, %d in bank"):format(IN.gold or 0, IN.bank or 0)) end, "gold gold on hand and in bank") M.command("look", function(w) local it = w[1] and IN.find(table.concat(w, " "), false)[1] if not it then return IN.err("look <container id or name>") end sendGMCP("Char.Items.Contents " .. it.id) send(" ", false) tempTimer(0.5, function() local c = IN.containers[it.id] IN.echo(it.name .. ": " .. (c and acs.count(c.items) or 0) .. " items") if c then for _, x in pairs(c.items) do IN.line(x) end end end) end, "look <container> refresh and list a container") M.command("get", function(_, rest) if rest == "" then return IN.err("get <text>|gold") end local n = rest == "gold" and IN.pickup_gold() or IN.pickup(rest) if n == 0 then IN.echo("nothing here matches") end end, "get <text>|gold pick up matching room items") M.command("autogold", function(w) IN.settings.autogold = IN.onoff(w[1], IN.settings.autogold) acs.save("in") IN.echo("autogold " .. (IN.settings.autogold and "on" or "off")) end, "autogold on|off pick up gold when it appears") M.command("low", function(w) local key, n = w[1], tonumber(w[2]) if key == "sips" and n then IN.settings.low_sips = n elseif key == "default" and n then IN.settings.low_default = n elseif key and n then IN.settings.low[IN.rift_key(key)] = n else IN.echo(("warn below %d (default), %d sips"):format(IN.settings.low_default, IN.settings.low_sips)) for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(IN.settings.low)) do cecho(("\n %s %d"):format(k, IN.settings.low[k])) end return end acs.save("in") IN.echo("saved") end, "low <item|default|sips> <n> low-stock warning level (0 = off)") M.command("prefer", function(w) if w[1] ~= "herb" and w[1] ~= "mineral" then return IN.err("prefer herb|mineral") end IN.settings.prefer = w[1] acs.save("in") IN.echo("prefer " .. w[1] .. " when you have both") end, "prefer herb|mineral which form to use when you have both") M.command("refresh", function() IN.request_all(true) IN.request_vials(false) tempTimer(1.5, function() IN.request_pipes(false) end) tempTimer(3, function() IN.request_weapons(false) end) tempTimer(4.5, function() IN.request_armour(false) end) IN.echo("refreshing inventory, room, rift, vials and pipes") end, "refresh re-read everything from the game") M.command("refill", function(w) local show, src = false, nil for _, x in ipairs(w) do x = x:lower() if x == "plan" then show = true elseif x == "rift" or x == "tun" then src = x end end IN.refill(show, src) end, "refill [plan] [rift|tun] fill empty vials with what your set is missing") M.command("want", function(w) local f, n = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), tonumber(w[2]) if f == "venoms" and n then IN.settings.refill_venoms = n elseif f and n then IN.settings.vial_set[f] = n else IN.echo("vial set (fluid: vials wanted / have)") for _, x in ipairs(IN.wanted()) do cecho(("\n %-12s %d / %d"):format(x.fluid, x.want, #IN.vials_of(x.fluid))) end return end acs.save("in") IN.echo(("want %s %d"):format(f, n)) end, "want [<fluid>|venoms <n>] vials of each fluid in your set (0 = none)") M.command("weapons", function(w) if w[1] == "show" then IN.show_weapons() else IN.request_weapons(true) end end, "weapons [show] WEAPONLIST: damage, to-hit, speed, decay") M.command("armour", function(w) if w[1] == "show" then IN.show_armour() else IN.request_armour(true) end end, "armour [show] ARMOURLIST: cutting, blunt, magical, decay") end

Script.name: refill
Script.script:
-- IN refill: fill empty vials with whatever your vial set is missing. -- -- The set is IN.settings.vial_set (elixirs and salves, n vials each) plus -- refill_venoms vials of every venom. Missing = wanted minus the non-empty -- vials of that kind in the last ELIXLIST. Each missing vial takes one empty -- vial, cures first, then venoms, until the empties run out. A liquid comes -- from your rift when the rift has it, otherwise from a tun (stand in the -- shop and have the gold on you).
function IN.wanted() local r = {} for _, l in ipairs({ IN.elixirs, IN.salves }) do for _, f in ipairs(l) do local n = IN.settings.vial_set[f] or 0 if n > 0 then r[#r + 1] = { fluid = f, want = n } end end end -- anything else you added with "in want" for _, f in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(IN.settings.vial_set)) do local known = false for _, x in ipairs(r) do if x.fluid == f then known = true end end for _, v in ipairs(IN.venoms) do if v == f then known = true end end local n = IN.settings.vial_set[f] or 0 if not known and n > 0 then r[#r + 1] = { fluid = f, want = n } end end for _, v in ipairs(IN.venoms) do local n = IN.settings.vial_set[v] or IN.settings.refill_venoms or 0 if n > 0 then r[#r + 1] = { fluid = v, want = n } end end return r end
-- Where to fill a liquid from: forced source, else rift if it has some. function IN.refill_source(fluid, force) if force then return force end return IN.rift_count(fluid) > 0 and "rift" or "tun" end
-- Work out the refills. source = "rift", "tun" or nil (pick per liquid). Returns { cmds = {...}, filled = {{vial, fluid}}, -- short = {fluid = n still missing after empties ran out} }. function IN.refill_plan(source) local empties = {} for _, v in ipairs(IN.vials) do if v.kind == "empty" then empties[#empties + 1] = v.id end end local plan = { cmds = {}, filled = {}, short = {} } for _, w in ipairs(IN.wanted()) do local missing = w.want - #IN.vials_of(w.fluid) for _ = 1, missing do local vial = table.remove(empties, 1) if vial then local src = IN.refill_source(w.fluid, source) local cmd = IN.settings.refill_cmd:gsub("{vial}", vial):gsub("{fluid}", w.fluid):gsub("{source}", src) plan.cmds[#plan.cmds + 1] = cmd plan.filled[#plan.filled + 1] = { vial = vial, fluid = w.fluid, source = src } else plan.short[w.fluid] = (plan.short[w.fluid] or 0) + 1 end end end return plan end
local function report(plan, verb) if #plan.filled == 0 and not next(plan.short) then IN.echo("nothing missing from your vial set") return end local names = {} for _, f in ipairs(plan.filled) do names[#names + 1] = f.fluid .. (f.source == "rift" and " (rift)" or "") end if #names > 0 then IN.echo(("%s %d: %s"):format(verb, #names, table.concat(names, ", "))) end if next(plan.short) then local s = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(plan.short)) do s[#s + 1] = k end IN.echo("<orange>no empty vials left for: " .. table.concat(s, ", ")) end end
-- Send the refills, then ELIXLIST again so the counts are right. -- show_only = true just prints the plan; source as in IN.refill_plan. function IN.refill(show_only, source) local plan = IN.refill_plan(source) if show_only then report(plan, "would refill") return plan end report(plan, "refilling") for _, c in ipairs(plan.cmds) do IN.send(c) end if #plan.cmds > 0 then IN.M.timer(2, function() IN.request_vials(false) end) end return plan end

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- IN startup: GMCP handlers, ELIXLIST header trigger, commands. Safe to run -- again; acs.module removes what was registered before.
function IN.init() -- bare = false: "in" alone stays the direction; "in <cmd>" is ours local M = acs.module("in", { prefix = "in", bare = false }) M.title = "IN inventory" IN.M = M IN.settings = acs.store("in", IN.defaults) -- the first refill wording was wrong; move saved copies to the real one if IN.settings.refill_cmd == "refill {vial} with {fluid}" then IN.settings.refill_cmd = IN.defaults.refill_cmd end acs.gmcp_support({ "Char.Items 1", "IRE.Rift 1" })
M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.List", IN.on_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Add", IN.on_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", IN.on_remove) M.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Update", IN.on_update) M.on("gmcp.IRE.Rift.List", IN.on_rift_list) M.on("gmcp.IRE.Rift.Change", IN.on_rift_change) M.on("gmcp.Char.Status", IN.on_status) M.on("acs.login", function() IN.request_all() end)
-- Uninstalling the package removes its handlers, triggers and alias. M.on("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg ~= "IN" then return end if IN._cap and IN._cap.trig then killTrigger(IN._cap.trig) end IN._cap = nil M.cleanup() end)
-- Typing ELIXLIST yourself also updates the vial list. M.trigger([[^\s*(?:Vial|Container)s?\s.*Sips]], function() IN.start_capture("vials", false) end) M.trigger([[^\s*Status\s+Pipe\s+Contents\s+Puffs]], function() IN.start_capture("pipes", false) end) M.trigger([[^\s*Weapon\s+Dmg\s+To-hit\s+Speed]], function() IN.start_capture("weapons", false) end) M.trigger([[^\s*Armour\s+Cutting\s+Blunt\s+Magical]], function() IN.start_capture("armour", false) end)
IN.register_commands(M)
if acs.online() and gmcp.Char then IN.on_status() IN.request_all() end IN.echo(("loaded v%s. Type <white>in help<reset>."):format(IN.version)) end
IN.init()

Script.name: people tracker
Script.script:
-- PT: People Tracker for Achaea (Mudlet) -- Core: namespace, output, settings and the people database file. -- Built on the shared ACS core (00_acs_core.lua), so it installs side by -- side with the other ACS packages.
pt = pt or {} pt.version = "0.1.0"
-- Registry from the shared ACS core: handlers, triggers, aliases and the -- "ptr" command root (plain "pt" is a game command). Re-running this file removes what it registered before. pt.M = acs.module("pt", { prefix = "ptr", tag = "pt" }) pt.M.title = "PT people tracker " .. pt.version pt.on, pt.trigger, pt.alias, pt.timer = pt.M.on, pt.M.trigger, pt.M.alias, pt.M.timer
function pt.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "pt") end function pt.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "pt") end function pt.debug(msg) if (pt.settings and pt.settings.debug) or (acs.core and acs.core.debug) then cecho("\n<dim_grey>[pt dbg] " .. tostring(msg)) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Helpers
-- Database key for a name: lower case, letters only. function pt.key(name) if not name then return nil end local k = tostring(name):lower():gsub("[^%a]", "") if k == "" then return nil end return k end
function pt.cap(s) if not s or s == "" then return s end s = tostring(s) return s:sub(1, 1):upper() .. s:sub(2):lower() end
pt.now = acs.now
pt.copy, pt.merge_defaults, pt.words, pt.sorted_keys = acs.copy, acs.merge_defaults, acs.words, acs.sorted_keys
function pt.ago(t) if not t then return "never" end local d = pt.now() - t if d < 90 then return math.floor(d) .. "s ago" end if d < 5400 then return math.floor(d / 60) .. "m ago" end if d < 129600 then return math.floor(d / 3600) .. "h ago" end return math.floor(d / 86400) .. "d ago" end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Settings are per character (acs.store "pt"). The people database is one -- file per Mudlet profile (pt_db.lua), so all your characters share what -- you know about other people.
pt.default_settings = { debug = false, autocheck = true, -- look up unknown names you see on the Achaea API stale_days = 7, -- re-check API records older than this recheck_every = 60, -- seconds between automatic online checks (0 = off) arrivals = true, -- echo when people enter or leave your room roomlist = true, -- echo who is here when you move into a room highlight = true, -- colour known names in game text highlight_all = true, -- colour everyone with a known city, not just listed people hostile_cities = {}, -- city -> true: everyone from it counts as an enemy hostile_houses = {}, -- house -> true colors = { enemy = "red", ally = "green", unknown = "grey", ashtan = "magenta", cyrene = "cornflower_blue", eleusis = "forest_green", hashan = "yellow", mhaldor = "firebrick", shallam = "gold", targossas = "white", none = "light_grey", }, ui = false, }
function pt.path(what) return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/pt_" .. what .. ".lua" end
function pt.load_file(path) local t = {} local f = io.open(path, "r") if f then f:close() local ok = pcall(table.load, path, t) if not ok then pt.err("could not read " .. path) t = {} end end return t end
function pt.load() pt.settings = acs.store("pt", pt.default_settings) pt.db = pt.merge_defaults(pt.load_file(pt.path("db")), { people = {}, lists = { enemies = {}, allies = {} } }) end
function pt.save_settings() acs.save("pt") end
-- The database changes often (every room you walk into), so writes are -- batched: at most one save every few seconds. function pt.save_db(now) if now then if pt._save_timer then killTimer(pt._save_timer) pt._save_timer = nil end local ok, err = pcall(table.save, pt.path("db"), pt.db) if not ok then pt.err("could not save database: " .. tostring(err)) end return end if pt._save_timer then return end pt._save_timer = tempTimer(5, function() pt._save_timer = nil pt.save_db(true) end) end
pt.db = pt.db or { people = {}, lists = { enemies = {}, allies = {} } }

Script.name: people database
Script.script:
-- PT people database: records, lists (enemies, allies, your own), and the -- read API other scripts use (pt.class, pt.city, pt.is_enemy, ...). -- -- A record looks like: -- { name = "Bob", fullname = "Sir Bob the Bold", city = "mhaldor", -- house = "...", class = "serpent", race = "...", level = 80, -- xp_rank = 120, player_kills = 10, mob_kills = 3000, -- checked = <time of API lookup>, seen = <time last seen>, -- room = { num = 1234, name = "...", area = "..." }, -- note = "...", locked = { class = true }, src = { class = "seen" } } -- -- City, house, class and race are stored lower case.
pt.cities = { "ashtan", "cyrene", "eleusis", "hashan", "mhaldor", "shallam", "targossas" } pt.is_city = {} for _, c in ipairs(pt.cities) do pt.is_city[c] = true end
pt.fields = { name = "string", fullname = "string", city = "lower", house = "lower", class = "lower", race = "lower", gender = "lower", level = "number", xp_rank = "number", explore_rank = "number", player_kills = "number", mob_kills = "number", age = "number", might = "number", note = "string", }
function pt.get(name) local k = pt.key(name) return k and pt.db.people[k] end
function pt.person(name) local k = pt.key(name) if not k then return nil end local p = pt.db.people[k] if not p then p = { name = pt.cap(k), src = {}, locked = {} } pt.db.people[k] = p end p.src, p.locked = p.src or {}, p.locked or {} return p end
function pt.clean(field, value) local kind = pt.fields[field] if value == nil or value == "" then return nil end if kind == "number" then return tonumber(value) end value = tostring(value) if kind == "lower" then value = value:lower() if value == "(none)" or value == "none" or value == "(hidden)" or value == "unknown" then return field == "city" and "none" or nil end end return value end
-- Set one field. source is "manual", "seen", "honours" or "api". -- Sources rank manual > seen > honours = api: a value from a lower source -- never replaces one from a higher source. So a class worked out from -- someone's attacks (pt.observe) beats what the API says, and a manual value -- beats everything until "ptr unset". What the API said is always kept in -- p.api[field], so it can be shown next to what you saw. -- Returns true if the value changed. pt.source_rank = { manual = 3, seen = 2, honours = 1, api = 1 }
function pt.set(name, field, value, source) local p = pt.person(name) if not p then return false end source = source or "seen" value = pt.clean(field, value) if source == "api" then p.api = p.api or {} p.api[field] = value end if source == "manual" then p.locked[field] = value ~= nil or nil if value == nil then return pt.unset(name, field) end else if value == nil then return false end if p.locked[field] then return false end local cur = p[field] ~= nil and p.src[field] if cur and (pt.source_rank[cur] or 1) > (pt.source_rank[source] or 1) then return false end end if source == "seen" then p.seen_at = p.seen_at or {} p.seen_at[field] = pt.now() end local old = p[field] p[field] = value p.src[field] = source pt.save_db() if old ~= value then raiseEvent("pt.person.updated", p.name, field, value, old) return true end return false end
-- Clear a manual or seen value; falls back to what the API said. function pt.unset(name, field) local p = pt.get(name) if not p then return false end local old = p[field] p.locked[field] = nil if p.seen_at then p.seen_at[field] = nil end local api = p.api and p.api[field] p[field] = api p.src[field] = api ~= nil and "api" or nil pt.save_db() if old ~= api then raiseEvent("pt.person.updated", p.name, field, api, old) end return true end
-- Where a field's value came from and, for seen values, when: -- pt.source("Bob", "class") -> "seen", <time> function pt.source(name, field) local p = pt.get(name) if not p or p[field] == nil then return nil end return p.src[field], p.seen_at and p.seen_at[field] end
-- What combat triggers call when someone's attacks show their class: -- pt.observe("Bob", "class", "serpent"). Takes priority over the API. function pt.observe(name, field, value) return pt.set(name, field, value, "seen") end
function pt.forget(name) local k = pt.key(name) if not k then return end pt.db.people[k] = nil for _, l in pairs(pt.db.lists) do l[k] = nil end pt.save_db() raiseEvent("pt.person.updated", pt.cap(k), nil) end
function pt.field(name, f) local p = pt.get(name) return p and p[f] end function pt.class(name) return pt.field(name, "class") end function pt.city(name) return pt.field(name, "city") end function pt.house(name) return pt.field(name, "house") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Lists
function pt.list(listname, create) listname = tostring(listname):lower() if create and not pt.db.lists[listname] then pt.db.lists[listname] = {} end return pt.db.lists[listname] end
function pt.in_list(listname, name) local l, k = pt.list(listname), pt.key(name) return l and k and l[k] ~= nil or false end
function pt.list_add(listname, name) local k = pt.key(name) if not k then return end pt.person(name) pt.list(listname, true)[k] = pt.now() if listname == "enemies" then pt.list("allies", true)[k] = nil end if listname == "allies" then pt.list("enemies", true)[k] = nil end pt.save_db() raiseEvent("pt.list.changed", listname, pt.cap(k), true) end
function pt.list_del(listname, name) local l, k = pt.list(listname), pt.key(name) if not (l and k and l[k]) then return false end l[k] = nil pt.save_db() raiseEvent("pt.list.changed", listname, pt.cap(k), false) return true end
function pt.list_names(listname) local l = pt.list(listname) or {} local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(l)) do r[#r + 1] = (pt.db.people[k] or {}).name or pt.cap(k) end return r end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Relations. Allies always win. Then your enemies list, then hostile -- cities and houses.
function pt.is_ally(name) return pt.in_list("allies", name) end
function pt.is_enemy(name) if pt.is_ally(name) then return false end if pt.in_list("enemies", name) then return true end local p = pt.get(name) if not p then return false end if p.city and pt.settings.hostile_cities[p.city] then return true end if p.house and pt.settings.hostile_houses[p.house] then return true end return false end
function pt.relation(name) if pt.is_ally(name) then return "ally" end if pt.is_enemy(name) then return "enemy" end return "neutral" end
-- Colour name for a person: enemy/ally colour first, then city colour. function pt.color(name) local c = pt.settings.colors local rel = pt.relation(name) if rel ~= "neutral" then return c[rel] end local p = pt.get(name) if p and p.city then return c[p.city] or c.none end return c.unknown end
-- "Bob" coloured, plus a short "(Mhaldor serpent)" tag. function pt.tag(name, with_info) local p = pt.get(name) or { name = pt.cap(name) } local s = "<" .. pt.color(name) .. ">" .. p.name .. "<reset>" if with_info ~= false then local bits = {} if p.city and p.city ~= "none" then bits[#bits + 1] = pt.cap(p.city) end if p.class then bits[#bits + 1] = p.class end if #bits > 0 then s = s .. " <dim_grey>(" .. table.concat(bits, " ") .. ")<reset>" end local rel = pt.relation(name) if rel == "enemy" then s = s .. " <red>[enemy]<reset>" elseif rel == "ally" then s = s .. " <green>[ally]<reset>" end end return s end
-- People matching field == value (value lower case), e.g. pt.find("city", "mhaldor") function pt.find(field, value) value = value and tostring(value):lower() local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.db.people)) do local p = pt.db.people[k] local v = p[field] if v ~= nil and (value == nil or tostring(v):lower() == value) then r[#r + 1] = p.name end end return r end

Script.name: API lookups
Script.script:
-- PT lookups on the public Achaea API (api.achaea.com): -- /characters/<name>.json name, fullname, city, house, level, class, kills, ranks -- /characters.json everyone online right now -- Uses Mudlet's getHTTP (Mudlet 4.10 or newer). Requests go out one at a -- time with a short gap, so walking into a crowded room doesn't flood it.
pt.api = pt.api or {} local A = pt.api
A.base = "https://api.achaea.com" A.gap = 0.4 A.queue = A.queue or {} A.queued = A.queued or {} A.inflight = nil pt.online = pt.online or { names = {}, at = nil, count = 0 }
function A.char_url(k) return A.base .. "/characters/" .. k .. ".json" end A.online_url = A.base .. "/characters.json"
function A.available() return type(getHTTP) == "function" end
function A.decode(body) if yajl and yajl.to_value then local ok, v = pcall(yajl.to_value, body) if ok then return v end end return nil end
-- Queue a lookup. force skips the "checked recently" test. -- cb(record_or_nil) is called when it finishes. function A.lookup(name, force, cb) local k = pt.key(name) if not k or not A.available() then return false end if k == pt.key(pt.me()) then return false end local p = pt.get(k) if not force and p and p.checked and pt.now() - p.checked < pt.settings.stale_days * 86400 then return false end if A.queued[k] then if cb then A.queued[k][#A.queued[k] + 1] = cb end return true end A.queued[k] = { cb } A.queue[#A.queue + 1] = { kind = "char", key = k, url = A.char_url(k) } A.pump() return true end
function A.fetch_online(cb) if not A.available() then pt.err("this Mudlet has no getHTTP (needs Mudlet 4.10+)") return end A._online_cbs = A._online_cbs or {} A._online_cbs[#A._online_cbs + 1] = cb if #A._online_cbs > 1 then return end table.insert(A.queue, 1, { kind = "online", url = A.online_url }) A.pump() end
function A.pump() if A.inflight or #A.queue == 0 then return end A.inflight = table.remove(A.queue, 1) A.inflight.at = pt.now() pt.debug("GET " .. A.inflight.url) getHTTP(A.inflight.url) -- Don't wait forever on a request that never answers. local req = A.inflight tempTimer(15, function() if A.inflight == req then A.finish(req, nil) end end) end
function A.finish(req, body) if A.inflight ~= req then return end A.inflight = nil if req.kind == "char" then A.got_char(req.key, body and A.decode(body)) else A.got_online(body and A.decode(body)) end tempTimer(A.gap, A.pump) end
function A.match_req(url) local req = A.inflight if req and url and url:lower() == req.url:lower() then return req end end
function A.on_done(_, url, body) local req = A.match_req(url) if req then A.finish(req, body) end end
function A.on_error(_, err, url) local req = A.match_req(url) if req then pt.debug("API error for " .. tostring(url) .. ": " .. tostring(err)) A.finish(req, nil) end end
function A.got_char(k, data) local cbs = A.queued[k] or {} A.queued[k] = nil local p = pt.person(k) p.checked = pt.now() if type(data) == "table" and data.name then p.api_missing = nil pt.set(k, "name", data.name, "api") for _, f in ipairs({ "fullname", "city", "house", "class", "level", "xp_rank", "explore_rank", "player_kills", "mob_kills" }) do pt.set(k, f, data[f], "api") end else p.api_missing = true end pt.save_db() raiseEvent("pt.checked", p.name, not p.api_missing) for _, cb in ipairs(cbs) do if cb then pcall(cb, not p.api_missing and p or nil) end end end
function A.got_online(data) local cbs = A._online_cbs or {} A._online_cbs = {} if type(data) == "table" and type(data.characters) == "table" then local names = {} for _, c in ipairs(data.characters) do local k = pt.key(c.name) if k then names[k] = true end end pt.online = { names = names, at = pt.now(), count = tonumber(data.count) or #data.characters } raiseEvent("pt.online.updated", pt.online.count) else pt.err("could not fetch the online list") end for _, cb in ipairs(cbs) do if cb then pcall(cb, pt.online) end end end
-- Automatic recheck: every recheck_every seconds fetch the online list and -- look up anyone online whose record is missing or older than stale_days. -- New names are only looked up when autocheck is on. function A.recheck() if not acs.online() then return end -- not logged in A.fetch_online(function(o) for k in pairs(o.names) do if pt.db.people[k] or pt.settings.autocheck then A.lookup(k) end end end) end
function A.start_recheck() if A._recheck_timer then killTimer(A._recheck_timer) A._recheck_timer = nil end local every = tonumber(pt.settings.recheck_every) or 0 if every <= 0 or not A.available() then return end A._recheck_timer = pt.timer(every, function() A._recheck_timer = nil A.recheck() A.start_recheck() end) end
function pt.is_online(name) local k = pt.key(name) return k and pt.online.names[k] or false end

Script.name: room tracking
Script.script:
-- PT room tracking from GMCP: Room.Info, Room.Players, Room.AddPlayer, -- Room.RemovePlayer. Keeps who is in your room, when and where you last saw -- everyone, and echoes arrivals and departures.
pt.room = pt.room or { num = nil, name = nil, area = nil, players = {}, order = {} } local R = pt.room
function pt.me() if acs.me.name then return acs.me.name end local c = gmcp and gmcp.Char return (c and c.Status and c.Status.name) or (c and c.Name and c.Name.name) or nil end
function R.is_me(name) local me = pt.me() return me and pt.key(me) == pt.key(name) end
function R.here_info() return { num = R.num, name = R.name, area = R.area } end
function R.saw(name, fullname) local p = pt.person(name) if not p then return end p.name = name if fullname and fullname ~= "" and not (p.locked and p.locked.fullname) then p.fullname = fullname end p.seen = pt.now() if R.num then p.room = R.here_info() end pt.save_db() if pt.settings.autocheck then pt.api.lookup(name) end end
function R.on_info() local i = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not i then return end R.num = tonumber(i.num) or i.num R.name = i.name R.area = i.area -- Everyone still here was seen here (Room.Players for the new room follows). end
function R.add(name, fullname) local k = pt.key(name) if not k or R.is_me(name) then return false end local new = R.players[k] == nil R.players[k] = name if new then R.order[#R.order + 1] = k end R.saw(name, fullname) return new end
function R.remove(k) if not R.players[k] then return false end R.players[k] = nil for i, v in ipairs(R.order) do if v == k then table.remove(R.order, i) break end end return true end
function R.on_players() local list = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players if type(list) ~= "table" then return end local moved = R._listed_room ~= R.num R._listed_room = R.num local before = R.players R.players, R.order = {}, {} for _, pl in ipairs(list) do R.add(pl.name, pl.fullname) end if moved then if pt.settings.roomlist and #R.order > 0 then pt.echo("here: " .. pt.here_text()) end else -- Same room re-sent (it happens): treat differences as arrivals/departures. for k in pairs(R.players) do if not before[k] then pt.arrived(R.players[k]) end end for k, n in pairs(before) do if not R.players[k] then pt.left(n) end end end raiseEvent("pt.room.changed") end
function R.on_add() local a = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.AddPlayer if type(a) ~= "table" or not a.name then return end if R.add(a.name, a.fullname) then pt.arrived(a.name) raiseEvent("pt.room.changed") end end
function R.on_remove() local r = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer local name = type(r) == "table" and (r.name or r[1]) or r local k = pt.key(name) if k and R.remove(k) then local p = pt.get(k) if p then p.seen = pt.now() end pt.left(p and p.name or name) raiseEvent("pt.room.changed") end end
function pt.arrived(name) if pt.settings.arrivals then pt.echo(pt.tag(name) .. " <dim_grey>arrived") end raiseEvent("pt.arrived", name, pt.relation(name)) end
function pt.left(name) if pt.settings.arrivals then pt.echo(pt.tag(name, false) .. " <dim_grey>left") end raiseEvent("pt.left", name, pt.relation(name)) end
-- Names of the players in your room, in the order they appeared. function pt.here() local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(R.order) do r[#r + 1] = R.players[k] end return r end
function pt.is_here(name) local k = pt.key(name) return k and R.players[k] ~= nil or false end
function pt.enemies_here() local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(pt.here()) do if pt.is_enemy(n) then r[#r + 1] = n end end return r end
function pt.allies_here() local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(pt.here()) do if pt.is_ally(n) then r[#r + 1] = n end end return r end
function pt.here_text() local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(pt.here()) do r[#r + 1] = pt.tag(n) end return #r > 0 and table.concat(r, ", ") or "<dim_grey>nobody" end
function R.reset() R.players, R.order, R._listed_room = {}, {}, nil end

Script.name: honours
Script.script:
-- PT: read HONOURS output. When you send "honours <name>", the lines that -- follow are parsed for race, city, house, age, rank and might, and stored -- with source "honours". The wording is matched loosely on purpose; if your -- city or house isn't picked up, set it with "ptr set <name> city <city>".
pt.honours = pt.honours or {} local H = pt.honours
H.window = 4 -- seconds after the command to keep reading lines
function H.on_send(_, cmd) local who = tostring(cmd or ""):lower():match("^%s*honou?rs?%s+(%a+)%s*$") if who then H.pending = { key = pt.key(who), until_t = pt.now() + H.window, seen_header = false } end end
function H.strip_dot(s) return (s:gsub("%.%s*$", "")) end
-- Returns true if the line was used. function H.parse(l) local P = H.pending if not P then return false end if pt.now() > P.until_t then H.pending = nil return false end local k = P.key if not P.seen_header then -- "Sir Bob the Bold (male Human)." local full, gender, race = l:match("^(.-)%s*%((%a+)%s+([%a%s'%-]+)%)%.?%s*$") if full and full:lower():find(k, 1, true) then P.seen_header = true pt.set(k, "fullname", full, "honours") if gender == "male" or gender == "female" then pt.set(k, "gender", gender, "honours") pt.set(k, "race", race, "honours") else pt.set(k, "race", gender .. " " .. race, "honours") end return true end return false end local rest = l:match("^%s*[HhSsTtIi]%a*%s+(.+)$") if not rest or not (l:match("^%s*He ") or l:match("^%s*She ") or l:match("^%s*They ") or l:match("^%s*It ")) then return false end rest = H.strip_dot(rest) local low = rest:lower() local age = low:match("^is (%d+) years old") or low:match("^are (%d+) years old") if age then pt.set(k, "age", age, "honours") return true end local rank = low:match("ranked (%d+)%a%a in achaea") if rank then pt.set(k, "xp_rank", rank, "honours") return true end local might = low:match("approximately (%d+)%% of your might") if might then pt.set(k, "might", might, "honours") return true end -- City: "a citizen of Mhaldor", "a Duke in Hashan", "the Champion of Cyrene"... for _, c in ipairs(pt.cities) do if low:find("citizen of " .. c, 1, true) or low:find("in " .. c .. "$") or low:find("of " .. c .. "$") or low:find("of the city of " .. c, 1, true) then pt.set(k, "city", c, "honours") return true end end -- House: "a Disciple in the Shadowdancers", "a member of the Sentaari" local house = rest:match("^%a+ an? [%a%s'%-]- in the ([%u][%a%s'%-]+)$") or rest:match("^%a+ an? member of the ([%u][%a%s'%-]+)$") if house and not house:lower():find("army", 1, true) and not pt.is_city[house:lower()] then pt.set(k, "house", house, "honours") return true end return false end

Script.name: name highlighting
Script.script:
-- PT name highlighting. One trigger looks at every line that has a -- capitalised word, and colours the words that are known people: -- enemies (red, underlined), allies (green), others by city colour.
pt.hl = pt.hl or {} local HL = pt.hl
function HL.wanted(word) local k = pt.key(word) local p = k and pt.db.people[k] if not p then return nil end local rel = pt.relation(k) if rel ~= "neutral" then return pt.settings.colors[rel], rel == "enemy" end for _, l in pairs(pt.db.lists) do if l[k] then return pt.color(k), false end end if pt.settings.highlight_all and p.city then return pt.color(k), false end return nil end
-- Count plain (not pattern) occurrences of word in l that start before pos. local function occurrences_before(l, word, pos) local n, from = 0, 1 while true do local s = l:find(word, from, true) if not s or s >= pos then return n end n = n + 1 from = s + 1 end end
function HL.line(l) if not pt.settings.highlight or not l then return end -- Read the line as it is now on screen, in case another script already -- changed it, so the colour lands on the right letters. if getCurrentLine then local cur = getCurrentLine() if type(cur) == "string" and cur ~= "" then l = cur end end local pos, any = 1, false while true do local s, e = l:find("%u%l+", pos) if not s then break end local before = s > 1 and l:sub(s - 1, s - 1) or "" local after = l:sub(e + 1, e + 1) -- Whole words only: "Fitz" lights up in "Fitz waves" and "Fitz's", but -- not in "Fitztic", "McFitz" or "FITZ". if not before:match("%a") and not after:match("%a") then local word = l:sub(s, e) local color, under = HL.wanted(word) -- selectString counts every occurrence of the text, including inside -- longer words, so pick the one at this position. if color and selectString(word, occurrences_before(l, word, s) + 1) > -1 then fg(color) if under then setUnderline(true) end any = true end end pos = e + 1 end if any then resetFormat() deselect() end end
function HL.install() pt.trigger([[\b[A-Z][a-z]+\b]], function() HL.line(line) end) end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- PT commands, all under "ptr". "ptr <name>" shows what is known about someone.
local C = pt.M.command
function pt.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
function pt.show_list(title, list) pt.echo("<white>" .. title .. "<reset>: " .. (#list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "<dim_grey>none")) end
function pt.tags(names) local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(names) do r[#r + 1] = pt.tag(n) end return r end
function pt.show(name) local p = pt.get(name) if not p then pt.echo("nothing known about " .. pt.cap(name) .. (pt.api.available() and ", looking up..." or "")) pt.api.lookup(name, true, function(r) if r then pt.show(name) else pt.echo(pt.cap(name) .. ": not found on the API") end end) return end pt.echo(pt.tag(p.name) .. (p.fullname and p.fullname ~= p.name and (" <dim_grey>" .. p.fullname) or "")) local function row(label, value, field) if value == nil or value == "" then return end local mark = "" if field and p.src[field] == "manual" then mark = " <dim_grey>(set by you)" elseif field and p.src[field] == "seen" then mark = " <dim_grey>(seen " .. pt.ago(p.seen_at and p.seen_at[field]) .. ")" end local api = field and p.api and p.api[field] if api ~= nil and tostring(api) ~= tostring(p[field]) then mark = mark .. " <dim_grey>API says " .. tostring(api) end cecho(("\n <grey>%-9s<reset> %s%s"):format(label, tostring(value), mark)) end row("city", p.city and pt.cap(p.city), "city") row("house", p.house, "house") row("class", p.class, "class") row("race", p.race and ((p.gender and (p.gender .. " ") or "") .. p.race), "race") row("level", p.level, "level") row("xp rank", p.xp_rank, "xp_rank") row("kills", (p.player_kills or p.mob_kills) and (("%s players, %s mobs"):format(p.player_kills or "?", p.mob_kills or "?"))) row("might", p.might and (p.might .. "% of yours")) local lists = {} for _, ln in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.db.lists)) do if pt.db.lists[ln][pt.key(p.name)] then lists[#lists + 1] = ln end end row("lists", #lists > 0 and table.concat(lists, ", ") or nil) row("online", pt.online.at and (pt.is_online(p.name) and "<green>yes" or "no") .. " <dim_grey>(list " .. pt.ago(pt.online.at) .. ")" or nil) if p.seen then local where = p.room and (p.room.name or "?") .. (p.room.area and (" <dim_grey>in " .. p.room.area) or "") .. (p.room.num and (" <dim_grey>#" .. p.room.num) or "") or "?" row("seen", pt.ago(p.seen) .. ", " .. where .. (pt.is_here(p.name) and " <green>(here)" or "")) end row("note", p.note) row("checked", p.checked and (pt.ago(p.checked) .. (p.api_missing and " <red>(not on API)" or ""))) end
-- "ptr <name>" when <name> isn't a command. local run = pt.M.run pt.M.run = function(line) local w = pt.words(line) local sub = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if sub and not pt.M.commands[sub] and sub ~= "help" and #w == 1 and sub:match("^%a+$") then return pt.show(sub) end return run(line) end
C("who", function(w) if not w[1] then pt.err("usage: ptr NAME") return end pt.show(w[1]) end, "NAME (or who NAME) what is known about someone")
C("check", function(w) if not w[1] then pt.err("usage: ptr check NAME") return end for _, n in ipairs(w) do pt.api.lookup(n, true, function(r) if r then pt.echo("checked " .. pt.tag(r.name)) else pt.echo(pt.cap(n) .. ": not found on the API") end end) end end, "check NAME ... look someone up on the Achaea API now")
C("here", function() local names = pt.here() pt.echo(("here (%d): %s"):format(#names, pt.here_text())) end, "here who is in your room")
C("online", function(w) local scan = w[1] == "scan" pt.api.fetch_online(function(o) local by_city, enemies, allies, unknown = {}, {}, {}, 0 for k in pairs(o.names) do local p = pt.db.people[k] if not p or not p.checked then unknown = unknown + 1 if scan then pt.api.lookup(k) end end if p then local c = p.city or "?" by_city[c] = (by_city[c] or 0) + 1 end if pt.is_enemy(k) then enemies[#enemies + 1] = k end if pt.is_ally(k) then allies[#allies + 1] = k end end table.sort(enemies) table.sort(allies) local cities = {} for _, c in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(by_city)) do cities[#cities + 1] = "<" .. (pt.settings.colors[c] or "grey") .. ">" .. pt.cap(c) .. "<reset> " .. by_city[c] end pt.echo(("<white>%d online<reset>: %s%s"):format(o.count, table.concat(cities, ", "), unknown > 0 and (" <dim_grey>| " .. unknown .. " unknown" .. (scan and ", looking them up" or " (ptr online scan)")) or "")) pt.show_list("enemies online", pt.tags(enemies)) pt.show_list("allies online", pt.tags(allies)) end) end, "online [scan] who is online by city; scan looks up unknown names")
function pt.list_cmd(listname) return function(w) local sub = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if (sub == "add" or sub == "del" or sub == "remove") and w[2] then for i = 2, #w do if sub == "add" then pt.list_add(listname, w[i]) pt.echo(pt.tag(w[i], false) .. " added to " .. listname) elseif pt.list_del(listname, w[i]) then pt.echo(pt.cap(w[i]) .. " removed from " .. listname) else pt.err(pt.cap(w[i]) .. " is not in " .. listname) end end elseif sub == "clear" then pt.db.lists[listname] = {} pt.save_db() pt.echo(listname .. " cleared") else pt.show_list(listname, pt.tags(pt.list_names(listname))) end end end C("enemy", pt.list_cmd("enemies"), "enemy [add|del NAME...] your enemies list (allies win over enemies)") C("ally", pt.list_cmd("allies"), "ally [add|del NAME...] your allies list") C("enemies", pt.list_cmd("enemies"), "enemies same as ptr enemy") C("allies", pt.list_cmd("allies"), "allies same as ptr ally")
C("list", function(w) local ln = w[1] and w[1]:lower() if not ln then local r = {} for _, n in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.db.lists)) do r[#r + 1] = n .. " (" .. acs.count(pt.db.lists[n]) .. ")" end pt.show_list("lists", r) return end if (w[2] == "add") then pt.list(ln, true) end if not pt.list(ln) then pt.err("no list " .. ln .. " (create it with: ptr list " .. ln .. " add <name>)") return end if w[2] == "delete" then if ln == "enemies" or ln == "allies" then pt.err("can't delete " .. ln) return end pt.db.lists[ln] = nil pt.save_db() pt.echo("deleted list " .. ln) return end table.remove(w, 1) pt.list_cmd(ln)(w) end, "list [LIST [add|del NAME...|clear|delete]] your own lists (e.g. watch, marks)")
C("hostile", function(w) local kind, what = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), table.concat(w, " ", 2):lower() if (kind == "city" or kind == "house") and what ~= "" then local off = what:match("^(.-)%s+off$") what = off or what if kind == "city" and not pt.is_city[what] then pt.err("unknown city " .. what) return end local t = kind == "city" and pt.settings.hostile_cities or pt.settings.hostile_houses t[what] = not off or nil pt.save_settings() pt.echo(("%s %s is %s"):format(kind, pt.cap(what), off and "no longer hostile" or "<red>hostile")) else local cs, hs = {}, {} for _, c in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.settings.hostile_cities)) do cs[#cs + 1] = pt.cap(c) end for _, h in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.settings.hostile_houses)) do hs[#hs + 1] = h end pt.show_list("hostile cities", cs) pt.show_list("hostile houses", hs) end end, "hostile [city|house NAME [off]] everyone from it counts as an enemy")
C("set", function(w) local name, field = w[1], w[2] and w[2]:lower() local value = table.concat(w, " ", 3) if field == "rank" then field = "xp_rank" end if not name or not field or not pt.fields[field] or value == "" then pt.err("usage: ptr set NAME city|house|class|race|level|note|... VALUE") return end if field == "city" and not pt.is_city[value:lower()] and value:lower() ~= "none" then pt.err("unknown city " .. value) return end pt.set(name, field, value, "manual") pt.echo(pt.tag(name) .. ": " .. field .. " set (nothing changes it until 'ptr unset')") end, "set NAME FIELD VALUE set city/house/class/race/... by hand")
C("unset", function(w) local field = w[2] and w[2]:lower() if not pt.get(w[1]) or not field then pt.err("usage: ptr unset NAME FIELD") return end pt.unset(w[1], field) local v = pt.field(w[1], field) pt.echo(pt.cap(w[1]) .. ": " .. field .. (v and (" back to the API value, " .. tostring(v)) or " cleared")) end, "unset NAME FIELD clear a set or seen value (falls back to the API)")
C("note", function(w) local name = table.remove(w, 1) if not name then pt.err("usage: ptr note NAME TEXT") return end local text = table.concat(w, " ") pt.set(name, "note", text ~= "" and text or nil, "manual") pt.echo(pt.cap(name) .. (text ~= "" and (": note saved") or ": note cleared")) end, "note NAME [text] attach a note (no text clears it)")
C("find", function(w) local field, value = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), table.concat(w, " ", 2):lower() if field and pt.is_city[field] then field, value = "city", field end if not field or not pt.fields[field] then pt.err("usage: ptr find city|house|class|race VALUE (or: ptr find CITY)") return end local r = pt.find(field, value ~= "" and value or nil) pt.show_list(("%d with %s %s"):format(#r, field, value), pt.tags(r)) end, "find FIELD VALUE everyone known with that city/house/class, e.g. ptr find class serpent")
C("forget", function(w) if not w[1] then pt.err("usage: ptr forget NAME") return end pt.forget(w[1]) pt.echo("forgot " .. pt.cap(w[1])) end, "forget NAME remove someone from the database")
C("recheck", function(w) local v = w[1] == "off" and 0 or tonumber(w[1]) if v then pt.settings.recheck_every = v pt.save_settings() pt.api.start_recheck() end local e = pt.settings.recheck_every pt.echo(e > 0 and ("checking who's online every " .. e .. "s, looking up records older than " .. pt.settings.stale_days .. " days") or "automatic recheck off") end, "recheck [SECONDS|off] how often to check the online list (default 60)")
C("stats", function() local n, checked = 0, 0 for _, p in pairs(pt.db.people) do n = n + 1 if p.checked then checked = checked + 1 end end pt.echo(("%d people known, %d looked up on the API, %d lists. API queue: %d"):format( n, checked, acs.count(pt.db.lists), #pt.api.queue + (pt.api.inflight and 1 or 0))) end, "stats database size")
for _, k in ipairs({ "autocheck", "arrivals", "roomlist", "highlight", "debug" }) do C(k, function(w) pt.settings[k] = pt.onoff(w[1], pt.settings[k]) pt.save_settings() pt.echo(k .. " " .. (pt.settings[k] and "on" or "off")) end) end C("highlightall", function(w) pt.settings.highlight_all = pt.onoff(w[1], pt.settings.highlight_all) pt.save_settings() pt.echo("highlight everyone with a known city: " .. (pt.settings.highlight_all and "on" or "off")) end) pt.M.commands.debug.help = "debug on|off PT debug output" pt.M.commands.autocheck.help = "autocheck|arrivals|roomlist|highlight|highlightall on|off lookups, echoes, colours"
C("color", function(w) local what, color = w[1] and w[1]:lower(), w[2] if not what or not color then local r = {} for _, k in ipairs(pt.sorted_keys(pt.settings.colors)) do r[#r + 1] = "<" .. pt.settings.colors[k] .. ">" .. k .. "<reset>" end pt.show_list("colours", r) return end pt.settings.colors[what] = color pt.save_settings() pt.echo(what .. " colour: <" .. color .. ">" .. color) end, "color [CITY|ENEMY|ALLY|UNKNOWN COLOUR] name colours")
C("ui", function(w) pt.settings.ui = pt.onoff(w[1], pt.settings.ui) pt.save_settings() pt.ui.toggle(pt.settings.ui) end, "ui on|off window listing who is in your room")
C("save", function() pt.save_db(true) pt.echo("saved") end, "save write the people database now")

Script.name: room window
Script.script:
-- PT room window: who is here, enemies first. Toggle with "ptr ui".
pt.ui = pt.ui or {} local U = pt.ui
function U.create() if U.box or not Geyser then return end U.box = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "pt_ui", x = "-26%", y = "67%", width = "25%", height = "32%", fontSize = 9, color = "black", autoWrap = true, }) end
function U.toggle(on) if on then U.create() if U.box then U.box:show() U.refresh() end elseif U.box then U.box:hide() end end
function U.refresh() if not pt.settings.ui or not U.box then return end U.box:clear() local names = pt.here() U.box:cecho(("<gold>People<reset> <dim_grey>%s (%d)\n"):format(pt.room.name or "", #names)) table.sort(names, function(a, b) local ea, eb = pt.is_enemy(a), pt.is_enemy(b) if ea ~= eb then return ea end return a < b end) if #names == 0 then U.box:cecho(" <dim_grey>nobody\n") end for _, n in ipairs(names) do U.box:cecho(" " .. pt.tag(n) .. "\n") end end
U._pending = false function U.queue_refresh() if U._pending or not pt.settings.ui then return end U._pending = true tempTimer(0.2, function() U._pending = false U.refresh() end) end

Script.name: class signs
startup
Script.script:
-- PT startup: GMCP room events, API replies, honours reading, highlighting.
function pt.init() pt.load() pt.room.reset()
pt.on("gmcp.Room.Info", pt.room.on_info) pt.on("gmcp.Room.Players", pt.room.on_players) pt.on("gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", pt.room.on_add) pt.on("gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer", pt.room.on_remove) pt.on("sysGetHttpDone", pt.api.on_done) pt.on("sysGetHttpError", pt.api.on_error) pt.on("sysDataSendRequest", pt.honours.on_send) pt.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() pt.room.reset() end) pt.on("sysExitEvent", function() pt.save_db(true) end) pt.on("sysDisconnectionEvent", function() pt.save_db(true) end) acs.gmcp_support({ "Room 1" })
-- Show who you just targeted (works with any targeting that raises -- "acs.target" or sets the GMCP target). local function show_target(name) if name and name ~= "" and pt.get(name) then pt.echo("target " .. pt.tag(name)) end end pt.on("acs.target", function(_, name) show_target(name) end)
for _, ev in ipairs({ "pt.room.changed", "pt.person.updated", "pt.list.changed" }) do pt.on(ev, function() pt.ui.queue_refresh() end) end
pt.trigger([[^\S]], function() pt.honours.parse(line) end) pt.hl.install() pt.install_signs()
pt.api.start_recheck() if pt.settings.ui then pt.ui.toggle(true) end pt.echo(("loaded v%s, %d people known. Type <white>ptr help<reset>."):format(pt.version, acs.count(pt.db.people))) end
pt.init()

Script.name: bashing
Script.script:
-- BS: bashing (PvE hunting) for Achaea (Mudlet). Built on the shared ACS -- core (00_acs_core.lua), so it installs side by side with ss, ar, rm, pt. -- -- The global `bs` is this package's acs.module registry, so bs.on, -- bs.trigger, bs.timer and bs.command come from the core, and the "bs" -- alias is set up by it. Everything is per character; attacks and rage -- abilities are per class. -- -- Reads GMCP Char.Vitals, Char.Items (room), Room.Info, Room.AddPlayer, -- IRE.Target.Info, Char.Afflictions. Uses other packages when loaded: -- ss.has(aff) curing: what you're afflicted with -- pt.is_enemy(name) people tracker: who counts as an enemy -- rm.back_dir() room tracker: the way you came in -- bs.class_attack[class] = function(id) ... end an offense package (or -- you) can take over the swing for a class -- -- How an attack goes out (as AW's old pve did it): the swing is built into -- one game alias (stand, wield, rage ability, raze or attack) and put on -- the server queue, so the game fires it the moment balance comes back. -- QM does the SETALIAS/QUEUE when it's loaded; BS does it itself otherwise. -- -- You do the walking. Achaea's rules forbid automating gold and XP -- gathering, so nothing here moves you or runs unattended: hunting stays on -- while you walk room to room (or, with "bs stayon off", stops each time a -- room is clear or you move). -- -- Events raised: bs.started (), bs.stopped (why), bs.target (id, name), -- bs.killed (id, name), bs.clear (area), bs.warn (hp%), bs.fled (why, cmd).
bs = acs.module("bs", { prefix = "bs", tag = "bs" }) bs.title = "BS bashing" bs.version = "0.1.1"
bs.default_settings = { areas = {}, -- area name -> { "mob name", ... } in priority order attacks = {}, -- class -> "command with &tar" (overrides 05_classes) razes = {}, -- class -> raze command shatters = {}, -- class -> shield-breaking rage ability ("none" = don't) wields = {}, -- class -> "left, right" ("none" = leave weapons alone) preps = {}, -- class -> { commands sent when you start } rage = {}, -- class -> { { cmd = "...", cost = 14, cd = 16 }, ... } rage_low = 15, -- target health % under which no rage is spent rage_defend = 60, -- your health % under which defensive rage comes first rage_fear = false, -- use fear abilities (a feared mob runs off) rage_extra = {}, -- other afflictions to use rage on: { inhibit = true, ... } stayon = true, -- keep hunting as you walk; off = stop when a room is done settarget = true, -- "st <id>" so the game targets the mob (and reports its health) party = false, -- "pt target: <id>" to your party when the target changes stand = true, -- start each swing with "stand" qtype = "freestand", -- queue type the swing goes on (pve's BASHING alias used freestand) stash = "", -- e.g. "put sovereigns in pack" after picking up gold pickup = { "sovereign" }, -- text in item names to pick up warn_at = 50, -- health percent: warn once flee_at = 30, -- health percent: stop and leave the room flee_cmd = "", -- command to leave with ("" = back the way you came) pause_affs = { "paralysis", "prone", "stun", "asleep", "sleeping", "webbed", "bound", "entangled", "transfixation", "impaled", "roped", "shackled" }, anything = false, -- attack any mob in areas that have no list on_enemy = "pause", -- an enemy player walks in: "pause", "flee" or "ignore" } bs.settings = acs.store("bs", bs.default_settings)
-- Settings saved before 0.1.1 have the old "free" default; freestand is -- what pve used (it stands you up first instead of waiting). function bs.migrate() if not bs.settings.qtype_v2 then if bs.settings.qtype == "free" then bs.settings.qtype = "freestand" end bs.settings.qtype_v2 = true end end bs.migrate() bs.on("acs.char.loaded", bs.migrate)
function bs.save_settings() acs.save("bs") end function bs.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "bs") end function bs.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "bs") end function bs.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "bs") end
-- For classes 05_classes doesn't cover. "bs attack <command>" sets yours. bs.default_attacks = {} bs.class_attack = bs.class_attack or {}
-- Live state (not saved). You start every session idle. bs.active = false bs.room = {} -- id -> { id, name, attrib } bs.order = {} -- ids in room order bs.target = nil -- id we're attacking bs.target_hp = nil -- 66 from IRE.Target.Info "66%" bs.shield = false -- the target has a magical shield up bs.shields = {} -- id -> true for mobs in this room seen shielding bs.skip = {} -- ids to leave alone in this room bs.picked = {} -- ids we've already tried to pick up bs.affs = {} -- own aff list, used when ss isn't loaded bs.vit = { hpp = 100, bal = true, eq = true, rage = 0, stats = {} } bs.stats = bs.stats or { kills = 0, gold = 0, xp = 0 } bs._rage_cd = {}
function bs.has(aff) if ss and ss.has then return ss.has(aff) end return bs.affs[aff] ~= nil end
function bs.class() return acs.me.class or "none" end
function bs.area() return bs.area_name or "unknown" end
function bs.area_list(area) area = area or bs.area() bs.settings.areas[area] = bs.settings.areas[area] or {} return bs.settings.areas[area] end
-- Run the hunt logic once per batch of GMCP (many arrive per prompt). function bs.schedule() if bs._pending then return end bs._pending = true bs.timer(0, function() bs._pending = false bs.tick() end) end

Script.name: GMCP
Script.script:
-- BS GMCP: vitals, room, items, players, afflictions. -- A Char.Items list can arrive just before the Room.Info of the room it -- belongs to, so moving never clears the item list; the list replaces it.
function bs._is_mob(item) return item and item.attrib and item.attrib:find("m") and not item.attrib:find("d") end bs.is_mob = bs._is_mob
function bs.on_vitals() local v = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals if not v then return end local hp, maxhp = tonumber(v.hp), tonumber(v.maxhp) local t = bs.vit t.hpp = (hp and maxhp and maxhp > 0) and math.floor(hp * 100 / maxhp) or 100 t.bal = tostring(v.bal) == "1" t.eq = tostring(v.eq) == "1" -- charstats: { "Bleed: 0", "Rage: 23", "Spec: Dual Cutting", "Stance: Arash" } t.stats = {} for _, s in ipairs(v.charstats or {}) do local k, val = tostring(s):match("^%s*([^:]+):%s*(.-)%s*$") if k then t.stats[k:lower()] = val:lower() end end t.rage = tonumber(t.stats.rage) or 0 bs.schedule() end
function bs.on_room_info() local r = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info if not r then return end local num = tonumber(r.num) bs.area_name = r.area if num == bs.room_num then return end if bs.active and bs.room_num and not bs.settings.stayon then bs.stop("moved") end bs.back = nil for dir, to in pairs(r.exits or {}) do if bs.room_num and tonumber(to) == bs.room_num then bs.back = dir end end bs.room_num = num bs.skip, bs.target, bs.shield, bs.shields, bs._cleared = {}, nil, false, {}, false bs._return_to = nil bs.schedule() end
function bs.add_item(item) if not item or not item.id then return end local id = tostring(item.id) if not bs.room[id] then bs.order[#bs.order + 1] = id end bs.room[id] = { id = id, name = tostring(item.name or ""), attrib = item.attrib or "" } bs.check_pickup(bs.room[id]) end
function bs.remove_item(id) id = tostring(id) if not bs.room[id] then return end bs.room[id] = nil for i, v in ipairs(bs.order) do if v == id then table.remove(bs.order, i) break end end if bs.target == id then bs.target_gone() end end
function bs.on_items_list() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.List if not t or t.location ~= "room" then return end bs.room, bs.order = {}, {} for _, item in ipairs(t.items or {}) do bs.add_item(item) end if bs.target and not bs._is_mob(bs.room[bs.target]) then bs.target = nil end bs.schedule() end
function bs.on_items_add() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.Add if t and t.location == "room" then bs.add_item(t.item) bs.schedule() end end
function bs.on_items_remove() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.Remove if t and t.location == "room" and t.item then bs.remove_item(type(t.item) == "table" and t.item.id or t.item) bs.schedule() end end
function bs.on_items_update() local t = gmcp.Char.Items.Update if not (t and t.location == "room" and t.item) then return end bs.add_item(t.item) local id = tostring(t.item.id) if bs.target == id and not bs._is_mob(bs.room[id]) then bs.target_gone() end bs.schedule() end
function bs.on_target_info() local t = gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target and gmcp.IRE.Target.Info if t and tostring(t.id) == bs.target then bs.target_hp = tonumber(tostring(t.hpperc or ""):match("%d+")) bs.changed() end end
-- Gold and experience while hunting. Level "119 (10.60%)", xp "10.60%". function bs.on_status() local s = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status if not s then return end local counting = bs.active or acs.now() < (bs._pickup_until or 0) local gold = tonumber(s.gold) if gold then if bs._gold and gold > bs._gold and counting then bs.stats.gold = bs.stats.gold + gold - bs._gold end bs._gold = gold end local level = tonumber(tostring(s.level or ""):match("^(%d+)")) local xp = tonumber(tostring(s.xp or ""):match("([%d%.]+)")) if level and xp then if bs._level and counting then local gained = (level - bs._level) * 100 + xp - bs._xp if gained > 0 then bs.stats.xp = bs.stats.xp + gained end end bs._level, bs._xp = level, xp end end
function bs.on_player_added() local p = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.AddPlayer if p and p.name then bs.player_arrived(p.name) end end
-- Own affliction list, only consulted when the curing package isn't loaded. -- blindness, deafness, insomnia: defences GMCP also lists as afflictions local function not_aff(n) return acs.not_aff ~= nil and acs.not_aff(n) end function bs.on_aff_list() bs.affs = {} for _, a in ipairs(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List or {}) do if not not_aff(a) then bs.affs[a.name or a] = true end end bs.schedule() end function bs.on_aff_add() local a = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add if a and not not_aff(a) then bs.affs[a.name or a] = true end end function bs.on_aff_remove() local r = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove if type(r) == "string" then r = { r } end for _, a in ipairs(r or {}) do bs.affs[a] = nil end bs.schedule() end
bs.on("gmcp.Char.Vitals", bs.on_vitals) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Status", bs.on_status) bs.on("gmcp.Room.Info", bs.on_room_info) bs.on("gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", bs.on_player_added) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Items.List", bs.on_items_list) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Add", bs.on_items_add) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", bs.on_items_remove) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Items.Update", bs.on_items_update) bs.on("gmcp.IRE.Target.Info", bs.on_target_info) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List", bs.on_aff_list) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add", bs.on_aff_add) bs.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", bs.on_aff_remove) bs.on("sysConnectionEvent", function() bs.active, bs.room_num, bs.room, bs.order, bs.affs = false, nil, {}, {}, {} end) bs.on("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg == "BS" then bs.stop("uninstalled") bs.cleanup() end end) acs.gmcp_support({ "Char 1", "Char.Items 1", "Room 1", "IRE.Target 1" })

Script.name: hunting
Script.script:
-- BS hunting: target choice, the queued swing, rage, pickup, health -- thresholds and enemy players.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Pickup
function bs.check_pickup(item) -- RM's auto-pickup handles it (gold included) when it's loaded and on if rm and rm.pickup_on and rm.pickup_on() then return end if not (bs.active or acs.now() < (bs._pickup_until or 0)) then return end if bs.is_mob(item) or bs.picked[item.id] then return end local name = item.name:lower() for _, p in ipairs(bs.settings.pickup) do if name:find(p:lower(), 1, true) then bs.picked[item.id] = true acs.send("get " .. item.id) if bs.settings.stash ~= "" and name:find("sovereign", 1, true) then acs.send(bs.settings.stash) end return end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Targeting
-- Place of a mob in this area's list (1 = attack first), or nil to leave it. function bs.priority(name) name = name:lower() local list = bs.settings.areas[bs.area()] or {} for i, want in ipairs(list) do if name:find(want:lower(), 1, true) then return i end end if #list == 0 and bs.settings.anything then return 1 end end
-- Keeps the current target, except that a shielded one is dropped for an -- unshielded listed mob when there is one (it's razed last, if at all). function bs.pick() local through = (bs.classes[bs.class()] or {}).through local function shielded(id) return bs.shields[id] and not through end local cur = bs.target and bs.is_mob(bs.room[bs.target]) and bs.target or nil local best, bestp, free, freep for _, id in ipairs(bs.order) do local item = bs.room[id] if bs.is_mob(item) and not bs.skip[id] then local p = bs.priority(item.name) if p then if not bestp or p < bestp then best, bestp = id, p end if not shielded(id) and (not freep or p < freep) then free, freep = id, p end end end end -- the mob we left for its shield, once the shield's gone: finish it local back = bs._return_to if back and bs.is_mob(bs.room[back]) and not shielded(back) and back ~= cur then bs._return_to = nil best, free = back, back elseif cur and not (shielded(cur) and free) then return cur end if cur and shielded(cur) and free and free ~= back then bs._return_to = cur end best = free or best if best ~= bs.target then local was = cur and bs.room[cur] bs.target, bs.target_hp, bs.shield = best, nil, best and bs.shields[best] or false bs.taffs = {} if best then local why = not was and "bashing" or bs.shields[cur] and "shielded, switching to" or "back to" bs.echo(why .. " <white>" .. bs.room[best].name .. "<reset> (" .. best .. ")") if bs.settings.settarget then acs.send("st " .. best) end if bs.settings.party then acs.send("pt target: " .. best) end raiseEvent("bs.target", best, bs.room[best].name) end end return best end
function bs.target_gone() local was = bs.room[bs.target] bs.stats.kills = bs.stats.kills + 1 raiseEvent("bs.killed", bs.target, was and was.name) bs.target, bs.target_hp, bs.shield = nil, nil, false end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Building the swing
function bs.attack_cmd(c) return bs.class_part("attack", c) end
function bs.rage_list() return bs.settings.rage[bs.class()] or bs.default_rage[bs.class()] or {} end
local function split(cmd, into) for part in tostring(cmd):gmatch("[^/]+") do part = part:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if part ~= "" then into[#into + 1] = part end end end
-- The commands for one swing at mob id, and which rage ability it uses. -- Shielded: the shield-breaking rage ability plus the attack when there's -- rage for it, otherwise the raze. Otherwise a ready rage ability first, then -- the attack. All in one go, as the old pve alias did. function bs.build(id) local c = bs.context() local cmds, rage_i = {}, nil if bs.settings.stand then cmds[1] = "stand" end for _, w in ipairs(bs.wield_cmds(bs.class_part("wield", c))) do cmds[#cmds + 1] = w end local custom = bs.class_attack[bs.class()] local attack = custom and custom(id, c) or bs.attack_cmd(c) if not attack then return nil end if c.shield then local shatter = bs.class_part("shatter", c) if shatter and c.rage >= bs.shatter_cost then split(shatter, cmds) split(attack, cmds) else split(bs.class_part("raze", c) or attack, cmds) end else local i, r = bs.choose_rage(c.rage, bs.target_hp, bs.vit.hpp or 100) if r then split(r.cmd, cmds) rage_i = i end split(attack, cmds) end for n, cmd in ipairs(cmds) do cmds[n] = (cmd:gsub("&tar", id)) end return cmds, rage_i end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- The queue. One game alias holds the whole swing; it sits on the server -- queue until balance comes back. When the game runs it, bs.swung() starts -- the rage cooldown and the next swing is queued straight away.
bs.ALIAS = "bsbash"
function bs.queue_swing(cmds, rage_i) local text = table.concat(cmds, "/") bs._queued_rage = rage_i if bs._queued and text == bs._queued_text then return end local qtype = bs.settings.qtype local ok if qm and qm.queue then ok = qm.queue(cmds, { type = qtype, mode = "addclear", key = "bash", on_run = function() bs.swung() end }) else ok = text == bs._alias_text or acs.send("setalias " .. bs.ALIAS .. " " .. text) if ok then bs._alias_text = text end if ok and not bs._queued then ok = acs.send("queue addclear " .. qtype .. " " .. bs.ALIAS) end end if not ok then -- not marked as queued, so the next prompt or GMCP update tries again bs._queued, bs._queued_text = false, nil if not bs._send_warned then bs._send_warned = true local why = acs.online and not acs.online() and "ACS hasn't seen you log in yet; it sends once GMCP vitals arrive" or "the queue command didn't go out (acs debug on shows why)" bs.err("couldn't queue the swing: " .. why) end return end bs._send_warned = false bs._queued, bs._queued_text = true, text end
function bs.clear_swing() if not bs._queued then return end bs._queued, bs._queued_text = false, nil if qm and qm.clear then qm.clear(bs.settings.qtype) else acs.send("clearqueue " .. bs.settings.qtype) end end
function bs.swung() bs._queued, bs._queued_text = false, nil if bs._queued_rage then local r = bs.rage_list()[bs._queued_rage] if r then bs._rage_cd[bs.class() .. bs._queued_rage] = acs.now() + (r.cd or 0) if r.aff then bs.mob_aff(r.aff) end end bs._queued_rage = nil end bs.schedule() end
-- Without QM, watch for the game running our alias. bs.trigger([[^\[System\]: Running queued \S+ command: BSBASH]], function() if not (qm and qm.queue) then bs.swung() end end)
-- Something the swing depends on changed (shield, target health, class state). function bs.changed() bs.schedule() end
-- Why we're holding the swing, or nil. function bs.blocked() for _, a in ipairs(bs.settings.pause_affs) do if bs.has(a) then return a end end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Start, stop, leave
function bs.listed_here() for _, id in ipairs(bs.order) do local item = bs.room[id] if bs.is_mob(item) and bs.priority(item.name) then return true end end return false end
function bs.start() if not bs.settings.stayon and not bs.listed_here() then bs.echo("nothing here is on " .. bs.area() .. "'s list: 'bs room' shows the mobs, 'bs add NAME' adds one") return end bs.active, bs._warned, bs._cleared, bs.skip, bs.picked = true, false, false, {}, {} bs.stats.since = bs.stats.since or acs.now() bs.echo("<green>hunting<reset> in <white>" .. bs.area() .. "<reset>, attack: " .. tostring(bs.attack_cmd())) if #(bs.settings.areas[bs.area()] or {}) == 0 and not bs.settings.anything then bs.echo("no targets listed for " .. bs.area() .. " yet: 'bs room' to add some") end for _, cmd in ipairs(bs.class_part("prep") or {}) do acs.send(cmd) end for _, id in ipairs(bs.order) do bs.check_pickup(bs.room[id]) end raiseEvent("bs.started") bs.schedule() end
function bs.stop(why) if not bs.active then return end bs.clear_swing() bs.active, bs.target = false, nil bs._pickup_until = acs.now() + 3 -- the last kill's gold can land just after bs.echo("<red>stopped<reset>" .. (why and (" (" .. why .. ")") or "")) local s = bs.stats bs.echo(("%d kills, %d gold, %.2f%% xp so far"):format(s.kills, s.gold, s.xp)) raiseEvent("bs.stopped", why) end
function bs.back_dir() if rm and rm.back_dir then return rm.back_dir() or bs.back end return bs.back end
function bs.flee(why) bs.stop(why) local s = bs.settings local cmd = s.flee_cmd ~= "" and s.flee_cmd or bs.back_dir() if cmd then -- clears whatever was queued and goes as soon as balance allows if qm and qm.queue then qm.queue(cmd, { type = "eqbal", mode = "addclear", key = "flee" }) else acs.send("queue addclear eqbal " .. cmd) end bs.echo("<red>leaving (" .. why .. "): " .. cmd) else bs.err("no way out known (" .. why .. "); set one with 'bs flee command'") end raiseEvent("bs.fled", why, cmd) end
function bs.is_enemy(name) if pt and pt.is_enemy then return pt.is_enemy(name) end return false end
function bs.player_arrived(name) if not (bs.active and bs.is_enemy(name)) then return end local act = bs.settings.on_enemy if act == "flee" then bs.flee("enemy " .. name) elseif act == "pause" then bs.stop("enemy " .. name .. " arrived") end end
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
function bs.tick() if not bs.active then return end local s, hpp = bs.settings, bs.vit.hpp if hpp <= s.flee_at then bs.flee("health " .. hpp .. "%") return end if hpp <= s.warn_at then if not bs._warned then bs._warned = true bs.echo("<yellow>health " .. hpp .. "%") raiseEvent("bs.warn", hpp) end else bs._warned = false end local id = bs.pick() if not id then bs.clear_swing() if not bs._cleared then bs._cleared = true bs.echo("room clear") raiseEvent("bs.clear", bs.area()) if not s.stayon then bs.stop("room clear") end end return end bs._cleared = false if bs.blocked() then return end local cmds, rage_i = bs.build(id) if not cmds then bs.err("no attack for " .. bs.class() .. ": set one with 'bs attack command'") bs.stop("no attack set") return end bs.queue_swing(cmds, rage_i) end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- BS commands. "bs" on its own starts or stops hunting; "bs help" lists the rest.
function bs.show(title, list) bs.echo("<white>" .. title .. "<reset>: " .. (#list > 0 and table.concat(list, ", ") or "<dim_grey>none")) end
function bs.find_entry(list, w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if n and list[n] then return n end local name = table.concat(w, " "):lower() for i, v in ipairs(list) do if v:lower() == name then return i end end end
-- The core treats a bare "bs" as "bs help"; make it the start/stop toggle. local dispatch = bs.run function bs.run(line) if acs.words(line)[1] == nil then if bs.active then bs.stop("by hand") else bs.start() end return end dispatch(line) end
bs.command("on", function() bs.start() end, "on|off start or stop hunting (or just: bs; bstart/bstop too)") bs.command("off", function() bs.stop("by hand") end)
-- The old pve aliases, for muscle memory. bs.alias([[^bstart$]], function() bs.start() end) bs.alias([[^bstop$]], function() bs.stop("by hand") end) bs.alias([[^bget$]], function() bs.run("room") end)
bs.command("status", function() local s = bs.settings local t = bs.target and bs.room[bs.target] bs.echo(("%s<reset> | area <white>%s<reset> | class <white>%s<reset> | attack <white>%s"):format( bs.active and "<green>HUNTING" or "<red>idle", bs.area(), bs.class(), tostring(bs.attack_cmd()))) if bs.target then local cmds = bs.build(bs.target) if cmds then bs.echo("next swing: " .. table.concat(cmds, "/") .. (bs.shield and " <yellow>(shielded)" or "")) end end bs.echo(("warn %d%% | leave %d%% via %s | enemy: %s | target: %s"):format(s.warn_at, s.flee_at, s.flee_cmd ~= "" and s.flee_cmd or ("way back (" .. tostring(bs.back_dir()) .. ")"), s.on_enemy, t and (t.name .. " (" .. bs.target .. ")" .. (bs.target_hp and (" " .. bs.target_hp ..
