"%") or "")) or "none")) local why = bs.active and bs.target and bs.blocked() if why then bs.echo("waiting: " .. why) end end, "status area, target, thresholds, attack")
-- Like the old bget: each mob is a link that adds it to (green: removes it -- from) this area's list. function bs.toggle_mob(name) local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, { name:lower() }) if i then table.remove(list, i) bs.echo("<red>removed<reset> " .. name) else list[#list + 1] = name:lower() bs.echo("<green>added<reset> " .. name .. " (#" .. #list .. ")") end bs.save_settings() bs.schedule() end
bs.command("room", function() local any = false bs.echo("<white>mobs in " .. bs.area() .. "<reset> (click to add or remove)") for _, id in ipairs(bs.order) do local item = bs.room[id] if bs.is_mob(item) then any = true local p = bs.priority(item.name) local col = id == bs.target and "<red>" or p and "<green>" or "<grey>" local label = "\n " .. col .. item.name .. "<reset> (" .. id .. ")" .. (p and (" #" .. p) or "") if cechoLink then cechoLink(label, function() bs.toggle_mob(item.name) end, (p and "remove " or "add ") .. item.name, true) else cecho(label) end end end if not any then cecho("\n <dim_grey>none") end end, "room mobs here; click one to add or remove it (old bget)")
bs.command("add", function(w) local name = table.concat(w, " "):lower() if name == "" then bs.err("usage: bs add mob name") return end local list = bs.area_list() if bs.find_entry(list, w) then bs.echo(name .. " is already on the list") return end list[#list + 1] = name bs.save_settings() bs.echo("added <white>" .. name .. "<reset> to " .. bs.area() .. " (#" .. #list .. ")") bs.schedule() end, "add mob name add to this area's targets (part of the name is enough)")
function bs.del(w) local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, w) if not i then bs.err("not on this area's list") return end bs.echo("removed " .. table.remove(list, i)) bs.save_settings() end bs.command("del", bs.del, "del mob name|# remove from this area's targets") bs.command("remove", bs.del)
bs.command("up", function(w) local list = bs.area_list() local i = bs.find_entry(list, w) if not i then bs.err("not on this area's list") return end if i > 1 then list[i - 1], list[i] = list[i], list[i - 1] bs.save_settings() end bs.run("list") end, "up mob name|# attack it before the one above it")
bs.command("list", function(w) local area = #w > 0 and table.concat(w, " ") or bs.area() local r = {} for i, v in ipairs(bs.settings.areas[area] or {}) do r[#r + 1] = i .. "." .. v end bs.show("targets in " .. area, r) end, "list [area] this (or another) area's targets, in order")
bs.command("areas", function() local r = {} for _, a in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(bs.settings.areas)) do local n = #bs.settings.areas[a] if n > 0 then r[#r + 1] = a .. " (" .. n .. ")" end end bs.show("areas", r) end, "areas areas that have target lists")
-- attack / raze / shatter / wield: per-class overrides of 05_classes. local function part_cmd(part, needs_tar, help) bs.command(part, function(w, rest) local cls, key = bs.class(), part .. "s" local cmd = rest or "" if cmd ~= "" then if cmd == "default" then cmd = nil elseif needs_tar and cmd ~= "none" and not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end bs.settings[key][cls] = cmd bs.save_settings() bs.changed() end bs.echo(part .. " for " .. cls .. ": " .. tostring(bs.class_part(part))) end, help) end part_cmd("attack", true, "attack [command|default] this class's attack; &tar = the mob (added at the end if left out)") part_cmd("raze", true, "raze [command|default] what to hit a shielded mob with") part_cmd("shatter", true, "shatter [command|none|default] rage ability that breaks shields (needs 17 rage)") part_cmd("wield", false, "wield [left, right|none|default] weapons each swing wields, e.g. shield, blackjack")
bs.command("prep", function(w, rest) local cls = bs.class() if rest == "default" then bs.settings.preps[cls] = nil elseif rest == "none" then bs.settings.preps[cls] = {} elseif rest and rest ~= "" then local t = {} for c in rest:gmatch("[^|]+") do t[#t + 1] = (c:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end bs.settings.preps[cls] = t end bs.save_settings() bs.show("sent when you start, for " .. cls, bs.class_part("prep") or {}) end, "prep cmd|cmd|none|default commands sent when you start hunting")
local function toggle(key, label, help) bs.command(key, function(w) local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s[key] = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s[key] = false else s[key] = not s[key] end bs.save_settings() bs.echo(label .. ": " .. (s[key] and "on" or "off")) end, help) end toggle("stayon", "keep hunting as you walk", "stayon on|off on: hunting stays on as you walk; off: stops when a room is done") toggle("settarget", "st ID on each new target", "settarget on|off 'st ID' on each new target (gives its health)") toggle("party", "pt target: ID on each new target", "party on|off tell your party each new target") toggle("stand", "stand before each swing", "stand on|off put 'stand' at the front of each swing")
bs.command("qtype", function(w) if w[1] then bs.settings.qtype = w[1] bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("swings queue as: " .. bs.settings.qtype) end, "qtype TYPE server queue type for swings (default freestand, as pve)")
bs.command("stash", function(w, rest) if rest == "none" then bs.settings.stash = "" elseif rest and rest ~= "" then bs.settings.stash = rest end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("after picking up gold: " .. (bs.settings.stash ~= "" and bs.settings.stash or "nothing")) end, "stash command|none send after picking up gold, e.g. put sovereigns in pack")
bs.command("rage", function(w) local cls, s = bs.class(), bs.settings if w[1] == "add" and tonumber(w[2]) and tonumber(w[3]) and w[4] then local cmd = table.concat(w, " ", 4) if not cmd:find("&tar") then cmd = cmd .. " &tar" end s.rage[cls] = s.rage[cls] or acs.copy(bs.default_rage[cls] or {}) table.insert(s.rage[cls], { cost = tonumber(w[2]), cd = tonumber(w[3]), cmd = cmd }) bs.save_settings() elseif w[1] == "clear" then s.rage[cls] = {} bs.save_settings() elseif w[1] == "default" then s.rage[cls] = nil bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "low" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.rage_low = tonumber(w[2]) bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "defend" and tonumber(w[2]) then s.rage_defend = tonumber(w[2]) bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "fear" then s.rage_fear = w[2] == "on" bs.save_settings() end if w[1] == "extra" and w[2] then s.rage_extra[w[2]] = not s.rage_extra[w[2]] or nil bs.save_settings() end local r = {} for _, x in ipairs(bs.rage_list()) do local what = x.kind == "aff" and x.aff or x.kind == "cond" and ("needs " .. table.concat(x.needs, "/")) or x.kind or (bs.rage_damages(x) and "dmg" or "?") r[#r + 1] = x.cmd .. " (" .. x.cost .. "/" .. x.cd .. "s " .. what .. ")" end bs.show(("rage for %s (none under %d%% mob health, defensive under %d%% yours, fear %s)"):format( cls, s.rage_low, s.rage_defend, s.rage_fear and "on" or "off"), r) local ex = acs.sorted_keys(s.rage_extra) if #ex > 0 then bs.echo("also using rage for: " .. table.concat(ex, ", ")) end end, { "rage add COST COOLDOWN command battlerage ability for this class", "rage | bs rage clear | bs rage default list, remove all, or go back to the defaults", "rage low PCT no rage on a mob under this health (default 15)", "rage defend PCT under this health of yours, stun/weaken/etc first (default 60)", "rage fear on|off use fear abilities (off: feared mobs run away)", "rage extra AFF also spend rage giving AFF (inhibit, recklessness...); again to undo" })
bs.command("pickup", function(w) local list = bs.settings.pickup local text = table.concat(w, " ", 2):lower() if w[1] == "add" and text ~= "" then list[#list + 1] = text bs.save_settings() elseif (w[1] == "del" or w[1] == "remove") and text ~= "" then for i, v in ipairs(list) do if v == text then table.remove(list, i) break end end bs.save_settings() end bs.show("pick up", list) end, "pickup [add|del text] what to pick up (gold by default)")
bs.command("warn", function(w) local v = tonumber(w[1]) if v then bs.settings.warn_at = v bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("warn at " .. bs.settings.warn_at .. "% health") end, "warn PCT warn once at this health percent")
bs.command("flee", function(w, rest) local s, v = bs.settings, tonumber(w[1]) if v then s.flee_at = v elseif w[1] == "back" then s.flee_cmd = "" elseif w[1] then s.flee_cmd = rest end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("leave at " .. s.flee_at .. "% health via " .. (s.flee_cmd ~= "" and s.flee_cmd or "the way you came")) end, { "flee PCT stop and leave at this health percent", "flee command | bs flee back how to leave (default: the way you came)" })
bs.command("enemy", function(w) if w[1] == "pause" or w[1] == "flee" or w[1] == "ignore" then bs.settings.on_enemy = w[1] bs.save_settings() end bs.echo("when an enemy arrives: " .. bs.settings.on_enemy) end, "enemy pause|flee|ignore what to do when an enemy (people tracker) arrives")
bs.command("anything", function(w) local s = bs.settings if w[1] == "on" then s.anything = true elseif w[1] == "off" then s.anything = false else s.anything = not s.anything end bs.save_settings() bs.echo("attack anything in areas without a list: " .. (s.anything and "on" or "off")) bs.schedule() end, "anything on|off attack any mob in areas with no list")
bs.command("skip", function() if not bs.target then bs.echo("no target") return end bs.skip[bs.target] = true bs.target, bs.shield = nil, false bs.schedule() end, "skip leave the current target alone in this room")
bs.command("stats", function(w) if w[1] == "reset" then bs.stats = { kills = 0, gold = 0, xp = 0, since = bs.active and acs.now() or nil } end local s = bs.stats local mins = s.since and math.max(1, math.floor((acs.now() - s.since) / 60)) or 0 bs.echo(("%d kills, <yellow>%d gold<reset>, %.2f%% xp in %d min"):format(s.kills, s.gold, s.xp or 0, mins)) end, "stats [reset] kills, gold and xp since you started")

Script.name: classes
Script.script:
-- BS class data, ported from AW's old "pve" bashing scripts. -- -- Each class can have: -- attack(c) the normal swing: a string, or a function of the context c -- and returning a string ("a/b" = two commands in one go) -- raze what to use on a shielded mob when rage is short -- shatter rage ability that breaks shields (used when rage allows, -- followed by the normal attack) -- wield "left, right" as the old weaponscheck took it: "shield, -- blackjack", "bastard, both", "nothing, nothing", "same, same" -- prep commands sent once when you start hunting -- through true: the attack goes through shields, so ignore them -- The context c: hp (target health %), shield, spec ("dual cutting" ...), -- stance, rage, state (class flags from triggers, see bs.cstate). -- "&tar" is replaced by the mob's id. "bs attack/raze/wield/prep ..." -- override any of it per class.
bs.cstate = bs.cstate or {}
local function knight(c) local spec = c.spec or "" if spec == "sword and shield" then return "combination &tar slice smash", "combination &tar raze smash", "longsword, shield" end if spec == "dual blunt" then return "doublewhirl &tar", "fracture &tar", "flail, flail" end if spec == "two handed" then return "battlefury focus speed/slaughter &tar", "battlefury focus speed/carve &tar", "bastard, both" end return "dsl &tar", "rsl &tar", nil end
bs.classes = { runewarden = { attack = function(c) return (knight(c)) end, raze = function(c) local _, r = knight(c) return r end, wield = function(c) local _, _, w = knight(c) return w or "scimitar532696, scimitar567131" end, shatter = "fragment &tar", }, unnamable = { attack = function(c) return (knight(c)) end, raze = function(c) local _, r = knight(c) return r end, wield = function(c) local _, _, w = knight(c) return w or "scimitar532696, scimitar567131" end, shatter = "unnamable sunder &tar", }, infernal = { attack = function(c) return (knight(c)) end, raze = function(c) local _, r = knight(c) return r end, wield = function(c) local _, _, w = knight(c) return w end, }, paladin = { attack = function(c) return (knight(c)) end, raze = function(c) local _, r = knight(c) return r end, wield = "scimitar, scimitar", shatter = "faithrend &tar", }, jester = { attack = function(c) return c.hp <= 50 and "gallowshumour &tar" or "bop &tar" end, raze = "badjoke", shatter = "throw jacks at &tar", wield = "shield, blackjack", }, monk = { attack = "combo &tar sdk ucp ucp", raze = "combo &tar rhk ucp ucp", shatter = "spk &tar", wield = "nothing, nothing" }, waterlord = { attack = "warp &tar", raze = "command gremlin at &tar", shatter = "spk &tar", wield = "shield, nothing" }, dragon = { attack = "incantation &tar", raze = "tailsmash &tar", shatter = "psishatter &tar", wield = "shield, nothing" }, serpent = { attack = "garrote &tar", raze = "flay &tar shield", shatter = "excoriate &tar", wield = "shield, lash522550" }, magi = { attack = "staffcast lightning at &tar", raze = "cast erode at &tar", shatter = "cast disintegrate at &tar", wield = "shield, staff" }, pariah = { attack = "epitaph advance &tar", raze = "trace fissure &tar", shatter = "accursed scour &tar", wield = "knife, shield", prep = { "epitaph focus serpent skein sun", "crux let me" }, }, depthswalker = { attack = "reap &tar", raze = "kneel &tar", shatter = "intone nakail &tar" }, sentinel = { attack = function(c) if c.hp >= 100 then return "bushwhack wolf at &tar" end if c.hp <= 33 then return "skullbash &tar" end return "doublestrike &tar" end, raze = "rivestrike &tar", shatter = "bore &tar", wield = "shield, spear", }, occultist = { attack = function(c) return c.hp >= 100 and "attend &tar" or "command hound at &tar" end, raze = "command gremlin at &tar", shatter = "ruin &tar", wield = "shield, nothing", }, bard = { attack = function(c) if c.stance ~= "heart's fury" then return "heartsfury" end return "tunesmith rapier accentato/jab &tar" end, -- Bards have no weaponry raze; punctuate strips rebounding, then shields raze = "blade punctuate &tar", shatter = "play resonance at &tar", wield = "shield, rapier", }, blademaster = { attack = function(c) if c.stance ~= "arash" then return "arash" end return "infuse fire/drawslash &tar sternum" end, raze = "raze &tar", shatter = "shin shatter &tar", wield = "nothing, nothing", }, shaman = { attack = function(c) return c.state.canjinx and "jinx bleed bleed &tar" or "curse &tar bleed" end, through = true, wield = "shield, nothing", }, psion = { attack = function(c) return c.state.trans and "psi shatter &tar/weave flurry &tar" or "weave flurry &tar" end, raze = function(c) return c.state.trans and "psi splinter &tar/weave flurry &tar" or "weave cleave &tar" end, shatter = "weave pulverise &tar", wield = "shield, nothing", }, -- Not in pve; from the wiki's skill pages (denizen attacks and shield strips). priest = { attack = "smite &tar", raze = "angel strip &tar" }, alchemist = { attack = "educe iron &tar", raze = "educe copper &tar" }, sylvan = { attack = "thornrend &tar", raze = "cast shear at &tar" }, druid = { attack = "grove thornlash &tar" }, apostate = { attack = "deadeyes &tar bleed bleed", through = true, wield = "shield, nothing" }, }
-- Class flags the attacks look at, from the old pve triggers. bs.cstate_lines = { { [[^Summoning your malign power, you direct a twin assault of the curses]], "canjinx", false }, { [[Your malign power may be unleashed in the form of a jinx against your victim\.]], "canjinx", true }, { [[Your body and mind fall out of their transcendent state\.]], "trans", false }, { [[Your body and mind continue to harmonise: ]], "trans", false }, { [[Your inaction causes the harmonisation of your body and mind to falter:]], "trans", false }, { [[You have achieved transcendence: your body and mind operate as one\.]], "trans", true }, { [[Your body and mind are in perfect harmony; transcendence is yours\.]], "trans", true }, } for _, l in ipairs(bs.cstate_lines) do bs.trigger(l[1], function() bs.cstate[l[2]] = l[3] bs.changed() end) end
-- What a setting or class entry gives for this context. local function value(v, c) if type(v) == "function" then return v(c) end return v end
function bs.context() local st = bs.vit.stats or {} return { hp = bs.target_hp or 100, rage = bs.vit.rage or 0, shield = bs.shield == true and not (bs.classes[bs.class()] or {}).through, spec = st.spec, stance = st.stance, state = bs.cstate, } end
-- part = "attack", "raze", "shatter", "wield" or "prep" function bs.class_part(part, c) local cls = bs.class() local over = bs.settings[part .. "s"] and bs.settings[part .. "s"][cls] if over == "none" then return nil end if over then return over end if part == "attack" and bs.default_attacks[cls] and not bs.classes[cls] then return bs.default_attacks[cls] end local def = bs.classes[cls] return def and value(def[part], c or bs.context()) end
-- The old weaponscheck: "left, right" -> wield commands. function bs.wield_cmds(w) if not w or w == "" then return {} end local w1, w2 = w:match("^%s*(.-)%s*,%s*(.-)%s*$") if not w1 then return { "wield " .. w } end if w1 == "same" and w2 == "same" then return {} end if w2 == "both" then return { "wield " .. w1 } end if w1 == "nothing" and w2 == "nothing" then return { "unwield all" } end if w1 == "nothing" then return { "wield right " .. w2, "unwield left" } end if w2 == "nothing" then return { "wield left " .. w1, "unwield right" } end return { "wield " .. w1 .. " " .. w2 } end

Script.name: shield
Script.script:
-- BS shield tracking for the mob you're bashing, from the old pve triggers. -- A shielded target gets the class's raze (or its shield-breaking rage -- ability when there's rage for it) until a line says the shield is gone.
bs.shield_up_lines = { [[^A nearly invisible magical shield forms around (.*)\.$]], [[^A dizzying beam of energy strikes you as your attack rebounds off of (.*)'s shield\.$]], }
-- (.*) is the mob; lines without one count for whatever you're hitting. bs.shield_down_lines = { [[^You raze (.*)'s magical shield with .*\.$]], [[^The ordered barriers of (.*) stand before you\. Thus, they are sundered\.$]], [[^You whip .* through the air in front of (.*), to no effect\.$]], [[^Your rage is wasted as (.*) is not protected by a shield\.$]], [[^(.*) slaps you on the cheek\.$]], [[^You say in a monotone voice, ]], [[^A savage slash of your knife trails crimson fire as you carve the logograph of the fissure into the air before (.*)\.$]], [[^You flick your hand towards (.*), and a sheet of sand rises to scour the magical shield surrounding \w+\.$]], [[^You weave a great warhammer into being and with an overhand swing obliterate the magical shield surrounding (.*)\.$]], [[^You bring a translucent battleaxe in a powerful overhead blow down upon (.*)\.$]], [[^You strike at (.*)'s translucent shield with .*, drawing the outline of a rough rune that detonates, consuming the shield\.$]], [[^You deliver a single, powerful blow against the magical shield surrounding (.*), fracturing it\.$]], [[^You lurch forward at (.*), swinging .* in a wildly innacurate blow\.$]], [[^You hum a low note at (.*), causing \w+ translucent shield to shatter as it resonates with the power of your voice\.$]], [[^You unleash a burst of Shin energy at (.*), tearing apart \w+ translucent shield\.$]], [[^You blast (.*) with psychic energy, demolishing \w+ translucent shield\.$]], [[^You flick your tail at (.*), dismissively brushing aside the paltry shield protecting \w+\.$]], [[^Your cantata shatters the magical shield surrounding (.*)\.$]], [[^You summon a whirlwind of flame around (.*) which consumes \w+ translucent shield\.$]], [[^You cast a spell of erosion at (.*)\.$]], [[^A warhammer comes into being in \S+'s hands, and with an almighty overhand swing \w+ annihilates the magical shield surrounding .*\.$]], [[^You throw a handful of small metallic jacks at (.*), the sharpened points shredding \w+ translucent shield\.$]], [[^You command your gremlin to shatter the defences surrounding (.*)\.$]], [[^You gesture in a slashing motion at (.*), and small tears form in \w+ translucent shield as chaos rips it apart\.$]], [[^The magical shield surrounding (.*) fades away\.$]], [[^Lunging forward, you bring .* down in a savage diagonal blow, carving through (.*)'s magical shield\.$]], [[^You thrust forward with a .*, piercing through (.*)'s shield\.$]], [[^You thrust a .* towards (.*)\.$]], [[^As your kick strikes the magical shield surrounding (.*), it bursts into shimmering fragments\.$]], [[^With a baying howl a chaos hound leaps upon (.*), ripping the magical shield surrounding \w+ to tatters with its claws\.$]], [[^(.*) has no shield to shatter\.$]], [[^You lash out at (.*) with your whip, stripping \w+ translucent shield\.$]], [[^You flay away (.*)'s shield defence\.$]], }
-- Is this name (from a line) the mob we're bashing? function bs.is_target_name(name) local t = bs.target and bs.room[bs.target] if not t or not name then return false end return t.name:lower() == name:lower() end
function bs.set_shield(up) if bs.target then bs.shields[bs.target] = up or nil end if bs.shield == up then return end bs.shield = up bs.debug("target shield " .. (up and "up" or "down")) bs.changed() end
for _, p in ipairs(bs.shield_up_lines) do bs.trigger(p, function(m) if bs.is_target_name(m[2]) then bs.set_shield(true) end end) end -- A shield came down on some other mob in the room (it attacked you, or it -- faded): forget it, and bs.pick() goes back to it if we'd left it. function bs.unshield_name(name) name = name:lower() for id in pairs(bs.shields) do if bs.room[id] and bs.room[id].name:lower() == name then bs.shields[id] = nil end end bs.changed() end
for _, p in ipairs(bs.shield_down_lines) do bs.trigger(p, function(m) if not bs.active then return end if not m[2] or bs.is_target_name(m[2]) then bs.set_shield(false) else bs.unshield_name(m[2]) end end) end

Script.name: battlerage
panel
Script.script:
-- GUI: one Geyser panel for the ACS system. It draws what the other -- packages already know (SS curing, AR offense, PT people, RM room, IN -- inventory) and falls back to plain GMCP for anything whose package isn't -- loaded, so it works on its own too. It never sends commands to the game -- except when you click a name (which runs your own "t <name>" alias). -- -- Everything is read through gui.data (below), so the windows don't care -- where a value came from.
gui = gui or {} gui.version = "0.1.0"
gui.M = acs.module("gui", { prefix = "gui" }) gui.M.title = "GUI" local M = gui.M
-- The panel: the mapper's map across the top, and under it a 2x2 grid: -- self (your vitals, balances, affs, defs) | target (enemy status, attackers) -- room (room, exits, players) | mobs (only while bashing) -- A box that's off, or the mobs box while you aren't bashing, gives its -- space to the box beside it. "map" holds the mapper's map, not text. gui.box_names = { "map", "self", "target", "room", "mobs" } gui.grid = { { "self", "target" }, { "room", "mobs" } } gui.LAYOUT = 2 -- bump when the default layout changes; old saved layouts are reset
gui.default_settings = { on = true, layout = gui.LAYOUT, side = "right", -- right | left width = 35, -- percent of the Mudlet window map_height = 50, -- percent of the panel's height for the map font = 9, font_name = "", -- empty: Mudlet's default monospace font boxes = { map = { on = true }, self = { on = true }, target = { on = true }, room = { on = true }, mobs = { on = true }, }, click_target = true, -- clicking a player in the room box runs "t <name>" colors = { bg = "#101014", border = "#2a2a33", frame = "#56688c", title = "#8aa0c8", hp = "#b33a3a", mp = "#3a5fb3", ep = "#3a9a4a", wp = "#9a7a2a", }, } gui.settings = acs.store("gui", gui.default_settings)
function gui.save() acs.save("gui") end
-- Saved settings from the old stacked layout: keep side, font, colours and -- click, take the new layout's boxes, width and map size. function gui.migrate() local st = gui.settings if st.layout == gui.LAYOUT then return end for _, k in ipairs({ "boxes", "width", "map_height", "vitals_height", "supplies", "low" }) do st[k] = nil end acs.merge_defaults(st, gui.default_settings) st.layout = gui.LAYOUT gui.save() end function gui.echo(msg) acs.echo(msg, "gui") end function gui.err(msg) acs.err(msg, "gui") end function gui.debug(msg) acs.debug(msg, "gui") end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Own GMCP state, used only when SS / RM / IN aren't loaded.
gui.g = gui.g or { affs = {}, defs = {} } local G = gui.g
function G.names_of(list) local r = {} for _, it in ipairs(list or {}) do if type(it) == "table" and it.name then r[acs.norm(it.name)] = true end end return r end
-- blindness, deafness, insomnia: defences GMCP also lists as afflictions local function not_aff(n) return acs.not_aff ~= nil and acs.not_aff(n) end function G.on_affs_list() G.affs = G.names_of(gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List) for n in pairs(G.affs) do if not_aff(n) then G.affs[n] = nil end end end function G.on_affs_add() local a = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add if a and a.name and not not_aff(a.name) then G.affs[acs.norm(a.name)] = true end end function G.on_affs_remove() local r = gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove for _, n in ipairs(type(r) == "table" and r or { r }) do G.affs[acs.norm(type(n) == "table" and n.name or n) or ""] = nil end end function G.on_defs_list() G.defs = G.names_of(gmcp.Char.Defences.List) end function G.on_defs_add() local d = gmcp.Char.Defences.Add if d and d.name then G.defs[acs.norm(d.name)] = true end end function G.on_defs_remove() local r = gmcp.Char.Defences.Remove for _, n in ipairs(type(r) == "table" and r or { r }) do G.defs[acs.norm(type(n) == "table" and n.name or n) or ""] = nil end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- gui.data: one function per thing the windows show.
gui.data = gui.data or {} local D = gui.data
function G.num(v) return tonumber(v) end
-- { hp = {cur, max}, mp = ..., ep = ..., wp = ..., bal, eq, nl, stats } function D.vitals() local v = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Vitals or {} local r = { bal = tostring(v.bal) == "1", eq = tostring(v.eq) == "1", nl = G.num(v.nl), stats = {} } for _, k in ipairs({ "hp", "mp", "ep", "wp" }) do r[k] = { cur = G.num(v[k]) or 0, max = G.num(v["max" .. k]) or 0 } end for _, st in ipairs(type(v.charstats) == "table" and v.charstats or {}) do local k, val = tostring(st):match("^%s*([^:]+):%s*(.-)%s*$") if k then r.stats[k:lower()] = val end end return r end
-- Curing balances SS tracks: list of { name, ready } (empty without SS). D.cure_bals = { "herb", "salve", "smoke", "sip", "moss", "focus", "tree" } function D.balances() local r = {} if not (ss and ss.bals) then return r end for _, b in ipairs(D.cure_bals) do r[#r + 1] = { name = b, ready = ss.bals[b] ~= false } end return r end
-- Own afflictions, sorted; SS's view (includes ones only seen in text) if loaded. function D.affs() local src = (ss and ss.affs) or G.affs return acs.sorted_keys(src) end
-- Defences: { up = sorted list, missing = sorted list or nil (needs SS keepup) } function D.defs() local src = (ss and ss.defs) or G.defs local up = {} for _, d in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(src)) do if src[d] then up[#up + 1] = d end end local missing if ss and ss.keepup and ss.keepup.missing then local ok, m = pcall(ss.keepup.missing) if ok then missing = m end end return { up = up, missing = missing } end
-- Target: { name, class, city, color, relation, hp, affs, chances = {{aff, pct, on}}, -- defs, limbs = {{limb, pct}}, parrying, lock, outs, here, bals } or nil. -- Class and city come from PT when AR hasn't seen the class itself. function D.target() if ar and ar.enemy and ar.enemy.name then local EN = ar.enemy local lock, outs if EN.lock_info then lock, outs = EN.lock_info() end local here = true if ar.target and ar.target.here then here = ar.target.here() end local bals = {} if EN.bal_left then for _, k in ipairs({ "eat", "apply", "smoke", "focus", "tree" }) do bals[#bals + 1] = { name = k, left = EN.bal_left(k), can = EN.can and EN.can(k) } end end -- every aff that might be on, with AR's chance: most likely first local chances = {} for aff, pct in pairs(EN.prob or {}) do chances[#chances + 1] = { aff = aff, pct = pct, on = EN.affs[aff] ~= nil } end table.sort(chances, function(a, b) if a.on ~= b.on then return a.on end if a.pct ~= b.pct then return a.pct > b.pct end return a.aff < b.aff end) local limbs = {} for _, k in ipairs(acs.sorted_keys(EN.limbs or {})) do if (EN.limbs[k] or 0) > 0 then limbs[#limbs + 1] = { limb = k, pct = EN.limbs[k] } end end local who = D.person(EN.name) return { name = EN.name, class = EN.class or who.class, city = who.city, color = who.color, relation = who.relation, hp = ar.target and ar.target.hp, affs = acs.sorted_keys(EN.affs), chances = chances, defs = acs.sorted_keys(EN.defs), limbs = limbs, parrying = EN.parrying, lock = lock, outs = outs, here = here, bals = bals, } end local t = gmcp.IRE and gmcp.IRE.Target if t and t.Set and t.Set ~= "" then local info = t.Info or {} local hp = G.num((tostring(info.hpperc or ""):gsub("%%", ""))) local who = D.person(tostring(t.Set)) return { name = tostring(t.Set), class = who.class, city = who.city, color = who.color, relation = who.relation, hp = hp, affs = {}, chances = {}, defs = {}, limbs = {}, here = true, bals = {}, plain = true } end return nil end
-- The mapper's walk in progress: { dest, steps_left } or nil. function D.walking() if rm and rm.walking then return rm.walking() end if type(mmp) == "table" and mmp.autowalking then local path, dirs = mmp.speedWalkPath or {}, mmp.speedWalkDir or {} return { dest = tonumber(path[#path]), steps_left = math.max(0, #dirs - math.max(1, mmp.speedWalkCounter or 1) + 1) } end end
-- Room: { name, num, area, exits = {dirs}, players = {names}, mobs = {{name, n}}, walk } function D.room() local r = { players = {}, mobs = {}, exits = {}, walk = D.walking() } if rm and rm.room then r.name, r.num, r.area = rm.room.name, rm.room.num, rm.room.area for _, e in ipairs(rm.exit_list and rm.exit_list() or {}) do r.exits[#r.exits + 1] = e.dir end r.players = rm.player_list and rm.player_list() or {} if rm.grouped and rm.denizens then r.mobs = rm.grouped(rm.denizens(true)) end return r end local info = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Info or {} r.name, r.num, r.area = info.name, G.num(info.num), info.area r.exits = acs.sorted_keys(type(info.exits) == "table" and info.exits or {}) local me = acs.me.name and acs.me.name:lower() for _, p in ipairs(gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Players or {}) do if p.name and p.name:lower() ~= me then r.players[#r.players + 1] = p.name end end table.sort(r.players) return r end
-- How a player's name is drawn: colour, relation, short info. Uses PT when loaded. function D.person(name) if pt and pt.color then local p = pt.get and pt.get(name) or nil return { name = p and p.name or name, color = pt.color(name), relation = pt.relation and pt.relation(name) or "neutral", city = p and p.city, class = p and p.class, } end return { name = name, color = "yellow", relation = "neutral" } end
-- Attackers from SS: list of { name, class, city, hits, last, affs }. function D.attackers() if ss and ss.attackers and ss.attackers.list then local ok, l = pcall(ss.attackers.list) if ok and type(l) == "table" then return l end end return {} end
-- Bashing, for the mobs box: nil unless BS is hunting. Otherwise -- { area, mobs = {{id, name, hp, target, wanted, shield}}, kills, xp, gold, -- since, level, level_pct, gold_now } function D.bash() if not (bs and bs.active) then return nil end local r = { area = bs.area and bs.area() or nil, mobs = {} } for _, id in ipairs(bs.order or {}) do local it = bs.room and bs.room[id] if it and (not bs.is_mob or bs.is_mob(it)) then r.mobs[#r.mobs + 1] = { id = id, name = it.name, target = bs.target == id, hp = bs.target == id and bs.target_hp or nil, wanted = bs.priority and bs.priority(it.name) ~= nil and not (bs.skip or {})[id], shield = (bs.shields or {})[id] == true, } end end local st = bs.stats or {} r.kills, r.xp, r.gold, r.since = st.kills or 0, st.xp or 0, st.gold or 0, st.since local cs = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Status or {} r.level = tonumber(tostring(cs.level or ""):match("^(%d+)")) r.level_pct = tonumber(tostring(cs.xp or cs.level or ""):match("([%d%.]+)%%")) r.gold_now = (IN and IN.gold) or G.num(cs.gold) return r end

Script.name: render
Script.script: -- GUI render: turn gui.data into lines for each box. Kept apart from the -- Geyser code so it can be tested without Mudlet. -- -- A box renders to a list of lines. A line is a cecho string, or a list of -- segments where a segment is a cecho string or { text, cmd, hint } for a -- clickable piece. gui.render = gui.render or {} local R = gui.render local D = gui.data function R.join(list, color, sep) if #list == 0 then return "none" end return "<" .. color .. ">" .. table.concat(list, "" .. (sep or ", ") .. "<" .. color .. ">") end function R.title(s) return "" .. s end -- Balance strip under the gauges: bal/eq plus the curing balances. function R.balance_html(v, bals) local function dot(name, ok) return ('%s'):format(ok and "#5fd35f" or "#d35f5f", name) end local parts = { dot("bal", v.bal), dot("eq", v.eq) } for _, b in ipairs(bals) do parts[#parts + 1] = dot(b.name, b.ready) end local extra = {} local bleed = tonumber(v.stats.bleed) if bleed and bleed > 0 then extra[#extra + 1] = ('bleed %d'):format(bleed) end for k, val in pairs(v.stats) do if k ~= "bleed" then extra[#extra + 1] = ('%s %s'):format(k, val) end end table.sort(extra) local s = table.concat(parts, " ") if #extra > 0 then s = s .. "  " .. table.concat(extra, " ") end return s end function R.self() local L = {} local affs = D.affs() L[#L + 1] = R.title("Afflictions") .. (#affs > 0 and (" (" .. #affs .. ")") or "") L[#L + 1] = " " .. R.join(affs, "orange_red") local d = D.defs() if d.missing then L[#L + 1] = R.title("Missing defences") L[#L + 1] = " " .. (#d.missing > 0 and R.join(d.missing, "yellow") or "all up") end L[#L + 1] = R.title("Defences") .. " (" .. #d.up .. ")" L[#L + 1] = " " .. R.join(d.up, "dark_sea_green") return L end R.lock_color = { soft = "yellow", hard = "orange", ["true"] = "red" } -- Limb damage colour: 100% and over is a break. function R.limb_color(pct) if pct >= 100 then return "red" elseif pct >= 66 then return "orange" elseif pct >= 33 then return "yellow" end return "grey" end function R.target() local t = D.target() if not t then return R.with_attackers({ "no target" }) end local L = {} local head = "<" .. (t.color or "white") .. ">" .. t.name local info = {} if t.city and t.city ~= "none" then info[#info + 1] = t.city end if t.class then info[#info + 1] = t.class end if #info > 0 then head = head .. " " .. table.concat(info, " ") end if t.relation == "enemy" then head = head .. " [E]" elseif t.relation == "ally" then head = head .. " [A]" end if t.hp then head = head .. (" <%s>%d%%"):format(t.hp > 60 and "green" or t.hp > 30 and "yellow" or "red", t.hp) end if not t.here then head = head .. " (not here)" end L[#L + 1] = head if t.plain then L[#L + 1] = "load AR for afflictions and locks" return R.with_attackers(L) end if t.lock then local s = ("<%s>%s lock"):format(R.lock_color[t.lock] or "red", t.lock) if t.outs then s = s .. " outs: " .. table.concat(t.outs, ", ") end L[#L + 1] = s end -- on and sure: plain; on but not sure: with its chance; maybe: grey with chance local a = {} for _, c in ipairs(t.chances) do local pct = math.floor(c.pct + 0.5) if c.on and pct >= 100 then a[#a + 1] = "" .. c.aff elseif c.on then a[#a + 1] = ("%s %d%%"):format(c.aff, pct) else a[#a + 1] = ("%s %d%%"):format(c.aff, pct) end end L[#L + 1] = R.title("Affs") .. " (" .. #t.affs .. ")" L[#L + 1] = " " .. (#a > 0 and table.concat(a, ", ") or "none") if #t.limbs > 0 or t.parrying then local l = {} for _, x in ipairs(t.limbs) do l[#l + 1] = ("<%s>%s %d%%"):format(R.limb_color(x.pct), x.limb, math.floor(x.pct + 0.5)) end local s = R.title("Limbs ") .. table.concat(l, " ") if t.parrying then s = s .. " parrying " .. t.parrying end L[#L + 1] = s end if #t.defs > 0 then L[#L + 1] = R.title("Defs ") .. R.join(t.defs, "cyan") end if #t.bals > 0 then local b = {} for _, x in ipairs(t.bals) do if x.can == false and x.left == 0 then b[#b + 1] = "" .. x.name .. " blocked" elseif x.left > 0 then b[#b + 1] = ("%s %.1f"):format(x.name, x.left) else b[#b + 1] = "" .. x.name end end L[#L + 1] = table.concat(b, " ") end return R.with_attackers(L) end function R.room() local r = D.room() local L = {} L[#L + 1] = ("%s %s"):format(r.name or "?", r.num and ("#" .. r.num) or "") if #r.exits > 0 then L[#L + 1] = "" .. table.concat(r.exits, " ") end if r.walk then L[#L + 1] = { ("walking to %s, %d step%s "):format(tostring(r.walk.dest or "?"), r.walk.steps_left, r.walk.steps_left == 1 and "" or "s"), { text = "[stop]", cmd = "mstop", hint = "stop walking" } } end -- enemies first, then allies, then everyone else local order = { enemy = 1, ally = 2, neutral = 3 } local people = {} for _, n in ipairs(r.players) do people[#people + 1] = D.person(n) end table.sort(people, function(a, b) local oa, ob = order[a.relation] or 3, order[b.relation] or 3 if oa ~= ob then return oa < ob end return a.name < b.name end) L[#L + 1] = R.title("Players") .. " (" .. #people .. ")" if #people == 0 then L[#L + 1] = " nobody" end for _, p in ipairs(people) do local info = {} if p.city and p.city ~= "none" then info[#info + 1] = p.city end if p.class then info[#info + 1] = p.class end local seg = { " " } local text = "<" .. p.color .. ">" .. p.name if gui.settings.click_target then seg[#seg + 1] = { text = text, cmd = "t " .. p.name, hint = "target " .. p.name } else seg[#seg + 1] = text end local tail = #info > 0 and (" " .. table.concat(info, " ")) or "" if p.relation == "enemy" then tail = tail .. " [E]" elseif p.relation == "ally" then tail = tail .. " [A]" end seg[#seg + 1] = tail L[#L + 1] = seg end -- while bashing the mobs box lists them if #r.mobs > 0 and not gui.ui.mobs_shown() then local m = {} for _, g in ipairs(r.mobs) do m[#m + 1] = g.name .. (g.n > 1 and (" x" .. g.n) or "") end L[#L + 1] = R.title("Denizens ") .. R.join(m, "orange") end return L end -- Who's hitting you (SS), under the enemy status. function R.attackers() local list = D.attackers() if #list == 0 then return {} end local L = { R.title("Attackers") } local now = acs.now() for _, a in ipairs(list) do local p = D.person(a.name) local s = (" <%s>%s %s %dx %ds"):format(p.color, a.name, a.class or p.class or "?", a.hits or 0, math.floor(now - (a.last or now))) if type(a.affs) == "table" and next(a.affs) then local affs = a.affs[1] and a.affs or acs.sorted_keys(a.affs) s = s .. " " .. table.concat(affs, " ") end L[#L + 1] = s end return L end function R.with_attackers(L) for _, l in ipairs(R.attackers()) do L[#L + 1] = l end return L end -- Mobs box: only drawn while bashing (the layout hides it otherwise). function R.mobs() local b = D.bash() if not b then return { "not bashing" } end local L = { ("Bashing %s"):format(b.area or "") } if #b.mobs == 0 then L[#L + 1] = " no mobs here" end for _, m in ipairs(b.mobs) do local s if m.target then s = "> " .. m.name .. (m.hp and (" " .. m.hp .. "%") or "") elseif m.wanted then s = " " .. m.name else s = " " .. m.name end if m.shield then s = s .. " [shield]" end L[#L + 1] = s end L[#L + 1] = "" local mins = b.since and math.floor((acs.now() - b.since) / 60) or nil L[#L + 1] = ("%d kills +%.2f%% xp +%d gold%s"):format( b.kills, b.xp, b.gold, mins and (" " .. mins .. "m") or "") local now = {} if b.level then now[#now + 1] = ("level %d%s"):format(b.level, b.level_pct and (" " .. b.level_pct .. "%") or "") end if b.gold_now then now[#now + 1] = "gold " .. b.gold_now end if #now > 0 then L[#L + 1] = table.concat(now, " ") end return L end -- Plain text of a rendered line (for tests and debugging). function R.plain(line) if type(line) == "table" then local r = {} for _, seg in ipairs(line) do r[#r + 1] = type(seg) == "table" and seg.text or seg end line = table.concat(r) end return (line:gsub("<[%w_]+>", "")) end

Script.name: layout
Script.script:
-- GUI layout: the Geyser panel. One container down one side of the main -- window (main text is pushed aside with setBorderRight/Left): the map on -- top, then a 2x2 grid of MiniConsoles. The self box has the four gauges -- and the balance strip across its top. -- -- Everything is created once and then moved and resized in pixels by -- gui.ui.apply(), which runs again when the window is resized or a layout -- setting changes. Boxes are only rewritten when their text changed. -- Geyser reuses elements by name across all packages, hence acs_gui_*. gui.ui = gui.ui or {} local U = gui.ui local R = gui.render U.gauges = { "hp", "mp", "ep", "wp" } U.FRAME = 2 -- border width in pixels around each box U.labels = { hp = "HP", mp = "MP", ep = "EP", wp = "WP" } U.last = U.last or {} function U.css_box() local c = gui.settings.colors return ("background-color: %s; border: 1px solid %s;"):format(c.bg, c.border) end function U.window_size() if getMainWindowSize then local w, h = getMainWindowSize() if w and w > 0 then return w, h end end return 1200, 800 end function U.create() if U.root or not Geyser then return U.root ~= nil end local c = gui.settings.colors U.root = Geyser.Container:new({ name = "acs_gui_root", x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10 }) U.bg = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "acs_gui_bg", x = 0, y = 0, width = "100%", height = "100%" }, U.root) U.bg:setStyleSheet("background-color: " .. c.bg .. ";") -- a bordered frame behind each box, made first so the boxes sit on top U.frame = {} for _, name in ipairs(gui.box_names) do U.frame[name] = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "acs_gui_frame_" .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10 }, U.root) end U.style_frames() U.g = {} for _, k in ipairs(U.gauges) do local g = Geyser.Gauge:new({ name = "acs_gui_gauge_" .. k, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10 }, U.root) -- through the Gauge method, which strips margins from the front label g:setStyleSheet(("background-color: %s; border-radius: 3px;"):format(c[k]), ("background-color: #222228; border: 1px solid %s; border-radius: 3px;"):format(c.border), "") U.g[k] = g end U.bal = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "acs_gui_bal", x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10 }, U.root) U.bal:setStyleSheet("background-color: " .. c.bg .. "; font-family: monospace;") U.box = {} for _, name in ipairs(gui.box_names) do if name ~= "map" then -- the map is made in U.map_box, only when it's on local b = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "acs_gui_" .. name, x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10, fontSize = gui.settings.font, color = c.bg, autoWrap = true, scrollBar = false, }, U.root) if gui.settings.font_name ~= "" and b.setFont then b:setFont(gui.settings.font_name) end U.box[name] = b end end return true end function U.style_frames() local c = gui.settings.colors local css = ("background-color: %s; border: %dpx solid %s; border-radius: 4px;"):format( c.bg, U.FRAME, c.frame or c.border) for _, f in pairs(U.frame or {}) do f:setStyleSheet(css) end end -- The mobs box only shows while bashing. function U.mobs_shown() return gui.settings.boxes.mobs.on and bs ~= nil and bs.active == true end function U.visible(name) local b = gui.settings.boxes[name] if not (b and b.on) then return false end if name == "mobs" then return U.mobs_shown() end return true end -- Pixel geometry for the current settings and window: returns -- { x, w, h, gauges = {k = {x,y,w,h}}, bal = {...} or nil, boxes = {name = {x,y,w,h}} }. -- frames = {name = rect}: the bordered cell; boxes sit inside it. -- Boxes that aren't shown are left out; the box beside them takes the row, -- and a row with nothing in it gives its height to the other. function U.geometry(W, H) local s = gui.settings local pw = math.floor(W * math.max(10, math.min(60, s.width)) / 100) local g = { x = s.side == "left" and 0 or W - pw, w = pw, h = H, gauges = {}, boxes = {}, frames = {} } local pad, gap = 4, 4 local inner = pw - pad * 2 local y = pad local rows = {} for _, row in ipairs(gui.grid) do local r = {} for _, name in ipairs(row) do if U.visible(name) then r[#r + 1] = name end end if #r > 0 then rows[#rows + 1] = r end end if U.visible("map") then local mh = #rows > 0 and math.floor((H - pad * 2) * math.max(10, math.min(90, s.map_height)) / 100) or (H - pad * 2) g.boxes.map = { x = pad, y = y, w = inner, h = mh } y = y + mh + gap end local rh = #rows > 0 and math.floor((H - pad - y - gap * (#rows - 1)) / #rows) or 0 for i, r in ipairs(rows) do local h = i == #rows and (H - pad - y) or rh local cw = math.floor((inner - gap * (#r - 1)) / #r) for j, name in ipairs(r) do local w = j == #r and (inner - (cw + gap) * (#r - 1)) or cw g.boxes[name] = { x = pad + (j - 1) * (cw + gap), y = y, w = w, h = h } end y = y + h + gap end -- inside each frame: its border plus a little room local inset = U.FRAME + 2 for name, r in pairs(g.boxes) do g.frames[name] = r g.boxes[name] = { x = r.x + inset, y = r.y + inset, w = r.w - inset * 2, h = r.h - inset * 2 } end -- self: gauges stacked across its top, then the balance strip, then text local sb = g.boxes.self if sb then local gh, by = 16, sb.y for _, k in ipairs(U.gauges) do g.gauges[k] = { x = sb.x, y = by, w = sb.w, h = gh } by = by + gh + 2 end g.bal = { x = sb.x, y = by, w = sb.w, h = 32 } by = by + 32 + 2 g.boxes.self = { x = sb.x, y = by, w = sb.w, h = math.max(10, sb.y + sb.h - by) } end return g end -- The mapper's map in the panel. Mudlet has one map widget, so making -- this moves the map into the panel; it's only made once the map box is -- on, so "gui box map off" from the start leaves your own map window alone. function U.map_box() if not U.box.map and Geyser.Mapper then U.box.map = Geyser.Mapper:new({ name = "acs_gui_map", x = 0, y = 0, width = 10, height = 10 }, U.root) end return U.box.map end function U.place(el, r) el:move(r.x, r.y) el:resize(r.w, r.h) end function U.apply() if not gui.settings.on then return U.hide() end if not U.create() then return end local W, H = U.window_size() local g = U.geometry(W, H) U.root:move(g.x, 0) U.root:resize(g.w, g.h) U.root:show() if setBorderRight then setBorderRight(gui.settings.side == "right" and g.w or 0) setBorderLeft(gui.settings.side == "left" and g.w or 0) end for _, k in ipairs(U.gauges) do if g.gauges[k] then U.place(U.g[k], g.gauges[k]) U.g[k]:show() else U.g[k]:hide() end end if g.bal then U.place(U.bal, g.bal) U.bal:show() else U.bal:hide() end if g.boxes.map then U.map_box() end U.style_frames() for name, f in pairs(U.frame) do if g.frames[name] then U.place(f, g.frames[name]) f:show() else f:hide() end end for name, b in pairs(U.box) do if g.boxes[name] then U.place(b, g.boxes[name]) b:show() else b:hide() end if b.setFontSize then b:setFontSize(gui.settings.font) end end U.last = {} U.draw_all() end function U.hide() if U.root then U.root:hide() end if setBorderRight then setBorderRight(0) setBorderLeft(0) end end --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Drawing function U.sig(lines) local r = {} for i, l in ipairs(lines) do if type(l) == "table" then local p = {} for _, seg in ipairs(l) do p[#p + 1] = type(seg) == "table" and (seg.text .. "@" .. seg.cmd) or seg end r[i] = table.concat(p) else r[i] = l end end return table.concat(r, "\n") end function U.write(box, lines) box:clear() for i, l in ipairs(lines) do local nl = i < #lines and "\n" or "" if type(l) == "table" then for _, seg in ipairs(l) do if type(seg) == "table" and cechoLink then local cmd = seg.cmd cechoLink(box.name, seg.text, function() expandAlias(cmd) end, seg.hint or cmd, true) else box:cecho(type(seg) == "table" and seg.text or seg) end end if nl ~= "" then box:cecho(nl) end else box:cecho(l .. nl) end end end -- Redraw one box if its text changed. Returns true if it was rewritten. function U.draw(name) if name == "map" then return false end -- the mapper draws itself local box = U.box and U.box[name] if not box or not U.visible(name) then return false end local ok, lines = pcall(R[name]) if not ok then lines = { "" .. tostring(lines) } end local s = U.sig(lines) if U.last[name] == s then return false end U.last[name] = s U.write(box, lines) return true end function U.fmt(n) if n >= 10000 then return ("%.1fk"):format(n / 1000) end return tostring(n) end function U.draw_vitals() if not U.g or not U.visible("self") then return end local v = gui.data.vitals() for _, k in ipairs(U.gauges) do local x = v[k] local text = ('
%s %s/%s
'):format(U.labels[k], U.fmt(x.cur), U.fmt(x.max)) local s = k .. x.cur .. "/" .. x.max if U.last["g" .. k] ~= s then U.last["g" .. k] = s U.g[k]:setValue(math.max(0, x.cur), math.max(1, x.max), text) end end local html = R.balance_html(v, gui.data.balances()) if U.last.bal ~= html then U.last.bal = html U.bal:echo(html) end end function U.draw_all() if not (U.root and gui.settings.on) then return end U.draw_vitals() for _, name in ipairs(gui.box_names) do U.draw(name) end end

Script.name: commands
Script.script:
-- GUI commands: "gui ..." (help lists them).
local M = gui.M gui.S = function() return gui.settings end
function gui.onoff(v, cur) if v == "on" then return true elseif v == "off" then return false end return not cur end
function gui.changed() gui.save() gui.ui.apply() end
M.command("on", function() gui.S().on = true gui.changed() gui.echo("panel on") end, "on / off show or hide the panel") M.command("off", function() gui.S().on = false gui.changed() gui.echo("panel off") end)
M.command("side", function(w) local v = (w[1] or ""):lower() if v ~= "left" and v ~= "right" then return gui.err("gui side left|right") end gui.S().side = v gui.changed() end, "side left|right which side of the window")
M.command("width", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("width " .. gui.S().width .. "%") end gui.S().width = math.max(10, math.min(60, n)) gui.changed() end, "width [percent] panel width, 10-60 (default 35)")
M.command("font", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("font size " .. gui.S().font) end gui.S().font = math.max(6, math.min(20, n)) gui.changed() end, "font [size] text size in the boxes")
M.command("box", function(w) local name = (w[1] or ""):lower() local b = gui.S().boxes[name] if not b then gui.echo("boxes: map on top; self | target, room | mobs below") for _, n in ipairs(gui.box_names) do local x = gui.S().boxes[n] local note = n == "mobs" and " <dim_grey>(shows while bashing)" or "" cecho(("\n %-8s %s%s"):format(n, x.on and "<green>on" or "<red>off", note)) end return end b.on = gui.onoff(w[2], b.on) gui.changed() gui.echo(name .. " " .. (b.on and "on" or "off")) end, "box [name on|off] list boxes, or turn one on/off (its neighbour takes the space)")
M.command("map", function(w) local n = tonumber(w[1]) if not n then return gui.echo("map takes " .. gui.S().map_height .. "% of the height") end gui.S().map_height = math.max(10, math.min(90, n)) gui.changed() end, "map [percent] map's share of the panel height (default 50)")
M.command("border", function(w) local c = w[1] if not c then return gui.echo("border colour " .. gui.S().colors.frame) end if not c:match("^#%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return gui.err("gui border #rrggbb") end gui.S().colors.frame = c gui.changed() end, "border [#rrggbb] colour of the lines around each box")
M.command("click", function(w) gui.S().click_target = gui.onoff(w[1], gui.S().click_target) gui.changed() gui.echo("click a player to target: " .. (gui.S().click_target and "on" or "off")) end, "click on|off clicking a player runs 't <name>'")
M.command("redraw", function() gui.ui.apply() end, "redraw rebuild the layout and redraw everything")
M.command("reset", function() for k in pairs(gui.S()) do gui.S()[k] = nil end acs.merge_defaults(gui.S(), gui.default_settings) gui.S().layout = gui.LAYOUT gui.changed() gui.echo("settings reset") end, "reset back to default layout and settings")
M.command("status", function() local s = gui.S() gui.echo(("%s, %s side, %d%% wide, font %d"):format(s.on and "on" or "off", s.side, s.width, s.font)) local src = {} for _, p in ipairs({ { "ss", ss }, { "ar", ar }, { "pt", pt }, { "rm", rm }, { "bs", bs }, { "hb", hb } }) do src[#src + 1] = (p[2] and "<green>" or "<dim_grey>") .. p[1] end cecho("\n sources: " .. table.concat(src, " ") .. "<reset> <dim_grey>(grey = not loaded, GMCP used instead)") end, "status settings and which packages it is reading from")

Script.name: startup
Script.script:
-- GUI wiring. With the heartbeat package (hb) the boxes redraw on the beat -- when something they show has changed; without it a short timer does it. -- Reloading is safe: acs.module removes the old handlers, and registering -- the same hb names replaces them.
local M = gui.M local U = gui.ui local G = gui.g
-- Which box (or boxes) each change key redraws. gui.keys = { vitals = "vitals", ["gui.bals"] = "vitals", affs = "self", defs = "self", ["gui.self"] = "self", ["gui.target"] = { "target", "mobs" }, room = "room", players = "room", items = { "room", "mobs" }, ["gui.room"] = "room", ["gui.mobs"] = "mobs", } function gui.boxes_for(key) local b = gui.keys[key] return type(b) == "table" and b or { b } end
-- Events from the other packages (and GMCP the others don't cover) -> key. gui.event_keys = { { "ss.aff.gained", "gui.self" }, { "ss.aff.lost", "gui.self" }, { "ss.def.up", "gui.self" }, { "ss.def.down", "gui.self" }, { "ss.balance", "gui.bals" }, { "ss.attacker.hit", "gui.target" }, { "ss.attacker.expired", "gui.target" }, { "ss.attackers.changed", "gui.target" }, { "ar.target", "gui.target" }, { "ar.enemy.aff", "gui.target" }, { "ar.enemy.def", "gui.target" }, { "ar.enemy.lock", "gui.target" }, { "ar.enemy.reset", "gui.target" }, { "ar.enemy.limb", "gui.target" }, { "ar.class.seen", "gui.target" }, { "gmcp.IRE.Target.Set", "gui.target" }, { "gmcp.IRE.Target.Info", "gui.target" }, { "pt.room.changed", "gui.room" }, { "pt.person.updated", "gui.room" }, { "pt.list.changed", "gui.room" }, { "rm.players.changed", "gui.room" }, { "rm.items.changed", "gui.room" }, { "rm.moved", "gui.room" }, { "rm.walk.start", "gui.room" }, { "rm.walk.arrived", "gui.room" }, { "rm.walk.stop", "gui.room" }, { "mmapper arrived", "gui.room" }, { "mmapper failed path", "gui.room" }, { "mmapper stopped", "gui.room" }, { "bs.target", "gui.mobs" }, { "bs.killed", "gui.mobs" }, { "bs.clear", "gui.mobs" }, { "gmcp.Char.Status", "gui.mobs" }, }
function gui.draw_key_box(box) if box == "vitals" then U.draw_vitals() else U.draw(box) end end
function gui.hb_register() if not (hb and hb.register) then return end local by_box = {} for key in pairs(gui.keys) do for _, box in ipairs(gui.boxes_for(key)) do by_box[box] = by_box[box] or {} table.insert(by_box[box], key) end end for box, keys in pairs(by_box) do table.sort(keys) hb.register("gui." .. box, function() if U.root and gui.settings.on then gui.draw_key_box(box) end end, { owner = "gui", priority = 85, watch = keys, urgent = box == "vitals" }) end -- seconds counters (attacker age, target cure balances, time bashing) tick on their own hb.register("gui.tick", function() if U.root and gui.settings.on then U.draw("target") U.draw("mobs") end end, { owner = "gui", priority = 86, every = 1 }) for _, ek in ipairs(gui.event_keys) do hb.watch(ek[1], ek[2]) end end
-- Without hb: coalesce changes for 0.1 s, plus a 1 s tick. gui._dirty = {} gui.pending = false function gui.flush() gui.pending = false local d = gui._dirty gui._dirty = {} for box in pairs(d) do gui.draw_key_box(box) end end function gui.mark(key) if hb and hb.mark then return hb.mark(key) end if not gui.keys[key] or not U.root then return end for _, box in ipairs(gui.boxes_for(key)) do gui._dirty[box] = true end if not gui.pending then gui.pending = true M.timer(0.1, gui.flush) end end
function gui._tick() if not (hb and hb.register) then U.draw("target") U.draw("mobs") end M.timer(1, gui._tick) end
gui.resize_pending = false function gui.on_resize() if gui.resize_pending then return end gui.resize_pending = true M.timer(0.3, function() gui.resize_pending = false U.apply() end) end
function gui.init() gui.migrate() acs.gmcp_support({ "Char 1", "Char.Afflictions 1", "Char.Defences 1", "Room 1", "IRE.Target 1" }) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.List", G.on_affs_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Add", G.on_affs_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Afflictions.Remove", G.on_affs_remove) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.List", G.on_defs_list) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.Add", G.on_defs_add) M.on("gmcp.Char.Defences.Remove", G.on_defs_remove) -- without hb, follow the same keys by event local std = { { "gmcp.Char.Vitals", "vitals" }, { "gmcp.Room.Info", "room" }, { "gmcp.Room.Players", "players" }, { "gmcp.Room.AddPlayer", "players" }, { "gmcp.Room.RemovePlayer", "players" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.List", "items" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.Add", "items" }, { "gmcp.Char.Items.Remove", "items" } } for _, m in ipairs({ "List", "Add", "Remove" }) do std[#std + 1] = { "gmcp.Char.Afflictions." .. m, "affs" } std[#std + 1] = { "gmcp.Char.Defences." .. m, "defs" } end for _, l in ipairs({ std, gui.event_keys }) do for _, ek in ipairs(l) do local key = ek[2] M.on(ek[1], function() if not (hb and hb.register) then gui.mark(key) end end) end end M.on("hb.ready", gui.hb_register) M.on("sysWindowResizeEvent", gui.on_resize) M.on("acs.char.loaded", function() gui.migrate() U.apply() end) -- the mobs box comes and goes with bashing M.on("bs.started", function() U.apply() end) M.on("bs.stopped", function() U.apply() end) -- uninstalling must give the main window its width back M.on("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg ~= "GUI" then return end U.hide() if hb and hb.unregister_owner then hb.unregister_owner("gui") end M.cleanup() end) gui.hb_register() gui._tick() U.apply() gui.echo(("loaded v%s. Type <white>gui help<reset>."):format(gui.version)) end
gui.init()

Script.name: help
Script.script:
-- SHELP: in-game help for every ACS package. Type "shelp" in game. -- -- The help text lives in shelp.data (src/10_data.lua), generated from the -- packages' own source by tools/gen_help.py: their "<prefix> help" lines, -- extra aliases, public functions with the comment above each, events, and -- READMEs. Commands a loaded package registers that the data doesn't know -- yet are picked up live from acs._modules, so a newer package still shows -- its new commands before SHELP is rebuilt. -- -- shelp index of packages -- shelp <pkg> what it does and its commands (ss, ar, bs, ...) -- shelp <pkg> <command> one command, with what its README says about it -- shelp <pkg> functions [x] public Lua functions (filter by text) -- shelp <pkg> events|aliases|guide -- shelp <function> e.g. shelp ss.server.sync, shelp IN.count -- shelp search <text> search everything -- shelp <word> finds a command, alias or function by that name
shelp = shelp or {} shelp.version = "0.1.0" shelp.data = shelp.data or {}
-- Other names people may type for a package. shelp.names = { curing = "ss", offense = "ar", offence = "ar", bashing = "bs", hunting = "bs", inventory = "in", inv = "in", room = "rm", rooms = "rm", map = "rm", follow = "af", autofollow = "af", people = "pt", tracker = "pt", heartbeat = "hb", panel = "gui", core = "acs", legacy = "system", old = "system", }
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Output
function shelp.out(s) cecho("\n" .. s) end
-- cecho reads anything in <angle brackets> as a colour, so placeholders -- like <aff> in help text are shown as ‹aff› instead. function shelp.esc(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("<", "‹"):gsub(">", "›")) end local E = shelp.esc
function shelp.head(s) shelp.out("<cyan>" .. s .. "<reset>") end
function shelp.err(s) cecho("\n<dim_grey>[<cyan>shelp<dim_grey>]<reset> <red>" .. s) end
-- A clickable "shelp <topic>" when Mudlet can make links, plain text otherwise. function shelp.link(text, topic, pad) local fill = pad and string.rep(" ", math.max(1, pad - #text)) or "" if cechoLink then cechoLink("<white>" .. text, ([[expandAlias("shelp %s")]]):format(topic), "shelp " .. topic, true) if fill ~= "" then cecho(fill) end else cecho("<white>" .. text .. "<reset>" .. fill) end end
-- Light Markdown: `code` and **bold** in white, headings in cyan, tables as -- "cell : cell", code fences dropped. function shelp.md(line) local s = E(line) if s:match("^%s*```") then return nil end if s:match("^%s*|[%s:%-|]+|%s*$") then return nil end if s:match("^%s*|") then local cells = {} for c in s:gsub("\\|", "\1"):gmatch("[^|]+") do c = c:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""):gsub("\1", "|") if c ~= "" then cells[#cells + 1] = c end end s = " " .. table.concat(cells, " : ") end local h, rest = s:match("^(#+)%s*(.*)$") if h then return "<cyan>" .. rest .. "<reset>" end s = s:gsub("%*%*(.-)%*%*", "<white>%1<reset>") s = s:gsub("`([^`]+)`", "<white>%1<reset>") return s end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Lookup
function shelp.pkg(name) if not name then return nil end name = shelp.names[name:lower()] or name:lower() for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do if p.key == name or p.prefix == name or p.dir == name then return p end end end
function shelp.installed(p) if not acs then return false end if p.key == "acs" then return acs._core_version ~= nil end if p.key == "system" then return acs.commands ~= nil and acs.version ~= nil end return acs._modules ~= nil and acs._modules[p.module] ~= nil end
-- Pick up commands a loaded package has that the generated data lacks. function shelp.merge_live() if not (acs and acs._modules) then return end for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do local M = p.module and acs._modules[p.module] if M and M.commands then for word, c in pairs(M.commands) do if not p.commands[word] then local h = c.help if type(h) == "string" then h = { h } end p.commands[word] = { help = h or {}, readme = {}, live = true } end end end end end
-- Every function across the packages whose name matches (exact first, -- then case-insensitive, then by its last part). function shelp.find_functions(name, only) local exact, loose, last = {}, {}, {} local lname = name:lower():gsub(":", ".") for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do if not only or only == p then for _, f in ipairs(p.functions) do local fl = f.name:lower() if f.name == name then exact[#exact + 1] = { p, f } elseif fl == lname then loose[#loose + 1] = { p, f } elseif fl:match("%.([^%.]+)$") == lname or fl:sub(-#lname - 1) == "." .. lname then last[#last + 1] = { p, f } end end end end if #exact > 0 then return exact end if #loose > 0 then return loose end return last end
function shelp.sorted_keys(t) local r = {} for k in pairs(t or {}) do r[#r + 1] = k end table.sort(r) return r end
function shelp.first_word(s) return (s:match("^(%S+)") or ""):lower() end
function shelp.help_lines(c) return type(c.help) == "string" and { c.help } or (c.help or {}) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Topics
function shelp.index() shelp.head("SHELP: help for the ACS packages") for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do shelp.out(" ") shelp.link(p.key, p.key, 8) local n = #shelp.sorted_keys(p.commands) cecho(("%s%s <dim_grey>(%d commands)%s"):format(p.title, p.legacy and " <dim_grey>[legacy]<reset>" or "", n, shelp.installed(p) and " <green>loaded" or "")) end shelp.out("") shelp.out("<grey>shelp ‹pkg› what a package does and its commands") shelp.out("<grey>shelp ‹pkg› ‹command› one command in detail, e.g. <white>shelp ss prio") shelp.out("<grey>shelp ‹pkg› functions its Lua functions; also <white>events<grey>, <white>aliases<grey>, <white>guide<grey> (full README)") shelp.out("<grey>shelp ‹function› e.g. <white>shelp ss.server.sync") shelp.out("<grey>shelp search ‹text› search everything") end
function shelp.show_pkg(p) shelp.head(p.title .. (shelp.installed(p) and " <green>loaded" or " <dim_grey>not loaded")) if p.legacy then shelp.out("<yellow>Legacy package: kept for reference, use SS and AR instead.") end if p.blurb ~= "" then shelp.out(shelp.md(p.blurb)) end shelp.out("") shelp.out("<white>Commands<reset> (click one, or <white>shelp " .. p.key .. " ‹command›<reset>):") local any = false for _, word in ipairs(shelp.sorted_keys(p.commands)) do local c = p.commands[word] local lines = shelp.help_lines(c) if #lines > 0 then for i, l in ipairs(lines) do shelp.out(" ") if i == 1 then shelp.link(p.prefix .. " " .. word, p.key .. " " .. word) cecho("<grey>" .. E(l:sub(#word + 1))) else cecho("<grey>" .. p.prefix .. " " .. E(l)) end end any = true elseif not c.see then shelp.out(" ") shelp.link(p.prefix .. " " .. word, p.key .. " " .. word) cecho(" <dim_grey>(no description)") any = true end end if not any then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>none") end if #p.aliases > 0 then shelp.out("<white>Other aliases:") for _, a in ipairs(p.aliases) do shelp.out((" <white>%-22s<grey>%s"):format(E(a.usage), E(a.help))) end end shelp.out("") shelp.out("<grey>More: ") for _, t in ipairs({ "functions", "events", "guide" }) do shelp.link("shelp " .. p.key .. " " .. t, p.key .. " " .. t) cecho(" ") end end
function shelp.show_command(p, word) local c = p.commands[word] if c.see and #shelp.help_lines(c) == 0 then shelp.out(("<grey>%s %s is part of %s %s:"):format(p.prefix, word, p.prefix, c.see)) word, c = c.see, p.commands[c.see] end shelp.head(p.prefix .. " " .. word .. " <dim_grey>(" .. p.title .. ")") local lines = shelp.help_lines(c) if #lines == 0 then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>no description in the source") end for _, l in ipairs(lines) do shelp.out(" <white>" .. p.prefix .. " " .. E(l)) end for w2, c2 in pairs(p.commands) do if c2.see == word then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>also: " .. p.prefix .. " " .. w2) end end if c.readme and #c.readme > 0 then shelp.out("") shelp.out("<white>From the guide:") for _, r in ipairs(c.readme) do shelp.out(" " .. shelp.md(r)) end end if c.live then shelp.out("<dim_grey>(found in the loaded package, newer than this help)") end end
function shelp.show_function(p, f) shelp.head(E(f.sig) .. " <dim_grey>(" .. p.key .. (f.file and (", " .. p.dir .. "/" .. f.file) or "") .. ")") if #f.doc == 0 then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>no comment in the source") end for _, l in ipairs(f.doc) do shelp.out(" " .. E(l)) end end
function shelp.list_functions(p, filter) filter = filter and filter:lower() shelp.head(p.title .. ": functions" .. (filter and (" matching '" .. filter .. "'") or "")) local n = 0 for _, f in ipairs(p.functions) do local blob = (f.name .. " " .. table.concat(f.doc, " ")):lower() if not filter or blob:find(filter, 1, true) then shelp.out(" ") shelp.link(f.sig, f.name) if f.doc[1] then cecho(" <grey>" .. E(f.doc[1])) end n = n + 1 end end if n == 0 then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>none") end end
function shelp.list_events(p) shelp.head(p.title .. ": events it raises") if #p.events == 0 then shelp.out(" <dim_grey>none") end for _, e in ipairs(p.events) do shelp.out(" <white>" .. E(e)) end shelp.out("<grey>Listen with registerAnonymousEventHandler(\"<event>\", fn).") end
function shelp.list_aliases(p) shelp.head(p.title .. ": aliases") shelp.out((" <white>%-22s<grey>%s"):format(p.prefix .. " ‹command›", "everything in shelp " .. p.key)) for _, a in ipairs(p.aliases) do shelp.out((" <white>%-22s<grey>%s"):format(E(a.usage), E(a.help))) end end
function shelp.guide(p) if #p.guide == 0 then shelp.out("<dim_grey>no README for " .. p.key) return end shelp.head(p.title) for _, l in ipairs(p.guide) do local s = shelp.md(l) if s then shelp.out(s) end end end
function shelp.search(text) local q = text:lower() local hits = {} local function add(kind, topic, label, why) hits[#hits + 1] = { kind = kind, topic = topic, label = label, why = why or "" } end for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do for word, c in pairs(p.commands) do local h = table.concat(shelp.help_lines(c), " ") if (word .. " " .. h):lower():find(q, 1, true) then add("command", p.key .. " " .. word, p.prefix .. " " .. word, shelp.help_lines(c)[1] and shelp.help_lines(c)[1]:sub(#word + 1)) end end for _, a in ipairs(p.aliases) do if (a.usage .. " " .. a.help):lower():find(q, 1, true) then add("alias", p.key .. " aliases", a.usage, a.help .. " (" .. p.key .. ")") end end for _, f in ipairs(p.functions) do if (f.name .. " " .. table.concat(f.doc, " ")):lower():find(q, 1, true) then add("function", f.name, f.name, f.doc[1]) end end for _, e in ipairs(p.events) do if e:lower():find(q, 1, true) then add("event", p.key .. " events", e, "event (" .. p.key .. ")") end end end table.sort(hits, function(a, b) if a.kind ~= b.kind then return a.kind < b.kind end return a.label < b.label end) shelp.head(("search '%s': %d found"):format(E(text), #hits)) for i, h in ipairs(hits) do if i > 60 then shelp.out(("<dim_grey>... and %d more; narrow the search"):format(#hits - 60)) break end shelp.out((" <dim_grey>%-8s "):format(h.kind)) shelp.link(h.label, h.topic) cecho(" <grey>" .. E((h.why:gsub("^%s+", "")))) end end
-- A bare word: a command in some package, an alias, a function, or a search. function shelp.word(w) local found = {} for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do if p.commands[w:lower()] and not p.legacy then found[#found + 1] = p end end if #found == 1 then return shelp.show_command(found[1], w:lower()) end if #found > 1 then shelp.head("'" .. w .. "' is a command in more than one package:") for _, p in ipairs(found) do shelp.out(" ") shelp.link(p.prefix .. " " .. w:lower(), p.key .. " " .. w:lower(), 20) cecho("<grey>" .. p.title) end return end for _, p in ipairs(shelp.data) do for _, a in ipairs(p.aliases) do if not p.legacy and shelp.first_word(a.usage) == w:lower() then shelp.head(E(a.usage) .. " <dim_grey>(" .. p.title .. ")") return shelp.out(" " .. E(a.help)) end end end local fns = shelp.find_functions(w) if #fns == 1 then return shelp.show_function(fns[1][1], fns[1][2]) end if #fns > 1 then shelp.head("functions named '" .. w .. "':") for _, pf in ipairs(fns) do shelp.out(" ") shelp.link(pf[2].sig, pf[2].name) end return end shelp.search(w) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Entry point: everything after "shelp".
function shelp.run(line) shelp.merge_live() line = (line or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "") if line == "" or line:lower() == "index" or line:lower() == "help" then return shelp.index() end local first, rest = line:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") local lf = first:lower() if lf == "search" or lf == "find" then if rest == "" then return shelp.err("search for what? e.g. shelp search tree") end return shelp.search(rest) end local p = shelp.pkg(first) if p and not first:find("[%.:]") then if rest == "" then return shelp.show_pkg(p) end local sub, arg = rest:match("^(%S+)%s*(.*)$") local ls = sub:lower() if p.commands[ls] then return shelp.show_command(p, ls) end if ls == "functions" or ls == "function" or ls == "api" then return shelp.list_functions(p, arg ~= "" and arg or nil) end if ls == "events" then return shelp.list_events(p) end if ls == "aliases" then return shelp.list_aliases(p) end if ls == "guide" or ls == "readme" then return shelp.guide(p) end for _, a in ipairs(p.aliases) do if shelp.first_word(a.usage) == ls then shelp.head(E(a.usage) .. " <dim_grey>(" .. p.title .. ")") return shelp.out(" " .. E(a.help)) end end local fns = shelp.find_functions(sub, p) if #fns == 1 then return shelp.show_function(p, fns[1][2]) end if #fns > 1 then return shelp.list_functions(p, sub) end shelp.err(("'%s' isn't a %s command; searching instead"):format(E(sub), p.prefix)) return shelp.search(rest) end if first:find("[%.:]") then local fns = shelp.find_functions(first) if #fns >= 1 then for _, pf in ipairs(fns) do shelp.show_function(pf[1], pf[2]) end return end end shelp.word(line) end

Script.name: help text
startup
Script.script:
-- SHELP startup: the "shelp" alias (any case: SHELP, Shelp). Safe to run -- again; the previous alias is removed first.
if shelp._alias then killAlias(shelp._alias) end shelp._alias = tempAlias([[^(?i)shelp(?:\s+(.*))?$]], function() local ok, err = pcall(shelp.run, matches[2] or "") if not ok then shelp.err(tostring(err)) end end) cecho(("\n<dim_grey>[<cyan>shelp<dim_grey>]<reset> SHELP v%s loaded, help for %d packages. Type <white>shelp<reset>."):format( shelp.version, #shelp.data))

Script.name: bundle finish
Script.script:
-- Achaea bundle: uninstalling "Achaea" runs each package's own uninstall -- cleanup, which looks for its old package name. -- Installed as a module (Module Manager) it's "sysUninstallModule", which is -- also what "acs update" (reloadModule) raises before loading the new file. for _, h in ipairs(achaea_bundle_uninstall or {}) do killAnonymousEventHandler(h) end achaea_bundle_uninstall = {} for _, ev in ipairs({ "sysUninstallPackage", "sysUninstallModule" }) do achaea_bundle_uninstall[#achaea_bundle_uninstall + 1] = registerAnonymousEventHandler(ev, function(_, pkg) if pkg ~= "Achaea" then return end for _, p in ipairs({ "GUI", "BS", "IN", "HB" }) do raiseEvent("sysUninstallPackage", p) end end) end
-- "acs update": reload the bundle from its module file, so a new version -- copied over that file takes effect without uninstalling anything. Saved -- settings live in their own files (acs_<char>_<pkg>.lua, pt_db.lua) and are -- saved first, so nothing is lost. function acs.is_module() if type(getModules) ~= "function" then return false end for _, m in ipairs(getModules() or {}) do if m == "Achaea" then return true end end return false end local function reload() for name in pairs(acs._stores or {}) do acs.save(name) end if rawget(_G, "pt") and pt.save_db then pcall(pt.save_db, true) end acs.echo("reloading Achaea...") tempTimer(0, function() reloadModule("Achaea") end) end
-- With an update address set ("acs update url <address>"), download the new -- Achaea.xml from it first, check it's a Mudlet package, put it over the -- module file and reload. Without one, just reload the file as it is. function acs.update(word, rest) if word == "url" then acs.core.update_url = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(https?://%S+)") or nil acs.save("core") acs.echo("update address: " .. (acs.core.update_url or "none (acs update just reloads the file)")) return end if not acs.is_module() or type(reloadModule) ~= "function" then acs.err("Achaea is installed as a package, so it can't reload itself. Install it once as a module: " .. "Toolbox > Module Manager > Install, pick Achaea.xml, leave Sync off. Then 'acs update' works.") return end local url = acs.core.update_url if word == "local" or not url then return reload() end local path = type(getModulePath) == "function" and getModulePath("Achaea") if not path or not path:lower():match("%.xml$") then acs.err("the module file isn't Achaea.xml (" .. tostring(path) .. "). Install Achaea.xml as the module to download updates.") return end local tmp = path .. ".download" local done, failed local function stop() killAnonymousEventHandler(done) killAnonymousEventHandler(failed) end done = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", function(_, file) if file ~= tmp then return end stop() local f = io.open(tmp, "r") local head = f and f:read(4096) or "" if f then f:close() end if not head:find("<MudletPackage", 1, true) then os.remove(tmp) acs.err("the download isn't a Mudlet package; nothing changed. Check 'acs update url'.") return end os.remove(path .. ".old") os.rename(path, path .. ".old") local ok, err = os.rename(tmp, path) if not ok then os.rename(path .. ".old", path) acs.err("couldn't replace the module file: " .. tostring(err)) return end os.remove(path .. ".old") acs.echo("downloaded the new Achaea.") reload() end) failed = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", function(_, err, file) if file and file ~= tmp then return end stop() acs.err("download failed: " .. tostring(err) .. ". Nothing changed.") end) acs.echo("downloading " .. url .. " ...") downloadFile(tmp, url) end if acs._modules and acs._modules.core then acs._modules.core.command("update", function(w, rest) local word = w[1] and w[1]:lower() acs.update(word, word == "url" and (rest or ""):gsub("^%S+%s*", "") or nil) end, { "update download the latest Achaea (when an address is set) and reload it", "update url <address> where 'acs update' downloads Achaea.xml from", "update local just reload the module file as it is" }) end if achaea_bundle_cecho then cecho, achaea_bundle_cecho = achaea_bundle_cecho, nil end cecho("\n<dim_grey>[<cyan>acs<dim_grey>]<reset> Achaea v0.5.0 loaded. Type <white>shelp<reset> for help.")
